All Pathway Abilities

Sequence abilities, from the first potion to the divine.

Fool Pathway

Sequence 9: Seer

Traits

  • Enhanced Memory: Initially, those who drink the Seer potion will gain a slight increase in memory that will continuously improve during potion digestion.
  • This Enhanced Memory grants a Seer the ability to memorise and learn the steps of various Ritualistic Magic and Divination Arts.
  • Spirituality: A Seer's Spirituality will get enhanced upon drinking this potion.
  • Spirit Vision: They can use Spirit Vision (opens in a new tab) to see non-physical things, such as ghosts and spectres. They could see the different parts of a Soul, deduce a person's health and emotions through it, and determine if something has a magical aura.
  • They can “see” obstructed objects and “hear” faint footsteps, allowing them to take pre-emptive judgement. However, their visual, auditory, and tactile senses do not have any enhancements.
  • Divination Arts & Ritualistic Magic: They can master all kinds of Divination methods, including astrology, spiritual numbers, and scrying as well as become more learned than a Mystery Pryer when it comes to Ritualistic Magic.
  • Seers don't gain knowledge on how to directly utilise these mystical arts, only the ability and talent to do them at an expert level. Their mastery is dependent on their time of learning.
  • Danger Intuition: They can intuitively detect danger using their Spirituality.

Sequence 8: Clown

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: After advancing into a Clown, they will possess a strong control over their body, making them akin to a master acrobat and circus performer.
  • A Clown has near complete control over their bodily functions and facial expressions.
  • Their face will only show the expressions they wish to show, with the only situations such as extreme shock or pain causing them to show their true feelings, making them the nemesis of Spectators. This also applies to their limbs and other body parts.
  • They can also project their current appearance by calming their mind.
  • Their dexterity and speed become exceptional, while their strength gains a decent increase.
  • These enhancements allow a Clown to commit various feats of acrobatics, such as swinging themselves up by their feet, easily scaling the outsides of buildings or using backflips to very steadily escape from attacks during fights.
  • They gain powerful coordination and a near inhumane sense of balance. A Clown will never lose their balance, barring certain extreme circumstances.
  • Their enhanced coordination allows them to walk over tightropes as if they were flat ground, jump and land on the backrest of a chair without stumbling, while also making them talented with various combat techniques.
  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality gets marginally enhanced.
  • Danger Intuition: The Danger Intuition of a Clown is greatly enhanced, even granting them a short-term form of premonition, though often ambiguous and unclear.
  • They can supernaturally see the appearance of someone (or a group of people) standing behind a door without ever having to open it themselves. This does not rely on Spirit Vision (opens in a new tab).
  • They can sometimes intuitively predict the next action somebody will take. This can only provide an opportunity to take advantage of as it happens infrequently.
  • Like Divination, this ability is much more reliable when it comes to actions that will cause harm to the Clown. This allows them to often pre-dodge attacks that would be very lethal.

New Abilities

  • Paper Daggers: A Clown becomes capable of temporarily turning sheets of paper as hard and sharp as steel, allowing them to throw them as flying daggers or use them as knives.
  • These Paper Daggers that a Clown makes are powerful enough to stick to solid stone and pierce through a Hunter's flesh and bone.

Sequence 7: Magician

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Magicians experience a qualitative change to their overall dexterity.
  • Their hands become more agile and their body become more nimble, allowing them to master many non-supernatural magic tricks.
  • Spirituality: A Magician's Spirituality will get enhanced once more upon reaching this level.
  • Spirit Vision: Their ability to see various spiritual things gets slightly enhanced, but not by much.
  • They cannot see the Astral Projection deep in the Ether Body, and as such, are unable to discern whether a target is a Beyonder or not.
  • They possess many different ways to interfere with the Spiritual Intuition of a target.

New Abilities

  • Magicians possess 9 spell-like abilities that they are able to cast at high speeds, without needing to chant or inject Spirituality to activate them.
  1. Damage Transfer: So long as a Magician is not dead and can still move their hand, they can Transfer wounds to an different areas like arms or legs, turning fatal wounds into minor injuries.
  • Each wound can only be Transferred once.
  • They cannot Transfer damage with objects.
  • They can Transfer the wounds of others.
  1. Flaming Jump: A Magician can phase through a fire spark that they had left behind and any flame that existed within 30 meters. The range would increase over time as they digest the potion.
  • During Flaming Jump, Magicians will become immune to ordinary flames. This will last until after they come out of it, after which they must use Flame Controlling for protection.
  • A Pyromaniac's Flames and a Witch's Black Flames are also things they can phase into and be immune to during the teleportation process.
  • This is similar to the Teleportation abilities of a Traveler in that it uses the unique traits of the Spirit World. However, Magicians do not directly enter it.
  • This means Magicians are able to use Flaming Jump inside areas where the connection to the Spirit World is restricted.
  • However, if one’s Luck is extremely bad or that section of the Spirit World has issues, there could still be danger.
  1. Air Bullet: Magicians can produce air projectiles with power and speed comparable to that of bullets fired from a custom revolver just by snapping their fingers or mimicking a gun sound.
  • The power and speed of their Air Bullets will improve along with the digestion of the potion and the raising of their Sequence.
  1. Paper Figurine Substitute: Magicians can transform a Paper Figurine into themselves and swap places with it. It can not only block a fatal blow but also weaken the damage from Curses.
  • This can be used as crude body doubles to fool others into thinking they were there.
  • After using one, the Magician would reappear in a different but nearby location.
  1. Flame Controlling: Magicians are able to freely manipulate flames and ignite certain flammable substances within a range of 30 meters with a simple gesture or action.
  • Like their other abilities, the range of manipulation will increase with the digestion of the potion and raising of their Sequence.
  • Once the potion has been completely digested, a Magician could summon a single swirling flame out of thin air.
  1. Underwater Breathing: A Magician can create a thin, invisible air pipe which would allow them to breath freely underwater and seemingly turn into a Murloc (opens in a new tab).
  • The initial length of this invisible air pipe a Magician could conjure up is exactly 5 meters. As the potion digests, the length of the pipe would increase.
  1. Bone Softening: This ability allows a Magician the ability to soften their bones to some degree. This can be used to escape from a variety of different restraints like handcuffs, ropes, and chests.
  2. Drawing Paper As Weapons: This is an evolution of the Clown's Paper Daggers. It now allows a Magician to turn paper into a variety of different weapons, such as bats, bricks, canes etc.
  3. Illusion Creation: They can influence the environment, creating Illusions with colours, sounds, and smells that would be close to reality, allowing them to pass off the false as true.
  • They can use sounds Illusions to secretly transfer their sounds to others.

Sequence 6: Faceless

Traits

  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality grows to a large extent upon becoming a Faceless.
  • Their Divination skills receive a substantial improvement.

New Abilities

  • Shapeshifting: They can become anyone at any time with their ability to freely mould their body and flesh, enabling them to perfectly mimic their target's face, body, voice, or even smell to some degree.
  • While it is possible for a Faceless to mimic the facial features and body proportions of someone of the opposite gender, they cannot change their actual physical gender.
  • A Faceless restrictions include height and mass. They cannot mimic the body proportions of an individual that is too disparate in size from their original body.
  • Their new height cannot be more than a head taller or shorter than their original height
  • There is a limit to the enlargement and shrinkage of the head, legs, arms, bones etc.
  • A Faceless possesses full control over the transformation on their body.
  • They can freely shift the position of their eyes and other facial features around on their face.
  • They can make their face completely featureless, without any eyes, nose, or mouth,
  • They can even create "fake" facial features on their face such as false eyes.
  • They can change their body odour by adjusting the pores on their skin.
  • However they still are unable to change their lower body.
  • Shapeshifting and their bodily control make a Faceless good at acting.
  • They are able to accurately recall the shape and temperament of everyone they know and recognise them no matter how well disguised they may be.
  • The accumulation of the previous potion skills along with Shapeshifting leads to them being good at combat, Tracking, and anti-Tracking.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their previous abilities are enhanced.
  • Flame Controlling, Flaming Jump, and other spell-like abilities had become about 30% stronger.
  • The original power of their Air Bullets and the length of their invisible pipe that enables Underwater Breathing have increased severalfold.
  • The number of times a Faceless can use Paper Figurine Substitutes and Damage Transfer has increased as a result of their Spirituality gain.

Sequence 5: Marionettist

New Abilities

  • Spirit Body Threads Manipulation: This is the core power of a Marionettist. With it, they are able to perceive and manipulate Spirit Body Threads, from up to 100 meters away.
  • Through manipulating the Spirit Body Threads of an organism, they directly influence the target’s Soul Body, Astral Projection, Body of Heart and Mind, and Ether Body. Then, using the Ether Body as a bridge, they can control their target’s body.
  • Within the same Sequence level, targets who have been turned into Marionettes are unable to utilise their Resurrection methods to Revive and escape being a Marionette.
  • This includes, but might not be limited to, the Resurrection abilities of the Undying, the Unaging, the Bloody Archduke, the Knight of Misfortune, and the Black Emperor.
  • The Marionette can Resurrect using their original Pathway's abilities; however, they will remain a Marionette.
  • If the Marionette state is lifted and the Marionette dies, the original owner will still not be able to Resurrect.
  • Instead, they will remain a Marionette and continue dying until their Resurrection is fully depleted.
  • Through the changes within the Spirit Body Threads of an individual target, a Marionettist will have the capability to be able to detect the Parasitism caused by a **Parasite**.
  • By tracing the Spirit Body Threads of a target, a Marionettist can perceive Invisible targets, such as a Shadow Ascetic's Shadow Lurking or a Witch's Invisibility.
  • The process of Spirit Body Threads Manipulation can be hard to detect, and only Beyonders with Divination or Prophetic abilities are able to detect it happening.
  • The process of controlling a target's Spirit Body Threads has a limited range of 5-10 meters (depending on potion digestion) and is split into 2 separate phases.
  • The initial phase of control takes between 5 and 20 seconds to achieve, depending on the rate of potion digestion and the potency of their target's Spirit Body.
  • The target's movements and thoughts begin to slow considerably and are often the first sign that they are being controlled. They can still attempt to fight back and can still think and move, but at reduced speed and greater difficulty; this will only increase as the Marionettist deepens the control of their Spirit Body Threads.
  • This process can be interrupted by external stimuli, usually sharp and abrupt pain, both physical and mental. Upon the process being interrupted, the target immediately regains full faculty over both thoughts and physical movement and the Marionettist would have to start the process over from the beginning.
  • The final phase occurs if the first step is not interrupted for around 5 to 2 and a half minutes, which will lead to full transformation of a target into a Marionette.
  • The amount of time needed to turn a target into a Marionette varies according to the potency of their target's Spirit Body and their digestion of their potion.
  • Marionette: Akin to a puppet, they are under full control of their Marionettist. They are dead for all intents and purposes, although they still retain a Soul.
  • Apart from superficial surface thoughts, they would not be able to know about the details of their Marionette's previous lives unless it encounters something or someone familiar.
  • Only then will they "remember" details about this familiar place or person.
  • Marionettists are initially limited to 1 Marionette at a time. They can have a maximum of 3 Marionettes at a time after completely digesting their potion.
  • They are still able to control others' Spirit Body Threads, but are unable to fully convert them into Marionettes without exceeding their current limit.
  • Marionettes can speak any languages they had learned when they were alive, even ones that the Marionettist does not currently know.
  • However, the Marionettist doesn't "learn" the language in this manner and will not be able to speak it themselves.
  • The initial maximum range for controlling a Marionette is 100 meters, this goes up to at least 200 meters with digestion of their potion.
  • Marionettists can possess their Marionettes, allowing them to fully experience everything their Marionettes sees and feels.
  • It can use all its original Beyonder powers, consuming its own Spirituality, allowing them to be directed from afar without danger.
  • Marionettes are unable to consume potions for advancements, as their Spirit Bodies are essentially dead.
  • As Marionettes are considered dead, a Spirit Guide can interfere and influence a Marionette; however, at Sequence 4, the core of a Marionette can have a Worm of Spirit inside. Thus, at those stages it also depends on multiple factors like relative strength of both sides, condition, how much effort is exerted, etc.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Marionettists will also receive a 50% or more increase to their Beyonder abilities.
  • Air Bullet: Its strength is comparable to a bullet shot from a steam rifle.

Sequence 4: Bizarro Sorcerer

Traits

  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality has been massively improved.
  • Divination: Bizarro Sorcerers are able to obtain more information using simple Divination methods such as instantaneous Dream Divination with a flip of a coin.
  • Spirit Vision: The restriction of having to do a corresponding action to activate Spirit Vision is now removed as now they’re capable of activating it at will.

New Abilities

  • Bestowal: Bizarro Sorcerers can "gift" their Worms of Spirit to their Marionettes allowing those "gifted" to use the Bizarro Sorcerers' Beyonder powers.
  • Initially, Bizarro Sorcerers are only only split 50 Worms of Spirit from their Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). This will increase with digestion of their potion.
  • If they go beyond their limit, they will suffer from symptoms of schizophrenia that cannot be treated. This will increase their tendency of losing control.
  • They can retrieve, "gift" and switch Worms of Spirit to any Marionette within a range of 1 kilometre through their Spirit Body Threads.
  • If the Worms of Spirit's connection to the Bizarro Sorcerer is cut, the Marionette that has been disconnected will die shortly after.
  • Bizarro Sorcerers must implant at least a single maggot in a Marionette if they want it to use their Beyonder abilities.
  • Being technically dead, Marionettes through Shapeshifting can be moulded into shapes impossible for a living creature to assume (such as a 2 finger width human figure).
  • Through this, they can increase the range of their ability to make new Marionettes by 1150 meters (1000 meters as the initial range for controlling a Marionette, plus 150 meters as the initial range for taking control of a new one) by using their already converted Marionettes to take control of new Marionettes.
  • Marionettes converted in this manner can only be "gifted" a new Worm of Spirit via the already converted Marionette, so the latter must have more than one small maggot in it for it to do so.
  • When a Marionette with a small maggot dies, it's Beyonder Characteristics will return to them after a certain time period due to the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence (opens in a new tab).
  • If the process for the return of their small maggots' Beyonder Characteristics is interrupted, that Worm of Spirit may be lost.
  • Since Worms of Spirit are part of Bizarro Sorcerers, "gifting" those Worms of Spirit to their Marionettes will not grant them the ability to think and be self-conscious.
  • Concealment: Bizarro Sorcerers possess Concealment abilities to a certain degree.
  • They are able to hide their Sequence level from a Beyonder of the same or lower level of the Justiciar Pathway, but are not able to hide the fact that they are a Beyonder.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their previous abilities as a Beyonder have been massively enhanced.
  • Their abilities as a Magician have been massively improved.
  • Damage Transfer: Their wounds or that of others can be Transferred onto a paper figurine.
  • Air Cannon: The upgraded form of Air Bullet whose might has increased to that of a cannon.
  • Flaming Jump: The range for them to phase using flames has increased to 1 kilometre.
  • Illusion Creation: Their illusion abilities have experienced a qualitative upgrade.
  • Their auditory illusions that are nearly as loud as a Cataclysmic Interrer's roar.
  • They are able to hide an entire cruise liner as well as create illusory thoughts.
  • Shapeshifting: They can transform into any animals that aren't too disparate in size.
  • When they are in a Spirit Body state, this restriction is removed.
  • Spirit Body Threads Manipulation: Their ability to control the Spirit Body Threads of others have been massively strengthened and enhanced.
  • The initial control of someone's Spirit Body Threads can be achieved by a Bizarro Sorcerer in just 3 seconds while full control is achieved within 15 seconds.
  • The initial range for them being able to control Spirit Body Threads has increased to 150 meters. This range will increase as they digest the potion.
  • Marionette: The amount, effect, and corresponding alterations Bizarro Sorcerers can do with their Marionettes have increased tremendously.
  • They are initially able to control up to 50 Marionettes which increases with potion digestion. In addition, they can control Marionettes within a range of 1 kilometer.
  • If a Marionette were to go beyond their control range, as long as they return in range within 10 minutes, the Marionette wouldn't escape their control and truly die.
  • A Marionette's superficial consciousness can be read, and through enhanced control over Spirit Body Threads, they can achieve effects similar to Spirit Channelling.
  • The higher the level of the Marionette they are trying to gain information from, the poorer the effects of a Bizarro Sorcerer's emulated Spirit Channelling.
  • Marionette Interchange: Bizarro Sorcerers are able to seamlessly swap places with their Marionettes within a distance of 1 kilometer.
  • When they are swapping positions with a Marionette, a Bizarro Sorcerer can only choose to swap their bodies or bodies and external objects.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 4 Demigod they possess some level of Godhood, and with it comes an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). The small transparent maggots inscribed with three-dimensional sinister tentacle patterns are called the Worms of Spirit.
  • The three-dimensional layers of mysterious symbols connect to higher and lower levels, directly presenting the abstract concepts of Bizarreness, Madness, Change, Strength, and Wisdom.
  • The Worm of Spirits induce feelings of Madness and Bizarreness at this level.
  • Two Worm of Spirits can fill an entire bedroom with Madness and Bizarreness. Make the surrounding lights then dim and brighten from time to time in a non-uniform fashion.
  • Bizarro Sorcerers can divide Worms of Spirit from their own Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab).
  • They can kill these maggots and wait for the minute Beyonder Characteristics to be released, then use the carcasses to contain power that is bestowed by a high-level existence.
  • Through this, they are able to use the carcasses of their Worms of Spirit as high-level materials to create various charms and special bullets.
  • This fractures their own Spirit Body, dealing considerable damage and making them unable to do this frequently unless they want death.
  • If they lose too much Worms of Spirit they are able to recover by absorbing the Beyonder Characteristics of the Fool Pathway.

Sequence 3: Scholar of Yore

New Abilities

  • History: Their main ability is to access and get help from History, which is divided into three parts- Historical Void Borrowing, Historical Void Projection, and Historical Void Hiding.
  • Historical Void Borrowing: They have the ability to Borrow strength from their past self, whose power can be borrowed as many times as they want so long as they have enough Spirituality.
  • To a certain extent, this is something that’s self-perpetuating, preventing a Scholar of Yore from ever really being in the nadir until their Spirituality is completely drained.
  • Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) Borrowed a past state of his island of consciousness being invaded by Hvin Rambis (opens in a new tab), and with the fact that he was able to maintain his lucidity in Dreams and the Mind World regardless of any intrusions, he began to examine if there were any abnormalities in his mind and thoughts that were being Parasitised.
  • Before their Spirituality is drained, they can always Borrow energy from their own past self, with there being no limit to the number of times they can borrow it.
  • As for the Spirituality of a Scholar of Yore who digested 80% of the potion, even without the process of recovering, they are able to Borrow power nearly ten times a day, maintaining it for five minutes each time.
  • Historical Projection Summoning: They can Summon people or objects that existed in the past for a limited time as Historical Projections from the Historical Void.
  • There are three factors that influence the probability of successfully Summoning the target from the Historical Void and the duration of the Summoned target:
  1. The more detailed and the better the understanding one has of the corresponding piece of history and matters, the higher the chance of success is and the longer it will last.
  2. The lower the target’s level is relative to the Scholar of Yore, the higher the chance of success in Summoning the Historical Projection and the longer it will last.
  3. Increasing one's affinity with the target they wish to Summon in the future from will increase the chances of success in Summoning it and its duration.
  • At 80% potion digestion, if it’s the most ordinary item or something that was once theirs, they can maintain its availability for a maximum of 15 minutes.
  • Historical Projections would also have their corresponding Spirit Body Threads and thus, can be turned into Marionettes. In addition, Marionettes can be summoned as well.
  • Scholars of Yore can only summon 3 Historical Projections at a single instance in time. This also includes Historical Projections which are Summoned by their Marionettes.
  • Successfully Summoned Historical Projections of a higher level than the Scholar of Yore will only have a portion of the strength and quality of the original target.
  • Historical Projections of Historical Projections can be Summoned. The difficulty of Summoning these are reduced, but so are their strength.
  • Historical Projections are reliant on orders and lack intelligence, making them limited to an instinctive and mechanical manner in combat.
  • Due to the mysticism principle of "a unique shared consciousness in time", a Historical Projection does not contain the past memories of it's counterpart.
  • This means that a Scholar of Yore is not able to utilise a Historical Projection in order to ask and gain answers to questions they don't have knowledge on.
  • While the principle above does not apply to the deceased, a Scholar Of Yore's level is insufficient to summon Historical Projections that are fully conscious.
  • If the target's true body hides in the Historical Void or enters a Concealed state, they can send their mind to their Historical Projection and control it.
  • Existences who have died but still have a Soul remaining (or have residual will) can sense when their Historical Projection have been Summoned.
  • They are connected to their Historical Projection(s) and can utilise this connection to communicate their intent and orders directly without speaking.
  • This relies on the Scholar of Yore's Historical Projection's lack of intelligence and/or having a good relationship with it as a means of control.
  • This allows for a Scholar of Yore to quickly coordinate with an ally who is controlling their summoned Historical Projection.
  • They cannot Summon things directly related to a Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) which includes Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) as objects and those who have accommodated it within them.
  • However, there are ways to bypass this restriction to some extent, they can instead Summon objects/people which a Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) can exert power on.
  • Zaratul (opens in a new tab) summoned an Angel (opens in a new tab) from the "Red of War" army, whose members could link with Red Angel Medici (opens in a new tab) to become one.
  • Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) summoned 0-17's (opens in a new tab) Historical Projection to be used as Evernight Goddess's (opens in a new tab) descent vessel.
  • Historical Projections have natural flaw, problem, and weakness in terms of Fate and Time, which determines the time limit on their existence.
  • If Fate chooses the Fate Tributary of Historical Projection were prematurely terminated due to unexpected influence, they will naturally dissipate.
  • If the duration of a Historical Projection ends, it will dissipate. As such, for Pathways with authority over the flow of Time, they can hasten its end.
  • Historical Void Hiding: They can enter the Historical Void (opens in a new tab) and Hide within its gaps, so long as their Spirituality allows. This allows a Scholar of Yore to avoid danger, but they must come out the exact spot in the world once the Scholar of Yore stops hiding.
  • The prerequisite of Summoning and Borrowing from the past while in the Historical Void (opens in a new tab) is that there is a past of themselves within the gap of history they are in.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) could not Borrow power from his past self because he was Hiding inside a gap corresponding to a period of history where Giant King Aurmir (opens in a new tab) buried "His" parents.
  • The gaps that they can Hide inside within the Historical Void (opens in a new tab) are limited to the Scholar of Yore's understanding of the corresponding history.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) Hid inside the Historical Void corresponding to a period of history where Giant King Aurmir (opens in a new tab) buried "His" parents. This prevented Zaratul (opens in a new tab) from following him there even though the former was an Attendant of Mysteries.
  • While Hiding in the Historical Void, a Scholar of Yore is able to send their consciousness back to their Historical Projection and control it by themselves.
  • Contacting an unilluminated point within the Fog of History is very dangerous. It's best to research the corresponding History first before exploring.
  • Even if the History has been isolated, as long as the Scholar of Yore knows it, they would be able to enter it.
  • Scholars of Yore gain the ability to produce fog and reduce the temperature of an area.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their abilities as a Magician have been enhanced.
  • Paper Figurine Substitutes: Their Paper Figurine Substitutes has undergone several qualitative changes, being able to disrupt Divination, Prophecy powers, tracking, and gazes.
  • Their Paper Figurine Substitutes can now also substitute certain parts of a target (like organs). Before one discovers that it’s fake, things can continue proceeding as per normal.
  • Damage Transfer: Scholars of Yore are now able to transfer a certain part of ailments, Curses, Prophecies, attacks and gazes to their Paper Figurine Substitutes.
  • Flaming Jump: Their range of phasing into flames have increased to 5 kilometres. Their Flaming Jump is now able to transfer objects to them or their Marionettes.
  • Air Cannon: The power of a Scholar of Yore's Air Cannon is now equivalent to coastal defence artillery and it's corresponding power could be adjusted at will.
  • Shapeshifting: Scholars of Yore can transform into any creature that is within a certain limit. Some of the organs of the creature they Shapeshift to would work while others wouldn't.
  • Spirit Body Threads Manipulation: A Scholar of Yore's ability to control Spirit Body Threads has been massively strengthened in distance and time.
  • The initial control time of a target's Spirit Body Threads has been reduced to just 2 seconds, and full control can be achieved in just 10 seconds.
  • Marionette Interchange: The limit of swapping positions between a Scholar of Yore and their Marionettes is now 5 kilometres.
  • The initial range for a Scholar of Yore to completely transform someone into a Marionette has been increased to 500 meters.
  • In addition, Scholars of Yore can control Marionettes within a range of 5 kilometres.

Mythical Creature Form

  • The divine pattern on their Worms of Spirit become more complex and has become more expressive of the themes of the Fool Pathway. In addition, a Scholar of Yore can now split about 600 Worms of Spirit from their Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab).
  • This change is a result of the acquired Beyonder Characteristics and mythical knowledge contained within the potion. These divine patterns can differ from person to person because it relates to their personal traits as well.
  • it can showcase concepts of strength, strangeness, and supernaturalness.
  • After complete digestion of the potion, a Scholar of Yore would be able to recover from having nearly 500 Worms of Spirit die at once in their Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab).
  • Losing all corresponding Beyonder Characteristics wouldn't cause them to lose their status and level. They can slowly recover by absorbing Beyonder Characteristics of the Fool Pathway.
  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can listen to prayers within a certain range. They can allow different Worms of Spirit from their Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) instinctively listen to prayers and respond to them while turning in the complicated ones to the main body.

Sequence 2: Miracle Invoker

Beyonder Characteristics:

There are a total of nine Miracle Invoker Beyonder Characteristics in existence. A maximum of six Miracle Invokers are allowed to exist at once if there are three Attendants of Mysteries already due to the limited amount of Beyonder Characteristics.

Traits

  • Spirituality: "Their" corresponding Spirituality and the aspects of "Their" Soul (be it Spiritual Intuition, Divination Arts, etc.) have been enhanced.
  • "They" can see the result of "Their" Dream Divination in front of "Their" eyes without falling asleep.
  • "They" are able to make "Their" Spirit Body leave "Their" physical body and go to the Spirit World.
  • "Their" corresponding Danger Intuition and Spiritual Intuition receive a massive boost.
  • These abilities can be used together with Dream Divination so that "They" can see several possibilities of the future of subjects or objects "They" wanted to Divine.
  • "They" can see future scenes that have a connection to them in detail even if "They" are at a far distance from the source of the connection itself.

Authorities

  • Miracles: "They" are able to perform Miracles for others and "Themselves", thus being able to achieve a myriad of effects with varying potency, which scales based on the similar accumulated Wishes that "They" have granted to others beforehand.
  • Its effects don't only come from the Beyonder Characteristics but also from similar Wishes of different creatures with Spirituality that may be related to the Sea of Collective Subconscious.
  • To put it simply, Miracle Invokers need to seek out and satisfy all kinds of Wishes before "They" could fulfil "Their" own Wishes, turning the corresponding situation into a reality.
  • As for how "They" could fulfil others' Wishes, "They" have 2 known methods.
  • "They" could use other Beyonder powers that "They" or the Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) that "They" wield possess to achieve the corresponding effects.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) fulfilled other people's Wishes to know about the answers to their corresponding questions by using Arrodes (opens in a new tab).
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) utilised Life's Cane (opens in a new tab) fulfil Jasmine's Wish of restoring her appearance before she was burned in an accident.
  • "They" could also just directly grant a Wish with "Their" previous accumulated power of Wishes in order to create a true Miracle.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) rebuilt various houses and buildings, and eventually Constant City (opens in a new tab) to its former, non-war-torn state via a Wish.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) removed all the deformations and disfigurements of the body in all the citizens of Moon City (opens in a new tab) via a Wish.
  • At the very beginning, the Wishes that "They" could fulfil were small and trivial. "They" had to accumulate them one step at a time before "They" could create a true Miracle.
  • The effects of the Miracles each Miracle Invoker can perform are varied based on "Their" personally accumulated Wishes. Some effects include Teleportation, the dissipation of Godhood, the shrinkage of an area, and much more.
  • "They" can use Wish to extend "Their" lifespan and the upper limit depends on how powerful "Their" Wish-granting ability is.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) shrunk the Belltaine City Library (opens in a new tab) so that its boundaries prevented 0-02 (opens in a new tab) from delivering severe punishment to others.
  • Antigonus (opens in a new tab) moved a portion of an ancient Divine Kingdom from “His” memories into the real world through a Wish.
  • Kotar (opens in a new tab) made Godhood dissipate in an area, suppressing all Beyonder powers above the Sequence 5 level.
  • With enough Miracles, "They" can use a Wish to briefly obtain power equivalent to a Sequence 1.
  • Miracles can be used to break through a Clarivoyant's Prophecies.
  • Wishes are often distorted, and the bigger the Wish, the more distorted its outcome, which can cause unwanted things to happen. Therefore, "They" should be careful of what "They" Wish for.
  • The distortion of "Their" Wishes can be reduced by setting some clear constraints for the Wish such as time and area limits.
  • Additionally, with Wishes that directly alter a high-level being's state, there will be either a lower effect or more distortion.
  • If a half-Lord of Mysteries' (opens in a new tab) Wish was to affect the Primordial Demoness (opens in a new tab), who is the female body of Primordial God Almighty (opens in a new tab), clear time and space constraints must be made.
  • Otherwise, the Wish may distort into a direction favouring "Her".
  • Limited at the level of Sequence 7, Zaratul (opens in a new tab) in The Fool's Dream (opens in a new tab) set a time limit of "His" Wish being 30 seconds long with it being poor at affecting those with Godhood.
  • The stronger the Godhood, the more likely the opposing Beyonders with Godhood will be able to break through the restrictions of "His" Wish and interfere with "Him".
  • The Godhood of Evernight Goddess (opens in a new tab) caused the power of Kotar's (opens in a new tab) Wish to gradually be weakened in high speed, until it was completely nullified.
  • This brought Godhood back starting at the Sequence 4 level.
  • Although "They" are able to perform Miracles for the same person repeatedly, A Miracle Invoker cannot grant similar Wishes to the same person within a short period of time.
  • Note: Although it is very dangerous as switching Pathways within the same Sequence would inevitably lead to a half semi-madness state, it is theoretically possible for a Miracle Invoker who is also a Trojan Horse of Destiny to quickly accumulate Wishes by continuously creating Avatars through manipulating or absorbing characteristics, making Wishes upon them, and then repeating the same Wish in battle.

Strengthened Abilities

  • History: "Their" improved use of the Historical Void (opens in a new tab) includes several abilities along with greater enhancements to the things "They" are able to summon as well.
  • Resurrection: When a Miracle Invoker dies, "Their" Beyonder Characteristics will enter the Historical Void (opens in a new tab) and fuse with "Their" Worms of Spirit from the past, turning them corporeal. When "They" will it, these Worms of Spirit will escape the Historical Void (opens in a new tab) and reform in reality to allow the Miracle Invoker to Resurrect.
  • "They" need to resurrect within 3 days or "They" will truly die or become an Evil Spirit (opens in a new tab).
  • This is also a type of Miracle "They" can do at default without accumulating Wishes.
  • "Their" ability to Resurrect becomes completely ineffective after 4 utilisations.
  • "Their" Spirit Body (but not physical) can be reborn inside Historical Void (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" are limited to reviving in a certain range around "Their" corpse.
  • Despite that, if "They" have made Wishes of a correct enough domain, "They" are able to make a Miracle for "Them" to Revive in a distant place away from "Their" corpse.
  • Kotar (opens in a new tab) gave up on reviving near the area of "His" original corpse and instead fulfilled "His" own Wish to revive at a distant spot far away from it.
  • When "They" die naturally, "They" will consume a Resurrection to reset "Their" state. This will naturally reset "Their" lifespan, making "Them" younger.
  • Jamming in Fate: A Miracle Invoker can exert some influence on the future so that the probability of something becomes larger or smaller to a certain extent.
  • This ability is equivalent to interfering with the Fate of a target; however, this aspect is still different from how Wheel of Fortune Beyonders manipulate Fate.
  • Historical Void Summoning: "They" are no longer limited to just Summoning items and people. It can be extended to certain scenes and historical events that "They" are familiar with.
  • This ability is limited to a total of 9 items/people/scenes, with only 3 at Angel (opens in a new tab)-level.
  • Zaratul (opens in a new tab) summoned a Historical Projection of fish meat at Klein's (opens in a new tab) request and warned him that it could only be maintained for 45 minutes.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) summoned the projection of the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire’s Hall of Consuls (opens in a new tab), a scene filled with Distortions.
  • Spirit Body Threads Manipulation: "Their" ability to control Spirit Body Threads of others and turn others into Marionettes has been massively strengthened.
  • Marionette: The number of Marionettes that "They" can control has reached at least 5000 and "They" can control them within a city-wide range.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) made Utopia (opens in a new tab), where "He" not only controlled it's 5000 residents, but all of its animals as well. This includes rats, cockroaches, moths, ants, flies, mosquitoes, and pigeons.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab). "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is a vortex stacked with groups of Worms of Spirit with invisible tentacles that grow from within.
  • Due to "Their" constitution as Worms of Spirit, "They" have a high capacity for regeneration, being able to recover quickly from serious and disabling injuries.
  • Such injuries include being able to regenerate "Their" entire limbs within seconds.
  • "They" can separate at least 5000 Worms of Spirit and implant them into "Their" Marionettes.

Sequence 1: Attendant of Mysteries

Description

These are Angels (opens in a new tab) who serve the profound mysteries. "They" have gained initial control of the corresponding domain's authorities. "They" can summon Spirit Body Threads of objects that originally existed. "They" can combine many physical objects or abstract concepts together.

Traits

  • "They" lose the boundary between "Their" physical and Spirit Body; where the 2 exist as one yet separated. This is a manifestation of Bizarreness and Spirit World symbols.
  • This is a delicate state that allows "Them" to shift the body's status between physical and spirit forms at will as well as separate and integrate these aspects as one at will.

New Abilities

  • Regenerate: If the materials that made up an item once had a Spirit Body, then "They" could Regenerate the past Spirit Body Threads of it to make it become "Their" Marionette.
  • "They" can't allow something that didn't have Spirit Body Threads to produce them, but "They" can allow items that used to have Spirit Body Threads to possess them again.
  • The former mainly consisted of metallic items, gold coins, gold pounds, and so on.
  • The latter mainly consisted of beef, fish, plants, and other types of food.
  • Once creatures ate food that had "Their" Spirit Body Threads renewed, they would also transform into Marionettes, as though they had gained intense corruption.

Authorities

  • Reassembly (Tampering/Grafting): Reassembly reflects the authority of Change domain, it can Reassemble many physical objects and/or abstract concepts into something different, resulting in an Inconceivable yet real effect. It is like changing something's definition, orientation, logic, or rules.
  • Simply put, Reassembly can Graft together things that normally wouldn't have a direct connection, achieving Inconceivable effects.
  • A simple example was to mix the concept of the beginning and the end of a path into one common node, making it impossible for anyone who walked that path to leave.
  • For Beyonders, many abilities can achieve similar feats, but an Attendant of Mysteries' Grafting acts directly upon concepts themselves, its level was very high, like the descent of a True Deity.
  • Grafting as the authority of Change, is a lesser authority formed by a low manifestation of Change and Bizarreness symbols.
  • Not only the effects of Reassembly are Bizarre, but it also has a hint of Concealment.
  • The simplest application of Grafting is for "Them" to Graft various locations or areas within either the real world and/or the Spirit World together.
  • "They" can utilise Graft to freely enter the Spirit World and indirectly achieve a Teleportation effect; however, the prerequisite is if "They" could locate the region in the Spirit World.
  • On this point, an Attendant of Mysteries that owns Sefirah Castle (opens in a new tab) would gain a unique advantage. Otherwise "They" could only rely on "Their" preparations.
  • Grafting a location to a place near "Their" main body ensures "Their" Marionettes won't go out of range, enabling "Their" Marionettes to go around the world.
  • Other applications of Grafting include Reassembling: connections, Anchors and prayers, targets, beginnings and endpoints, etc.
  • If "They" have something similar to Graft on it, "They" can Tamper with the opponent's Death and Cull in order to prevent the Substitute's death from becoming the original's death.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) Grafted Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatars' target of Theft from his thoughts to a drop of blood blessed by the Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab), instantly impregnating the Avatars.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) Grafted the events of Roselle's (opens in a new tab) "rebirth" and "death" directly to each other, bypassing the process of Corruption that occurred in-between these two states.
  • Antigonus (opens in a new tab) Grafted the beginning and endpoint of the pages in Trunsoest Brass Book's (opens in a new tab) law-making, trapping it in an infinite loop to prevent its effects.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) Grafted the corresponding Anchors from the Sea God Scepter (opens in a new tab) to "Himself" while "He" Grafted the prayers into Derrick Berg (opens in a new tab).
  • Realm of Mysteries: "They" wield certain level of Concealment authority, whenever "They" are thinking about important matters, there will always be a thin shadow, which takes a form of curtain, around "Them" that no one else could see, it was equivalent to the embryonic form of a Divine Kingdom, the Realm of Mysteries. It distorts Space-Time to separate the affected area from outside, preventing enemies and information from leaving.
  • The Realm of Mysteries formed by an Attendant of Mysteries is harder to break than both a Naturewalker's conceived Worlds and a Valley God's Paramita.
  • However, a Valley God's Paramita is harder to fully destroy or Seal compared to an Attendant of Mysteries' Realm of Mysteries.
  • The Realm of Mysteries isn't only an independent space, it also has certain special effects similar to Pale World and Holy Kingdom.
  • Examples of Realm of Mysteries in use are:
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) stirred the power of Sefirah Castle (opens in a new tab) to cast Realm of Mysteries on Antigonus's (opens in a new tab) palace to prevent interference from Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatars and others from disrupting "His" Apotheosis Ritual (opens in a new tab).
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) used Realm of Mysteries around "Himself" whenever "He" was thinking about important matters, which allowed "Him" to think directly of Adam's (opens in a new tab) name without alerting "Him".
  • Miracles: "They" can directly interfere with others and produce fantastical, Bizarre, almost magical effects without relying on forms of lower or same-level abilities or authorities.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Spirit Body Threads Manipulation: The full control of a target's Spirit Body Threads and conversion into a Marionette by an Attendant of Mysteries can be achieved in just 3 to 4 seconds.
  • "Their" control over Spirit Body Threads reaches a point where "They" can make a Marionette use "Their" powers without placing a Worm of Spirit inside of it.
  • In the foggy town, Zaratul (opens in a new tab) strengthened the connection between Klein (opens in a new tab) and his Marionette, allowing the Marionette to use his abilities even without a Worm of Spirit.
  • Resurrection: "Their" Resurrection count is reset, meaning "They" can Resurrect four times regardless of how many times "They" have Resurrected as a Miracle Invoker.

Sequence 0: Fool

Description

This is a True Deity. In a sense, "They" are an embodiment of the corresponding authorities. "They" are a master of trickery, adept at using all kinds of methods to Fool all things, showcasing all kinds of fascinating Miracles.

Symbolism

  • As a Pathway under the Lord of Mysteries (opens in a new tab), the best and most proficient at utilising symbolism, "They" can use surface-level symbolism application of "Their" authorities.
  • Blind Stupidity (Foolishness): "They" hold the symbol of "Blind Stupidity" within the mind domain, corresponding to the authority of Fooling.
  • This is the simplest implementation, it would greatly lower others' IQ forcefully so that they aren't able to have proper thoughts. This can even affect Sequence 0 True Gods.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) and Antigonus (opens in a new tab) used Blind Stupidity on the Trunsoest Brass Book (opens in a new tab), making it not realise that it kept skipping the middle process of its law-making.
  • "They" can Fool "Their" targets, weaken their analytical and thinking abilities to degree they don't notice, making them reach wrong judgements.
  • If "Their" targets remember their judgement more carefully and think more about how they have reached it, they would realise that they were Fooled.
  • The Fool (opens in a new tab) Fooled the Hidden Sage (opens in a new tab), causing "Him" to believe that the Great Mother (opens in a new tab) would save "Him" even when "He" had no evidence of that being the case.
  • The Celestial Worthy (opens in a new tab) Fooled the Tarot Club (opens in a new tab) into believing that they had put Peng Deng (opens in a new tab) in the last few steps when it comes to confirming his situation.
  • "They" can Fool "Their" targets to make them forget an information that they have known or make them not pay any attention to it.
  • The Celestial Worthy (opens in a new tab) Fooled the minds of Miss Justice (opens in a new tab) and other people within the Fool's Dream (opens in a new tab) to subconsciously forget about An Xiaotian (opens in a new tab).
  • For beings that act on instinct, using Fooling won't be so effective.
  • As such, writing matters into one's instinct is a good way to resist its effects.

Authorities

  • Fooling: This is one of the two core authorities of the Fool which encompasses the partial authorities over History, Time, Fate, Change, and Concealment with its corresponding symbol of "Blind Stupidity" within the Mind Domain. Its main effect is turning falsehood into reality.
  • History: "They" are able to Fool History, separating the self of one second from the next. This allows "Them" to swap the past, present, or future conditions of "Themselves", making "Their" past become the present and vice versa.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) Fooled History into swapping "His" past and present condition while in a cage without a fixed "door". The corresponding past state of "Himself" (now as a Historical Projection) was in the cage while "His" present self was outside of it.
  • Time: "They" can Fool Time, confusing the sequence of events, delaying the effects of extraordinary abilities as if breaking free from Time's constraints, moving within a frozen environment through various real or conceptual gaps.
  • Unlike the Error's Time authority, the Fool's Fooling Time does not involve operations like speeding up or slowing down Time. Instead, it disrupts the current manifestation of Time, thereby causing operations that require Time to succeed or fail.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) Fooled Time, confusing its order of events so that Amon's (opens in a new tab) Worms of Time split up at the incorrect timing, allowing Klein (opens in a new tab), to escape.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) Fooled Time, escaping its limitations to freely move within the frozen environment created by Amon's (opens in a new tab) Time authority.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) Fooled Time, allowing for the effects of "His" Grafted star to linger even after the combination was dispelled.
  • Change: "They" are able to induce significant Changes and alter the surrounding environment based on certain concepts.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) Grafted and Fooled the concepts of massive, Extremely High Gravity, Temperature, Heat, and Nuclear Fusion together to Change "His" surroundings into a conceptual star.
  • For a falsehood to be turned into truth, it first needs the said falsehood to exist.
  • If "They" were to turn a fictional character into a real person, the character would need to be created first; only then could "They" make it a reality.
  • "They" can use Fooling to make the falsehood real in order to change their own gender from male to female or vice versa.
  • The authority of Fooling, being the symbol of Blind Stupidity within the Mind Domain, overlaps with the Mind authority of the Visionary, capable of influencing the Minds of living beings and exert some effect within the Mind World.
  • Reassembly (Tampering/Grafting): The authority of Reassembly, born from the interplay of the symbols Change and Bizarreness, forms one of the two core authorities of The Fool.
  • "They" can directly Graft physical objects, entities and abstract concepts: including "Themselves": that originally had no connection, producing Inconceivable yet entirely real effects.
  • The authority of Reassembly can directly act on "concepts" and even "authority" itself.
  • The ability, Damage Transfer, is a subordinate and specialised application of Grafting.
  • At the level of Lord of Mysteries (opens in a new tab), Reassembly is a manifestation of Bizarreness symbolism, while at this level, it's the authority of Change. Simply put, one is a Symbolism and the other is a lower-tier authority manifested from the interplay of Bizarreness and Change symbols.
  • Controller of the Spirit World: Unlike the Door Pathway: which primarily utilises the Spirit World for Travelling: and the Error Pathway: which leverages it for Decryption and influencing the Body of Heart and Mind, the Fool Pathway controls most of the authorities regarding the Spirit World. Thus, "They" can be regarded as a lesser version of the Lord of the Spirit World.
  • Thus, the Fool Pathway can be considered as the core of the Lord of Mysteries's Pathways (opens in a new tab) in matters regarding the Spirit World.
  • The Fool cannot achieve the effect of Sealing off the Spirit World. Only through merging with the Door can "They" accomplish it to some extent.
  • The Fool, to some extent, is able to command the Seven Lights (opens in a new tab) and Angel-level Spirit World creatures through Controller of the Spirit World.
  • When fighting within the Spirit World, the Fool will have natural home ground advantage.
  • Puppetry: A lesser authority created by a low manifestation of the symbols of Bizarreness, Change, and the Dominator of the Spirit World.
  • Regenerating or manipulating Spirit Body Threads are superficial applications of the Spirit World authority. In truth, these authorities are not confined solely to the Spirit World, but also involve lower manifestations of the Bizarreness and Change symbols, making them composite abilities.
  • "They" can turn conceptual beings into "Their" Marionettes. This will work even against the Door when "They" are in "Their" Conceptualisation state.
  • History: "Their" authority of History formed from the fusion of the symbolisms of the King of Space-Time and Bizarreness.
  • Although the past cannot be altered and History has already been established, the Fool can still manipulate History to a certain extent by temporarily Fooling it.
  • Miracles: The Fool's authority over Miracles belongs to the Inconceivable symbolism, which is also known as Bizarreness.
  • Miracles are 'Unexplainable' and 'Incomprehensible': that is why they are called Miracles.
  • The Fool can reset "Their" Resurrection count once, and the upper limit of "Their" Resurrections has increased.
  • Realm of Mysteries (Concealment): "Their" Divine Kingdom is complete; it arises naturally from the fusion of the symbolisms of Bizarreness and the King of Space-Time.
  • Since the Bizarreness symbol is also known as the Inconceivable symbol, it naturally encompasses the concept of the Incomprehensible, meaning it carries a degree of Concealment.
  • The Concealment elements that are present in the Fool's symbolism originate here, representing a manifestation of Bizarreness.
  • Within the Fool's Divine Kingdom, the Realm of Mysteries, there are various objects Tampered with various effects that makes it hard for others to brute force their way into.
  • Klein's (opens in a new tab) Realm of Mysteries contained various doors that were Grafted with many effects. One of them made it where opening it will cause the target to instantly be Teleported into the sea.
  • Anchor of Destiny: This is an authority under the symbolism of the Beacon of Destiny. The Fate of the Anchor of Destiny is exceedingly difficult to alter and unless "They" exercise self-restraint, "Their" words will become one of the nodes in the future development of the River of Fate (opens in a new tab).
  • Whatever "They" say becomes the future, though the manner of its realisation and the ultimate outcome may not necessarily be what "They" intended, and could turn out highly Distorted.
  • Shapeshifting: It is one the authorities that belong to the symbol of Change.

Error Pathway

Sequence 9: Marauder

Description

Marauders are difficult to separate from ordinary bandits or thieves. Perhaps the means available to them are more impressive, but their goal of stealing riches is not for enjoyment or survival - for them, it is more like answering a calling or passion.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: After advancing, they will gain a certain degree of physical improvement.
  • Combat Proficiency: They are good at using short weapons, such as daggers and short swords.
  • Agile Hands: The stability and flexibility of their wrist and fingers have enhanced.
  • This makes their hands known for their speed and agility.

New Abilities

  • Superior Observation: They are be able to directly sense valuable items within a ten meter range, but can't determine where they exactly are.
  • This intuition can be so powerful, that they can sense if there is something valuable in a drawer or cupboard, without actually being capable of seeing what's inside.
  • They can sense if there is a concealed target by sensing the valuables they have.
  • Theft (Stealing): They can easily Steal items from a target's pockets without being detected.

Sequence 8: Swindler

Description

These Beyonders like to take part in committing fraud. They gain enjoyment from swindling.

Traits

  • Charm: They possess strong Charm that makes them more approachable and Charming.
  • The Swindler's Charm makes people believe them easily.
  • Physical Enhancement: They have become much more agile and fast.
  • They are quick in action and fast in speed when executing matters related to their plans.
  • They can somersault out of areas and dodge the Paper Daggers of a Clown.

New Abilities

  • Eloquence: Their Eloquence includes both the simple improvement of speech techniques and the addition of Beyonder effects that make people convinced.
  • "They" use the Spirit World to influence the Body of Heart and Mind.
  • Thought Misdirection: This can be achieved through their Eloquence, as well as be accomplished through their actions, postures, surrounding environment, arrangements, etc.
  • Likewise, a skilled Swindler can Misled others even without using the Beyonders abilities related to Thought Misdirection.
  • Mental Disruption: A Swindler can cause certain hallucinations to be experienced by a target.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Superior Observation: In addition to being used to sense valuables, a Swindler can use their Superior Observation to see a target person's micro-expressions and small movements.
  • Although it is not as powerful as a Spectator, it is enough to grasp the target's mental state.
  • Theft (Stealing): They can Steal some spiritual materials from a shorter distance.
  • However, the premise is that spiritual material interacts with the Spirit World.
  • Hazel Macht (opens in a new tab) had Stolen a spiritual material that was buried under the dirt through the dirt without having to excavate the buried area and getting it herself physically.

Pathway Versions Difference

  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Pathway Version of Sequence 8 Swindler lacks the qualitative transformation of Superior Observation and only gains it upon becoming a Sequence 4 Parasite.
  • When encountering Amon (opens in a new tab), except for gifted Swindlers, such as Lanevus (opens in a new tab), even if "He" is merely pranking without using be Beyonders abilities, they cannot see through it which makes them a target of mockery.

Sequence 7: Cryptologist

New Abilities

  • Decryption: Cryptologists can recreate the truth behind anything related to mysticism or predict the development of events just from bits and scraps of evidence.
  • There are three aspects that make up this ability:
  1. Their ability to observe, associate thoughts, and deduce is improved.
  2. Their own Spiritual Intuition has been massively enhanced.
  3. They gain the mastery of mysticism knowledge.
  • Decryption is not Divination or Prophecy. A Cryptologist needs enough information for deduction and they can’t make wild guesses.
  • They need to be wary as some Decryption efforts may bring attention from high-level beings.
  • They can Decrypt the Honorific Names of Deities, however, they have to respect it.
  • They can Decrypt dreams, Illusions, various mysteries, the location of enemies.
  • They can Decrypt the incantations to activate various charms and Mystical Items (opens in a new tab).
  • They can Decrypt the secrets behind Mystical Items (opens in a new tab) and Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab).
  • Cryptologists are even skilled at Decrypting symbolism.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Superior Observation: It now also includes an additional perception of subtle clues and faint traces.

Pathway Versions Difference

  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Pathway Version does not have this additional enhancement until becoming a Parasite, which results in many Cryptologists having incomplete and insufficiently sharp abilities.

Sequence 6: Prometheus

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They gain additional physique, strength, and speed enhancements.
  • Mental Resistance: They have an increased resistance towards mental Corruption.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Theft (Stealing): From Sequence 6 onward, not only would Theft have its effects and success rate increase, but it would also obtain a deeper level of conceptualization. A Prometheus's Theft can affect Beyonder powers and objects across a distance.
  • Prometheus has two types of Theft:
  1. Within 50 meters radius, A Prometheus can temporarily Steal a target's Beyonder power and use it themselves with proficiency for about 10 minutes. Once they have selected the ability they wish to Steal, by simply flicking their wrists, they detach the ability and cause it to fly towards them swiftly.
  • There are several factors involved when it comes to Stealing powers.
  • The more one understands the target, the easier it is to Steal the specific desired one; the more ignorant one is, the closer it is to random, depending on Luck.
  • Depending on Luck means sensing various colored lights on the target's body and then making a choice.
  • They must be able to locate the corresponding symbols that make up the desired ability, which takes time if they don’t know what to look for.
  • When the target's Sequence is higher than 6, failed results may occur; the further up, the greater the probability of failure.
  • High-Sequence Beyonders can also be Stolen from; however, the probability of success is smaller.
  • Knowledge of the victim's Pathway and the corresponding mysticism is vitally important to increase their chances of a desired Theft.
  • A successful Theft will make their target lose the Stolen power and would need anywhere from a couple of hours to a couple of days to recover.
  • The minimum time to recover will be at least twelve hours.
  • A Stolen ability will continue to function if activated prior to the Theft, preventing it from being a way to stop foreign Beyonder powers.
  • Mental Corruption can be considered a kind of Beyonder power and thus can also be Stolen, albeit at one's own risk.
  1. They can covertly Steal objects from a target within a 50 meter range, or conversely, covertly slip dangerous items into the pockets and hands of their target within the same range.
  • They can Steal more diverse things such as fire.
  • At an unknown Sequence when they can handle it, they will become able to Steal natural phenomena such as Lightning and Torrential Rain.
  • Ownerless objects aren't hard to Steal.
  • Superior Observation: They can directly sense where valuable items are within a 50-meter range, their approximate value, and possible types.
  • Unless there are Beyonder powers of Concealment that can resist this type of perception, no treasure can escape a Prometheus' nose.

Pathway Versions Difference

  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) version lacks the second type of Theft and the transformation of Superior Observation, and its resistance to mental corruption is not enhanced until reaching Sequence 4.

Sequence 5: Dream Stealer (Dreams Thief)

New Abilities

  • Disguise (Theft of Heavenly Secrets): They can Disguise themselves as a follower of a True Deity, bypass defenses, Steal prayer responses, and create all sorts of Ritualistic Magic.
  • In battle, through the use of longer incantations, pre-arrangements, or the Stealing of prayer responses, they can get some kind of enhancement or use some kind of abilities.
  • Harrison (opens in a new tab) completed "Theft of the Secrets of Heaven", accessing certain powers from the Samaritan Woman's Spring.
  • The incantation consisted from two sentences, one sentence was "Steal the secrets of heaven," and the other was unclear at the beginning, ending with "Swift as a decree, be driven."
  • Through Disguising themselves as a follower of a True Deity, a Dream Stealer is able to create Charms of that corresponding True Deity's domain.
  • The higher the intelligence of the corresponding True Deity, the greater the probability for the Disguise to fail.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Theft (Stealing): A Dream Stealer's Theft has become more conceptualized, now allowing them to utilize Theft on thoughts, intentions, languages, knowledge, ideals, attacks, memories, and Dreams within 80 meters range.
  • Though they are unable to enter Dreams, Dream Stealers are able to infuse scenes within the Dream to influence their target's future decisions and actions.
  • This is done by Stealing, storing, and transferring Dreams.
  • Through this they can also disrupt Dream Divination.
  • Thought Usurpation: They can Steal the Thoughts the opponent is about to put into practice, causing them to experience a brief state of dullness.
  • It is possible for the targets to completely miss the fact that Thoughts were Stolen by them, unless if they were to think about it carefully.
  • At this stage, one cannot retain the Stolen thoughts and must instead perform the corresponding action in place of the Stolen target.
  • Mobet Zoroast (opens in a new tab) Stole the King of the North Ulyssan's (opens in a new tab) intention to unleash a breath attack, causing the former to spit and the latter puzzled on what it wanted to do.
  • They can Steal certain general abilities, such as the ability to walk, fly, speak, or even the ability to speak particular language.
  • However, those as well will take one of the Theft slots.
  • Anderson Hood (opens in a new tab) used a Mystical Item (opens in a new tab) related to the Error Pathway to Steal the ability to speak Dutanese (opens in a new tab) language from someone else.
  • They can Steal the attacks targeting them in order to nullify them, and unless the attack itself has a side effect on the user, there won't be any side effect on the Dream Stealer.
  • If Amon (opens in a new tab) hadn’t Stolen the corresponding damage dealt to Klein (opens in a new tab), "He" would've been contaminated by the fog created after Bladel's (opens in a new tab) death.
  • This would make "Him" become a Cursed entity that roams that area.
  • They can Steal a Reaper's Cull or Flame without their body being burned by the Flames.
  • They can Steal Beyonder powers within 80 meter range.
  • The corresponding Stolen Beyonder power can be used for half an hour, but it cannot be used in different time periods.
  • If a Dream Stealer has not yet used the Stolen Beyonder power when they first got it, the power itself can be kept by them for a week.
  • Within that time, the victim of the Theft cannot use the Stolen ability again unless they drink another corresponding Beyonder potion.
  • They can Steal things such as an organ or a fetus from a mother's womb.
  • By Stealing a target's ideal they can make the target lose motivation.
  • Decryption: They are able to Decrypt Bizarro Sorcerer-level Illusions.
  • After the Illusion ended, Hazel Macht (opens in a new tab) reflected on the scenes she witnessed and sensed that something was amiss. She confirmed that she hadn’t been dreaming, nor had it been a brief hallucination caused by her mind drifting. Instead, she was thrown into an Illusion that lasted nearly ten seconds.

Pathway Versions Difference

  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Pathway Version removes Theft of Heavenly Secrets, with it being partial restored at Sequence 4 and complete restored at Sequence 3. They also can't keep the Stolen abilities.
  • However, they regained the second type of Theft that they lacked at Prometheus stage.

Sequence 4: Parasite

Traits

  • As parts of their body have been transformed into Worms, they will not actually die from attacks unless they are hit in a vital part.

New Abilities

  • Parasitism: This is a form of Theft, specifically Theft of Life, a Parasitic Theft at the physical level. Parasites can use their Worms of Time to be a literal leech that can latch onto a target's Spirit Body, turning that target into their host.
  • Parasitism has 2 modes:
  1. Initial Parasitism: They can use the host to hide themselves, extend life, and recover from injuries while being able to perceive everything their host sees and hears but cannot fully Control their host at this stage. This means the host has to speak vocally for communication.
  • This also grants them some level of Concealment abilities as Divinations that are directed at them will instead be obstructed by their host.
  1. Deep-Level Parasitism: They gain full control, nearly merging with the host's Spirit Body, directly hearing their thoughts, understanding their intentions, and being able to actively take over the body; except for the thoughts still belonging to themselves, the host can no longer control anything else.
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar had Parasitised Klein (opens in a new tab), making Klein (opens in a new tab) unable to Control his body or Conceal his thoughts from "Him".
  • Parasitism can be used as a way to extend lifespans or recover from weakness, however switching hosts is energy-consuming, therefore they usually choose hosts that live longer.
  • They prefer Beyonders (opens in a new tab) of the same Pathway, their second choice is the Fool Pathway or Door Pathway because their Beyonder Characteristics can supplement Parasites and help them recover faster.
  • The host can also influence their Parasite through their body structure and hormones.
  • If the host is a normal animal, a Parasite risks being affected: losing auditory speech and forgetting their Identity as a human. In these cases, they must keep talking to humans to prevent losing control.
  • Parasites will always Steal something when emerging from their Parasitised host.
  • Flora Jacob (opens in a new tab), when she emerged from her Parasitic form, Stole Klein's (opens in a new tab) Marionette's Thoughts, Beyonder powers of Air Cannon and Paper Figurine Substitutes, and other items such as his belt, coat, and hat.
  • Depending on the mode, the way of discretely interacting with the host will differ.
  • In the Initial Parasitism, one can respond to the host through Dreams, subconscious dialogue, etc., without worrying about being discovered by the Parasite.
  • This is because the Parasite must rely on the host's senses to perceive things around and cannot sense and read the host's Thoughts.
  • Under Deep-Level Parasitism, there exists no way to bypass the Parasite to talk to the host, but there is a chance for removal
  • By relying on the object of the host's faith, when one opens their heart and prays, the object of faith can discover the existence of the Parasite and give feedback with the help of certain Ritualistic Magic to complete separation or removal of the Parasite from the host's body.
  • Of course, the prerequisite is that the host themselves does not know what will happen, otherwise the Parasite will inevitably be alert and stop it.
  • The time needed and the probability of failure for a Parasite to fully Parasitize a target varies for different Pathways.
  • Parasitizing an Unshadowed would be very difficult, with a high probability of failure. However, this doesn't mean it's impossible.
  • It would take a massive amount of courage for a Parasite to enter the body of a Demigod of the Tail-Devourer Pathway.
  • Avatars: Upon complete digestion, they can separate some of their Beyonder Characteristics and create Avatars which can operate independently from the main body.
  • Avatars and the main body are still the same; however, they can be located in different areas.
  • Low-level Avatars have the ability to use some of their higher Sequence powers. Still, certain matters regarding the use of high Sequence powers would take time.
  • Avatars can absorb Error Pathway Beyonder Characteristics to enhance their level.
  • Creating an Avatar that equals the main body in level could leave the mental state unstable and can make said Avatar rebel against them.
  • However, they are able to set a level limit for "Their" Avatars. Whenever "Their" Avatars reach that limit, they will automatically fracture and create even more Avatars.
  • This effectively prevents any chance of rebellion.
  • Synchronization: A type of Synchronization that was invented by Amon (opens in a new tab), they are able to choose whether or not to synchronize certain information with their Avatars.
  • This might help them to create a ruse at some point in time.
  • The limit of Stolen abilities for the same target is shared between the main body and Avatars.
  • Avatars can be created by separating Beyonder Characteristics or deep Parasitism.
  • At their current level, the number of Avatars they are able to create is pretty small.
  • There is a qualitative difference between a Marionette and an Avatar.
  • For the former, it requires the utilization of Spirit Body Threads and is something fundamentally distinct while for the latter is something that relies on oneself.
  • Having Avatars Steal at the same time as the main body increases the chance of a successful Theft. The more Avatars there are, the better the result
  • With high numbers, achievable at higher Sequences, as long as they weren’t extremely unlucky, there would always be a few who would’ve succeeded.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Decryption: Their ability as a Cryptologist has been drastically enhanced. Whether it be through evidence or observation, they can expertly track others through the clues they reveal.
  • Flora Jacob (opens in a new tab) Decrypted the mystery about Klein's (opens in a new tab) Location, finding him quickly.
  • Theft (Stealing): Their Theft has been fundamentally enhanced. A Parasite can now can Steal general abilities on large scale, and conceptual things like position, distance, or the different aspects of Life, thus being able to achieve unbelievable effects in combat.
  • They are now able to relatively accurately Steal desired abilities from a target, generally choosing one out of three, the more one understands, the higher the probability of success.
  • The number of abilities that can be Stolen from the same target has increased from one to three, but only one can be Stolen at a time.
  • Stolen Beyonder powers, regardless of the targeted Beyonders' status or level, will remain usable to a Parasite for about 2 hours.
  • If the Theft target's level is lower than them, and they have a deep grasp of the target's situation, a Parasite can Steal whatever is desired
  • Due to the symbolism of Inconceivable, Theft has the effect of making Stealing from clones, such as Marionettes, Avatars, etc, is considered as Stealing from the main body, which will cause abilities from the main body to be Stolen as well.
  • Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) was an exception due to the blessings of the Sefirah Castle (opens in a new tab). A normal Beyonder from the Fool Pathway needs to be at least an Attendant of Mysteries to be able to regain their abilities via Marionette Interchange.
  • However, at a similar level Theft will also experience a qualitative change of its own.
  • They can perform large-scale Thefts, Stealing multiple things or abilities at the same time.
  • Flora Jacob (opens in a new tab) Stole Klein's (opens in a new tab) Marionettes’ ability to walk and use certain Beyonder abilities.
  • At this level, they can keep the Stolen items for a long time, and can control the items they Steal and make them appear at a suitable time.
  • Thought Usurpation: They are now able to Steal the Thoughts and ideas of others without having to act out the corresponding actions.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) repeatedly brought along items and Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) "He" Stole from other people.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) Stole Klein (opens in a new tab)'s Thoughts of suicide, without doing the follow-up actions.
  • Their Theft now could be applied on the different aspects of Life as well.
  • This allows them to Steal living beings' organs, like someone's heart.
  • They are now able to Steal at least 500 meters of Distance and Position.
  • Flora Jacob (opens in a new tab) Stole Gehrman Sparrow (opens in a new tab) Marionettes' Position, replacing each other Position.
  • Flora Jacob (opens in a new tab) Stole the Distance between her and Klein (opens in a new tab), instantly appearing beside him.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 4 Demigod they receive some level of Godhood, and with it comes an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). The small worms with 8 circles, transparent rings, and three-dimensional patterns as though time is swirling through it are called Worms of Time.
  • Parasites can divide Worms of Time from their own Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab).
  • They can kill these maggots and wait for the minute Beyonder Characteristics to be released, then use the carcasses to contain power that is bestowed by a high-level existence.
