  • Through this, they are able to use the carcasses of their Worms of Time as high-level materials to create various charms and special bullets.
  • This fractures their own Spirit Body, dealing considerable damage and making them unable to do this frequently unless they want death.
  • If they lose too much Worms of Time they are able to recover by absorbing the Beyonder Characteristics of the Error Pathway.

Pathway Versions Difference

  • In Amon's (opens in a new tab) Pathway Version, though they get the previous Beyonder abilities they were lacking, they didn't get all the corresponding information about their abilities while some remain incomplete.

Sequence 3: Mentor of Deceit

TRANSLATION NOTE

"欺瞒" (Qīmán, lit: "Deceit", WebNovel translation: "Deceit" and "Lying") is the term used in the Chinese version of the novel to refer to the Mentor of Deceit's ability.

"欺诈" (Qīzhà, lit: "Fraud", WebNovel translation: "Deceit", "Deception", "Manipulation" and "Cheating") is the term used in the Chinese version of the novel to refer to the Sequence 0: Error's authority and Lord of Mysteries (opens in a new tab)' symbolism.

Authorities

  • Deceit: A Mentor of Deceit is a more profound version of a Swindler as their Deceit now extends to more abstract concepts and rules of reality. This is a lesser Deceit authority.
  • They are masters of Deceit and trickery and can Deceive people very easily by using their enemies' problems and weaknesses.
  • Against Mentors of Deceit one will fall before uncountable tricks, make Errors in judgements, be misled from the truth and the right choices, and ignore obvious problems.
  • Qonas Kligor's (opens in a new tab) body, under the effect of Deceit, didn't realise the fact that he had already escaped from the Parasitised state, therefore his body didn't obey his orders.
  • Qonas Kilgor (opens in a new tab), under Deceit, had unknowingly entered the range where his Spirit Body Threads could be controlled by Klein (opens in a new tab) for around 3 seconds.
  • Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) didn't realise the issues with Amon's (opens in a new tab) self-proclaimed "Half-Mad" state until it was too late, effectively being Deceived.
  • Their voices are filled with a persuasive power that makes them able to easily Deceive their enemies, gaining trust and belief in their words without much of thinking about it.
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar words to Flora Jacob (opens in a new tab) made Klein (opens in a new tab), who the words were not even addressed to, find extremely reasonable, forgetting the true reason for coming to the forest.
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar made Flora Jacob (opens in a new tab), who was on the verge of losing control, calm down, follow, listen, and become persuaded by his words.
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar Deceived Flora Jacob (opens in a new tab) so she couldn't realise the potential problems he'll bring to her with his actions.
  • They are able to create various tricks and plans that are very hard to not to fall for and are very difficult to know the true meanings (if there is any) behind.
  • Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) didn't realise the problems with Amon (opens in a new tab) talking about the hidden history a lot and the real intentions behind "His" actions in the Forsaken Land of Gods (opens in a new tab).
  • They can Manipulate the laws of nature, the rules of the world, and the mystical connections surrounding all.
  • Using false Information is a way of Deception, but it's not the entirety.
  • It's like an Error that violates the laws of nature.
  • They can extend an **Unaging's** death to their body, Mirror selves, and dormant Mirrors, however, this has a certain risk of failure.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) Deceived the rules of the Pride mask (opens in a new tab), allowing him to enter the Garden of Eden (opens in a new tab).
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) Deceived a lantern, allowing it to emit light without needing fuel for a week.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) constructed the Sea Prayer Ritual (opens in a new tab) to constantly siphon power via Deceit.
  • Pallez Zoroast (opens in a new tab) Deceived Gehrman Sparrow's (opens in a new tab) destination to change it.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Superior Observation: Mentors of Deceit are able to directly discern a target's weaknesses, which they can then use to trick their opponents.
  • The actions of others can quickly expose their problems in the eyes of a Mentor of Deceit, making it easy for them to mislead their enemies into making Errors in their judgement.
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar, only from Klein's (opens in a new tab) action of turning only insects and animals into Marionettes, was able to determine Klein's (opens in a new tab) weaknesses and take the most appropriate action against him, so "He" could easily mentally break the latter down.
  • Mentors of Deceit are not only able to see a target's mental state and problems but are also able to sense the changes in the order and rules.
  • Theft (Stealing): Their ability to Steal has been marginally enhanced.
  • They are now able to Steal three Beyonder powers in 1 attempt.
  • A Mentor of Deceit can increase the accuracy of their Theft by Stealing the last three Beyonder powers their target has used, beginning with the most recent power.
  • Disguise (Theft of Heavenly Secrets): In combat, they can now rely on incantations or arrangements to Steal Blessings or gain Beyonder abilities of corresponding True Deities.
  • The lower the True Deities' intelligence, the higher the likelihood of success.
  • Avatars: They have mastered the ability of creating Avatars.
  • The number of Avatars they can create has experienced a qualitative change.

Mythical Creature Form

  • At this level, their Worms of Time have transparent rings that have many three-dimensional patterns as though Time is swirling through them.
  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can listen to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Trojan Horse of Destiny (Fate Stealer)

New Abilities

  • Loopholes: "They" can exploit the Loopholes within the world's order and rules, creating all sorts of strange and terrifying effects that are very hard to deal with.
  • Everything is relative, and all of them have Loopholes. No Beyonder power is uncrackable and those Loopholes can be exploited in any suitable situation.
  • Tampering with another person’s Fate, making certain Errors appear within a certain period of time, is an exploitation of a certain Loophole in Fate.
  • "They" can find the Loopholes within Fate, thus allowing "Them" to break through Destined / Inevitable states.)
  • "They" can exploit a Loophole that allows "Them" to consume Lower Sequence Beyonder Characteristics from adjacent Pathways without a severe increase in madness.
  • "They" can exploit a Loophole that uses the expiration of the Envisioned objects, so as to also become a figment of Imagination to leave the surroundings.
  • If two Doors created from the Door Pathway have enough similarities, "They" can use one of the Doors to reach the other side of the other Door.
  • Without "Their" ability to sense the changes in Order and rules, there is no way for "Them" to accurately find and exploit the Loopholes of the world.

Authorities

  • Destiny: "They" gain partial authority over Destiny, derived from the Beacon of Destiny symbolism.
  • "They" can sense subtle changes in "Their" Destiny and ripples generated by Fate, making "Them" able to detect the actions and incidents which "They" are a part or centre.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) can use the deaths of "His" Avatars to see the corresponding changes in Destiny; thus, finding the source of the stir and figuring out the activity range of the mastermind.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) had said that if Klein (opens in a new tab) had worn the monocle over his right eye with the intention of imitating "Him", "He" would have been able to notice.
  • "They" are able to become immediately aware of any sudden abnormalities hidden within "Their" Fate and Destiny or that of the region "They" are currently in.
  • Pallez Zoroast (opens in a new tab) was able to feel the abnormalities that happen in the Fate of the area, taking countermeasures against Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar that attacked Klein (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can tinker with the Destiny of other beings, making certain Errors appear within it.
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar made it so no one could notice Klein's (opens in a new tab) intentions to seek help, be it through the creation of various commotions or prior agreements that were set by Klein (opens in a new tab).
  • Even if Klein (opens in a new tab) were to use Evernight's (opens in a new tab) emblem, it will only cast Concealment and not transmit his intentions of seeking help. Even creating an explosion will not make the pedestrians and servants in the room nearby hear a thing.
  • "They" can bore through Fate and alter it, creating deviations in Prophecies.
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar caused a deviation of 1 to 2 days for Will Auceptin's (opens in a new tab) Prophecy.
  • "They" might gain a premonition about if certain actions or things will be very useful for "Them" at certain point in the future.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) didn’t finish off Jacob family (opens in a new tab) descendants, because "He" had a premonition that the treasure trove would be very useful later. After a thousand years, "He" ended up getting the last Worm of Time Beyonder Characteristic (opens in a new tab) because of it.
  • "They" can sense the changes of others' Fate such as Luck changes.
  • Theft (Stealing): "They" wield partial authority over Theft with "Them" now able to Steal various aspects of Fate, connections, identity, self-awareness and Beyonder Characteristics.
  • "They" can invade and permanently Steal the identity and Destiny of a person, and most will not realise that the person has changed without deep observation. Through this, the target would be left without a Fate, becoming disconnected from reality, unlucky, while also slowly dying.
  • Stealing the Fate, identity, and self-awareness of a high-level target simultaneously triggers an identity crisis, stemming from conflict between "Them" and the target's self-awareness.
  • This sort of problem is similar to devouring a high level Beyonder Characteristic that contains a strong mental imprint.
  • This Theft grants "Them" all the information, memories, and experiences of the target, and renders all abilities directed at "Their" original identity ineffective.
  • If "They" were to Steal someone's Fate and identity that also entails experiencing all that their Fate encompasses, be it fortunate or calamitous.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) personally Stole Termiboros's (opens in a new tab) identity, allowing "Him" to gain "His" Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristic; however, at the same time Amon (opens in a new tab) had to possess Termiboros's (opens in a new tab) Fate, which was being Sealed inside Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab).
  • Fate Siphoning: "They" can siphon off the Fate between two creatures in a short time, and when the Fate Siphoning is done, it's akin to the swapping of Fates.
  • "They" don't need to go fully with the exchange and can instead transfer the target's future Fate to "Themself" or transfer a shorter personal future Fate onto a target.
  • Audrey (opens in a new tab) used the Fate Siphon (opens in a new tab) Charm to siphon off the Fate of being Hypnotised by Hvin Rambis (opens in a new tab) between her and him, making Hvin Rambis (opens in a new tab) be Hypnotised by Audrey (opens in a new tab).
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Painting siphoned off the Fate between Overseer Perle's (opens in a new tab) Painting and Lumian (opens in a new tab), making Lumian's (opens in a new tab) Fate to fall asleep affect Perle's (opens in a new tab) Painting instead of him.
  • "They" are able to directly Steal Beyonder Characteristics from others.
  • Even if the target stopped resisting and actively cooperated, Stealing the highest Sequence Beyonder Characteristics from another would still take significant time and carry a notable risk of failure. Moreover, it required an exceptionally high level of authority.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) Stole Medici's (opens in a new tab) two Conqueror Beyonder Characteristics, lowering Medici (opens in a new tab) Sequence from King of Angels (opens in a new tab) to a mere Angel (opens in a new tab).
  • Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) Stole an Attendant of Mysteries Beyonder Characteristics from "Himself" to begin "His" Apotheosis Ritual (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" are able to use this speciality of the Error Pathway in order to lower "Their" Sequence level whenever "They" need to through the process of creating Avatars and giving "Their" unwanted Beyonder Characteristics to it.
  • Completing a Fate and identity Theft before attempting to Steal a target's Beyonder Characteristics will make the Theft success in a few tries, even if the target's level is much higher than "Them".
  • "They" are able to Steal the mystical connections between a Beyonder and any external power source, preventing the Stolen target from accessing said power source.
  • Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) Stole Evil Spirit Sasrir's (opens in a new tab) mystical connection to the Blasphemy Slate (opens in a new tab), and thus "His" connection to the Chaos Sea (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can Steal Spirit Body Threads, and with Deceit, make it so that any attempt at manipulating "Their" Spirit Body Threads will instead affect the Stolen Spirit Body Threads.
  • This is a counter to the Fool Pathway's Spirit Body Threads Manipulation.
  • Parasitism: "They" can split off "Their" Worms of Time and invade "Their" targets in a concealed manner through Spirit Body Threads. This is a more unavoidable form of Parasitism.
  • "They" can Parasitise a Sealed Artifact (opens in a new tab) with living characteristics, significantly reducing the negative effects and making it obedient.
  • "They" can Steal up to 6 Beyonder powers from a single target in only one attempt, and they will still be usable for a week after the activation.
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar stole 6 Beyonder powers from Sequence 4 Klein (opens in a new tab) in 1 attempt.
  • Deceit: "They" can Deceive and misdirect mysticism laws, even the ones that Angels (opens in a new tab) are forced to obey, "They" can also use Theft together with Deceit.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab), by using Sefirah Castle (opens in a new tab) to complete Trojan Horse of Destiny level Deceit, Deceived the rules of "His" revival needing to be a certain range around "His" corpse, misdirecting and Deceiving the rules into thinking that his blood is "His" corpse.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Avatars: The nature of "Their" Avatars have been enhanced, now possessing the traits of Angels (opens in a new tab), such as being capable of shattering Beyonder Characteristics.
  • "They" can use "Their" Avatars to gather and consume Beyonder Characteristics, which can return to the main body, making them become even stronger.
  • By the same mechanism, the Avatars can use the strongest one as the centre and automatically gather together to achieve an elevation in strength.
  • Avatars can be used to bypass certain limitations of abilities due to "Their" nature.
  • Although it is very dangerous as switching Pathways within the same Sequence would inevitably lead to a half semi-madness state, it is theoretically possible for a Trojan Horse of Destiny who is also a Miracle Invoker to quickly accumulate Wishes by continuously creating Avatars through manipulating or absorbing Beyonder Characteristics, making Wishes upon them, and then repeating the same Wish in battle.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form is now complete. It's called the Worm of Time.

Pathway Versions Difference

  • From this Sequence onward, there are no differences between Pathway Versions.

Sequence 1: Worm of Time

Description

The dark side of Time, the Loophole in Time.

Authorities

  • Theft (Stealing): At this level, "They" can temporarily Steal Time, anchors, and authorities.
  • "They" can Steal the different aspects of Time to achieve unbelievable effects:
  • Aging: "They" can cause the target to lose a significant amount of lifespan, increasing "Their" own lifespan in the process while having the target enter an Aged state.
  • What is Stolen is purely the duration of survival, which does not grant growth to the target. This means Aging only reduces the predetermined years of life, with accelerated Aging being a symbolic manifestation of the Theft of lifespan.
  • As such, if a Worm of Time were to Steal the lifespan of a baby, the baby would only rapidly Age and die and not grow up.
  • Dying of old Age is something that the majority of Resurrection abilities cannot take effect against.
  • A Miracle Invoker's Resurrection is an example of one that can reset Age.
  • "They" can Steal an amount of Time from a target, making certain processes take longer.
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar Stole a general amount of Klein's (opens in a new tab) Time, making "His" convergence to Pallez Zoroast (opens in a new tab) be slower, but the process couldn't be fully interrupted.
  • If "They" "gift" back Stolen Time, "They" can reverse the state of the target.
  • "They" can Steal general Time periods like Day and Night.
  • If both Day and Night were Stolen simultaneously this will results in a state of chaos.
  • "They" can directly Steal the anchors of Beyonders through certain Loopholes, granting "Them" the stability provided through its prayers.
  • While this type of Theft is normally of little value, it is very useful at the critical moment of an advancement or apotheosis ritual, the sudden decrease in anchors would tip the balance of advancing Beyonders and make them lose control on the spot.
  • When "They" Steal authorities, "They" Steal it completely.
  • For example, if "They" were to Steal the authority of Change from an Attendant of Mysteries, "They" would Steal all the abilities associated with Change as well as Grafting itself.
  • "They" can Steal a Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) from a target who accommodated it.
  • This type of Theft will take countless failures in order to succeed, unless "They" were previously able to Steal target's corresponding Fate first.
  • "They" can Steal some traits of Sefirot.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) Stole certain traits of the Chaos Sea (opens in a new tab), and later “He” released this Stolen trait to attract the Blasphemy Slate (opens in a new tab), to Steal it before the True Creator (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can Steal the power of Convergence.
  • "They" can Steal any Distance within "Their" perception.
  • Time: "They" have a weakened authority over Time, derived from the King of Space-Time symbolism.
  • "They" can summon a phantom of huge ancient stone clock whose hands on the clock are "Their" Worms of Time. With it, "They" can alter Time and choose whether or not to affect certain objects within range to avoid friendly fire.
  • "They" can slow down Time, even to the point of stopping it. It'll also slow down the movement of the torrents of the River of Fate (opens in a new tab) to a point of almost completely stillness.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) slowed Time, making everything in "His" surroundings slow down, allowing "Him" to interfere with Arianna's (opens in a new tab) attack on Klein (opens in a new tab) as well as slowing Zaratul (opens in a new tab) down.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) used 0-62 (opens in a new tab) to Replicate Amon's (opens in a new tab) Beyonder authority of Time, causing the freezing of a lightning sea created by Sasrir's (opens in a new tab) Evil Spirit (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can speed up Time within the area.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) accelerated Time, making the surroundings lose ten to twenty seconds in a second which also lowered the Time that Klein's (opens in a new tab) Historical Projections could operate.
  • "They" can reverse Time, but only briefly.
  • This reverses the flow of Time itself, unlike a Snake of Mercury who only overwrites the current state of Fate and cannot reverse Time.
  • Pallez Zoroast (opens in a new tab) reversed Time on Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab), making Klein (opens in a new tab) regain his lifespan that was stolen by one of Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatars.
  • "They" have a certain degree of control over History.
  • A Worm of Time is able to make the Fog of History take the form of a 'curtain', which projects the recent events that have happened in the area. The things "They" are able to see in this greyish-white fog 'curtain' takes the form of pictures.
  • Pallez Zoroast (opens in a new tab) displayed the recent events in Lake Dalsh (opens in a new tab) to know what Oxyto (opens in a new tab) was trying to hide with his actions before his escape.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Decryption: "They" are capable of Decrypting almost any mystery and the most symbolic meanings within various things, recreating the truths behind them if "They" have sufficient evidence.
  • Pallez Zoroast (opens in a new tab) was able to Decrypt some of the symbolic meaning of Lumian's dream (opens in a new tab) to a certain degree, though "He" was unable to Decrypt it fully because of insufficient evidence.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) was able to Decrypt the mystery behind the reason why "His" connection to his Avatars had cut off, just through finding one piece of evidence.
  • Avatars: "They" can divide or make "Their" Avatars absorb Error Pathway Beyonder Characteristics to have their level and strength increase up to Sequence 2 without fearing any issues.
  • In the advent of a Worm of Time's death, a Sequence 2 Avatar can turn into "Them" by Stealing the main body's Spirit Body, consciousness, and psyche.
  • Loopholes: Whenever there are a Time limit or requirement, "They" have an exploitable Bug.
  • "They" are able to find exploitable Loopholes within the Inevitability formed by the Circle of Inevitability (opens in a new tab), however, "They" will need time to find said Loopholes.
  • "They" are able to exploit certain Loopholes within Historical Projections in order to slow down the rate at which those projections dissipate.

Sequence 0: Error (Bug)

Description

A Bug, once translated, it's: The Trojan Horse of Destiny, The Worm that Erodes Time, The Loopholes in Rules, The Manifestation of all Errors.

Symbolism

  • As a Pathway under the Lord of Mysteries (opens in a new tab), the best and most proficient at utilizing symbolism, "They" can use surface-level symbolism application of "Their" authorities.

Authorities

  • Error (Bug/Loopholes): An authority born from the interplay of Error, Change, and Inconceivable symbols. "They" are the Loopholes in rules, the embodiment of all Errors in the world. Thus, "They" can fix all and create Errors within everything of a normal or abnormal nature.
  • If the authority of Error were to take effect at the same level, it would often have different preconditions. Once an Error is created, it would be very difficult to fully defend against or completely terminate its effects when compared to Fooling.
  • The following preconditions include, but are not limited to:
  1. The medium and target had to be similar enough.
  2. There is a certain connection between the two.
  3. There are certain logical contradictions between certain matters or objects.
  4. Some of the rules are indeed incomplete.
  5. While not directly affecting the target, construct an Erroneous environment as a Divine Kingdom.
  • "They" can Steal certain authorities or permissions of the imitated object by Substituting the false for the real.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) released the suppression of the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings (opens in a new tab) imprint on "His" body, satisfying the first category from the conditions, allowing "Him" to effectively become an owner of the Sefirah Castle (opens in a new tab).
  • With the combination of the Door and Error authority, as well as releasing the suppression of the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings (opens in a new tab) on "His" body, Amon (opens in a new tab) was able to enter the Sefirah Castle (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can avoid enemy attacks by creating Loopholes.
  • "They" can create a Loophole to separate "Themselves" from the real world, allowing "Them" to avoid damage in the real world. At the same time, "They" cannot interact with reality.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) borrowed the Error authority to avoid Amon's (opens in a new tab) Space Destruction attack.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) used the Error authority to avoid Bladel's (opens in a new tab) Twilight Sword attack.
  • "They" can formulate an Error within "Themselves" to let "Their" shadow replace "Themselves", allowing "Their" true body to remain unharmed from most forms of damage.[[64]](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Error_Pathway/Abilities#cite_note-1.1383-64)
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) used the Error authority to avoid various attacks from Klein (opens in a new tab).
  • "If "They" are attacked by multiple enemies simultaneously, "They" can induce an Error, misdirecting those attacks toward another target, resulting in friendly fire.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) redirected the attacks of the Historical Projections forms of Arianna (opens in a new tab), Roselle (opens in a new tab), Zaratul (opens in a new tab), and Antigonus (opens in a new tab) to the Red of War member possessed by Medici (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can exploit the Law of Similarity by creating Bugs, using Loopholes, or turning falsehood into truth, causing various effects to be imposed on all affected entities.
  • "They" can make an Avatar replace "Themselves" by substituting falsehood with truth, thereby swapping positions.
  • This is similar to the swapping of Marionettes of the **Fool** domain, but at this level, the principles were different. It wouldn’t be interrupted in most situations.
  • By creating a Bug, "They" can make it so that attacking a Substitute is equivalent to attacking the true body.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) Parasitized Klein's (opens in a new tab) Paper Figurine Substitute then created a Bug so that the Substitute getting Parasitized is equivalent to Klein getting Parasitized.
  • By creating an Error, "They" can make Parasitizing a conscious Historical Projection equal to Parasitizing the main body.
  • The principal behind this is: Even if the body is merely a Historical Projection, for the Error, if a Historical Projection is Parasitized, this means the original was also Parasitized, and If the past self is Parasitized, how could the present self possibly avoid it? it's inevitable for the present to be affected by the past.
  • Under certain circumstances, if someone admitted something as a truth, even if it was for a short period and it was nothing but a lie, The Error can turn it into a truth, creating corresponding mystical connection that can be exploited.
  • An unknown Demon acknowledged his name to be Naboredisley (opens in a new tab), and regardless of whether this name was his or not, before Mr. Fool's (opens in a new tab) Error authority, "He" was exorcised using the mystical connection brought by this self-proclaimed name.
  • Using a Loophole, "They" can turn the escape of the true body into the escape of all Avatars.
  • After using the Door's authority to leave, Amon (opens in a new tab) turned the act of “Amon’s (opens in a new tab) true body leaving” to being equivalent to “Amons leaving.”
  • "They" can exploit a Loophole to avoid the negative effects of "Their" Avatars from acting on "Their" actual body.
  • However, the Avatars "Themselves" could still be affected by the connection between each others, as "Their" level can't reach Sequence 0.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab), relying on such a Loophole, avoided the effect of Blind Stupidity on "His" actual body after affecting an Avatar.
  • "They" can elevate profound mystical connections into one akin to that between an Avatar and its true body, or oneself and oneself, even Great Old Ones are not exempt from this.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) used the firm and close connection between the Black Emperor, Nation of Disorder (opens in a new tab), Genie (opens in a new tab), and Uncertain Mist (opens in a new tab) such that severely injuring the weak Genie (opens in a new tab) would be equivalent to severely injuring the powerful Uncertain Mist (opens in a new tab).
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) reconstructed the mystical connection and symbolisms of the Chained Uniqueness, causing the Ravings and Curses that affected the Tenebrous World (opens in a new tab) to be transferred onto the Mother Tree of Desire (opens in a new tab).
  • As the embodiment of Errors, "They" can effectively restrain the Hermit's authority over Backups.
  • This is due to the nature of Information undergoing loss, degradation, Errors, and chaos in the process of repeated Backups.
  • By creating a Loophole, "They" can travel using the Dreams of other creatures.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab), using the chaotic nature of Sea of Ruins (opens in a new tab) to satisfy the needed condition, created a Loophole to travel quickly using the Dreams there.
  • By using an Error, "They" can separate 2 of "Their" own Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics from "Their" main body to create Sequence 1 Avatars.
  • Under a chaotic situation, The Error could play many tricks. It is even possible that "They" will be able to find weaknesses in an instant and bypass any obstacle.
  • If a target respond to "Their" prayers, "They" can locate it then directly use an Error to appear besides the target.
  • "Their" Divine Kingdom is an Erroneous environment, which is not direct Divine Kingdom like a Red Priest but instead rules-based like that of a Fool's or Door's Divine Kingdom.
  • Deceit: "They" hold the authority of Deceit.
  • For a master of Deceit, if "They" were to go mad, lacking rationality to restrain oneself and making "Their" actions more instinctive, that would be fatal.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) had completely Deceived Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) about "His" plans, leaving the latter having no way to realise the Deception until it was too late.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) had Deceived the Sefirah Castle (opens in a new tab) in order to fulfil and create the corresponding requirement to complete the creation of a Bug.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) had Deceived the rules, lied to "Himself", guiding "His" instincts into certain acts to resist the authority of Blind Stupidity.
  • Theft (Stealing): The authority of Theft, one of the core authorities of the Error Pathway, created from the main symbol of Theft together with symbol of Inconceivable. When an Error faces a True Deity, “They” could also use Theft that had reached the level of authority.
  • It now has reached a deeper level of conceptualization; being able to Steal more specific aspects of a concept as well as have a higher success rate on most matters.
  • "He" can now Steal more abstract concepts like someone's childhood and teenage phases, allowing that person to instantly grow up, a feat "He" couldn't do as a Worm of Time.
  • The Eternal Slumber of Darkness can be Stolen and Gifted.
  • Decryption: Stemming from the Spirit World, "Their" power to Decrypt is massively improved, allowing "Them" to crack the secrets of many things from a tiny amount of information.
  • "They" are able to instantly sense the secrets and general traits of environments "They" enter.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) cracked the secrets and found Loopholes in the **Fool’s** (opens in a new tab) Divine Kingdom from the information "He" gained from just 2 attempts of breaking into it.
  • In addition, "He" fully Decrypted Klein's (opens in a new tab) reasons for constructing a Divine Kingdom.
  • Puppetry: A lesser authority created by a low manifestation of the symbols of Bizarreness, Change, and the Dominator of the Spirit World.
  • "They" can create at least two Sequence 1 level Avatars.
  • Theoretically, similar to before, The Error can create a Sequence 1 Avatar by gathering several Error Pathway Beyonder Characteristics until an Avatar possesses the status of a Worm of Time without needing to separate the relevant characteristics.
  • Time: "They" have an authority over Time, derived from the King of Space-Time.
  • Space: "They" have partial authority over Space.
  • This is because Space-Time authorities cannot be completely separated.

Door Pathway

Sequence 9: Apprentice

Description

An Apprentice's abilities are rather strange. Apprentices pursue the footprints of freedom and are rarely trapped and very difficult to stop. They are often able to escape from situations and pass through obstacles every time.

New Abilities

  • Door Opening: Apprentices possess the ability to Open some things related to Doors.
  • Using the unique traits of the Spirit World, an Apprentice can phase through walls and other big obstacles by Opening a symbolic, incorporeal Door.
  • The premise is that there are no restrictions from Beyonder powers present and that the barriers an Apprentice is phasing through is not too thick.
  • In terms of mysticism definitions, as long as the barrier can still be called a wall in the conventional human understanding, it is not considered too thick.
  • Apprentices are not able to bring other people with them while using this ability, but can bring the things that are currently on their body.
  • Even if an Apprentice's connection to the Spirit World is blocked, they are still able to use Door Opening to accomplish this feat.
  • They can Open any lock which doesn’t contain mystical powers, as well as a small number of locks that are reinforced with Beyonder effects.

Sequence 8: Trickmaster

New Abilities

  • Trickmasters wield all kinds of strange but relatively weak Spells and Spell-like abilities which are more about performing tricks than defeating enemies.
  • Gas Transfer: This Spell lets them Transfer toxic or harmful gases away or to a place where they are needed, with the Transfer destination not exceeding 15 meters from the Trickmaster.
  • Flash: This Spell is not usually used not to illuminate the environment but to affect others’ vision, with a Flash intensity several times more dazzling than old-fashioned flash cameras.
  • Escape Trick: They can use a combination of props, Loud Noises, Black Curtains, or Flashes to divert the target’s attention, which lets them quickly move themselves around.
  • This is a lesser form of Blink.
  • Tumble: This Spell makes a 5-6 meter radius area act as if coated with grease, causing people to slip and fall, or it could make a designated target’s footing slip directly.
  • Object Manipulation: Trickmasters can move or bounce designated objects within a 5 meters but are unable to perform more precise operations with them.
  • Electric Shock: Through a medium, they can create an Electric Shock with an intensity similar to non-high-voltage electric shocks in modern society.
  • Freezing: This Spell creates a rapid cooling effect, creating frost or thin ice. This can also be transmitted through palm contact or in a ray form.
  • The ray form of this Spell has a speed close to that of an arrow and has an effective range no more than 10 meters .
  • Loud Noise: This creates a massive sound out of nowhere, which can be used to fake explosions or disrupt enemies’ attention and hearing.
  • Black Curtain: Like a magician, a Trickmaster is able to create a lightless curtain out of thin air that can be used to Conceal objects.
  • Burning: Through rubbing their fingers, a Trickmaster can use this Spell to ignite and Burn objects within a 3 meter range.
  • Fog: Trickmasters are able to use this Spell to generate Fog all around them within an effective range of 15 meters.
  • Wind: With this Spell, Trickmasters are able to manifest a Wind with a force level equivalent to a level 7 or 8 gale.

Sequence 7: Astrologer

Traits

  • Spirituality: An Astrologer's Spirituality will get greatly enhanced upon drinking this potion.
  • Spiritual Intuition: Their Spiritual Intuition has also been greatly improved.
  • They can use this Intuition to consult their own Spirituality for Divination.
  • This allows an Astrologer the ability to experience premonitions of danger.

New Abilities

  • Interference: They can interfere with others' Divination and Spiritual Intuition.
  • Astrology: An Astrologer is able to use a Crystal Ball for Divination.
  • They are able to utilize a Crystal Ball to recall their own past memories. The way this operates is extremely similar to that of a Dream Divination.
  • By overlapping the silhouettes of 2 people, even if they are disguised, Astrologers can determine whether or not they are the same person.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Door Opening: Their ability to phase into obstacles have been enhanced.
  • Astrologers can now bring other people with them when phasing through obstacles.
  • They can open a tiny Door in a wall in order to see the inside of a room.

Sequence 6: Scribe

New Abilities

  • Recording: After witnessing a Beyonder power, Scribes can attempt to Record its mystical symbols, patterns, and labels: storing them for a single use if they succeed.
  • In principle, this ability uses their Soul as a pen and their Spirit Body as the paper to function.
  • Recording/Replication is different compared to the  ![White Tower Symbol2|26 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/White_Tower_Pathway) White Tower Pathway's Imitation.
  • If we use a computer analogy, Recording and Replication are equivalent to a "copy-paste" operation, whereas Imitation is equivalent to reverse-engineering the code yourself and writing a similar version from scratch.
  • There are several limitations to a Record but they will lessen as they digest the potion.
  • The probability of successfully Recording is not guaranteed for powers above Sequence 6.
  • The higher the Sequence the power is, the less likely it is to successfully Record it. Sequence 4 powers may not be able to be Recorded even after attempting 10 times.
  • At this level, the chances of successfully Recording an Angel-level Beyonder power is extremely low: nearly impossible.
  • The number of powers they can Record is limited, which increases with digestion.
  • They are initially limited to 1 Beyonder power at the Demigod-level, 8 Beyonder powers for Sequence 5-6, and 20 Beyonder powers for Sequence 7-9.
  • After complete digestion of the potion, a Scribe will be able to Record 2 Beyonder powers at the Demigod-level.
  • Recording can only be used on active Beyonder powers, not passive ones.
  • The effects of Recorded Beyonder powers will be weaker than the original.
  • Demigod-level Beyonder powers will be halved at best. Sequence 5 and 6 Beyonder powers will have more than 50% of their original strength, while Sequence 7 and lower Beyonder powers will be almost as powerful as the original Beyonder power itself.
  • When a power originating at Sequence 7 is demonstrated by a Sequence 5 Beyonder and Recorded in a Sequence 7 slot, it will manifest at the Sequence 6 level.
  • When Recording is used, the spell "I came, I saw, I recorded" will appear.

Sequence 5: Traveler

New Abilities

  • Positioning: Travelers are able to identify where they exactly are; however, no matter how good the Navigation is, it is still limited by the Traveler using it.
  • Travelers have an intuitive sense of direction while they are in the Spirit World, allowing them to never get lost or accidentally get injured when they come out.
  • Traveler's Door (Door of Teleportation, Traveling): They can open a Door to the Spirit World and Travel there while still sensing the real world. This gives them a form of long distance Teleportation.
  • The longer the distance, the less instantaneous Traveling will be. In addition, the maximum range they can Travel depends on their Sequence and Spirit Body's strength.
  • Similar to Door Opening, other individuals are able to Travel with a Traveler if they were to come into physical contact with them when they are Traveling.
  • If their connection to the Spirit World is severed, they will no longer be able to Travel.
  • In this scenario, Travelers are still able to utilize Traveling to achieve a form of Invisibility by using the unique traits of the Spirit World.
  • Blink: A form of short distance Traveling that leaves afterimages in its wake.
  • A Traveler could keep phasing around a target, opening up and narrowing distances as they pleased, catching people by surprise.
  • This can also prevent the enemy from inflicting a successful blow.
  • If a Traveler's Teleportation powers were to be suppressed, Travelers will be limited to only Blink within a relatively small area.
  • By rapidly Blinking, never staying in one place long enough, they can avoid being Charmed by Demoness Pathway.
  • The difference between Blink and Teleportation is that Blink is Positioning and using the Spirit World corresponding to an area, while Teleportation is Positioning using the entire Spirit World.
  • Frequent Teleportations can achieve the Blink effect, however the consumption of Spirituality is much larger than normal Blink.
  • Invisible Hand: They can capture objects from a distance using an Invisible Hand.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Recording: A Traveler's ability to Record Beyonder powers has been greatly enhanced.
  • They can Record up to 4 Demigod powers, whose effects are close to a true Sequence 4.

Sequence 4: Secrets Sorcerer

Description

When it comes to the “Secret” of a Secret Sorcerer, it represents numerous hidden spaces, including that of the **Mirror World**, the world within various Paintings, etc.

Traits

  • Spirituality: Their Spiritual Intuition and capabilities with Astrology have been enhanced.
  • Their eyes can turn dark, dotted with countless points of resplendence which will form "gravel" from stars that spin rapidly, causing them to quickly break free from any Illusions.
  • They have to stop for a moment before using this capability, in order to break free from a potent spell that puts the target under an illusion, generated by a Mysticologist.
  • Spiritual Intuition: Their Spiritual Intuition has become strong enough to warn them of Demigod-level Illusions; however, not immediately or in advance.

New Abilities

  • Space Concealment: This can be seen as a core ability of a Secrets Sorcerer. With it, they can split a targeted area into 2 to create a Concealed space, only accessible through a specific Door.
  • Every Concealed Space must have a Door, used as an exit or to observe the outside world.
  • The location of the Door depends on the creator's thoughts.
  • It is often faster to directly remove the Concealment than to exit the hidden Space.
  • Secrets Sorcerers can instantaneously Conceal an area to restrain the enemy during combat.
  • They can create a special Mystical Item (opens in a new tab) that houses a small Concealed space.
  • The principle is to transform an area of the Spirit World into a Concealed space and use the chaos of the Spirit World overlapping with reality to form a Door to the item.
  • As a Mystical Item (opens in a new tab), it has a duration and must be recharged periodically. Otherwise, the items inside will be lost in the Spirit World and will be almost impossible to recover.
  • Because part of the Door is in the Spirit World and the other part is in the real world, the negative effects of the Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) inside will still affect the wielder.
  • At Higher Sequences, they can create a Seal that significantly diminish the negative effects of the Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) inside the special Mystical Item (opens in a new tab) and prevents Beyonder Characteristics from fusing into their environment.
  • When it comes to area, a small hand-sized pocket Mystical Item (opens in a new tab) created by a Secret Sorcerer can hold a Concealed space similar to a large apartment.
  • Transfiguration: "They" could transform into one illusory Door after another. These Doors layers repeatedly, extending to an infinite number to make attacks never reach them.
  • To avoid the Spear of Longinus, a Mysticologist Spell that makes a spear that is able to lock on against the targeted enemy, they would have to keep on "entering" into different Concealed spaces and hiding within illusory Doors over and over again as they were destroyed.
  • The illusory Doors created by Transfiguration differ in appearance. Some of such illusory Doors were made up of two winding stone golems, had a fist-sized hole by the gaps of the Door, were embedded with silver nails, or were covered in mysterious patterns.
  • Secret Keeping: They can Conceal Secrets and block intuition, or become a Secret by shattering a crystal ball, affecting tracking via mysticism means.
  • A Secrets Sorcerer can utilize Secret Keeping to Conceal certain matters about someone.
  • A Secrets Sorcerer can prevent conversations from leaking out.
  • Exile: This creates illusory Doors that can throw a target that they had gained initial control of into a corresponding chaotic Space-Time turbulence.
  • These Doors differ in appearance, come in bountiful numbers, and overlap together.
  • Some are double Doors that open outwards or are Doors that are deep and recessed. Others are covered in mysterious patterns or hollow in the middle, allowing one to vaguely see the boundless Darkness behind them.
  • Each of these Doors represent different scenes where danger and opportunity coexist.
  • At this Sequence, Exile will last for only 20 seconds. Once time is up, the Exiled target will return to the Secret Sorcerer's side through the same illusory Door.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Recording: Their ability of Record has undergone a qualitative change.
  • Secrets Sorcerers are now able to Record Angel-level (opens in a new tab) Beyonder powers, even those of Kings of Angels (opens in a new tab); however, those Beyonder powers will be much weaker than the real deal.
  • At this level, a Recorded Beyonder power of a Snake of Mercury's Reboot can only Reboot reality for 3 seconds and affect a tiny room.
  • Secrets Sorcerers are not only capable of Recording Beyonder powers for use, but can now even Record the "states" of various existences to use in combat.
  • Botis (opens in a new tab) had Recorded a particular "state" of an Abomination: a "state" that transformed his arm and would cause the surrounding vicinity to be tainted with madness.
  • The number of Beyonder powers they can have Recorded has greatly increased.
  • Door Opening: They can use this ability to Open up certain restrictions on their Travelling capabilities.
  • Even if Teleportation has been Prohibited or suppressed, a Secrets Sorcerer will be able to make a few adjustments to the blockage in order to release that effect on them. This is under the condition that this suppression is from a Beyonder whose level isn't high enough.
  • A Secrets Sorcerer would still be able to Open up the illusory Door created by a Judge that blocked their path to the Spirit World.
  • Blink: Their Blink ability has been greatly enhanced.
  • While they are in Blinking state, they could use various different Beyonder powers at a speed faster than normal; however, they cannot maintain this for too long.
  • The effect of releasing Beyonder powers at a speed faster than normal is something that is achieved through the individual actions of their numerous Worms of Star.
  • They can use Blink to avoid mental attacks.
  • They can utilize Blink to dodge a Manipulator's Virtual Persona.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 4 Demigod they receive some level of Godhood, and with it comes an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). The insects formed from resplendent starlight, whose bodies are bent into a semi-circle, forming a magical glow that resembled illusory Doors are called the Worms of Star.
  • They can divide Worms of Star from their own Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab).
  • They can kill these maggots and wait for the minute Beyonder Characteristics to be released, then use the carcasses to contain power that is bestowed by a high-level existence.
  • Through this, they are able to use the carcasses of their Worms of Star as high-level materials to create various charms and special bullets.
  • This fractures their own Spirit Body, dealing considerable damage and making them unable to do this frequently unless they want death.
  • If they lose too many Worms of Star they are able to recover by absorbing the Beyonder Characteristics (opens in a new tab) of the Door Pathway.
  • Secrets Sorcerers can negate some mental attacks by dividing the burden across their Worms of Star, while leaving some of them still in control of their bodies.
  • To make this work effectively they need to use a mental Beyonder power like Hypnosis to support them, enabling them to divide the burden without having to do it manually.

Sequence 3: Wanderer

New Abilities

  • Wandering: Wandering is connected to the Cosmos (opens in a new tab) and the Astral World.
  • This means that the Spirit World can no longer trap Wanderers, allowing them to Wander through the Astral World, enter the Cosmos (opens in a new tab) and head to different planets.
  • Space Tearing: Through physical contact, they can Tear Space and make it become swallowed by the void, causing things within the area to gradually collapse and shatter in a Space-Time storm.
  • Space Integration: This Beyonder power serves both as a form of Concealment and an adaption to the various different planetary and interdimensional environments in the universe.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Space Concealment: A Wanderer can now utilize their ability to create Concealed spaces to form a temporary "spatial cage", which is equivalent to a form of Sealing.
  • They can create a cage which blocks all directions except one, making it hard for their enemies to evade incoming attacks.
  • The Demoness of Brown (opens in a new tab) used the Wanderer Bracelet to twist the space in front, behind, above, and to the right of Franca (opens in a new tab) into shadowy barriers, cutting off her ability to travel through the Mirror World or evade in other ways as the only exit was to the left.
  • Door Opening: Except for some special Beyonder powers that can prevent it, a Wanderer can Open a Door and break through almost all types of barriers.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can listen to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Planeswalker

New Abilities

  • Symbolization: "They" can transform "Themselves" into Symbols.
  • This lets "Them" use the Astral World more effectively to head to different planets and worlds.
  • Dimension Sight: "They" gain initial contact with the power of Dimensions.
  • "They" are able to project distant scenes from other locations into a circular veil, enabling them to watch scenes not within "Their" direct line of sight.
  • Fors Wall (opens in a new tab) created a circular veil and projected Lumian's (opens in a new tab) figure away from "Her" into the veil.
  • "They" can miniaturize persons, objects, and scenes for storage, turning them into toys. The effective range can cover a city the size of Backlund (opens in a new tab).
  • The affected living beings will barely be able to move as their movements will turn stiff and jerky, akin to that of lifelike wind-up toys.
  • These living beings must be released within 24 hours, otherwise, they will be permanently converted into toys. Even their Spirit Bodies will never enjoy an eternal rest.
  • Beyonders up to Sequence 5 will not notice they have become toys, while those at Sequence 3 or above will be able to recognize their situation and respond.
  • A Sage's state as a torrent of Information can let "Them" reassemble "Themselves" into a regular state, breaking free from the restrictions of a toy.
  • A Demoness of Unaging can use the method of self-destruction and Resurrection via their Mirror Self to escape such influence.
  • "They" can only store a single miniaturized space with "Them"; however, "They" are able to swap and replace it with a new region.

Authorities

  • Teleportation: "They" have initial control over Teleportation, a lesser form of the Space authority.
  • Blink: "They" can be located in different locations at the same time by repeatedly Teleporting back and forth to produces multiple Afterimages, enabling "Them" to fight on different battlefields.
  • Fors Wall (opens in a new tab) confined Loki (opens in a new tab) in the Spirit World, and at the same time, "She" was also present in Port Santa (opens in a new tab) to enforce the Seal on the spaceship containing an embryonic black hole.
  • "They" are also able to directly create Doors that lead to a targeted location without having to use the corresponding mediums to enter those areas.
  • "They" have 2 methods of entering a location. The first is to directly open a Door to that realm while the second involves using Replication to copy the relevant abilities.
  • Mirror World: "They" can open a Door to the Mirror World using two methods:
  1. "They" can open an illusory Door of Mirror World without using any Mirror as well as travel through and locate Mirrors in different locations without getting lost.
  2. "They" can also Replicate the ability of those in the Demoness Pathway to travel to the Mirror World; however, this method would require a Mirror.
  • Underworld: "They" can open a Door to the Underworld using two methods:
  1. "They" can freely open an illusory Door to the Underworld anywhere by using this application of "Their" ability without any need of locating the Underworld.
  2. In the case of the Underworld being hidden, "They" can Replicate the ability of a Gatekeeper from the Death Pathway and travel to the Underworld.
  • Dreams: "They" are also able to open an illusory Door to Dreams.
  • Some Dreams are dangerous and hard to enter into; however, even if "They" can't enter it, "They" can form Doors to it in order to establish a channel of influence.
  • Madam Magician (opens in a new tab) with Miss Justice's (opens in a new tab) abilities is able to allow Miss Justice (opens in a new tab) to influence The Fool's Dream (opens in a new tab) to a certain degree.
  • "They" can't enter the Historical Void without using a Replicated power.
  • Wandering: "They" can cause all those present to begin to Wander towards a desired location.
  • This is done by making starlight sprinkle down across a targeted area.
  • Replication (Recreation): An authority related to Spirit World. Once "They" have enough understanding about the corresponding 'objects', "They" can directly Replicate without needing to Record.
  • "They" can Replicate certain Beyonder powers through 2 methods.
  1. "They" are able to directly Replicate Beyonder powers and use it "Themselves".
  • Fors Wall (opens in a new tab) Sealed the Sacred Heart Cloister of Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun (opens in a new tab), which was enforced by Lightning and Darkness from "Her" Replication.
  1. "They" can directly Replicate instances of people using 1 Beyonder power.
  • "They" can Replicate scenes which can bring 2 separate effects.
  1. "They" can cross all obstacles and distances if the corresponding scene still exists in the real world, directly descending to "Their" desired destination.
  2. "They" are able to fully change the area around "Their" targets and allow the corresponding scene to manifest in the real world.
  • This allows "Them" to relocate various things simultaneously from one place to another.
  • "They" can forcefully relocate two ships, containing three Saints, multiple Mid Sequences, and other humans and sailors from the underwater cavity, instantly reappearing on the sunny, calm, turquoise sea beyond a Seal.
  • There are certain limitations to Replication.
  • Replicated high level-powers are quite different from the original, however, it will still be able to show a certain level of authority that isn't easy to ignore.
  • Normally, it's impossible to copy authorities, and that's why the  ![Hermit Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Hermit_Pathway) Hermit's Knowledge authority and  ![White Tower Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/White_Tower_Pathway) White Tower's Imitation can't simulate one, however, Replication authority carries the Inconceivable symbolism, which can make what is originally impossible possible to an extent.
  • As such, Replication is capable of Replicating authorities.
  • Not every ability can be Replicated, those that alter one's state without being used directly are especially difficult to use.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Space Tearing: “They” can tear the area around a target and warp it into the void, shattering both the Space around “Them” and “Their” target into a myriad of small fragments.
  • The alternate space that accompanied the Tree of Shadow (opens in a new tab) where Fors Wall (opens in a new tab) battled Suah (opens in a new tab) bore gaping holes, as if swallowed by an endless void.
  • Sealing: "They" can use starlight as a method of Sealing.
  • "They" can make brilliant starlight shine with "Their" eyes to create a pair of dreamlike Doors.
  • These Doors can transfer an object into the deep, dark Cosmos.
  • "They" are able to Seal concepts in both a literal and mystical sort of sense with starlight.
  • Fors Wall (opens in a new tab) Sealed Cattleya's (opens in a new tab) listening abilities in both the literal and mystical senses to significantly reduce the effect of the seeped in Immortal Voice, the voice of a great being which is specialized in transmitting madness (opens in a new tab).
  • Astrology: "They" can turn "Their" surroundings into a celestial spectacle filled with twinkling stars, allowing "Them" to perform Astrology without the need of a crystal ball.
  • Space Concealment: Planeswalkers are able to create spaces similar to Hostels, just like the Angels from the High-Dimensional Overseer Pathway.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) appears to be that of a huge human figure composed of a light ball formed by many Worms of Stars and constructed by layers of real and illusory Doors.

Sequence 1: Key of Stars

New Abilities

  • Space Fragmentation (Gravity Manipulation): "They" can use the power of stars and the gravitational force that are emanating from them, shattering and bending Space, time, and light.
  • Fors Wall (opens in a new tab) used the Cloak of Stars (opens in a new tab) to split "Herself" into nine and behind each figure, different colored planets hazily appeared that created nine different directional gravitational forces that tore apart the surrounding Space, slowed the flow of time, and changed the trajectory of light.

Authorities

  • Position: "They" will never lose track of "Their" own Position, are able to make "Their" enemies never find "Their" Position, and can even make those enemies lose their ability to locate their Position.
  • By using the information in the Spirit World or the mystical connections between things, "They" can precisely locate the Position of anything "They" desire anywhere.
  • Even Concealed objects can be located, but the prerequisite is to create a corresponding mystical connection and to exploit it before it is cut off by the other party.
  • Mr. Fool (opens in a new tab) was able to form a directional, dreamlike key, forcibly opening the barrier of the Special Mirror World (opens in a new tab) to locate Lumian Lee's (opens in a new tab) current Position.
  • Once the target has been located and there is nothing blocking "Them", "They" are able to use "Their" authority to exert influence and affect the target.
  • Fors Wall (opens in a new tab) was able to Seal the Position of Lumian's (opens in a new tab) Mirror Person once his Position has been located by "Her" using the Cloak of Stars (opens in a new tab).
  • Seals: "They" have initial control of the authority over Seals.
  • Space-Time Labyrinth (Journey): Time is Space, and Space is Time. "They" can create various kinds of mazes to trap others, including those with Spatial loops or Temporal disorder.
  • This is the control over Journey and Space wielded by High-Sequence Beyonders of the Door pathway. Though there must be a Door and destination, "They" could set the exit at the farthest point and turn the Journey between a maze that couldn't be quickly traversed.
  • What was originally a few dozen meters can become winding and tortuous, twisting back and forth, as if one had to navigate a maze to reach their destination.
  • Fors Wall (opens in a new tab) trapped Torioppe (opens in a new tab) within a set area by setting the exit point to the farthest place from the entrance, making a journey of a few dozen meters into a winding Space-Time Labyrinth that would take much longer to finish.
  • Outside the maze lay ethereal darkness filled with brilliant stars, without any paths. Once entered, one would likely become lost immediately, unable to find an exit, let alone reach the intended destination.
  • "Their" Seals take the form of starlight.
  • "They" can let a resplendent starlight descend upon the target, with each starlight transforming into an illusory Door, seamlessly melding with and merging into the target.
  • This type of starlight Seal is able to repair itself when damaged, has the capability of Sealing an embryonic Black Hole.
  • The illusory Doors that have merged with the target can manipulate the void to effectively Seal the target.
  • "They" are able to unveil a vast and dreamlike starry sky formed from starlight to cover an entire area, effectively Sealing it in a defensive barrier.
  • Its range is enough to Seal all the Protected Zones (opens in a new tab) created by The Fool (opens in a new tab) and Grisha Adam (opens in a new tab).
  • The Sealing authority of the Door Pathway isn't only limited to physical entities, but it also possess the ability to act on concepts as well, as such it's capable of doing the following applications, but some of them might need the Door level to be used:
  • After achieving a certain degree of control over a target, Sealing one of their abilities or authorities, thereby weakening them or even completely Depriving the target of them.
  • The Key of Stars is able to Seal a certain possibility away to avoid it similar to a Chaoswalker, however, "They" cannot Seal the River of Fate (opens in a new tab) into a specific possibility.
  • Sealing connections in order to strengthen them, thereby preventing abilities or authorities such as Grafting from taking effect.
  • This is similar to the Reality authority of the Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab).
  • Applying Sealing to the universal rules of the world themselves.
  • For example, Sealing certain rules within the battlefield, thereby to a certain extent changing the battlefield rules or weakening the limitations of rules.
  • "They" can Seal their own Convergence Instinct.
  • Teleportation: "They" can open Doors to Higher Dimensions.
  • Fors Wall (opens in a new tab) had opened a Door in a Higher Dimension where an Observer was located at to allow Medici (opens in a new tab) and "His" legion to kill "Them".

Strengthened Abilities

  • All of "Their" Beyonder powers have been reinforced and enhanced.
  • Dimension Sight: With a burst of dazzling starlight, "They" can conjure a fantastical screen in front of "Them" which will show "Their" targets, including those moving between Dimensions.

Sequence 0: Door

Symbolism

  • As a Pathway under the Lord of Mysteries (opens in a new tab), the best and most proficient at utilizing symbolism, "They" can use surface-level symbolism application of "Their" authorities.

Authorities

  • Door: The concept of Doors, which encompasses authority over Space, Sealing, Alternate Worlds, etc. "They" can open or close all things related to the concept of Doors in the entire world, causing Seals to be broken or strengthened within a certain period.
  • Space: "They" possess the authority over Space and can use it to exert sufficient influence across all different and alternate Dimensions.
  • "They" can instantly Travel to any Space, being able to move "Themselves" and others to any part of the Physical, Spirit and Astral World.
  • During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual (opens in a new tab), Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatars attempted to move Klein (opens in a new tab) out of the real world into the Cosmos (opens in a new tab) in order to make "Him" lose control.
  • "They" are able to cause the surrounding Space to degrade and collapse, making any target caught within vanish into the void.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) formed a starlight oval that illuminated Klein's (opens in a new tab) figure before making a gesture of "tearing", causing the Space covered by starlight to collapse and degrade.
  • This forced Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) to rapidly expend Paper Figurine Substitutes and later, borrow the authority of the Error to save himself.
  • "They" can step through Doors that open and close simultaneously, preventing other beings from knowing what entered or what lay behind those Doors.
  • "They" can split into multiple Doors that opened and closed at the same time, preventing a Sequence 0 Darkness from knowing where "They" went.
  • "They" are able to create various Alternate Worlds. However ,"Their" Alternate Worlds can't become completely independent.
  • The Alternate Worlds that the Door creates should therefore use the Reality (opens in a new tab), the Spirit World, or the Astral World as a foundation.
  • At most, "They" are able to divide a part of the Spirit World into it, connected to reality but unable to connect (flow through) due to being Sealed; the Astral World's concepts and symbolism cannot be isolated.
  • An Alternate World can be defined by the Door as "Their" Divine Kingdom, even if it was something like the Underworld.
  • Bethel Abraham (opens in a new tab), with the explicit permission of Alista Tudor (opens in a new tab) and the Primordial Demoness (opens in a new tab), had established and created the Special Mirror Worlds (opens in a new tab).
  • This authority, combining with Death, was used by Gregrace (opens in a new tab) to gave rise to the Underworld, the common Endpoint of life.
  • "Their" Alternate Worlds don't need the help of other True Gods to be given special rules, this can be done simply by using Replication Authority.
  • Space Fragmentation (Gravity Manipulation): The Door can utilize Space Fragmentation in order to annihilate a planet.
  • The ultimate form of Blink is Omnipresence.
  • There is a limit for the number of Afterimages, so "Their" Omnipresence will reach a limit at certain point, however that limit might not be perceptible for ordinary creatures.
  • Omnipresence is a state, not a symbolism or authority.
  • "They" can make a Spatial Cage out of thin air.
  • Seals: The Door's authority over Seals includes Spatial Cages and also encompasses elements such as Time and mazes.
  • If "They" choose to affect the entire world, unless "They" put all “Their” energy into this matter, such authority wouldn’t be able to influence the entire world for too long.
  • "Their" Apotheosis Ritual (opens in a new tab), causes all physical Doors to open and all Seals to weaken, making most Seals in various churches fail.
  • "They" can temporarily shut off everything related to the concept of a Door, greatly strengthening the effects of any Seal.
  • This prevented people from opening ordinary Doors and caused Orthodox Churches (opens in a new tab) and Secret Organizations (opens in a new tab) to be unable to use Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) for a period of time.
  • Even if a True Deity descended from the Astral World, it would still take “Them” a certain amount of time before “They” could break the restrictions.
  • Besides being able to simply affect the world in an all-round way, "They" are also able to directly create various types of Seals that can even trap a True Deity.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) made Hidden Sage's (opens in a new tab) Information collapse towards a point, squeezing it together, compressing and Sealing it into a dark spherical ball which "He" then made explode outward with a thunderous sound, destroying the overall Information structure.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) created a "fishnet veil" that began to twist and reassemble to form a strong cage that trapped Klein (opens in a new tab). Inside the "fishnet veil" cage an illusory Door appeared and moved quickly without being fixed in place.
  • "They" can also temporarily Seal a Great Old One, provided the Great Old One does not resist.
  • However, this does not mean "They" can Seal Corruption, as the Corruption itself would not cooperate with "Them".
  • "They" are able to Seal Convergence (opens in a new tab).
  • A King of Angels with the  ![Door Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Door_Pathway) Door Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) can use the Sealing authority to resist the tendency to converge, preventing three Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics and the Uniqueness that are placed in "Their" body from inevitably converge rapidly, immediately becoming a True Deity, losing control on the spot, or dying directly.
  • This allows "Them" to achieve a level, statue, and power that aren't achievable by a normal King of Angels (opens in a new tab).
  • Except for specific Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) like the Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab), no other entity can trap "Them".
  • Sealing a King of Angels with three Key of Stars Beyonder Characteristics and  ![Door Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Door_Pathway) Door Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) requires two True Deities, like the Darkness and Tyrant, to Seal and Banish "Them".
  • In a sense, Eternal Slumber of the Darkness is an extreme Seal. The Door can undoubtedly be able to weaken the Seal or even make it lose its effectiveness.
  • Even authorities like Blind Stupidity or Reassembly, if they were to be used as a Seal, could be strengthened or weakened by the Door.
  • An example of this was the Seal over the Trunsoest Brass Book (opens in a new tab).
  • The Astral Barrier also has Sealing power, and thus, the Door undoubtedly has the authority to strengthen it.
  • While compressing a Star via Space authority is difficult, "They" can Seal one.
  • Conceptualization: An enhancement to Symbolization, allowing "Them" to turn into a Conceptual Creature that can avoid the damage caused by close proximity with a massive Star.
  • In this form, "Their" figure would become distorted, instantly dyed with brilliant starlight as well as becoming extremely illusory, as if they have transformed into a star Door.
  • "They" would no longer look like normal physical creatures, but more like a collection of Symbols such as "Wandering", "Astral Passage", "Key", and "Door".
  • "They" can forcibly Conceptualize other entities by enveloping them in resplendent starlight, causing similar Concepts to gather together into a Conceptual Cluster.
  • Beings that have been Conceptualized into a Conceptual Cluster will enter a passive state where they won't be able to do any actions.
  • Concealment: "They" can make things related to "Themselves" unable to be spoken of directly.
  • This is similar to the Concealment authority of the Darkness.
  • "Their" Divine Kingdom is not direct like that of a Red Priest, but instead rules-based like that of a Fool or Error's Divine Kingdoms.
  • Replication (Recreation): The authority of Replication, also known as Recreation, an authority born from the Dominator of the Spirit World and Inconceivable symbolisms.
  • "They" can Replicate a True God's authorities without Replicating the corresponding symbols.
  • "They" are able to create Replicas of "Themselves" on the level of symbolism.
  • Despite this, "They" are unable to Replicate the symbolism of other Gods or Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab).
  • Position: The Position authority not only includes the domain of Space, but also extends to concepts and domains such as Time, Destiny, and Mind.
  • As such, the Position authority is the cornerstone of Beacon of Destiny symbolism, as it helps to determine the coordinates of direction in the River of Fate (opens in a new tab).

Visionary Pathway

Sequence 9: Spectator

Traits

  • Enhanced Mental Attributes: Their Body of Heart and Mind would receive great enhancements, mostly on their inferential, analytical, observational, and identification abilities along with their memory.
  • If an animal drinks this potion, it will gain intelligence and the ability to speak in human language.
  • When Susie (opens in a new tab) accidentally drank the potion, she started to become more human-like and eventually learned how to speak the human tongue in a couple of days.
  • Enhanced Vision: Upon drinking this potion, a Spectator will also possess the sharpened eyesight needed to analyze a target's body language.
  • Even though Audrey Hall (opens in a new tab) was in the corner of a ballroom party, she could still accurately notice the subtle movements of other people from afar.

New Abilities

  • Body Language Analysis: Spectators possess keen powers of observation when it comes to observing individuals in either an individual or group sense. 
  • They can look at a person strictly from a bystander's perspective, discovering their true thoughts from their expressions, their manners, and their subconscious actions.
  • Through this, they can accurately figure out connections and draw conclusions from the details they gathered to form an accurate mental model of the target.

Sequence 8: Telepathist

Traits

  • Enhanced Vision: Their eyesight has been further enhanced, being much clearer than before.

New Abilities

  • Mind Reading: Telepathists are able to read the superficial thoughts of others and are also able to simulate the trajectory of such thoughts to a certain degree.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Body Language Analysis: A Telepathist's observation is not only limited to superficial details, but deeper into one's aura, Ether Body, or other mysterious domains.
  • They also know what kind of emotional reaction to show in the appropriate situation and know in detail what kind of expression and body language to react with.

Sequence 7: Psychiatrist (Psyche Analyst)

Description

On the basis of the Telepathist, they have gone a step further and started to directly affect their target.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Psychiatrists will experience a slight increase in their physical attributes. This is no longer just limited to their eyesight.
  • Their strength and speed have become much stronger than before, while their enhanced eyesight will allow them to clearly see in the dark. They are also more healthy.
  • Their sense of smell is able to distinguish even more subtle smells, thus allowing them to grasp a target's truest emotions and thoughts.

New Abilities

  • Frenzy: They can trigger the emotions and mental state of their target, throwing the target into a Frenzy and making them suffer intense psychological damage.
  • This effects not only one's Body of Heart and Mind but also targets one's Spirit Body as well.
  • A Psychiatrist's Frenzy might even cause a direct loss of control at times.
  • Telepathy: Through mediums like candlelight and extracts, they can put their target in a partially hypnotic state. From there, they'll be able to directly communicate with their Body of Heart and Mind.
  • This also allows the Psychiatrist to enter the deepest part of the target's Soul, or in other words, the bottom of the target's dreamland. There, a corresponding scene will materialize.
  • Psychological Cue: Through the use of specific methods, words, and a medium, a Psychiatrist can Cue a target, letting them abide by their arrangements without them even realizing it.
  • They can also enter the Sea of Collective Subconscious using Psychological Cue on themselves.
  • They can make a target strongly abide by a particular promise from the bottom of their hearts.
  • Awe (Dragon's Might, Mass Chaos): Psychiatrists can cause target(s) within a certain range to instantly panic, freeze, and turn chaotic, as though they're facing a dragon.
  • This can be resisted against if the corresponding target possesses a strong mental resistance or knows in advance that the attack is coming.
  • Placate (Psychoanalysis): Psychiatrists can help Beyonders or mortals on the brink of losing control and becoming unstable regain their reason and escape danger.
  • The higher their Sequence compares to their "patients", the more easily Placate will succeed.
  • Compared to a Soul Assurer's Requiem, their Placate targets the consciousness.
  • Psychiatrists are also able to use Psychoanalysis in 2 other ways:
  • They can calm down various psychological instabilities and allow for communication.
  • They can awaken a feeling and memory, causing an unstable target to be Placated.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Body Language Analysis: Their analysis of a person can now be done indirectly.
  • A Psychiatrist can now analyze someone's body language in a picture to figure out their true emotions and thoughts, allowing them to form an effective mental model for the target.

Sequence 6: Hypnotist

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Be it their strength or agility, it would exceed an ordinary person's.
  • Dragon Scales: Besides their physical enhancements, Hypnotists could also form a layer of Dragon Scales over their skin, allowing them to largely resist and reduce any physical damage.

New Abilities

  • Psychological Invisibility: With a Hypnotist's control of their target's Body of Heart and Mind, they could remain in the blind spot of one's consciousness, achieving Psychological Invisibility.
  • This won't change even if the target employs Spirit Vision (opens in a new tab). Even a Hunter's Danger Intuition will not react until the user is prepared to strike. By comparison, a Shadow Ascetic's Shadow Lurking occasionally evokes the sensation of being watched by the darkness.
  • Psychological Invisibility also prevents the target from perceiving the user, even when the user is standing right before them and numerous others had already witnessed their presence.
  • In this state, Hypnotists can also carry items such as scented candles and still not be noticed by the target in the darkness; however, this effect will take all of their focus to maintain.
  • The target will still notice interactions with the surroundings, but the sense of their existence will be eliminated, and they will still be in the target's blind spot.
  • Once that interaction becomes stronger to the point where the target can't ignore it, the Psychological Invisibility of a Hypnotist will inevitably be broken.

Strengthened Abilities
