  • Hypnosis: Their Psychological Cue ability would undergo a qualitative change, becoming Hypnosis.
  • Non-Combat Hypnosis: Hypnotists can open the door and enter their target's Body of Heart and Mind by getting them to concentrate on something, which allowed them to directly alter their target's consciousness and subconscious.
  • If the suggestion directly harms their life, the things they most value in its subconscious, or if the target had a strong Soul and a firm body and mind, they can resist to a certain extent.
  • The target wouldn't notice that they were abiding by the Hypnotist's arrangements, nor realize they were taking actions that didn't align with their true intentions.
  • Battle Hypnotism: Besides Non-Combat Hypnosis, they could just forcefully Hypnotize an enemy, making their enemies do something abnormal, such as Hypnotizing them to attack their companions or avoid them.
  • Similar to Non-combat Hypnosis, Battle Hypnotism is unable to harm the target's life or make the enemy directly commit suicide.
  • Such Battle Hypnotism could only last for short periods of time, and the target would quickly snap awake and sense the problem.

Sequence 5: Dreamwalker

New Abilities

  • Alteration: Dreamwalkers can modify their target's Dreams, influencing them over a long period of time and making them do things that they usually wouldn't do without them realizing it.
  • The principle behind Alteration, is to use a dream as the incisive point and the Astral Projection as a point of leverage, slowing and contaminating the target's Spirit Body before affecting the Body of Heart and Mind, planting it deep in the subconscious.
  • Most scenarios involving love at first sight may include some hidden cases where it's a result of Alteration, where a person might have a Dream about an individual and spend romantic time with them. When they finally meet in real life, it won't take long before that love blossoms.
  • Compared to Hypnosis, Alteration is more mild and furtive, making it difficult to be noticed and suitable for targeting targets at a higher level. This control is so mild that it can be done to even Demigods with sufficient preparations.
  • Guidance: While perceiving the target's Dreams, a Dreamwalker could cause different changes within it, Guiding their target into subtly revealing their deepest secrets.
  • This ability is similar to a Nightmare. The difference was that a Nightmare could forcefully pull a person into a Dream. However, Dreamwalkers weren't capable of doing so unless they combined Guidance with Hypnosis to make the target enter a dream-like state.
  • Dream Traversal: Their physical and Spirit Body would turn incorporeal, allowing them to not only directly hide in someone else's dream but to also jump from one dream to another.
  • The restriction on a Dreamwalker's Dream Traversal was that the distance between two dreams couldn't exceed 500 meters, and they had to belong to intelligent creatures.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Placate (Psychoanalysis): Given enough time, they are able to treat a Demigod that hasn’t truly lost control due to using their Incomplete Mythical Creature Form back to normal.
  • The process will be more effective if the Demigod opens the door to the their Body of Heart and Mind, which will give the possibility to the Dreamwalker of splitting themselves to use Placate into multiple treatments during the process of purifying the corruption, as well as planting Psychological Cues, cuing them into believing that everything is fine, allowing them to easily converge their Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab) form and turn back into a human.
  • However, trying to treat their Body of Heart and Mind directly before using Placate a few times will infect the Dreamwalker with their inclination to lose control.

Sequence 4: Manipulator

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: As Demigods, their physical attributes are strengthened greatly.
  • They possess extraordinary strength and exaggerated dragon scale defenses, enough break through a block of steel with one punch and run faster than a steam train.

New Abilities

  • Manipulation: Their Body of Heart and Mind can pass through the Sea of Collective Subconscious and enter another person's Mind Island, allowing them to directly change the target's subconscious and read their thoughts, silently Manipulating them to do all sorts of things.
  • Manipulators can bury psychological hints deep inside the target's Mind Island. From there onwards, their victims will orderly and accurately attempt to carry the hint out.
  • They can manipulate groups of people like this, as if it were a mass mind control.
  • Even after recovering, most victims will not realize they were manipulated.
  • Mental Plague: They can secretly implant seeds of Mental Plague in the target's Mind Island, which would quietly infect the surrounding Sea of Collective Subconscious, forming an environment of "contagious mental diseases" without anyone within the area noticing.
  • This causes countless mental illnesses and extreme madness. Moreover, the madness and mental illnesses from a Mental Plague can also be transmitted through Spirit Body Threads.
  • Since Mental Plagues originate within oneself, it cannot be isolated by the blessings of an Angel (opens in a new tab). At best, the Mental Plague will be weakened, and their onset will be delayed.
  • This belongs to the erosion and infection of the Mind Island and the Spirit World, it's not a direct attack, and it's difficult to offset it by a Virtual Persona.
  • Virtual Persona: They can create up to 13 Virtual Personas (at the start) that have a corresponding Body of Heart and Mind. In this way, they can defend from a lot of influence in the Mind Domain and invade another person's Mind Island without any signs.
  • Hermes (opens in a new tab) used "His" Virtual Personas to elevate Klein Moretti's (opens in a new tab) Mind Island, suppressing his consciousness to fight back and make him unable to take multiple things into consideration.
  • Mind Storm: They can transform their designated thoughts into a Mind Storm and sweep the surroundings, which would affect the surrounding Sea of Collective Subconscious, causing all sorts of negative effects to those within its range.
  • It can cause the surrounding creatures to hear thousands of voices whose words contained corrupting knowledge, causing them to have a higher chance at losing control.
  • This Mind Storm will hit the enemy's Mind Island continuously, causing the target(s)' Spirituality to be strongly disturbed, effectively destroying their mind barrier.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Mind Deprivation: A qualitative change in Awe causes it to become Mind Deprivation. When activated, all creatures within its range will inevitably experience all sorts of abnormal conditions.
  • Among such abnormal conditions include the following:
  • Varying degrees of losing control as their knees would buckle as they slumped to the ground.
  • Showing their fervent expressions and crowding around the Manipulator like attendants.
  • Standing rooted to the ground in a daze or attempting to blindly escape the area.
  • Some victims would even faint immediately and fall into a coma.
  • Psychological Invisibility: Its potency has been enhanced, allowing them to evade the perception of most Demigods, so long as they don't directly come into their field of view.
  • Hvin Rambis (opens in a new tab) was able to hide from Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) using Psychological Invisibility.
  • Mind Dragon Breath: This Beyonder power that stems from their Mythical Creature Form as Mind Dragons is the upgraded version of Frenzy.
  • It is an attack that can directly stimulate and harm the target's Body of Heart and Mind. It deals damage in an area-of-effect manner.
  • Consciousness Stroll: A Manipulator's Dream Traversal ability has evolved when it comes to its scope, becoming Consciousness Stroll.
  • It allows their consciousness and their Spirit Body to easily swim and wander in the Sea of Collective Subconscious; however, they cannot bring their physical body into it.
  • They still have to use Dreams to traverse around areas.
  • Hypnosis: Their Combat Hypnosis ability have been enhanced.
  • Battle Hypnotism: Their Combat Hypnosis allows them to interfere with the thoughts passed through Spirit Body Threads. It is closer to the interference of will than the Hypnosis of the mind.
  • This is something that requires a deep-delve in their powers to figure out.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 4 Demigods they receive some level of Godhood, and with it comes an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). Disregarding all consequences, they can release their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) to become an incomplete Giant Mind Dragons.
  • Their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) looks like a Giant Mind Dragons that has yet to fully evolve. Their head remains in the form of a human and their back is covered in gray-skinned wings. Their limbs and thick and the grayish-white Giant Mind Dragons they possess will be engraved with complicated three-dimensional, mysterious symbols that extends into the flesh and out to the void. It appears that these symbols are a mesh of objects that didn't belong to the real world.
  • Anyone who laid their eyes upon their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) would suffer a form of mental confusion as their thoughts warped. Even one's Spirit Body would be tainted with all kinds of thoughts that came from deep within one's heart, eager to rip apart themselves.
  • When in this incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab), they gain the strength and defense of dragons. Although they would be strong in melee combat, they still lack the necessary, powerful offensive Beyonder powers that make them excel in it.
  • As a dragon avatar, they gain the ability of flight.[[15]](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Visionary_Pathway/Abilities#cite_note-1.1051-15)
  • Through the use of Psychoanalysis and Hypnosis, a newly advanced Manipulator will be able to manifest and maintain full control over their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) for about 1 minute before they suffer negative effects.

Sequence 3: Dream Weaver

New Abilities

  • Dream Weaving: Dream Weavers can Weave out objects, persons, and scenes within a Dream that are indistinguishable from reality making the target not even realize that they are in a Dream.
  • If the target believes the Weaved scenes, objects, or persons are real, then they are real to the target. Although these Weaved images don't cause physical manifestations when they attacked, it can make the target to die from fright or other mental reasons.
  • Pauli Derlau (opens in a new tab) attempted to create the Weaved images of Hermes (opens in a new tab) and Adam (opens in a new tab) to trick Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) into thinking those persons were real so he can use them for attacks.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Plague Storm: Through Mind Deprivation and Mental Plague, they can release a storm of thoughts, desires, and wills that affects everyone caught within it in half-illusory and real ways.
  • Within a Dream Weaver's Plague Storm, every affected and eroded creature will experience Corruption and go crazy on the spot.
  • For Angels (opens in a new tab), this kind of attack is the most dangerous, because "Their" mental state has certain problems, and "They" may lose control because of the tilt of the balance at any time.
  • Enhanced Mental Attributes: With a control over their psyche and spirit, an enemy's intuition can't form a picture in their mind, and it is difficult for others to predict their own behavior.
  • This made Klein's (opens in a new tab) Danger Intuition not able to form an image in his mind, making it difficult for Klein (opens in a new tab) to predict the Visionary Pathway Saint's actions.
  • Psychological Invisibility: They can create a mental mirage in a target's mind to mask their existence.
  • This application of Psychological Invisibility is so realistic that it could even fool Demigods who specialize in Spiritual Intuition and the discernment of various illusions.
  • Consciousness Stroll: The limitations regarding this ability have lessened.
  • In addition to their consciousness and Spirit Body, they can now let their physical body enter the Sea of Collective Subconscious, achieving a form of Teleportation in the process.
  • Dream Weavers are now able to just observe the movement of the Sea of Collective Subconscious around them, and through it, obtain insight into the truest thoughts of others.
  • Virtual Persona: What was now just virtual can become real.
  • They can separate their fake personalities or previous identities and turn them into living people. Even if these identities die it will not harm their true bodies.
  • The living people created from their Virtual Persona can fully interact with the environment and manage things independent from the main body.
  • Their identities can consume Visionary Pathway potions to advance, which is equivalent to the main body consuming another low-Sequence potion.
  • They are also able to create previous identities of others, as long as the target opens their Body of Heart and Mind to them.

Mythical Creature Form

  • The incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) a Dream Weaver exhibits develops further; there is a certain change in their head, making it closer to a lizard and not a human. In addition to that, their pupils as a Giant Mind Dragons had become golden and vertical while their Dragon Scales that had become intertwined with mysterious patterns that make it cold and warped.

Sequence 2: Discerner

Description

"Discernment" is the foundation of description, interference, arrangement, and Imagination. Knowing oneself and the enemy ensures victory in every battle.

New Abilities

  • Dream Maze: "They" are able to create a Dream Maze made up of the Mind Islands of many people. Inside will be doors that lead to the deepest part of someone's mind, where their secrets are kept.
  • This Dream Maze a Discerner can create can act as a labyrinth that subjects the minds inside to mental and spiritual interrogation, confusion, and disturbances.
  • Should there be Corruption inside the Dream Maze, it will affect the minds of all the people who made up the Dream Maze, leading to loss in control.

Authorities

  • Discernment: "They" can Discern the hidden psychological vulnerabilities of a target, identifying their deepest fears. The Discerner can also preliminarily perceive the target's past Destinies and the resulting causal connections that resulted from them.
  • Discernment can sometimes penetrate the cover of Concealment, and sometimes be blocked by Concealment, and the two restrain each other.
  • The same is true when "Their" Discernment faces Deceit, Fooling, and other similar abilities, sometimes penetrating through and sometimes being blocked.
  • Normal Anti-Divination and Anti-Prophecy methods can't protect its contents from Discernment.
  • Psychological Cue: It has been elevated to the level of an authority. If "They" believe "Themselves" to be powerful enough, "They" will be, unconstrained by external appearance or physical condition.
  • This authority is essentially Pure Idealism: like in a shōnen manga, where a character can suddenly unleash hidden power simply by believing in it.
  • If "They" have sufficient understanding of Outer Deities (opens in a new tab) and "Their" symbolism (which only Outer Deity (opens in a new tab) reincarnations can fully understand), "They" can briefly enter that level but will inevitably be assimilated afterwards, becoming a part in the corresponding entity.
  • This could allow the Primordial God Almighty (opens in a new tab) Resurrected in an Angel (opens in a new tab) to temporarily achieve this level, but "He" would only have the time to quickly kill one True Deity.
  • "They" don't necessarily have to reach the corresponding level, but "They" must have truly witnessed such powerful performances and understood the corresponding knowledge. Otherwise, "They" can't even imagine it.
  • If the Discerner were to fully understand a Sequence 1 Angel or True Deity, "They" would be able to temporarily elevate "Their" rank to that level.
  • Elevating to the level of a True God (opens in a new tab) means that "They" will be assimilated, becoming a part in the corresponding entity. This is a risk that stems from the symbolism.
  • If there is a Visionary, the Discerner won't be able to reach the level of a True Deity since it will conflict with the Visionary's Uniqueness (opens in a new tab).
  • Examples of this authority in use are:
  • Despite being turned into a rabbit through the Transfiguration Curse, Hermes's (opens in a new tab) belief could make "Him" become the size of half a mountain through self-belief.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Dream Weaving: "Their" ability of Dream Weaving has been massively enhanced in 2 ways:
  1. The effects of "Their" Weaving will even more affect the person in reality. Turning the target crazy, becoming a monster, or changing their personality are examples of the effects.
  2. A Discerner's Dream Weaving is now able to exit the Mind World and be Weaved into reality, creating a flawless illusion that is hard to discern as being a Weaved image.
  • Consciousness Stroll: A Discerner has a deeper, more meticulous perception of the Sea of Collective Subconscious, and can truly enter it, navigating its depths.
  • "They" are able to sense the exchange of the Consciousness in one's heart with the Sea of ​​Collective Subconscious.
  • Ariehogg (opens in a new tab) was able to sense the impression Liveseyd (opens in a new tab) left on Audrey (opens in a new tab) while Her Virtual Persona was roaming in the Sea of ​​Collective Subconscious.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab), "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is Giant Mind Dragon. However, for this Pathway, the Dragon form itself is but a conception of the highest authority, and may shift at any moment with a single thought.
  • Giant Mind Dragons can morph into any Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) and wield the corresponding Beyonder powers. If the enemy believes it to be the real form, it becomes real: but without an enemy, it cannot manifest as reality.
  • The powers that become real only work against those who believe that they are real.

Sequence 1: Author (Fairy Tale Author)

New Abilities

  • Dream of Reality: "They" can intertwine Dreams with reality, allowing illusion and substance to coexist and making it difficult for individuals to distinguish between the two.
  • As a True God, Adam (opens in a new tab) created the Dreamscape Garden of Eden (opens in a new tab) which was the headquarters for the councilors of the Psychology Alchemists (opens in a new tab).
  • Coincidence: An Author's preliminary control over the Sea of Collective Subconscious also enables "Them" to have mastery over the power of Coincidence.
  • "They" can turn seemingly accidental, wondrous phenomena into echoes of the mind and are able to make them appear whenever "They" desire.

Authorities

  • Envisioning (Fantasy into Reality): At this Sequence, "They" master a portion of the Envisioning authority, also known as the Fantasy into Reality authority.
  • The Envisioning authority involves not only the Psyche and the Sea of Collective Subconscious but also touches upon the Astral World. It can temporarily pull certain concepts into reality.
  • This will transform those concepts into truly existing entities that are capable of inflicting real damage or causing tangible changes.
  • In the Garden of Eden (opens in a new tab) multiple Mental concept (collectively known as Bestiality) existed as a real 'living' entity that could interfere with the target's Mind if touched.
  • The higher ups of the Psychology Alchemists (opens in a new tab) had masks that embodied different emotions that lead to the corresponding changes in the Mind when worn.
  • The stories "They" write or recite will become reality; the living creatures affected finding it hard to sense "Their" manipulations, believing that their actions were of their own will.
  • "Their" stories have to be within logical boundaries, but "They" are able to force even the most improbable events to occur with just vague reasoning such as "inexplicable" or "strange".
  • This effect will heavily increase "Their" Spirituality expenditure and likelihood of detection and cannot be done repeatedly within short periods of time.
  • The strength of an Author's stories depends on the various factors that influence the story. Involving higher-level beings within "Their" stories will lead to more unpredictability.
  • The range in which an Author's story can influence living beings is usually limited to a big city like Backlund (opens in a new tab), with it being difficult for an Author to exceed that range.
  • Some examples of this particular authority being used are:
  • With the use of the 0-08 (opens in a new tab), Ince Zangwill (opens in a new tab) orchestrated the various events that allowed him to take Saint Selena's Ashes (opens in a new tab) from the Chanis Gate (opens in a new tab) of Saint Selena Cathedral (opens in a new tab).
  • Quill of Alzuhod (opens in a new tab) was able to make a meteor shower arrive on Earth two days early with the meteors "just happening to" land in the forest where Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) was hiding.
  • Adam (opens in a new tab) narrated a story where Klein (opens in a new tab) had digested his Marionettist potion and fulfilled his Advancement Ritual, allowing him to advance to become a Demigod.
  • Discernment: The Author gains preliminary control over the Sea of Collective Subconscious and thus possesses the trait of "Whatever is spoken, shall be known".
  • Whatever is spoken about "Them" will be known and the more a person knows about "Them", the more "They" will know about that person and everyone they came in contact with.
  • This makes it more likely for those people to appear in "Their" stories.
  • This awareness is also able to be applied to a name or title.
  • Adam (opens in a new tab) would immediately know everyone who has spoken "His" name. This effect applied not only to "His" normal name, but also "His" alternative names as well.
  • If the Twilight Hermit Order (opens in a new tab) is mentioned to the outside world, it will be immediately noticed by Adam (opens in a new tab) and possibly the other members of the organization.
  • However, this effect can be blocked by certain existences.
  • Any being of similar level with Concealment abilities can block the effect.
  • Psyche (Mind): "They" gain partial authority over the Mind.
  • "They" can dominate the Psyche of every living being, compelling them to act according to "Their" will. Beings who are affected by the Author will hardly notice the influence, believing their actions stem from their own genuine thoughts.

Sequence 0: Visionary

Authorities

  • Envisioning (Fantasy into Reality): What "They" Envision will materialize; the Divine Kingdom "They" envision will descend upon the physical world; the futures "They" proclaim will unfold and be reality.
  • This involves not only the Psyche and cognition but also the Astral World (a realm where concepts and symbols converge). Thus, "They" can separate two Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics, replacing them with Imagined counterparts while maintaining "Their" own rank and power.
  • The true Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics (opens in a new tab) "They" had separated can be combined with another identity of the Visionary's or a life form that was Imagined, allowing "Them" to create an Author with complete freedom.
  • Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt (opens in a new tab) created Dragon of Nightmare Alzuhod (opens in a new tab) from "His" one Author Beyonder Characteristic (opens in a new tab). Adam (opens in a new tab) was also given one Author Beyonder Characteristic (opens in a new tab) by the Ancient Sun God (opens in a new tab) through this method.
  • Primordial Demoness (opens in a new tab) took advantage of Primordial God Almighty's (opens in a new tab) mind reviving in "Her" and used Envisoning to create another "Her" (opens in a new tab) with only a single Apocalypse Beyonder Characteristic (opens in a new tab).
  • When necessary or in life threatening danger, "They" are able to use a certain method or some mediums to transform these Authors into "Their" true form, acting as "Their" Resurrection plan when things go astray.
  • Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt (opens in a new tab) could Resurrect on Dragon of Nightmare Alzuhod (opens in a new tab) but failed, "They" later revived in Ariehogg (opens in a new tab) instead.
  • Ancient Sun God (opens in a new tab) partially Resurrected as Adam (opens in a new tab), becoming "His" Divinity. "His" humanity, on the other hand, formed the True Creator (opens in a new tab).
  • The future that "They" declare will be staged and become reality in the real world.
  • Ancient Sun God (opens in a new tab) declared that Antigonus's (opens in a new tab) future advancement to Fool would ultimately fail due to various reasons. This declared future then became reality.
  • "They" can Envision "Their" Divine Kingdom to descend upon the physical world.
  • Every Divine Kingdom of a Visionary is unique according to "Their" own Imagination and thus possesses a variety of different purposes and abilities.
  • Corpse Cathedral (opens in a new tab): It's a large holy cathedral made out of the bones of different races that forms a space where one's connection to the Spirit and Astral World is blocked.
  • It also boasts considerable defensive properties, possessing enough defense to be able to resist the destructive power of a True God.
  • City of Miracles, Liveseyd (opens in a new tab): It is a floating continent where the Dragon Race (opens in a new tab) lived. Its core is the Hall of Truth, where the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt (opens in a new tab) resided.
  • However, the Hall of Truth's purpose changed to Seal the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt (opens in a new tab)'s negative personality Corrupted by the Chaos Sea (opens in a new tab).
  • As long as "They" possess sufficient understanding and mastery of relevant concepts, "They" can be, in a sense, Omnipotent. However, such Omnipotence cannot resist authorities that erase Illusions or pierce through Fantasies.
  • If "They" gains control of the Chaos Sea (opens in a new tab) and accommodate a second Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) and the corresponding Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristic, to an extent, "They" can briefly achieve a "Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) that's not unique" and Envision the remaining, fake Symbolism and authority from the God Almighty (opens in a new tab) group.
  • This allows the Visionary to briefly obtain strength that transcended the Sequences, giving "Them" a Half Great Old One (opens in a new tab)'s strength.
  • Psyche (Mind): As the master of the Mind World (which includes individual Mind Islands and the Sea of Collective Subconscious), the Visionary holds dominion over all mental realms.
  • "They" can regress a being's mind to a fetal state, stripping all memories: even subconscious ones: while awakening the full depth of a target's cognition buried within their Soul and mind.
  • Humanity: Humanity is both good and evil, rational and mad. Humanity arises naturally but can also be manufactured artificially by the Visionary.
  • Adam (opens in a new tab) had given one of Klein Moretti's (opens in a new tab) Marionettes a unique sense of Humanity that was not able to be discovered by Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab).
  • This Marionette, who became a Gehrman Sparrow (opens in a new tab) that wanted rest and freedom, stabbed Klein's (opens in a new tab) heart with a stake that Sealed all of "His" Beyonder powers.
  • Discernment: As the The Ruler of The Mind World, the Visionary can also be, in a sense, Omniscient, but this effect is limited to matters related to the Mind World.
  • "Their" Discernment can also extend into the Fate, Reality, and Illusion Domains.
  • When facing the Visionary, one wouldn't have any secrets. Any plan, be it figured out from the past or on the spot, would be seen and heard clearly by the Visionary.
  • Dream: "They" hold partial Dream authority- the concept of Dreams itself.
  • Loss of Control: "They" hold partial authority over Loss of Control.
  • For Beyonders, the collapse of one's Psyche often marks the beginning of Loss of Control.

Sun Pathway

Sequence 9: Bard

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Upon advancement, their physical condition would be strengthened.

New Abilities

  • Singing:⁂ They can imbue all sorts of effects to themselves and allies through their Singing, a sort of "job" that brought about devotion and submission.
  • Bards can imbue courage, dispel Fear, enhance strength, as well as bring forth a degree of spiritual recovery, agility, speed, and other attributes through their Singing.
  • For believers of the Eternal Blazing Sun (opens in a new tab), a Bard's Singing will also have the effect of deepening their piety and improving their obedience.
  • Apart from being able to bestow physical enhancements, courage, bring forth a degree of spiritual recovery, etc. their Singing isn't able to do anything else.

Sequence 8: Light Suppliant

New Abilities

  • They can use a limited number of Spells from the Sun Domain, consisting of Light and Fire, that are effective against the undead and other Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab).
  • Sunshine: A Light Suppliant can create a Light like the scorching Sun at noon, which can cause great damage to corpses and ghosts, and affect the vision of other creatures.
  • Blessing: They can Bless themselves and their allies, reducing the effects of Fear, Cold, Darkness, and Death effects while enhancing their damage towards the undead.
  • Daytime: A Light Suppliant can allow the surrounding ten meters to receive Light, and this produced Light will naturally spread to further distances.
  • Night Vision: A Light Suppliant can light two "miniature Suns" in their eyes to see through Darkness and thus achieve Night Vision.
  • Knowledge (Mysticism): They have knowledge of Ritualistic Magic within the Sun Domain.
  • Some things that can only be accomplished in later Sequences can be done by a Light Supplicant through their Ritualistic Magic knowledge.
  • They can summon a pure beam of Fiery Light through this.
  • They are able to make Holy Water using Rituals .
  • Evil Detection:⁂ They can sense the presence of undead creatures and evil entities.

Sequence 7: Solar High Priest

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: A Solar High Priest's body becomes stronger as well as gains considerable resistance against ailments and treacherous environments.

New Abilities

  • They gain numerous theurgical abilities within the Sun Domain that can truly Purify depraved influences. The divine knowledge that fills their mind includes these following new Spells.
  • Sun Halo: They can form a golden halo around their head that enhances the courage of their companions within a 20 meter distance as well as Purifies the Evil energies in them.
  • Sun Holy Water: Solar High Priests can imbue ordinary water with this spell to turn it into Sun Holy Water that can Exorcise Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab), drive away the cold, and Purify wraiths.
  • Holy Oath: Upon silently reciting the relevant ancient words, a Solar High Priest can temporarily strengthen one’s own strength, agility, fire damage, and holy damage.
  • Holy Light Summoning: Solar High Priests can summon a holy beam of Light from the sky to Purify the undead and inflict certain damage on other normal targets.
  • Cleave of Purification: They are able to imbue their physical attacks, weapons, and bullets with this Purification effect that is especially effective on wraiths.
  • Horror Immunity: Upon activation by a Solar High Priest, a warm power will instantly fill the body, making the target no longer feel any Fear.
  • Horror Immunity works both on passive influences and also on active mental attacks done by Evil influences that aim to hurt one's psyche and/or cause one to falter.
  • Fire of Light: Solar High Priests are able to instantly produce dense, golden, and holy Flames instantaneously at a target location.
  • These golden illusory Flames exude the majestic and pervasive aura of the Sun, and because of their density, they will form an ocean.
  • Despite their expertise in Purification and Exorcism, those effects are not omnipotent.
  • The power of Purification and Exorcism works in the category of Evil, which includes the aura of depravity but not the undead. The latter isn't necessarily Evil, but can be Purified and Exorcised because it is incompatible with the real world and needs to return to the Spirit World.
  • Therefore, Purifying and Exorcising the undead will have less of an effect than doing it on distinctly Evil influences; however, in most cases it hardly makes a difference.
  1. Under the same concept, Parasitization can be counteracted via Purification.

Strengthened Abilities

  • The Spell and sacrifice abilities within this domain have been greatly enhanced.

Sequence 6: Notary

Description

The effectiveness of their Contracts promoted the development of business, and thus Notaries became an important part of the entire business, As such there were rewards of wealth and status. This is an indirect benefit, which was enviously called "Fortune" by the Church of the Fool (opens in a new tab).

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Notaries receive a massive boost in their already strong physical attributes.
  • Despite this, they still are more focused on playing a support role.

New Abilities

  • Notarization: By utilizing a language that stirs the powers of nature along with the relevant words, a Notary can either achieve Authentication, Amplification, and Nullification.
  • Authentication: Through their Notarization, a Notary is able to determine the authenticity of various things such as potion formulas, as well as enforce Contracts.
  • Once a signature is provided as confirmation, even a Sequence 5 Beyonder cannot violate it, and a Sequence 4 Demigod would have great difficulty breaking the Contract.
  • If a Sequence 4 Demigod tries to forcefully violate it, they will have to pay quite a price.
  • Those who lie or break the Contract would be engulfed in burning golden flames.
  • Unlike an Imperative Mage, the binding force of a Notary's Contracts comes from the witness of Gods or higher beings, rather than the rule-based order.
  • Amplification: By proclaiming with words like "God says it's effective!" and if the Notarization is valid, they can temporarily enhance the targeted Beyonder power.
  • Notaries can do this to their own Beyonder powers as well, greatly enhancing the potency of their Purification and Exorcism capabilities.
  • Nullification: By proclaiming with words like "God says it's ineffective!" and if the Notarization is invalid, they can forcefully disperse the targeted Beyonder power.
  • Powers of all kind, including verbal command abilities, authorities (Mutation, Wishes, etc.), and traits (Sovereign of Spirits) can be affected by Notarization.

Sequence 5: Priest of Light

Description

A Priest of Light masters various divine Spells in the Sun Domain and can Purify the undead and filthy creatures within a certain range. They are the nemesis of filth and the undead.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Among the divine Spells they have mastered, two divine Spells that were previously mastered have undergone qualitative changes, and the other Spells have also been enhanced in power.
  • Light of Holiness: Calls forth a pure and blazing hot pillar of Light, which is extra effective against the undead. This is a stronger version of Holy Light Summoning.
  • This pure, blazing Light column will descend from the sky, enveloping the Priest of Light's enemy and vaporizing their body.
  • The additional effect is two miniature suns will appear in their eyes- the effect of Night Vision automatically applied.
  • To activate this Spell, the Priest of Light's body will lean back with their arms open, as if they were embracing the Sun.
  • Purification Halo: Produces a halo-like effect, Purifying all undead and foul creatures within a certain range. This is the stronger version of Sun Halo.
  • It dyes the surrounding area golden, warms the companions around them, brings strong courage to allies, drives away Evil, as well as can be precisely controlled.

Sequence 4: Unshadowed

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They have evolved from an auxiliary clergyman into a more comprehensive Sun warrior, with qualitative changes in physique, strength, speed, agility, etc.
  • Intuition: As Demigods from the Sun Domain, they possess a sharp Intuition that helps them know if something has gone wrong.

New Abilities

  • Purification: This is the core power of an Unshadowed, allowing them to directly Purify all sorts of things without needing the relevant theurgical abilities.
  • An Unshadowed can directly Purify any kind of Degeneration, Corruption, Corrosion, Darkness, Evil, Aliments, and other Domains that influences a person or area.
  • This Beyonder power is extremely effective against wraiths, the fallen, and the unclean.
  • Purification makes it very hard for a Parasite to Parasitize an Unshadowed.
  • Since Beyonder Characteristics are not a distinctly original part of a Beyonder, an Unshadowed can directly Purify Beyonder Characteristics from them.
  • They can completely separate the highest sequence Beyonder Characteristics from a whole Beyonder Characteristic, making it two separate Beyonder Characteristics.
  • An Unshadowed can directly rid of the mental pollution or unclean influences contained within a Sealed Artifact (opens in a new tab) or Beyonder Characteristic through Purification.
  • They can directly Purify a Beyonder, taking 1 hour to lower their Sequence by 1. With 6 hours, they can turn even a Saint to a normal person.
  • An Unshadowed is able to recover Beyonder Characteristics from Beyonders who have failed to promote but are not yet dead or have lost control, helping them leave the mystical world and become an ordinary person again.
  • They can Purify mental madness, suppressing the Original Creator's (opens in a new tab) spiritual imprint, however, there are hidden dangers, for example, making others more extreme.
  • Unshadowed Domain: They can let a bright blazing Light illuminate every corner in a region, removing all darkness and revealing all Concealed objects within it. It also has Purification effects, weakening the Beyonder powers of Corruption, Degeneration, and Darkness.
  • It is effective at revealing the invisibility created from a Silver Knight's Light Concealment.
  • The Unshadowed Domain can also defend against Darkness and Evil Domain attacks.
  • An Unshadowed Domain does not possess a barrier in the physical sense.
  • Anyone could leave the domain or exert influence on the outside world.
  • Flaring Sun: An Unshadowed can call forth a huge ball of pure Light condensed by countless sacred flames instantaneously at a target location, shrouding and setting their enemies ablaze.
  • It inflicts great damage to those with Corruption, Degeneration, and Undying attributes.
  • The damage of Flaring Sun is powerful enough to even melt the Silver Armor of a Silver Knight.
  • However, the attack range is large, and it is easy for them to accidentally hurt their own side.
  • The gesture of activation is to open one's arms, as if embracing the gift of the gods.
  • Holy Eye:⁂ They can infuse power into their eyes, allowing them to directly seek out shadows of cold, crimson, or fallen Evil in their surroundings through any physical obstructions.
  • The Light of their Unshadowed Eye allows them to shoot out a burning Light that Purifies.
  • It can also allow them to directly see scenes of the surrounding areas through sunlight.
  • Holy Equipment:⁂ An Unshadowed can cause a golden glow to surge out of their bodies, condensing a layer of armor made of pure Light, forming a full set of Holy Armor.
  • A corresponding Holy Weapon of choice can be manifested, such as a huge mace of Light.
  • Unshadowed Spear: An Unshadowed is able to condense an Unshadowed Spear made out of pure Sunlight to surgically strike their foes from afar.
  • Upon contact or after being thrown a certain distance, an Unshadowed Spear would explode to a mass of brilliant Light like a miniature Sun.
  • This is especially devastating against those who are weak to Purification damage.
  • The miniature Sun is pure white and bright enough to illuminate a city.
  • Solar Oath: They can apply various enhancements to oneself and allies within a certain range.
  • Pure White Ray: They can condense Light into a scorching and dazzling ray attack.

**Strengthened Abilities

  • Notarization: Their Notarization powers are massively enhanced, its compatibility with their other Beyonder powers allow them to Amplify their already strong Purification capabilities.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 4 Demigods they receive some level of Godhood, and with it comes an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). Disregarding all consequences, they can release their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) to become an incomplete Sunbird wreathed in golden flames.

Sequence 3: Justice Mentor

Authorities

  • Contract & Order: During this Sequence, a Justice Mentor will form a set of Justice principles, that while idealistic and personal, will align with the traits of the Sun Pathway.
  • For a Justice Mentor, the set of Justice principles they have made will define their own Order: a Contract formed with themselves, the deities, and the world. Only after comprehending their core Justice can their powers be fully brought to bear.
  • As a result of this, the Justice Mentor will gain a portion of the Contract and Order authorities: with the Contract authority being the subordinate authority to Order.
  • If they violate any part of their own Justice standard, their powers may lose control, leading to self-Purification or, in serious cases, a complete loss of control.
  • Justice Halo: Within a 10-kilometer radius of them, any action that aligns with their Justice will be greatly enhanced while those that violate it will be greatly weakened or even nullified.
  • All actions that conform with their Justice will be greatly enhanced, which will include the Beyonder powers they used as well as Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) as well.
  • After identifying his core Justice, Mr. Sun (opens in a new tab) was able to empower the Proof of Glory's (opens in a new tab) various Beyonder powers to support his standard of Justice.
  • All actions that violate their standard of Justice will be greatly weakened or even directly nullified while within the range of the Justice Halo.
  • The Demonesses of Gold (opens in a new tab) and Orange (opens in a new tab) felt a powerful suppression that weakened them in all aspects after Mr. Sun (opens in a new tab) identified his core Justice.
  • This can be deactivated, otherwise, allied Wraiths or Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab) cannot approach and would be quickly suppressed and Purified.
  • Judgment of Justice: A Justice Mentor can designate a single target, drastically weakening or nullifying any powers they possess that violates their Justice principles.
  • Even Angels (opens in a new tab) can be affected by Judgement of Justice.
  • The effect is twice as strong as the Justice Halo.
  • Their abilities as a Notary and Unshadowed will gain new manifestations, enhancing actions aligned with their Justice while weakening actions that violate it.
  • Holy Contract: A Justice Mentor is able to establish Holy Contracts whose power is so binding that even an Angel (opens in a new tab) will not dare try to break the Contract.
  • Even without a Sequence 0 Sun, the presence of the Sun Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) ensures the automatic enforcement of the Holy Contract - this is the instinct of authority.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Unshadowed Domain: They can create a pure, warm, sacred golden light to quickly fill the area around them, causing the forces of Desolation and the aura of Death to retreat to the edges.
  • In such a Domain of sunlight, the vast majority of mystical Pathogens from the Demoness Pathway would quickly perish, while only a few ordinary diseases agents may survive.
  • Holy Equipment:⁂ A Justice Mentor is no longer limited to creating Holy Armor for themselves. They can now form Holy Armors on their allies even if they are not near them.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can listen to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Lightseeker (Sun Chaser)

Authorities

  • Sun & Light: "They" have obtained partial authority over the Sun and Light.
  • Solar Envoy: "They" can transform "Themselves" into a miniature Sun, radiating terrifying Heat and Light while unleashing devastating Purification.
  • The Solar Envoy of a Lightseeker is capable of evaporating and dissolving without a trace the Fog of War in a 2 kilometer radius.
  • The harm put onto "Them" by the forces of Darkness, Cold, Filth, Corruption, Death, Decay, etc. will naturally be dissipated to a great extent.
  • Praise the Sun: "They" can bring about absolute Purification, which will result in a qualitative enhancement to all aspects of "Themselves".
  • Birthing children is not an evil act for the Mother (opens in a new tab) but a sacred one, making it immune to "Their" Purification; however, transforming those infants into the Undead will make them susceptible to "Their" power.
  • "They" are able to transform into a pure and sacred condensed Light in order to fly and move at the speed of Light and have no mass.
  • "They" can turn into Light to withstand damage, and then reassemble "Their" body.
  • "They" are able anchor "Themselves" to the Sun, preventing loss of direction or prolonged influence from Space-Time Mazes.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "They" have gained an enhancement on "Their" divine Spells.
  • Spear of Light: "They" can summon a blazing pure white Spear of Light with illusory pure white angelic feathers on it's ends with to strike "Their" foes.
  • The feathers on the ends block the surrounding Space, preventing enemies from fleeing.
  • Justice Trial: Lightseekers who have fully defined and clearly understood the core Justice principle within "Their" set of Justice principles can inflict 3 to 5 times the damage of Justice Halo on targets who happened to violated that core Justice principle.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form becomes complete, making "Them" appear as a Sunbird wreathed in golden flaming feathers, appearing like a ball of light.

Sequence 1: White Angel

Authorities

  • Holiness, Order, & Faith: "They" possess a partial authority over Holiness, Order, and Faith.
  • Incarnation of Order: As long as commercial activities and overall Order related to "Them" remain intact, "They" can draw power from it to alleviate injuries and maintain their condition.
  • Holy Kingdom: "They" are able to create an illusory domain vast enough to encompass the city of Backlund (opens in a new tab), filled with the radiance of the Sun and the power of Purification.
  • In this domain, neither Darkness nor Undead can exist. This will effectively counter the Revival method of the Darkness Pathway: potentially even nullifying these revival methods.
  • Servant of Faith: Holiness inherently leads to Faith, making it a subordinate authority.
  • "They" can enable "Their" followers or "Themselves" to enter a state of religious fervor, granting temporary immunity to many forms of damage (Darkness, Filth, Death, etc.).
  • "They" can cause a target or a group of targets to feel a sense of Holiness, gradually praise the Sun, and ultimately become believers of the Eternal Blazing Sun (opens in a new tab).
  • Pure White Light: Destruction is a form of Purification, and likewise Purification will also bring forth destruction.
  • Except for Pure White and the Sun, everything will fall apart and be liberated under the Pure White Light that a White Angel can create.
  • Sun: A White Angel can theoretically serve as a Sun to illuminate the world.

Sequence 0: Sun

Symbolism

  • Inextinguishable Light: Due to "Their" symbolism of the Inextinguishable Light, "They" are exceedingly difficult to fully destroy: even if "They" are annihilated, revival is still possible.
  • Likewise, The Omnipotent and Omniscient (opens in a new tab) can more easily return via the Sun Pathway.

Authorities

  • Light: Wherever Light exists, "They" exist, illuminating and destroying everything.
  • This is also the essence of Energy, the cornerstone of The Omnipotent and Omniscient (opens in a new tab)'s Energy.
  • Order: Unlike the **Black Emperor's** Order, "Their" version is more positive, self-centered, and exclusive, and must derive from "Their" previous standard of Justice. There is an overlap and intersection in the authority of Order between the Black Emperor Pathway and the Sun Pathway.
  • Contracts: "They" possess authority over Contracts, a lesser authority derived from Order.
  • Powers of all kinds, including verbal-command abilities, authorities, and even traits can be affected by the Contracts authority.
  • Once a Contract is signed, even Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) who lack the corresponding Symbolism would be severely restricted by its effects.
  • Holiness: Under this authority, all dissonance shall be Purified and dispelled. In contrast, all acts of Holiness will be enhanced to their highest potential.
  • Faith: It is a lesser authority stemming from Holiness. It is the Purification of body and mind, as well as the worship of others and oneself.
  • If "They" have established fanatical beliefs, "They" can use the Faith authority to resist a Demoness' Charm; however, "They" cannot be completely immune to it.
  • The Sun can heavily restrain the Death.
  • Sun: The authority of the Sun is a lesser authority derived from a fusion of Holiness and Light.
  • "They" can make the childlike Sun within the Astral World become a blazing golden-yellow fireball, terrifying in its intensity, with the burning surface of this Sun being pure and Sacred.
  • "They" are able to make a blazing Sun appear within a region, replacing the Night with Day and causing all the Shadows and other influences in the area to rapidly disperse.
  • When the Eternal Blazing Sun (opens in a new tab) made a Sun appear above the forest, it caused the Shadows to disperse and the blood-colored robe covering Bethel (opens in a new tab) to rise, scattering more crimson Moonlight, allowing Lilith (opens in a new tab) to make all disturbances return to a mother's embrace.
  • "They" are a true Sun that satisfies physical reality and mystical definitions, capable of emitting Light intense enough to illuminate or destroy entire worlds and star systems.
  • "They" can project immense Energy, generate ultra-high-temperature flames, and Purify all related filth and evil. This can also be done through sending out a blinding ray of Sunlight that shines through the Darkness and melts everything that it encounters along the way.
  • As the True Deity of the Sun Pathway, "They" are able to create countless miniature burning Suns that can intertwine into an abnormally blinding, almost-real golden Sun, emitting a scorching Light that could illuminate or even destroy an entire Solar System (opens in a new tab).
  • When it comes to destroying an entire Solar System (opens in a new tab) with "Their" scorching Light, the process is slow and not fast.
  • "They" are able to create an Eternal Daytime in an area that could Purify filthy and evil objects, awaken sleeping creatures, and reveal everything that is Concealed.
  • "They" are the embodiment of the Sun, whose blinding Light will make it difficult for those affected to form proper thoughts.

Tyrant Pathway

Sequence 9: Sailor (Keeper of the Seas)

Traits

  • Aquatic Affinity: Sailors possess certain attributes common to sea creatures.
  • Even without any equipment they are able to easily submerge underwater for at least ten minutes.
  • Sailors can swim in the sea like a fish and move agilely underwater just like marine animals.
  • They are able to dive 15 meters into the Water without any protection, or equipment.
  • Phantom Scales: They possess illusory scales hidden within their skin.
  • It makes them slippery and as hard to grasp as a fish.
  • It also helps a Sailor resist some level of damage.
  • Balance: A Sailor possesses exceptional Balancing capabilities.
  • Even if a Sailor were to be on a boat in a rainstorm, they would be able to walk around freely as though they were on solid, stable ground.
  • Physical Enhancement: Sailors have outstanding strength.

Sequence 8: Folk of Rage (Guardian of the Storm)

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: A Folk of Rage's strength, speed and resistance capabilities have all been greatly enhanced - facing them is like facing a storm.

New Abilities

  • Wrath: When enraged, they can release several strikes that exceed ordinary thresholds.
  • This greatly enhances both a Folk of Rage's strength as well as their speed.
  • Raging Blow: This is a terrifying blow that is delivered with accumulated anger.
  • Folks of Rage must accumulate 'hits' first in order to activate this ability.
  • Being intoxicated can help aid in the process of accumulating 'hits'.

Sequence 7: Seafarer (Storm Priest)

Traits

  • Aquatic Affinity: Seafarers are even more beloved by the oceans and gain an overall enhancement to every part of them when they are at sea.
  • They can act and move freely underwater for more than half an hour.
  • Enhanced Mental Attributes: Their calculation skills have improved.
  • Enhanced Memory: Seafarers possess enhanced memory.

New Abilities

  • Navigation: They are scholars of astronomy and geography. They have an intuitive grasp of magnetic fields, ocean currents, wind direction, and clouds, while also possessing great sailing capabilities.
  • They can accurately judge distances, which allows them to precisely throw weapons at their target with their eyes closed after determining their location.
  • A boat with a Seafarer onboard will never get lost at sea as a result of their newfound grasp and affinity towards these fields of Navigation.
  • Seafarers are able to cast a limited number of different Water-related Spells. Some of the Spells are a result of their own capabilities and some come from a bestowal from the Tyrant.
  • They can disperse the Water they create with a simple gesture.
  • Some of the Spells that they can use include the following:
  • They can create a film of Water that covers a person's face to suffocate them. This film of Water is hard to get rid of, even with both hands free.
  • They are able to light up the surroundings with azure lights. These lights can intersect and create a huge wave of Water that sweeps forward.
  • They possess certain restorative Spells from the Water domain, however, these are inferior when compared to dedicated items or Spells.
  • They can form an aqueous light that can clean surfaces.

Sequence 6: Wind-blessed

Description

They are irascible at times, matching the characteristics of a gale and also possess remarkable Beyonder powers related to Water, Wind, and the Weather.

New Abilities

  • Wind-blessed: Blessed by the Wind, a Wind-blessed can unleash gales from within one’s own body to create pressure waves or surround themselves with howling Hurricanes.
  • Glide: They can use the Winds to Glide through the air if Flight was Prohibited by a Judge.
  • A Wind-blessed can generate Wind beneath their feet to more then double their running speed.
  • Windblades: They can make howling, invisible, sharp Windblades to slice targets from afar.
  • Flight (Short-range Flight): They are able to Fly for short durations and distances.
  • They can imbue their hands with spiraling Winds to increase their penetrative power.
  • They are able to Eavesdrop on people's hidden conversations using the Wind.
  • They can make air cushions to Cushion damage taken from impact.
  • Floating Wind: A Wind-blessed is able to hover in mid air.
  • Water Control: They can manipulate and use Water to a certain degree.
  • Deep Dive: A Wind-blessed can Dive to a depth of 100 meters.
  • Float: They can Float on the Water without sinking.
  • Night Vision: They can see in the dark.

Sequence 5: Ocean Songster

Traits

  • Aquatic Affinity: They have more comprehensive and longer-lasting talents for underwater areas.
  • They are now able to move freely underwater for even longer periods of time.
  • They are now able to understand and communicate with aquatic animals.
  • They are now able to freely extract oxygen from the water.

New Abilities

  • Lightning Manipulation: Ocean Songsters have superficial control over Lightning, and at this level, other than Lightning Strike, they must use other mediums to employ Lightning, such as arrows.
  • Lightning Bolt Arrow: With the aid of a bow and arrow, an Ocean Songster can condense a solid arrow from Lightning that deals massive damage to enemies.
  • It moves at an unavoidable speed, as if it were from a god of thunder.
  • The steps involved in a Lightning Bolt Arrow are as follows.
  • Their hair unfurls, defying nature, each strand distinct and swirling with Lightning. Upon drawing a bow, the sky darkens, clouds gather, and Lightning dances.
  • They then release the silver-white Lightning from their hair, entwining it with the arrow before releasing the string and shooting the arrow out.
  • Dark clouds lump the sky and a thick Lightning Bolt descends superimposing itself on the arrow, making it completely silver white.
  • Lightning Strike: An Ocean Songster can produce silver-white electric light capable of paralysis, generating a Lightning Strike to smite their targets.
  • Lightning Strikes contain Purification attributes that can damage Undead and Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab) and can be infused into weapons such as bullets, and daggers to augment them.
  • It can't be dodged: only preemptively avoided. Even if it does not hit, it will spread to nearby conductive materials in the form of countless small "electric snakes".
  • They are capable of transmitting sound over long distances in the form of Lightning, easily passing through various obstacles.
  • Upon reaching the target, the bolt of silver Lightning will turn back to the Ocean Songster's voice, relaying the message contained within.
  • Singing: The ability to influence targets with one's voice, it varies based on the user's individual traits.
  • This ability will be different because of every Ocean Songster's uniqueness, producing different branching paths, which includes:
  1. Using beautiful Singing to interfere with the enemy's Spirit Body, causing them to turn adrift and fall into a daze, or to enhance one's own explosive power.
  2. An Ocean Songster using chaotic and unpleasant Singing to leave the enemy frustrated, causing them to lose their rationality.
  3. Simulating a Thunderous boom to leave others in awe.
  • Blocking one's ears and converging one's Spirituality cannot fully eliminate the negative effects of this ability. Even a deaf person can hear it. This is because this includes an "exchange" at the spiritual level, making it difficult to defend against.
  • In addition, it is very difficult to avoid an Ocean Songster's Singing through Paper Figurine Substitutes within the affected area.
  • Pressure Resistance: A Spell-like effect that makes them not fearful of deep sea pressure.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Water Control: A Ocean Songster's ability to control water has been greatly improved.
  • They can now create enormous water spheres and corrosive rainwater.
  • They can create sticky liquid that has lubrication effects.
  • Water Curtain: They can create a Water Curtain for covering or defense.
  • Wind-Blessed: Their ability as a Wind-blessed has been moderately enhanced.
  • Wind Binding: They are able to create spiraling Winds to Bind a target's actions.
  • Flight: An Ocean Songster can now Fly for longer periods of time.

Sequence 4: Cataclysmic Interrer

Traits

  • Underwater Vision: They no longer have any reading troubles caused by insufficient light.
  • Even in the dark deep sea, they can see the surrounding objects clearly.
  • Scale Armor: Their Phantom Scales have strong defensive ability.

New Abilities

  • Hurricane: They can make violent Winds collide with the air, creating an explosive sound, while a terrifying Hurricane visible to the naked eye appears, swirling and winding.
  • The airflow of the Hurricane swirls in circles. If unchecked, it will suddenly rise from the ground, sweeping everything on the ground into the air while soaring into the sky is like a terrifying giant. Wherever it passes, the ground is clean and not a single thing is left behind.
  • The visible gales and howling Winds that a Hurricane causes sight-based mystical connections to be severed and obstructed.
  • The strength of a Hurricane depends on current potion digestion of the Cataclysmic Interrer and the environmental factors.
  • A Cataclysmic Interrer is able to choose to control the directions of their Hurricane or simply let it spiral out of control.
  • Tsunami: They are able to call forth huge Water waves approaching 10 meters high to crash down on their targets, washing everything away in a powerful torrent.
  • Alger Wilson (opens in a new tab) let the tidal waves he has made via a Tsunami envelop the Cathedral of Waves in a thick barrier with silver bolts of Lightning flashing within it.
  • Earthquake: They can easily create an Earthquake on any land, and in doing so, make the land split into two and have lava erupt from within the fault line.
  • Relying on their own power to cause ground subsidence and the eruption of magma, an Earthquake's power will be limited to level 6 and can be concentrated in one area.
  • If the earth itself is accumulating power and there are signs of a terrifying Earthquake, the upper limit depends on the magnitude of the Earthquake brewing in the area.
  • The lava formed from an Earthquake is enough to cause the Darkness from the underground of the Cathedral of Waves to shrink back a little and pause for a second.
  • Torrential Downpour: They can quickly form a Torrential Downpour across an extremely large area, obstructing any perception within that area.
  • This heavily restricts the use of Flame based abilities, like Flaming Jump, within such an environment.
  • In addition, they can create other Disasters like Snowstorms, Rainstorms and Floods, situated in the Domain of Calamities.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Water Manipulation: Their ability to control Water has undergone a qualitative change.
  • Water Wall: For protection, they can make a wall formed out of blue seawater besides them.
  • This blue seawater wall can effectively slow down the Petrification coming from the underground chamber within the Cathedral of Waves.
  • They can form a silent stream of Water that can surge out, eroding the area.
  • Cataclysmic Interrers also have the ability of Wave Manipulation.
  • Lightning Manipulation: They possess a stronger control and power over Lightning.
  • Thunder Strike: A Lightning Strike hitting their target will have more intensity and accuracy, instantly scorching them and dealing heavy Purification damage.
  • Chain Lightning: A Cataclysmic Interrer can create several Lightning Bolts at the same time, and those Lightning Bolts can Chain between targets.
  • Singing: Their capabilities when singing has been enhanced qualitatively.
  • Through singing a melody of death, a Cataclysmic Interrer is able to influence their surroundings and disrupt the operations of Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) within the vicinity.
  • Alger Wilson (opens in a new tab) sang a melody of death, influencing his surroundings and disrupting the operations of the other 2 Grade-1 Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) that weren't under his attention before.
  • Roar: A Cataclysmic Interrer's vocal cords have enough strength to produce a Roar with enough intensity to create a sound wave that can topple a ship.
  • Wind Control: Their ability to control the Wind has been enhanced.
  • Windblade Legion: They can manifest hundreds to thousands sharp and tiny Windblades that move towards the target from all directions.
  • Flight: A Cataclysmic Interrer possesses real Flight capability now and can move at speeds of up to 500 kilometers per hour.
  • Besides Windblade Legion and Flight, a Cataclysmic Interrer also possesses the Beyonder power Son of the Wind.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Sea King

Description

Even with range limitations, within the waters they control, Sea Kings are undoubtedly powerful rulers, able to walk freely on the seabed, wantonly stir up Tsunamis, cause Sea levels to rise, and dominate marine life. In their home turf, they are absolutely capable of overwhelming all Demigods of the same level.

Traits

  • Aquatic Affinity: They are able to freely walk on the Ocean seafloor.
  • Physical Enhancement: They have Sea-monster like strength.
  • Balance: They possess unimaginable levels of Balance.

Authorities

  • Wrath of the Sea: Part of the Sea authority, a Sea King can cause the entire sea area to repels the corresponding target, blocking and attacking them through various methods.
  • One such method are Tsunamis.
  • Sea Master: Formed from the partial authority of Aquatic Life and Tyrant authority, Sea Kings are equivalent to rulers of an entire expanse of the Sea.
  • Sea Kings can command many Sea creatures to do their bidding as well as transform themselves into any Sea creature, making the seabed be their home turf.
  • Their psyche is so potent that it is terrifying, and with that psyche, they are able to search for any possible abnormal spots within an area of the Sea.
  • This will cause external prying to be affected, turning everything indistinct.
  • A Sea King is able to turn the surrounding waters into a calm, windless lake, which can reflect the scenes of the past within the area.
  • When fighting in the Ocean, they can unleash their fullest potential and absolutely overwhelm any and all same level Demigods.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Hurricane: They can shatter Hurricanes into countless streaks of silvery-white Lightning, bursting with a destructive, violent aura that engulfs the area, forming a Lightning Storm.
  • Torrential Downpour: A Torrential Downpour could spread a Sea King's Spirituality, making every dark cloud and every drop of water from that Calamity become their eyes.
  • Tsunamis: With a rise in Sequence level, a Sea King is now able to set off 40 to 50 meter high Tsunamis wantonly as well as raise the Sea level of an entire region.
  • Lightning Calamities: Advancing to this level, a Sea King can now create Calamities from Lightning, such as balls of Lightning.
  • Water Manipulation:⁂ A Sea King can create Destructive Droplets through Water.
  • Destructive Droplet: By disintegrating or reorganizing Water droplets, a Sea King can release terrifying destructive power, which works by splitting hydrogen atoms (E = MC²).
  • Lightning Manipulation: Sea Kings are able to create Lightning Storms.
  • Lightning Storm: They can make silver-white "electric snakes" burst forth, slashing densely at the surroundings as "branches" that envelop an area of hundreds of meters in a Lightning "forest".
  • Any creatures caught within the Lightning Storm will be shattered and vaporized. This is a ranged attack that doesn't distinguish between friend and foe.       
  • A Sea King's Lightning Storm carries a destructive aura so intense it seems tangible, stunning enemies in place and interfering with their thinking.
  • They can generate Lightning Storms from the Sky or from thin air.
  • Thunderclap: A Sea King can create a sonorous Thunderclap, one that strikes awe into one's mind and spirit. This Thunderclap is one that can also awe Spirit Bodies.
  • Wind Manipulation:⁂ The power of a Sea King's Winds have been enhanced.
  • The speed of the Winds a Sea King can now conjure is able to break the sound barrier, creating Sonic Booms which could make a pirate ship fly out.
  • Flight: This also allows a Sea King to Fly at speeds faster than the speed of sound.
  • Sonic Boom: A Sea King can now create Sonic Booms at a distance.
  • Navigation: A Sea King can never get lost.
  • This is assuming there is no superposition of other powerful factors.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can listen and respond to prayers within a certain range. A Sea King's range for responding to prayers is relatively far-reaching compared to other Sequence 3 Beyonders.

Sequence 2: Calamity

Authorities

  • Calamities: "They" hold some authority over Calamities.
  • Descent of Calamity: Includes Thunder Storms, Snow Storms, Tsunamis, etc., which can be freely summoned, each capable of destroying a port or even an entire island.
  • "They" can summon a Calamity that creates an area of extreme coldness that can Freeze everything within the surroundings in seconds.
  • Storm Incarnation: "They" are able to unleash Hurricanes and Storms capable of destroying a large city. This is derived from part of the Calamities authority.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "Their" previous Beyonder powers have been enhanced.
  • Source of Wrath: Wrath can temporarily enhance one's power to the next Sequence.
  • The price of Source of Wrath is the abandonment of rational thought.
  • Source of Wrath is not able to enhance one's status.
  • It can be used on oneself or to influence a target.
  • Lightning Manipulation: "Their" ability to use Lightning has been enhanced.
  • Magnetic Pole Pull: "They" can create or manipulate Magnetic Fields to push, pull, or rotate targets. The rotation of a Magnetic Field itself can accumulate power.
  • Electromagnetic Disruption: "They" can cause severe information interference in a designated city cluster, large island, or corresponding Sea area.
  • This will render communication methods such as telegraphs ineffective.
  • Wind Manipulation: "Their" Flight speed has reached a qualitative change.
  • Flight: "They" can Fly at the speeds of a ballistic missile.
  • Singing: "They" can create sounds that bring extreme Fear.
  • Sound of Horror: Through sound, "They" can instill extreme Horror in living beings and even Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) within a radius of hundreds of kilometers, forcing them to obey.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) has become complete. "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is that of a giant octopus-like creature with thick, terrifying tentacles surrounded by silver-white Lightning.

Sequence 1: Thunder God

New Abilities[[29]]

  • Incarnation of Light: "They" can transform "Themselves" into an energy body, capable of flying or attacking at speeds approaching, but not quite reaching, that of light.

Authorities

  • Thunder, Wind, & Calamities: "They" hold authority over Thunder, Wind, and Calamities.
  • Heavenly Punishment: "They" can manifest a massive bolt of Lightning to descend from the sky, imbued with the powers of Disintegration, Purification, and Destruction.
  • It is very potent against targets from the Darkness, Death, Corruption, and Filth domains.
  • It can attack the weaknesses of targets that attempt to transcend nature or matter.
  • Targets that attempts to take on a non-natural form such as by becoming a torrent of Information or through Symbolization would still be harmed, preventing them from escaping the Lightning strike by shifting to other domains.
  • Heavenly Punishment is derived from a portion of the Thunder authority.
  • Storm Hell: "They" can designate a Sea area, a large island, or a city cluster to be engulfed in a destructive Storm Hell, with the effect potentially lasting indefinitely.
  • This is derived from part of the Calamities authority combined with the Wind authority.
  • Dance of Thunder: A Thunder God is able to use Invisible Thunder that disrupts, interferes with, and destroys Information and electromagnetic structures.
  • This makes it the nemesis of Information-based systems.
  • Ocean of Lightning: "They" can make a Sea composed of terrifying Lightning with intense electromagnetic effects.
  • A Thunder God's Ocean of Lightning is capable of covering an entire large island.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "Their" previous Beyonder powers have been enhanced.
  • Source of Wrath: The power stemming from "Their" anger has been enhanced.
  • "They" can reach close to a True Deity's power through "Their" anger.
  • Singing: "Their" ability to Roar has been greatly enhanced.
  • Roar of the Thunder God: This is a sonic attack that spreads at the speed of Lightning, inducing Horror, Intimidation, and other effects.
  • Roar of the Thunder God is particularly effective against targets from the Darkness, Death, Corruption, and Filth domains.

Sequence 0: Tyrant

Authorities

  • Matter: It is partially derived from the Maker symbolism and intersects with the Thunder authority. Matter can be converted into Energy, and Energy can be condensed back into Matter: thus encompassing the Electromagnetic, Strong, Weak, and other Fundamental Forces.
  • "They" are able to approach the speed of Light while retaining mass, as opposed to the Sun who moves at the speed of Light without mass.
  • "They" can turn into a current that reaches the speed of Light for a brief period.
  • "They" are able to make a portion of Matter approach the limit of speed, creating a violent "wave" capable of destroying a planet.
  • Thunder (Electricity & Magnetism): This authority is partially derived from the Maker symbolism. "They" command the forces of Electricity and Magnetism, capable of unleashing powerful Electromagnetic Storms that can destroy all information structures.
  • "They" can instantly summon tempestuous Lightning that strikes down like Torrential Rain.
  • Tyrant: The King of Kings. It encompasses the authorities of Intimidation, Wrath, and a portion of Horror; the ability of Singing is derived from this authority.
  • "They" are able to exude a terrifying aura, making all targets tremble in fear, awe, and submission. This can also be used through mediums that are not explicitly "Them".
  • Lord of Storms (opens in a new tab) generated Thunderclaps that awed all living beings, including Angels (opens in a new tab) (except 0-17 (opens in a new tab)), interrupting them and rendering them stiff.
  • "Their" aura is able to awe and stop a Chained pathway Beyonder from possessing someone; it is a testament of their terrifying aura.
  • "Their" Storms contain immense horror.
  • Water: This authority originates from the intersection of the Maker and Omnipotence symbols, it encompasses the authorities of the Seas and a portion of Aquatic Life.
  • The intersection of the Maker and Omnipotence symbols allow the Tyrant to be able to influence any source that is related to the concept of Water, such as the Sea of Collective Subconscious or Chaos Sea (opens in a new tab), either directly or indirectly.
  • The Water authority even encompasses the Spiritual Sea, River of Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab), and River of Fate (opens in a new tab), which is why "They" are part of the Omnipotent and Omniscient; however, not all of them can be interfered with directly, some can only be done indirectly, and the degree of influence isn't very high. Fog also does not fall under this authority.
  • Seas: The authority of the Seas is part of the Water authority.
  • "They" can cause the Seas to surge and rush towards the clouds, intersecting with the Sky.
  • Aquatic Life: This is part of the Water authority.
  • This authority can make certain Aquatic Life more octopus-like.
  • The two Divine Kingdoms of the Tyrant, Dreadful Heaven and Chasm of Storms, are derived from the fusion of the Tyrant, Thunder, and Calamity authorities.
  • Chasm of Storms: This Divine Kingdom focuses on the Thunder and Calamity authorities.
  • Dreadful Heaven (Sole Obedience to the Storm): This emphasizes the Tyrant authority.
  • Calamities: The Tyrant possesses partial authority over Calamities, which is an authority subordinate to the authority of Disaster.
  • "They" can banish others into a never-ending Storm to Seal them.
  • "They" are able to make Earthquakes that can destroy Earth (opens in a new tab).
  • Wind: The Wind authority intersects with the authority of Calamities.

White Tower Pathway

Sequence 9: Reader

Traits

  • Enhanced Mental Attributes: They gain an enhanced memory, comprehension, and learning abilities.

New Abilities

  • Reading: They gain a wealth of Knowledge through extensive Reading.
  • Ritualistic Magic: They gain the ability to use Ritualistic Magic.

Sequence 8: Student of Ratiocination

Traits

  • Enhanced Mental Attributes: They gain an increase in observational and logical reasoning skills.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Ritualistic Magic: Student of Ratiocinations are experts in Ritualistic Magic.

Sequence 7: Detective (Knowledge Keeper)

Description

A Detective is a "profession" that focuses on knowledge acquisition and reasoning ability, along with good fighting and weapon handling skills.

Traits

  • Enhanced Mental Attributes: They can become Masters of reasoning.
  • Weapon Proficiency: They have become proficient in using weapons.
  • They can become martial Masters; however, this term is relative to ordinary people.
  • As Detectives improve less on their physical attributes, this making them not as good compared to Beyonders who excel in combat.
  • Physical Enhancement: Detectives have become more agile.

New Abilities

  • Reconstruction: Detectives can use Beyonder methods to analyze and Reconstruct events that have occurred within a certain area.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Ritualistic Magic Master: A Detective can become a Master when it comes to Ritualistic Magic.

Sequence 6: Polymath

Description

This Sequence allows them to learn and understand a great deal. Because of their extensive knowledge, they become Jack-of-all-trades, able to identify, see clearly, remember, and Imitate abilities they've encountered.

New Abilities

  • Analysis: With prior knowledge, a Polymath can Analyze the Beyonder abilities used by an opponent, quickly identify the specific situation, and understand strengths as well as weaknesses. Of course, Analysis can also be wrong and fail.
  • The more comprehensive their knowledge and the deeper their understanding of the target's Pathway (opens in a new tab) and Beyonder powers, the more effective their Analysis becomes.
