  • If the Polymath makes errors or incomplete analyses while dissecting an ability, the ability will mutate strangely or just fail entirely.
  • The prerequisite for a Polymath's Analysis to work successfully is to have enough pre-existing knowledge of the target's Pathway (opens in a new tab) and subsequent Beyonder powers.
  • Analysis let's them rapidly identify a target's Beyonder powers, allowing them to know of the target's strengths and weaknesses as well as Imitate more quickly.
  • Despite having only directly confronted Jason Beria (opens in a new tab) once, Isengard Stanton (opens in a new tab) was able to use 2-081 (opens in a new tab) to Imitate and utilize the Beyonder power Danger Premonition.
  • This case is attributed to the properties of 2-081 (opens in a new tab), whose formation method enhanced the power of Analysis.
  • They can Analyze Demigod-level Beyonder abilities.
  • They can Analyze Fate-related Beyonder abilities.
  • Imitation: Once sufficiently Analyzed, There is a chance for the Polymath to Imitate an Analyzed ability to a certain extent.
  • The more effective their Analysis is, the higher the probability that their Imitation succeeds. However, the higher the Sequence of the Beyonder power, the higher that chances of failure.
  • Even if a Polymath manages to Imitate a Beyonder power of the same Sequence level as them, the power they Imitate will always be very different from the original.
  • Edwina Edwards (opens in a new tab) failed in her search for messengers partly because the Imitation of undead powers weren't enough to sign a Contract.
  • They can Imitate passive Beyonder powers such as a Devil's Danger Premonition. However, such abilities cannot be copied through observation alone and requires anatomical research.
  • In addition, the effect must be actively maintained through Imitation for passive abilities to show effects.
  • They can Imitate even powers like Recording, but it requires a lot of knowledge.
  • Polymaths are also able to Imitate Fate-related Beyonder abilities.
  • At the stage of a Polymath, as long as the corresponding knowledge is Analyzed and mastered, there is no limit to the number of Spells and abilities that can be Imitated.
  • However, the effect of Imitation will vary depending on the degree of Analysis, the degree of knowledge mastery in addition to the degree of potion digestion.
  • It may be 20% at the worst, and can reach to 50% of the original at the best.
  • Their Imitated abilities can Imitate Demigod-level power, and if the knowledge is fully grasped, not much difference from a Scribe's Recording.
  • The chances of successfully Imitating a Demigod-level power is very low, and they must fully master the knowledge of the corresponding power to reach its maximum level.
  • This Demigod ability can harm an Overseer of Chaos Mist Pathway.
  • This is different compared to Replication/Recording of the  ![Door Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Door_Pathway) Door Pathway.
  • Using a computer analogy, Imitation is equivalent to reverse-engineering the code yourself and writing a similar one, whereas Recording and Replication are equivalent to a "Copy" operation.
  • Imitation can't Imitate authorities, even when one reaches Sequence 0.

Notes:

  1. The Question used as a reference mentioned both Polymath and Mysticism Magister, and the author didn't specify any of them in the answer, so this statement might be for Polymath or Mysticism Magister.

Sequence 5: Mysticism Magister

New Abilities

  • Mystic Arts: A Mysticism Magister masters various magical, diverse, unique, and rare Mystic Arts, and can even invent their own strange yet effective Spells.
  • Depending on the chosen Ritual (opens in a new tab), the area of the Mystic Arts created and mastered by the Mysticism Magister will vary:
  • "Teaching at least five Mid-Sequence Beyonders who have independently comprehended Acting Method" means being more adept at creating and using Mystic Arts in the corresponding Mid-Sequence Beyonder's field.
  • "Teaching at least fifty Erudites" means being well rounded in the Mystic Arts field, with no weaknesses but also no strengths.
  • When a Mysticism Magister first advances, they can naturally obtain six to thirteen mystic arts from the current Omniscience authority holder.
  • After that, they can acquire Mystic Arts through learning and self-creation.
  • Mysticism Magisters can achieve the effect of being well-rounded with this ability.
  • So long as they have the required knowledge and materials at hand, they can make any Spell from healing to defense, offense, and support as Omniscience implies Omnipotence.
  • Their Spells include definitions such as Uncommon, Unique to Oneself, and Distinctive, and at the same time, their Spells may or may not have casting steps.
  • Unlike the Spells created by Warlocks, Mystic Arts can often omit the casting materials, incantations, and most casting steps, making them faster and more secretive.
  • Of course, not all Mystic Arts can omit those. Mystic Arts with prior preparations generally either have very special effects or are very powerful.
  • Some of the Spells and techniques they can use include but are not limited to:
  • Mirror Curse: Edwina Edwards (opens in a new tab) used a bizarre but powerful spell that uses a brass mirror to reflect Ulyssan (opens in a new tab)'s body parts, pinching the reflection at the mirror’s surface before pulling outward, causing Ulyssan's wound to instantly worsen.
  • Theoretically, if a Mysticism Magister has mastered sufficient knowledge, they can reproduce the Spells Evans Freezing Ray and Elemental Order (these Spells are from Cuttlefish's (opens in a new tab) other novel, Throne of the Magical Arcana (opens in a new tab)).
  • Evans Freezing Ray: This is a high-precision Freezing Spell that emits a concentrated, colorless dim ray that Freezes specific targets, turning their skin into a layer of crystal Ice and also Freezing the target's surroundings.
  • Elemental Order: This is a Spell based on the periodic law of basic elements, capable of precisely arranging electrons, allowing the them to control and combine elements for attack, defense or recycling.
  • Mysticism Magisters can use Mystic Arts to delay the loss of control of Beyonders, or to permanently or temporarily enhance their own physical abilities.

Strengthened Abilities

  • The previous Sequences’ abilities have been enhanced.
  • Imitation: Their Imitated Spells can now have 60% of the original effect.

Sequence 4: Prophet

Description

They begin to master higher levels of Mystical knowledge in the realm of Fate, thereby gaining the ability of “Prophecy".

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They gain the physical power of a Demigod.

New Abilities

  • Prophecy: They can get a relatively clear view of the most likely scenarios to happen in the future, or a vague view of the possibility that is most likely to become reality.
  • Lucca (opens in a new tab) Prophesied that he will be in a difficult circumstance in the future, and that one of the people he meets in the next few days (Gehrman Sparrow (opens in a new tab)) will help him deal with that situation.
  • Demigod-level Officials of the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom (opens in a new tab) Prophesied that Lumian (opens in a new tab) would appear in Azshara (opens in a new tab), thus allowing them to make arrests in advance.
  • Astral World Mystic Arts: Prophets can acquire some non-dangerous Astral World Knowledge, and thus rely on this knowledge to learn or create some mysticisms that utilize Astral World power.
  • Herabergen (opens in a new tab)'s Extermination of Worms Art: Because the concept of a "Worm" is targeted, this mysticism can effectively kill various individual "Worms" within its range, such as so-and-so, so-and-so, so-and-so, but not including an worms collection.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their previous Sequences’ abilities have been enhanced.
  • Imitation: Their Imitation of Spells is at 80% potency of the original effects now.
  • Analyze: They can discern Beyonders from ordinary people with Analysis.
  • Mystic Arts: Their ability to create various Mystic Arts has been enhanced.
  • Lucca Brewster (opens in a new tab) sealed himself to a certain extent at the critical moment so as not to instantly lose control when using his incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab).
  • Spellcasting: Their ability to create Spells has improved significantly.
  • Lucca Brewster (opens in a new tab) who was trapped underground, focused his attention on deciphering the secrets hidden within a Seal and used those secrets to invent Spells for his situation.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 4 Demigods they receive some level of Godhood, which they can use to transform into an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) that consists of Illusory Bookshelves.
  • They appear like llusory bookshelves that don't appear real. There are pools of black shadows hidden in different spots on the bookshelf as they curl and stretch like eyes from time to time.

Note:

  1. The Author literally wrote "So and so" three times, without mentioning what the three "So and so" are, however, considering the fact that he speaks about Worms (虫), and that it's three types of Worms, it's probably "The Worms of Spirit, the Worms of Time, and the Worms of Stars."

Sequence 3: Cognizer

Authorities

  • Law: "They" gain a partial Law authority.
  • Cognizing: It is the ability to understand the rules of the world and grasp many profound mysteries, enemies standing in front of a Cognizer can rarely hide any secret. Everything, be it their strengths, weakness, or anything else is all laid bare for the Cognizer to see.
  • They Cognize the essence without any senses or specific forms of cognition, effectively viewing the true essence of things without relying on their senses.
  • They can use their deep insight to see through and Analyze certain symbols and use it to create Spells through a process of Imitation.
  • For example, Cognizers can look and peer into the symbols of Lumian's Dream (opens in a new tab) and derive certain Spells based off the symbols they have comprehended.
  • Because a Cognizer possesses the leverage to move the world and achieve their goals, they are often able to solve problems in a very easy way.
  • For instance, a Cognizer can cause a mountain to collapse, perhaps even without the ability to cause calamity or destruction, just by simply prying away a rock.
  • A Cognizer does not directly manipulate the Laws, but rather, after understanding them, employs corresponding methods to leverage these Laws.
  • Compared to a Mentor of Deceit who directly deceives the Laws and Rules, a Cognizer first engages in targeted, misleading actions before leveraging the Laws to accomplish Deception in order to achieve a similar effect.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 3 Beyonders, they can now respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Wisdom Angel

Authorities

  • Wisdom: When "They" have to make a decision, "They" will always make most correct choices at the right time due to "Their" ability to accurately foresee shifts in situations.
  • Combined with their abilities as Prophets and Cognizers, after Cognizing all of "Their" enemies' abilities and secrets and Prophesying the future, "They" are very hard to kill or to deal with.
  • The Demoness of Gold (opens in a new tab) did not return to the Mirror World or face Xio (opens in a new tab) or Derrick (opens in a new tab). As the wielder of the Eye of God (opens in a new tab), she was able to always foresee shifts within a situation and make right choices at the right time, thus allowing her to evade many disasters that fell in others' way.
  • Wisdom also brings enhancements to abilities such as Learning and Analysis, allowing "Them" to utilize these authorities to a limited extent.
  • "They" are able to see the target's strengths and weaknesses, as well as unravel the mysteries, weaknesses, or flaws of the observed object.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "Their" previous Sequence capabilities have been improved.
  • Imitation: Imitated abilities and Spell effects can reach 90% of the original's potency.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is now complete; it is that of a phantom tower, each level composed of thick books, each book bearing a brass-colored eye. The higher the level, the darker it becomes, filled with an aura of Madness, Destruction, Misfortune, and Disaster.

Sequence 1: Omniscient Eye

Authorities

  • Omniscience: "They" are able to see the information about anyone and anything, regardless of whether it pertains to knowledge about a target's past, present, or future. The respective scope of this Omniscience is the monitoring of Information.
  • Omniscience can be activated on targets and situations that are nowhere near "Them", enabling "Them" to still be able peer into a target's past, present, or future information.
  • Arrodes (opens in a new tab), despite being nowhere near the Astral World, was able to hear a voice coming from deep within Tenebrous Heaven (opens in a new tab) that shouted the Sanguine Ancestor's (opens in a new tab) name.
  • "They" are able to instantly see all the information about the state, weaknesses, and the exploitable vulnerabilities of any target.
  • When "They" detect an exploitable problem, "They" could see how to exploit it with the most appropriate way, and see how exploiting it would be manifested.
  • Cheek (opens in a new tab) used Omniscience authority to know every information about Amon's (opens in a new tab) state, and weaknesses, searching for vulnerabilities to exploit, which she found quickly.
  • Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab), using Omniscience authority, was able to instantly detect the exploitable problems and ways to worsen it within the Malevolent Dragon (opens in a new tab).
  • An Omniscient Eye's Imitated abilities and Spell potency are now 100% identical to the original, but it does not involve authority.
  • Astral World Mentor: "They" can, in the short-term and with limited-scope, manipulate Astral World concepts to render certain actions of a target ineffective, cause an error or amplify their impact.
  • For example, "They" can redefine the concept of Water in the Sea of Collective Subconscious or Water in the Chaos Sea (opens in a new tab), making them unusable or better utilized by a Tyrant.
  • This temporary modification of concepts can only affect one aspect of the original concept and must not involve the subject, it also can't exceed more than one aspect.

Sequence 0: White Tower

Symbolism

  • "They" symbolize the underlying symbolism of Knowledge leads to Calamity.

Authorities

  • Omniscience: The White Tower has Omniscience over all things, which is unaffected by the Spirit World. At this level, the scope of "Their" Omniscience is Knowledge.
  • As Omniscience implies Omnipotence, "They" can Imitate any ability, achieving the original's power, or even optimize and surpass it; however, this does not include authorities and symbols.
  • Even if the White Tower fully grasped the knowledge to the corresponding authorities and symbolisms, "They" cannot acquire them, only imitating their external manifestations.
  • This is because authorities and symbolisms are more like the embodiment of permissions and concepts. Without obtaining them, they cannot be used.
  • Even if the White Tower can see the future information, this doesn't mean "They" can see it entirely. For example, "They" might gain vague foresight that one would gain something unique, however, "They" might not know what it's.
  • The God of Knowledge and Wisdom (opens in a new tab) had seen via Omniscience that Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) would gain something rather unique, but "He" didn't know what that 'thing' would be.
  • Omniscience can be influenced by Symbolisms like Foolishness and Inconceivable.
  • Laws: Knowing the Laws allows one to grasp and utilize it.
  • At this level, "They" can "open source" "Their" Spells to be used by ordinary people, albeit it won't be very strong and has some requirements.
  • These "open source" Spells require materials, incantations, Spirit World resonance, Spirituality absorption, etc.
  • This partial authority is subordinate to the Omniscience authority.
  • Astral World Ladder: "They" can influence the concept of Astral World convergence to a certain extent.
  • "They" can influence Astral World concepts, and while "They" can't yet completely block Proxy, Sacrifice, compliance, etc., "They" can effectively interfere with it.
  • For instance, it can cause the concept of "Allegiance" to briefly increase in extension or intension, causing the Hand of God's allegiance to suddenly fail to meet all conditions, allowing only proxying of a portion of the originally intended power, or even fail.
  • When it comes to the Twilight Giant, "They" can use their own methods to interfere with "Their" Proxy, reducing the power of the self-detonation.
  • Astral World Ladder also symbolizes the layers of Knowledge that lead to the most essential aspects of the universe as well as the most fundamental dangers.
  • Creation: A partial authority over Creation, originating from the Symbolisms of Maker and The Omnipotent and Omniscient.
  • The Omniscient White Tower can naturally Create anything, but it cannot escape the symbolisms and authorities that do not belong to "Them".
  • Calamity: "They" have a partial authority over Calamity.
  • They are capable of inflicting Madness and Destruction onto others as certain Knowledge is the embodiment of those symbols.
  • Wisdom: "They" have partial authority over Wisdom.
  • Omniscience means being able to provide the Wisest guidance and make the Wisest choices.
  • Learning: "They" have partial authority over Learning, which is derived from Omniscience and Wisdom.
  • Analysis: "They" have partial authority over Analysis, which is derived from Omniscience and Wisdom.
  • Tower of Omniscience (Tower of Madness): This is "Their" Divine Kingdom.

Mythical Creature Form

  • An illusory Tower, every level was made up of thick books. Each book has a brass eye on it. The higher one looks, the darker it becomes. It is filled with the aura of insanity, destruction, inauspiciousness, and disaster. The tower extends into the sky, as though it encompasses the entire world within itself.

Hanged Man Pathway

Sequence 9: Secrets Suppliant

Traits

  • High Spirituality: Secrets Suppliants have a high Spiritual Perception which they can use it to detect some mysterious and horrible existences.
  • Ritualistic Magic & Divination Arts: They can use their strong Spirituality to perform Divination and Ritualistic Magic, but it's not as accurate as Pathways that specialize in this field.
  • Their High Spirituality also allows them to detect auras of relatively powerful Beyonders (provided that those Beyonders did not conceal their aura beforehand).
  • Osta Trul (opens in a new tab) was able to feel that the real world was wrapped in a thick veil (opens in a new tab), and beyond that veil, emotionless eyes (opens in a new tab) were watching them.

New Abilities

  • Knowledge (Mysticism): Secrets Suppliants are bestowed with a decent amount of knowledge regarding sacrifices and some knowledge on Ritualistic Magic.
  • There are some Honorific Names (opens in a new tab) included in the potion's knowledge, but they're all secret entities with sinister names that includes elements like "depravity", "true kin", or the "gaze of fate".
  • It is known that the information attached to the potion contains the name of the True Creator (opens in a new tab) and Angel of Fate Ouroboros (opens in a new tab); however, the three parts of the name "gaze of fate" does not fully describe the latter's Honorific Name. Aurora Order (opens in a new tab) members who gave this name have other purposes, so they have made some processing on the name.
  • The knowledge attached to the potion given will more or less cause distortions in a Secrets Suppliants' cognitive perspectives and thus make it easy for them to lose control.

Sequence 8: Listener (Whispered)

Description

Nighthawk (opens in a new tab) files state that every Listener is a lunatic - even if they look normal on the surface, they are always crazy on the inside. The files also state that it was difficult for Listeners to survive the next five years after taking the potion if they were unable to advance, because they frequently came into contact with powerful, distorted entities.

Traits

  • High Spirituality: Their spiritual sense is further enhanced.

New Abilities

  • Listen: Every Listener can Listen directly into the whispers of the secret entities; thus, they frequently come into contact with information from powerful, distorted, and unique entities.
  • While they can obtain powerful, twisted, and unique abilities, if they cannot advance in Sequence, it would be difficult for them to survive for more than 5 years.
  • Every Listener is a lunatic - even if they look normal on the surface and behave normally at ordinary times, they are always crazy on the inside.
  • Even if they don't actively use Listening, one will hear more than ordinary people and most of the Low-Mid Sequence Beyonders within a normal area.
  • When the source of the sound is close enough to them, a Listener will be more affected and will receive more dangerous information.
  • At this stage, this Beyonder power is always active (in a passive state). At later Sequences, they can choose whether or not to proactively use it.

Sequence 7: Shadow Ascetic

New Abilities

  • A Shadow Ascetic gains a preliminary control and grasp over Shadows
  • Shadow Summon: Shadow Ascetics can summon Shadow creatures to influence, restrict or attack the target; however, Summoning a Shadow creature is a risky action.
  • The Summoned Shadow creature may be something terrifying and out of control, or it may merely be a monster that only feeds on the Shadow Ascetic.
  • Shadow Curse: Using the target's Flesh and Blood, the cooperation of a Ritual, or part of the target's Shadow as a medium, they can inflict a Curse on them.
  • Shadow Manipulation: After Lurking in the Shadows, Shadow Ascetics can influence the target's Shadow in the Shadow World, and even try to capture it.
  • A Shadow Ascetic can envelop a target in huge black chrysalis made from Shadows that can contain a Pugilist from the Twilight Giant Pathway that has lost control.
  • Shadow Lurking: Shadow Ascetics can Conceal themselves in larger Shadows as well as use the power of Shadows to secretly track a target.
  • In a Shadow Ascetic's visual perception, their surroundings will appear grayish-black and transparent with the surrounding area being blurred.
  • All the sounds a Shadow Ascetic will hear in this Concealed state will seem to come from the empty depths of the starry sky, empty and distant.
  • This state would occasionally evoke the sensation of being watched by the Darkness to the targets a Shadow Ascetic looks at.
  • Shadow Shaping: Shadow Ascetics are able to directly utilize the power of Shadows and Shape those Shadows into weapons or animals.
  • Such Shadow items can cause damage that makes the target cold and Degenerate.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Listen: It is at this Sequence where a Shadow Ascetic can turn off this Beyonder power.

Sequence 6: Rose Bishop (Rose Priest)

New Abilities

  • Flesh & Blood Magic: Every Rose Bishop is an expert in Flesh & Blood Magic.
  • As a result, Rose Bishops are extremely good at treating physical injuries and physical Mutation.
  • This is because it's essence is the deep control of cells. No matter what kind of changes occur in the body, as long as it does not involve the Soul, it can be recovered.
  • In other words, if they don't run out of Flesh and Blood and their Soul has not been annihilated, the body of the Rose Bishop does not have fatal weaknesses.
  • As a reference they can heal from and fully restore entire lost limbs. Even seemingly fatal wounds to their head or heart are not necessarily fatal.
  • As for the following manifestations of Flesh & Blood Magic, they are:
  • Flesh Creek: Rose Bishops can melt like a candle and turn into pure sticky Flesh and Blood that can quickly penetrate into the ground and move, or hide within other people's stomach in order to avoid detection.
  • To stay better Concealed, they are able to integrate with the host's body; however, once they leave the body, their host will die.
  • When a Rose Bishop enters the inside of a host body's stomach, they will be able to monitor the host's current status.
  • Parts of a Rose Bishop's body (like their face) can melt like a candle as a way to assimilate other creatures.
  • Heath Doyle's (opens in a new tab) plastered his face on the meter long blue fish, which stiffened and melted into a disgusting pool of Flesh and Blood that surged into his mouth.
  • Flesh Softening: They can soften blows on their body as though they were boneless piles of rotten Flesh. Even gunshots would only sink into their body, failing to do damage.
  • Disguise: To some extent, they can modify their own appearance, such as making them more muscular or slightly changing facial features with sufficient skill and practice.
  • However, it's just that a Rose Bishop can't adjust as precisely as a Faceless and the modifications may look a bit weird.
  • Flesh Bomb: Their body's Flesh or a part of it can be torn off and made into Flesh Bombs that can be thrown as explosives, which will explode into a rain of Corrosive Blood.
  • Their Flesh and Blood Bombs can also be buried inside other people's bodies, which can be detonated, turning them into sticky and rich Flesh and Blood.
  • Flesh and Blood Servants: They can create Flesh and Blood Puppets with immense strength, immunity to spirit attacks, as well as self-destruction capability.
  • Flesh and Blood Curse: If a target's Flesh and Blood falls into the hands of a Rose Bishop it can be used to inflict this type of Curse onto the target.
  • Body Hiding: A Rose Bishop is able to wrap a corpse up within their body by consuming it with their Flesh and Blood to clear a crime scene quickly.
  • Flesh Cloak: A Rose Bishop can create cloaks of sticky Flesh (either procured from them or others) that can reduce Spell and other damage.
  • Birth Control: A female Rose Bishop is capable of stopping her menstruation cycle at this Sequence as a Flesh and Blood expert.
  • A Rose Bishop must regularly replenish their Flesh and Blood.
  • If they do not do so, a Rose Bishop will not be able to fully exert the power of Flesh and Blood Magic and will easily lose control and/or die.

Sequence 5: Shepherd

New Abilities

  • Grazing: Shepherds can swallow a target's Soul and Beyonder Characteristics or Boon powers into their body, including Wraiths and Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab), and use those Beyonder powers for themselves.
  • They can Graze Saint-level (opens in a new tab) Souls, however, doing so will greatly increase their risk of losing control.
  • If a Grazed Soul is at the level of a Demigod, it can be directly released into the real world to fight. This is due to the corporeal Spirit Bodies that Demigods possess.
  • Using the Grazed Soul powers will only consume that Soul's Spirituality
  • Releasing a Soul won't allow the Shepherd to use another Soul.
  • Only one of such Soul can exist in the real world at a time.
  • Losing Grazing will make them lose control because of the Souls' interaction in their body.
  • Making them unable to use Grazed Souls will not have much of an effect on them. It is only when they lose the ability fully would they begin to lose control.
  • A Depriver's Deprivation as well as a Prometheus' Theft are examples of Beyonder powers that can cause a Shepherd to lose control.
  • Shepherds can't activate Grazing continuously, which restricts passive abilities.
  • As such Beyonder powers that are more passive in nature (like a Devil's Danger Premonition) are effective only when actively Grazing that particular Soul.
  • A Shepherd, upon full potion digestion, will be able to Graze up to 7 Souls.
  • They can only use one Soul at a time, but they can instantly switch between them.
  • They can only use up to 3 Beyonder powers from a particular Soul.
  • As the Sequence increases, they will be able to use more abilities from Grazed Souls.
  • When Grazing a new Soul, a Shepherd will be able to choose which powers to acquire.
  • They can still use their own Beyonder powers when using a Soul's Beyonder powers.
  • Beyonder powers that normally don't allow its user to move freely like a Nightmare's Nightmare State can be used without the Shepherd needing to stay still.
  • A Shepherd's Grazed target has to include a Soul.
  • Such a condition won't be changed even at higher Sequences. Even the Hanged Man needs a Soul to Graze a Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) or Beyonder Characteristic and cannot simply target it alone.
  • Grazing entails a certain reduction in the potency Beyonder powers of the Grazed Soul. This is because the Soul must be damaged before it can be Grazed by a Shepherd.
  • Even if the Soul of a target stays Grazed, it will gradually wear away afterwards, meaning it can't be permanently kept by them.
  • If a Soul does not fall in Depravity, and instead is forcibly Grazed, it won't completely cooperate with the Shepherd.
  • A Grazed Soul might only wield half of its original power.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Flesh and Blood Magic: They have further mastered abilities under Flesh and Blood Magic.
  • Devouring: Shepherds can directly Devour a target's Flesh and Blood, along with their Soul, leaving no traces behind. This is a strengthened version of Body Hiding.
  • Their previous capability of using Shadows as a Shadow Ascetic has been enhanced.
  • Commandeering Shadows: An advanced version of Shadow Shaping, now allowing a Shepherd to directly be able to Shape the deep non-living Shadows.
  • They can give these Shadows physical substance, make them bind targets, crush or compress objects, or Corrode and melt entities.

Sequence 4: Black Knight

New Abilities

  • Cull of Spiritual Flesh: This is the core Beyonder power of a Black Knight, stemming from the Degeneration domain. It manifests as a Black Greatsword and has the following effects:
  • It can render any living creature with Degenerate thoughts to lose their defenses.
  • It Corrodes both Flesh and Blood while also obliterating Souls.
  • It can cleave through powerful physical barriers.
  • Black Armor: They can transform into a small giant 2-3 meters tall, covered in a Black, cold Armor, with only two balls of deep red light flashing at the position of their eyes.
  • This Black Armor is formed from the powers of Degeneration, protecting them from various attacks and it can also fracture to redirect damage, protecting the Black Knight.
  • Shadow of Depravation: They can peel off one of their Depraved thoughts into a Shadow, forming an uncontrollable, independent creature.
  • This can be used to purge foreign consciousnesses out of their minds.
  • For instance, they can eject a Manipulator's Virtual Persona from their mind and turn it into a Shadow of Depravation, effectively canceling its effects on their mind.
  • If the Manipulator cannot quickly resolve the Shadow of Depravation, those Depraved thoughts would turn them half-mad, even causing them to lose control.
  • A Shadow of Depravation has the following characteristics:
  • It can induce Degeneration, turning targets against allies.
  • It is capable of instantly Corroding and breaking things.
  • It is able to shape Shadows into defensive armor.
  • It is able to dissolve into a piece of Darkness.
  • It can cover things in stick blackness.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their previous Beyonder powers from previous Sequences have been enhanced.
  • Flesh and Blood Magic: Their grasp on abilities of this domain have been strengthened.
  • Flesh Rug: They can transform themselves into a thin, Bloody, and Flesh-dripping Rug that covers an area, effectively dividing the battlefield and preventing grouping among enemies.
  • A Black Knight is better capable of utilizing the power of Shadows.
  • Commandeering Shadows: A Black Knight could make the enemy’s own Shadows surge like liquid, in order to entangle and restrict their enemies' movement.
  • The Shadow of a target is equivalent to a fraction of the target, so by severing the enemy's Shadow, it will make the enemy's spirit lose integrity.
  • Shadow Enclosure: A Black Knight can use the surrounding Shadows to create an Enclosed space to confine an enemy and chain them inside of it.
  • Grazing: Their ability to Graze Souls have been enhanced.
  • The can externally release any Grazed Soul.
  • Released Grazed Souls can use all their Beyonder powers.
  • They can hold up to 9 Grazed Souls.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 4 Demigods they receive some level of Godhood, and with it comes an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). Disregarding all consequences, they can release their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) to become a black Shadow and writhing Flesh.

Sequence 3: Trinity Templar

Authorities

  • Flesh and Blood: They gain certain manifestations of the Flesh and Blood authorities - A lower authorities under the Mutation authority.
  • Trinity Body: They can sprout out 2 Shadowed heads (one youthful and the other elderly) from their shoulders on each side that can further separate to form 3 bodies via Flesh and Blood.
  • In this form, up to 3 Souls can be Grazed at the same time (one per head).
  • Flesh and Blood Immortality: So long as there is a single cell left and so long as there is other Flesh and Blood around to be absorbed, a Trinity Templar can rebuild their body.
  • The premise is of course that their spirit is not destroyed.

Strengthened Abilities

  • They have gained improvements in Beyonder powers such as Cull of the Spirit Flesh and prior abilities
  • Trinity Templars are able to create Shadow Substitutes through Shadows.
  • Shadow Substitute: A Trinity Templar can weave the surrounding Shadows into their own image and swap places with it at will to avoid a fatal attack.
  • Grazing: A Trinity Templar's ability to Graze Souls have been enhanced.
  • They can release up to 3 Souls and use their Beyonder powers simultaneously as well as be able to Graze a total of 13 Souls.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can listen and respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Profane Presbyter

Authorities

  • Profane Language: "They" have mastered the Profane Language, a manifestation of the authorities of Degeneration and Filth.
  • "They" can weaponize a target's responses and words- extracting phrases or magnifying ambiguities to impose a word-spirit like effect such as imprisonment, Corruption or separation.
  • Any actions that have the meaning of “exchange” or “communication” can be affected by Profane Language, for example, the sign language can be distorted or misinterpreted.
  • When Klein (opens in a new tab) answered who he was, it ended up separating "a lonely traveler" from him, splitting his Gehrman Sparrow (opens in a new tab) persona that has the same thoughts and abilities, effectively canceling Klein's (opens in a new tab) Historical Projection Summoning.
  • The separation here was when Klein's Degenerate thoughts combined with his Shadow, which then cancelled out his Historical Void Summoning.
  • When Klein (opens in a new tab) said that he didn’t know where the owner of the city had gone, Angel of the Holy Word Steph (opens in a new tab) extracted the words “I don’t know where I went,” trapping him and isolating him from the outside world.
  • "They" can achieve enhancements on "Themselves", making it so that when "They" reveal "Their" identity, each word that references "Them" enhances "Their" level and strength.
  • When Steph (opens in a new tab) announced "Himself" to Klein (opens in a new tab), "He" used this aspect of the Profane Language authority, effectively enhancing "His" level and strength with each and every word.
  • "They" can induce a target to Degenerate via a "spiritual" Cull of Spiritual Flesh. Targets who possess Degenerate thoughts are not able to resist this influence.
  • This will bring out the Degenerate thoughts of "Their" opponents as their Soul plummets, sinking into the viscous black depths of their inner psyche, restraining their actions.
  • Through "Their" authority of Profane Language, "They" can create and direct Curses onto targets that inflict Degeneration and Corruption.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "Their" capabilities in the area of Flesh and Blood Magic as well Shadows have been strengthened.
  • Grazing: "They" can Graze up to 18 Souls.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) has become complete. "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is that of a black Shadow and writhing Flesh.

Sequence 1: Dark Angel

Authorities

  • Shadows (Shadow Ruler): A Dark Angel is able to control and use the Shadow World; however, "They" are not yet the Shadow World's full master.
  • Similar to the Demoness' Dark Magic authority, "They" are effectively immune to any Spells or abilities that utilize Shadows or the Shadow World, and can alter those powers freely.
  • This also makes "Them" Omnipotent against creatures that reside within the Shadow World.
  • After completing the Advancement Ritual (opens in a new tab) and advancing to Dark Angel, "They" will be the Shadow of the Sun, increasing "Their" resistance towards the Sun's Purification, making "Them" no longer be severely countered by the Sun Pathway as before.
  • Degeneration/Depravity: "They" have mastered the authorities of Degeneration domain.
  • A Dark Angel is able to make people, objects, projections and abilities Corrode and Betray their owner. Even a target's own body is no exception.
  • The Evil Spirit Sasrir (opens in a new tab) Degenerated Lovia (opens in a new tab)'s body, making it Betray her.
  • Profane Language: The Dark Angel's voice, being both evil and sinister, carries a strong sense of Degeneration that can achieve the following:
  • Using words like "Blasphemer, die!", "They" could make a Demigod's consciousness turn blurry, their energy evaporate, flesh wither inch by inch, and mind losing grasp over sanity.
  • With "Their" use of Profane Language, "They" can cause accelerated life drain on targets as well as intensify the madness that is within an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab).
  • Depraved Dependents: "They" can make released Grazed Souls into temporary followers, up to 22 Souls, but at the same time, they are affected by the Degeneration authority and will obey the Dark Angel's orders wholeheartedly as well as retain their full original abilities.
  • Darkness: A Dark Angel is able to manifest an embodiment of the Darkness authority.
  • "They" can conjure a pitch-black, viscous "ocean" filled with an aura of Degeneration, swallowing enemy attacks and nullifying them. Alternatively, it can coat the enemy's surface with a layer of viscous black liquid to disrupt cognition and movement.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Grazing: "They" can Graze up to 22 Souls.

Sequence 0: Hanged Man

Description

The True God presiding over the domain of Degeneration/Depravity, an amalgamation of Black Shadows and Writhing Flesh, possessing five heads and the corresponding Shadows. "He" holds partial authority over the domains of Shadow, Darkness, Degeneration/Depravity, Filth, and Mutation, while also embodying the concepts and partial Symbolism of Sin-Bearing and Sacrifice.

**Symbolism

  • Sin-Bearing (Scapegoat): "They" can take the damage and death intended for others, redirecting the enemy’s primary attacks toward "Themselves".
  • The True Creator (opens in a new tab) bears the world's Sins, making "His" believers innocent in the eyes of the world. As a result, they cannot be found guilty or punished by Beyonder powers similar to an Overseer's.
  • Sacrifice (Hanged Man): By Sacrificing "Themselves", "They" can secure absolute hope.

Authorities

  • Darkness: Compared to the Darkness, the Hanged Man’s Darkness leans toward an all-consuming, devouring Darkness and a Darkness that corrupts the heart.
  • Those who walk into "Their" Shadows and Darkness without sufficient protection or status will quickly fall into Depravity, turning into Corrupted monsters.
  • Every year, many individuals within the Forsaken Land of the Gods (opens in a new tab) fall under the Shadows and Darkness, quickly turning into Corrupted monsters.
  • Mutations: "They" hold authority over Mutations which is the authority that the Flesh and Blood authority is derived from.
  • "They" can create countless Corrupted monsters from nothing in the Darkness that possess the particularity of Resurrection: a qualitative change of Flesh and Blood Immortality.
  • The Forsaken Land of the Gods (opens in a new tab) is cursed with the influence of the Ancient Sun God (opens in a new tab), spawning countless Corrupted monsters in the Darkness.
  • The Hanged Man's authority of Mutation is also capable of influencing the Change of all things to some extent, which partially overlaps with the authority of the Fool.
  • Shadows (Lord of Shadows): "They" have now become the absolute ruler of the Shadow World.
  • "Their" Divine Kingdom is that of the entire Shadow World, or something similar.
  • "Their" Shadows inherently possess some Concealment abilities.
  • Degeneration/Depravity (Degenerate Nature): "They" are the Degenerate Nature of all living things.
  • "They" can make a Shadow rise and adhere to "Their" target's back, while other similar Shadows will continually emerge from the depths of the target's psyche, merging within and out and reshaping their form, being the inherent Degenerate Nature in all living things.
  • Apart from certain High Sequence Beyonders (such as an Angel of Redemption), no one is able to separate from their own Depraved Nature. At most, they will only be able to suppress it's effects on them.
  • While the Chaos Primogenitor's Degeneration authority focuses on a comprehensive Corruption of body, mind, and Spirit, the Hanged Man's authority over Degeneration is self-Corruption.
  • Filth (Incarnation of Filth): Being tainted by the Chaos Sea (opens in a new tab), "They" can Defile all things.
  • When combined with the Darkness and Degeneration, "They" are capable of projecting traces of the Chaos Sea (opens in a new tab)'s influence.
  • Grazing: "They" have the authority of Grazing, derived from the Omnipotence symbolism.
  • Profane Language: A manifestation of the authorities of Degeneration and Filth.
  • "He" can plant a "seed" that melts into the Spirit Body of "Their" target. Part of the target's body would be merged with the "seed", making it extremely hard to Purify. It would influence the target mystically, but would also influence their Mind and Fate.
  • The True Creator (opens in a new tab) planted a "seed" in Klein that forced him to meet Sasrir (opens in a new tab) in the Giant King's Court (opens in a new tab). This was partly due to mystic means but was also because of alterations in the mind as well as in Fate.

Darkness Pathway

Sequence 9: Sleepless

Traits

  • High Spirituality: A Sleepless and their corresponding Pathways have a High Spirituality compared to other Pathways. Thus they possess high spiritual perception and sensitivity.
  • Spirit Vision: They can use Spirit Vision; however, they are unable to precisely differentiate the status of different body parts. It can only be used to see spiritual things, but is not as effective as relying on their spiritual perception.
  • Divination Arts & Ritualistic Magic: Their potent Spirituality allows them to do limited Divination and Ritualistic Magic. However, their usage of Ritualistic Magic is far inferior to the likes of Seers and Mystery Pryers.

New Abilities

  • Nocturnality: The deeper into the night, the more powerful a Sleepless will become. Their physical strength, intuition, and mental capabilities are all the aspects that get strengthened.
  • They can see through the darkness even without any lights.
  • They are able to sense dangers that are hidden in the dark.
  • They only need to rest for around 3-4 hours a day.

Sequence 8: Midnight Poet

New Abilities

  • Midnight Poem: Midnight Poets can cast effects through the recital of a poem related to the night or the Evernight Goddess (opens in a new tab). These Midnight Poems can manifest all sorts of varying effects.
  • It is possible to resist the effects of Midnight Poems by Cogitating or stuffing one's ears.
  • However, repeatedly getting affected would eventually wear down one's defences.
  • The types of effects that a Midnight Poet can cast using a poem are:
  • Tranquillise:⁂ They can make people's bodies, hearts, and souls feel purified and Tranquil, which can cause Beyonders who lost control to reveal abnormal reactions.
  • The corresponding phrases to this Midnight Poem are:
  • "When once the sun sinks in the west, And dewdrops pearl the evening's breast; Almost as pale as moonbeams are, Or its companionable star, The evening primrose opens anew Its delicate blossoms to the dew; And, hermit-like, shunning the light."
  • "Lacking clothes and food, they have no shelter in the cold. They are drenched by rains, and huddle around the rocks for lack of shelter. They are orphans snatched from the breast, hope lost on them; they are the poor that have been forced off the proper path. The Evernight (opens in a new tab) did not forsake them, but bestowed them with love."
  • Lullaby:⁂ They are able to put multiple people to sleep via a Lullaby, while those that can resist would remain serene and find it hard to evoke and express emotions.
  • Those afflicted will believe they only heard the song in their Dreams.
  • The corresponding phrases to this Midnight Poem are:
  • _"Calm is the morn without a sound, Calm as to suit a calmer grief, And only thro' the faded leaf, The chestnut pattering to the ground."
  • Pacify:⁂ Midnight Poets are able to tranquillise their opponents and make them lose their desire to live, turning them limp and unresponsive.
  • The corresponding phrases to this Midnight Poem are:
  • _"Thus it blooms on while night is by; When day looks out with open eye, Bashed at the gaze it cannot shun, It faints and withers and is gone."
  • Midnight Poets can also use Midnight Poems to cause the opposing target to feel Fear.
  • Midnight Poets also have expertise in combat, marksmanship, climbing and spiritual perception.

Sequence 7: Nightmare

Traits

  • High Spirituality: Their Spirituality gets enhanced significantly.
  • They are able to use their strong Spirituality to resonate the air around them, allowing them to recite Midnight Poems without the use of their throat.

New Abilities

  • Nightmare State: A Nightmare can separate their Soul from their physical body while they sleep, allowing it to move around freely within an initial city-wide range and infiltrate Dreams.
  • Normal light will appear abnormally dim while in this Nightmare State and everything will be tainted with a sense of blurriness. Dreams will appear as blobs of illusory oval lights, its structure allowing a Nightmare to directly see what a person is dreaming.
  • Dream Shaping: Similar to that of a Dreamwalker, a Nightmare is able to cause different changes within a target's Dreams, guiding their target into displaying several behaviours.
  • This ability can be used to interrogate a target or get them to show their innermost secrets.
  • They can also use Dream Shaping to give fear and crush the target's spirit and psyche.
  • Dream Invasion: A Nightmare is able to forcefully drag their targets into Dreams without alerting them of having done so under most normal circumstances.
  • Dream Invasion has a limited range if done quickly, but a Nightmare is able to slowly coax their target into sleeping and thus Dreaming if they are within 100 meters.
  • They get pulled into the Dream along with their target and cannot move while using this ability. In addition at Sequence 7, they can coax to sleep a maximum of 10 targets at the same time, but can only enter the Dream of a single target.
  • Nightmare Limbs: A Nightmare is able to generate tentacle-like Nightmare Limbs protruding from their back as a means to fight at close range.
  • Due to the fact that these tentacle-like limbs are partially formed from their own flesh and blood, if they break, they will suffer the corresponding amount of damage.

Sequence 6: Soul Assurer

Traits

  • High Spirituality: A Soul Assurer's Spirituality will be enhanced slightly.
  • Ritualistic Magic & Divination Arts: They gain improvements in some spiritual abilities.
  • This gives them the ability to hold more complex Ritualistic Magic.
  • They can directly see spiritual lifeforms without the need to activate Spirit Vision.

New Abilities

  • Requiem: They can cause the Spirit Body to sleep, suppressing and soothing their targets' desires, moods, and thoughts, this causes them to slow down or freeze on the spot.
  • This can also suppress spiritual abilities such as the Spiritual Intuition of the targeted entity.
  • They are able to directly sooth Souls, ghosts, and the undead into silence using this ability.
  • Compared to a Psychiatrist's Placate, a Soul Assurer's Requiem targets the Soul.
  • Using Requiem, a Soul Assurer can also treat the emotional states of teammates.
  • This is akin to a Psychiatrist.

Strengthened Abilities

  • A Soul Assurer has gained enhancements in previous Sequence abilities.
  • Dream Invasion: They can force targets in Dreams within a 150 meter range.
  • Midnight Poem: They can use signing as a way to manifest effects.
  • Agitating:⁂ A Soul Assurer can agitate the Spirit Body of a target, heightening the target(s) corresponding frustrations and destructive urges.
  • They can discern any latent problems in their target's Soul or mind through this.
  • Nocturnality: They only need two hours of rest per day.

Sequence 5: Spirit Warlock

New Abilities

  • Spirit Commanding:⁂ They can Seal natural, evil, and deceased Spirits and put them to sleep, housing their targets within their bodies. These Spirits can then be summoned and Commanded.
  • Spirit Warlocks usually house these Spirits in their teeth and are better at controlling natural Spirits compared to Spirit Guides who are more suited towards deceased Spirits.
  • Their strength often depends on which deceased and natural Spirits they can find and control. In some cases, they can achieve 2-3 tasks at once with help from their Spirits.
  • The number of Spirits a Spirit Warlock can Command is limited by the strength of their own Spirit Body. At this Sequence, they can only control 4-5 Spirits at most.
  • Different types of Spirits are good at different things.
  • Examples of the Spirits they can use are:
  • They can use a Terror Banshee that is good at draining the consciousness of others and injecting feelings of terror in them as a form of offensive attack.
  • A natural Spirit that lets a Spirit Warlock sink to the ground and fuse with the earth before traversing at speeds faster than a steam train.
  • Various different natural, evil, and undead Spirits controlled by a Spirit Warlock can bestow them with the ability to achieve Flight.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Dream Invasion: The range has increased to 200 meters.

Sequence 4: Nightwatcher

Individual Differences

  • Bloodline Abilities: When they become a Nightwatcher, the bloodline traits of a True Deities' descendants they have used for their advancement will grant them new abilities.
  • Different True Deity bloodlines will grant each Nightwatcher distinct abilities; however, this only changes the abilities that they can use to deal with spiritual bodies.

New Abilities

  • Night Domain: Nightwatchers can make pure Darkness surge out of their body like a tide to form a domain that can boost their capabilities and weaken enemies trapped inside.
  • This can be used for defence, offset negative effects, as well as provide a good and comfortable combat environment for the Spirits controlled by the Nightwatcher.
  • Their Night Domain can weaken the enemy in many ways. It can corrode them and make them lose vitality, as well as also blessing them with Misfortune.
  • Hair Entanglement: Nightwatchers are able to create and manipulate countless hairs like a Demoness that can be used bind and immobilize enemies.
  • It brings coldness to those who touch them, making their thoughts still and their bodies peaceful, as if they no longer want to resist a peaceful slumber.
  • The hairs that the Nightwatcher can create can be invisible, as if they have emerged from the Darkness in a Dream, or they can appear black.
  • From the Hair Entanglement ability, one can vaguely glimpse the interchangeability of the Darkness Pathway and the Demoness Pathway.
  • Concealment: Nightwatchers possess some powers and abilities over Concealment.
  • A Nightwatcher is able to completely Conceal someone else's mystical connections in a state of secrecy by shrouding them with Darkness.
  • A Nightwatcher is able to Conceal someone else's exact form and physical appearance through shrouding them in a dreamy but dark mist.
  • Curse of Misfortune:⁂ They can give a certain amount of Misfortune to others.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Spirit Commanding:⁂ Their ability to control various Spirits has been enhanced.
  • For every tooth they have, that is 1 more Spirit they can Command.
  • At the Nightwatcher level, different species (due to differences in number of teeth) do indeed make a difference in the number of Spirits that can be commanded; however, at levels after that, numerical limits become largely meaningless anyway, since there can be so many.
  • They are very good at dealing with Spirit creatures.
  • Requiem: This Beyonder power has undergone a qualitative change.
  • It will extinguish a point of light and stain it with the densest and deepest Darkness. Within, there will be the sounds of chanting poetry, which is both peaceful and tranquil.
  • It can induce people to sleep as well as cause deceased Spirits and wraiths to become slow and Pacified, as if they have gained spiritual salvation.
  • Nocturnality: All they need is a dark environment to be enhanced.
  • The darker the environment, the stronger their strength and the faster the recovery speed. The opposite of this is true as well, making them significantly weaker in the midday sun.
  • Of course, this can be offset by relying on the Darkness created by Night Domain.
  • Dream Invasion: This has expanded to 1000 meters
  • It can also affect multiple targets and bring them in the same Dream.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 4 Demigods they receive some level of Godhood, and with it comes an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). Disregarding all consequences, they can release their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) to become an incomplete Eight-Legged Demonic Wolf.

Sequence 3: Horror Bishop

**New Abilities--

  • Sword of Darkness: It is a bone sword covered with strange patterns drawn from the depths of the Darkness, combining the power of Repose and Horror.
  • Swinging the sword can cause the Darkness to surge, making a tide of Darkness that symbolises the danger in the Darkness as well as silent destruction and vanquishment.
  • When the target is submerged by the surging Darkness, it will be infected by the power of Darkness and directly melt, becoming part of the tide.
  • If not prevented in advance, it is unavoidable and cannot be escaped.
  • As this tide of Darkness created from waving this sword also symbolises silent destruction and vanquishment, it is partially Concealed.
  • Nightmare World: They can create a Dream world and pull everyone in range into it.
  • A Horror Bishop's Nightmare World range is around that of a small city_._
  • It can protect a target's Soul from Evil or other kinds of Corruption.
  • They can move around while others are in the Nightmare World.

Authorities

  • Horror Aura: A lower manifestation of the authority of Horror.
  • When looking directly at them or being actively influenced by them, a target's body and mind will tremble involuntarily, which is difficult to contain and Conceal, and greatly affects their state.
  • Beyonders who are not strong enough may even be frightened to death by the Horror Bishop, or be scared out of control and become crazy.
  • As for "influence", a Horror Bishop merely entering a target's Dream can already cause that target to either lose control and/or die.
  • Newly promoted Horror Bishops cannot restrain their own terrifying aura, it is best that they don't appear in front of Low-Mid Sequence Beyonders and ordinary people.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their previous abilities were drastically enhanced.
  • Midnight Poem: This ability of theirs have been greatly enhanced.
  • Pacify:⁂ Their chants and poems are able to put an entire city to sleep.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Servant of Concealment

Authorities

  • Concealment: "They", to a certain extent, possess the authority of Concealment.
  • Concealed: "They" can make the target enter a Concealed state that cannot be sensed by the outside world. Regardless of the target wants- the target will be erased like an eraser.
  • In the Concealed state, the real world the target can see is covered with dark fog, and the target can only roughly distinguish where they are and what is around them.
  • In the Concealed state, the target can't exert influence on the outside world, and it is difficult for the outside world to influence them.
  • When a Historical Projection of "Themselves" is summoned, "They" can sense it and enter a state of Concealment, allowing "Them" to take control of the Projection.
  • "They" can Conceal secrets. These secrets may be inferred by others through clues left behind; however, if the knowledge is still in a Concealed state, it cannot be said out loud.
  • This lets "Them" also prevent everything that happens near "Them" from being seen.
  • "They" can enclose an area with a field, making all the actions in the area a secret. Actions within are impossible to be peeked at or Divined by even Sequence 1 Angels (opens in a new tab).
  • The secrets "They" keep can be presented to the others in the forms of scenes.
  • Reverse Concealment: Just as "They" can cause a target to enter a state of Concealment, Servants of Concealment can remove the Concealed state from a target.
  • Through cooperation with Concealment, "They" can directly extract Beyonder Characteristics (opens in a new tab) from a target that has no mental imprints.
  • Concealed World: "They" are able to create an entire area that is Concealed by itself. A target can be directly Sealed there through cloaking and uncloaking.
  • Battles that happen inside Concealed World won't damage the real world.
  • Servants of Concealment are also able to Conceal a variety of other different things, including but not limited to identities, actions, contents, etc.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "They" gain an improvement in previous Sequences' Beyonder powers.
  • Nightmare World: The range "Their" Dream world can affect is a large city.
  • Requiem: "Their" mere presence alone can bring extreme peace.
  • This can make "Them" capable of quickly suppressing the alarm raised by a Bizarro Sorcerer, even after the latter has already witnessed "Them".

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" possess a complete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is that of a Giant Eight-Legged Demonic Wolf with six hands; four of which grew from their ribs, and two legs.

Sequence 1: Knight of Misfortune

New Abilities

  • Physical Enhancement: "Their" strength, agility, physique, and speed live up to "Their" title as a Knight, making "Them" a physical Knight at the level of an Archangel (opens in a new tab).

Authorities

  • Misfortune: "They" can give Misfortune to enemies - the Darkness authority over Misfortune.
  • While "Their" Misfortune leans more towards Bad Luck, national-scale Misfortune is possible.
  • This can manifest in the decline of a country's fortune accompanied by natural disasters, or as Bad Luck affecting every citizen of that country.
  • The Misfortune authority can bestow Misfortune upon  ![Wheel of Fortune Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Wheel_of_Fortune_Pathway) Wheel of Fortune,  ![CircleOfInevitability crop (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Eternal_Aeon_Pathway) Eternal Aeon, and  ![GoddessOfFate crop (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Eternal_Edict_Pathway) Eternal Edict Beyonders (opens in a new tab) that are at the same level level as "Them".
  • Darkness (Servant of Darkness): "They" possess a certain manifestation of the power of Darkness.
  • In the Darkness of the night, a Knight of Misfortune is almost impossible to be truly killed as every time "They" die, "They" can return from the Darkness.
  • However, this doesn't mean immortality, since, eventually, one will integrate into the Darkness, becoming part of the Darkness.
  • Similar to the Demoness' Dark Magic authority, there will be a significant degree of mitigation of Darkness-related attacks against "Them".

Strengthened Abilities

  • Sword of Darkness: The Darkness this Sword creates brings Eternal Sleep, Despair and Destruction.
  • Commander of Spirits: "They" can put natural and undead Spirits to sleep and command them.

Sequence 0: Darkness

Authorities

  • Concealment: An authority that belongs to the Singularity of All symbolism. "They" can Conceal traces in all aspects, mislead related prying and Divination, make anything Concealed, undo such Concealment, and intuitively perceive and grasp many secrets.
  • "They" can directly drag "Their" targets into a Concealed World. Victims of this ability would seem to be wiped away from the real world, like a sketch being erased.
  • Those in the Concealed World would be hidden from the River of Fate (opens in a new tab).
  • Victims are able to attempt escape; however, doing so will take some time.
  • "They" can turn hidden realms into Concealed Worlds.
  • These Concealed Worlds can then be used as Divine Kingdoms (opens in a new tab) or as Seals.
  • "They" can silence others in various ways, ensuring that the secret "They" want Concealed will not be revealed by the target.
  • Darkness: "They" can induce Dreams, bring peace or Eternal Rest, and dissolve targets into Darkness, making them part of it. This can also be seen as partial authority over the Dream domain.
  • "They" can release the Darkness that is the Destination of All Things, which is extremely dangerous and may result in immediate death: even if "They" are trying to control it for an ally.
  • The remnants of "Their" own divine power can cause countless creatures within "Their" Darkness to vanish completely.
  • As Darkness is one of the most fundamental symbols of the universe and an important motif, "They" cannot die in Darkness and can Resurrect with its help.
  • The Tranquillity and Eternal Slumber brought by the Darkness authority can resist Corruption and mental attacks by soothing the target.
  • Even True Deities can be pulled into a Dream through the Darkness authority via deep sleep inducement.
  • Spirit Body & Spirituality: "They" are the destination of Spirits and their Master.
  • "Their" authority over the Spirit Body and Spirituality overlaps with the authority of the Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab) and Death.
  • Misfortune & Catastrophe: "They" can bring Catastrophes via Misfortune.
  • "Their" authority over Misfortune and Catastrophe overlaps with the authority of the Demoness, Red Priest, and Wheel of Fortune Pathways.
  • Horror: "They" are the embodiment of the emotion of Horror.
  • "They" are able to make others feel tremendous fear and Horror, interrupting their actions.
  • This authority overlaps with the authority of the Mother Tree of Desire (opens in a new tab).

Death Pathway

Sequence 9: Corpse Collector

Description

From this stage forward, these Beyonders will become increasingly afraid of Sunlight and Purification.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: A Corpse Collector, upon drinking the potion, will not only gain enhanced physical attributes but will also develop a gloomy presence and a lower body temperature.
  • A Corpse Collector will gain resistance to the Cold, Decay, and Corrosiveness of cadaveric auras, making them resistant to such effects to a certain extent.
  • Their gloomy presence and lower body temperature will prevent a Corpse Collector from being attacked by Undead creatures and Spirits.
  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality is slightly enhanced as a Beyonder, allowing them to use Spirit Vision.
  • Spirit Vision: A Corpse Collector can use Spirit Vision to see non-physical things, such as ghosts and spectres. They could see the different parts of a Soul, deduce a person's health and emotions, and determine if something has a magical aura.
  • Due to their unique nature, a Corpse Collector is able to directly see spiritual bodies, including a portion of Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab) and restless Wraiths, even without activating their Spirit Vision.

New Abilities

  • Knowledge (Undead): Corpse Collectors will gain an abundant wealth of information pertaining to the specific characteristics and weaknesses of many Undead creatures.
  • This also includes just regular corpses which makes a Corpse Collector an expert on autopsy.

Sequence 8: Gravedigger

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They become more physically nimble and agile.
  • Spirituality: They gain an increase in their Spirituality.
  • Spirit Vision: Their ability to use Spirit Vision (opens in a new tab) is enhanced.

New Abilities

  • Spirit Communication: They can initially Communicate with a small number of Spirits that are near their surroundings. This can be used to either scout an area or help them with certain tasks.
  • Through Spirit Communication, Gravediggers can command several Spirits to do simple actions such as tightly grasping onto a target to immobilise them.
  • Eye of Death: By pressing down on their eyes, it will turn gray then colourless, allowing them to quickly determine the weaknesses of even unfamiliar Undead and Spirit creatures through observation.
  • For them, it's like being able to enter the Spirit World and the realm of the Dead, looking down at the enemy from a higher level, looking for that very important node.

Sequence 7: Spirit Medium

Traits

  • Spirituality: A Spirit Medium's Spirituality has been greatly enhanced.
  • Spiritual Perception: Their Spiritual Perception becomes extremely strong.
  • They can sense the hidden Spirits around them even with their eyes closed.
  • Spirit Vision: Their Spirit Vision becomes more powerful.

New Abilities

  • Spirit Channelling: Their core ability is Spirit Channelling, allowing them to directly communicate with the natural Spirits and loitering dead souls in the real world.
  • With the advancement of each Sequence, the quantity and quality of natural Spirits, Undead and Spirit World creatures they can control and order increases exponentially.
  • They can use different Spirits they have controlled to actualise different kinds of effects, creating various kinds of supernatural phenomena in a rather multifaceted way.
  • Theoretically, a seance done by a Spirit Medium can involve only 1 Spirit.
  • Most Spirits need corresponding materials to safely communicate with.
  • These ingredients include but are not limited to Full Moon Essence Oil, Corpse Incense Medication, as well as a Spirit Medium's own blood.
  • Among some examples of the Spirits a Spirit Medium can use are:
  • Frost Shadow:⁂ A Spirit that can create a considerable Frozen domain within a 10 to 20 meter range, and possesses the ability to materialise a layer of armour-like Ice and a colossal, sharp, and crystalline Frost scythe.
  • This is among the most powerful Spirits a Spirit Medium can use that doesn't need any materials to be Channelled.
  • Earth Ghost:⁂ A Spirit with a pair of weathered, stone-like hands, it can be used to soften the ground like a swamp and drag a target underground, like a Druid's Underground Slink. This Spirit needs blood to be Channelled.
  • Since they can directly communicate with natural Spirits and ghosts, they have informants everywhere that can alert them of any danger or information.
  • It can also be used on living creatures to directly communicate with their Spirits to obtain real information, but this method holds a lot of danger for them.
  • Channelling a living Soul is difficult due to that Soul possessing it's own will; however, this could be faced by a Spirit Medium with two methods.
  1. Spirit Mediums can use their powerful Spirituality to triumph over the will of the other person, engaging in a barbaric method of communication.
  2. They can use medication to make the other party relax. Some examples are using Amantha Essence and Eye of the Spirit medication.
  • They have the means to protect themselves under the risk of being infected by a living Beyonder's potent Spirituality, which can't be learned or used by Beyonders of other Pathways. This is the case even when those means are explained to them.
  • A Spirit Medium is able to directly Channel recently deceased Spirits, such as fallen enemies, in order to obtain even more information from them.
  • A Spirit Medium could communicate with surrounding Spirits or through specific directions and descriptions without needing Ritualistic Magic.
  • However, unlike a Dancer, they cannot rely on a Summoning Dance and a location's uniqueness to attract more distant, hidden Spirits.
  • Spirit Affinity:⁂ To the deceased and natural Spirits around them, the Spirit Medium is akin to that of a fellow Spirit and thus not dangerous to them.
  • If the Spirit Medium is friendly enough, those deceased and natural Spirits will even take the initiative to pass on information to them.
  • Zombie Disguise:⁂ They can also Disguise themselves as a Zombie in order to better endure the erosion of Decay, Cold, Death and other auras.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Knowledge (Mysticism): They gain knowledge of various kinds of Ritualistic Magic related to Spirits.
  • They are armed with knowledge on how to deal with the dangers that come with Channelling a living creature's Spirit, as well as the effective communication methods in such a state.
  • Eye of Death: This Beyonder power becomes more powerful.

Sequence 6: Spirit Guide

Description

It is clear that Spirit Guides are very powerful against Zombies and Wraiths, and can even effectively target Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab). They can directly control groups of ownerless Dead with similar status; however, when faced with Higher Sequence Beyonders of the Death Pathway, their slaves and themselves will easily rebel.

New Abilities

  • Language of the Dead: By speaking a mystical language, they can urge a target's Spirit to leave a body, bypassing the physical protection provided by flesh and blood to target the Spirit Body.
  • This is an advancement of a Spirit Medium's powers. It could go from direct communication with the Spirit Body to that of commandeering and Enslavement.
  • As Marionettes are considered dead, a **Spi****rit Guide can interfere and influence a Marionette; however, at Sequence 4, the core of a Marionette can have a Worm of Spirit** inside. Thus, at those stages it also depends on multiple factors like relative strength of both sides, condition, how much effort is exerted, etc.
  • Resurrection: They can turn corpses into living skeletons and Zombies; however, this kind of Resurrection does not allow the reanimated corpse to have any will or vitality.

**Strengthened Abilities

  • Spirit Channelling: They can influence and are involved in the Spirit World, able to recruit messengers on their own, as well as obtain help from certain Spirit World creatures.
  • Compared to a Spirit Medium who needs to perform Spirit Channelling on site to achieve different effects, they can control and drive deceased and natural Spirits to fight in advance.
  • However, making these deceased and natural Spirits always follow their commands without being discovered and affected by other factors is a significant problem for a Spirit Guide.
  • In comparison with a Spirit Medium's capabilities, Spirit Guides are now capable of controlling groups of ownerless Undead that are of similar status to themselves.
  • Their maximum control of Undead and Spirits are in the thousands.
  • The strength of a Spirit Guide depends on the deceased or a natural Spirits they have found and controlled. This is the same with Spirit Warlocks.
  • However, the inclination for Spirit Guides are deceased Spirits, while Spirit Warlocks are better at controlling natural Spirits.
  • Knowledge (Spirit World): They have considerable information about the Spirit World.

Sequence 5: Gatekeeper

New Abilities

  • Door to the Underworld: Gatekeepers can sense, summon, and use gates to the Underworld.
  • A Gatekeeper can sense the entrance to the Underworld, allowing them to control the Undead inside, as though they watched over the gates that separated the dead from the living.
  • They can use the powers of the Door to the Underworld to some extent.
  • For example, they can solidify the Door to the Underworld as a brand in the palm of their hand, and summon it at critical moments to drag the target behind the door.
  • Bloody, skinless arms, slimy tentacles with teeth, and bluish-black vines with baby faces emerge within the Door to entangle targets and drag them into the Underworld.
  • The Door has a terrifying suction force. Most of it would be directed towards a target, though the remnant forces would continue to pull on the surroundings.
  • The main target can't help but stumble and be drawn in, while those nearby would find it difficult to even take a step.
  • The suction force generated from the Door can also be used to clear the environment of airborne poison.
  • Gatekeepers are able to use the Door to absorb the Fog of War of the Red Priest Pathway.
  • Internal Underworld: Using their bodies as a cage, they can house numerous Souls, deceased, and natural Spirits, allowing them to bring an Undead army wherever they go in a non eye-catching way.
  • Normally, the entrance to the Internal Underworld is at the centre of the Gatekeeper's brow.
  • With this, they gain various unique abilities and possess powerful helpers, for example:
  • Death Envoy: A unique ability of Ludwell's (opens in a new tab). The soft sobbing sounds from the Death Envoy causes the target's body to go numb while their blood seems to freeze, as if the target was possessed by a Wraith or Evil Spirit (opens in a new tab).
  • It is difficult to make an effective response, and the target can usually only watch death approach, feeling their vitality deplete at an increasing rate.
  • As this can be considered a miniature Underworld, Gatekeepers are a prime target of possession for Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab) as they provide an adequate environment for their existence.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Spirit Channelling: The maximum number of Undead and Spirits that a Gatekeeper can control has slightly increased, but it doesn't change much.

Sequence 4: Undying

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Physical attacks are no longer fatal unless their body is completely destroyed.
  • Spirit Body: An Undying is able to exist in a state that is between a physical body and a Spirit Body.

New Abilities

  • Reincarnation: They possess a long lifespan; however, every 60 years, they will die and then Resurrect, forgetting all their memories and resetting their madness levels. From there, they must then slowly retrieve their memories, as if starting a new life.
  • This is not completely without risk, the Undying would leave behind a death imprint in the River of Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab) with each Death. Once the number of Deaths reaches a certain level, their true bodies might be attracted to this Sefirah one day, causing them to truly die.
  • Dying too many times leads to an Undying's death imprints being washed away from the River of Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab), making their memories impossible to recover; their intelligence and rationality will degrade over time, eventually turning into wandering Undead monsters.
  • Underworld Authority: An Undying is able to gain some power and control over the Underworld, being able to use it to achieve all sorts of certain effects.
  • Sealing: From this level onward, they can reduce the negative effects of a Sealed Artifact (opens in a new tab) by forming a Seal with the help of the Underworld.
  • Spirit World Traversal: With their connection to the Underworld, they are able to use the Spirit World to achieve Spirit World Traversal.
  • This is very similar to the Door of Teleportation from Travelers, however, an Undying seems to lack the ability to Blink across short distances.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Door to the Underworld: With the forces of the Underworld, they can form a favourable battlefield.
  • This battlefield will inflict enemies with the attraction, summoning, and ravings from within the Underworld. Additionally, if lucky or well-connected in the Underworld, they could summon dangerous Undead creatures into the real world.
  • Language of the Dead: At this stage, the Language of the Dead will evolve into a Spell system related to Death, Spirits, Living Corpses, Withering, and Enslavement.
  • Withering Wind: It brings about a gust of Cold wind that silently causes Withering.
  • Patrick Bryan (opens in a new tab) created a cold gust of Withering Wind that caused a glass window to quickly crumble into countless "snowflakes".

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 4 Demigods they receive some level of Godhood, and with it comes an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). Disregarding all consequences, they can release their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) to become an incomplete Quetzalcoatl, also known as a Feathered Serpent.

Sequence 3: Ferryman

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Most forms of attack, except Purification-based ones (like that of the Tyrant or Sun Pathway) are ineffective against the Ferryman.

New Abilities

  • Hands of Life & Death:⁂ Those touched by their left hand will almost irreversibly approach Death, while those touched by their right hand will reverse the process of Death, regaining Life.
  • Thus, the Ferryman traverses back and forth between Life and Death.
  • Ferryman: From here on, they will become a part of the Underworld and Death itself.
  • Near the River Styx or its tributaries, they can effectively use their powers.
  • A Ferryman is able to also float upon the River Styx without sinking.
