  • Even when facing tributaries or the main the River of Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab), they can remain afloat for a very short time, two seconds at the current stage.

Authorities

  • Death: They wield partial authority over Death. Any living being that makes eye contact with the Ferryman will die instantly; even entities with Godhood will suffer devastating damage.
  • Even without direct eye contact, those caught by the Ferryman's sight will slowly Wither away, as if being ferried across the river of Death inch by inch.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Undying: Instead of dying, Reviving, and losing all their memories, they would instead gradually transform into a sentient Undead creature over time.
  • This also means that they will not instantly die in the Underworld.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Death Consul

Authorities

  • Death: At this Sequence level, "They" possess an authority over Death.
  • Nation of the Dead: "They" can create a large city-sized domain filled with Death and Pallor where life not strong enough will instantly die and transform into Undead creatures.
  • Even beings with Godhood will begin to slowly Wither and Perish.
  • Dead Death Consuls are still Death Consuls. The boundary between Life and Death no longer applying to "Them", making "Them" extremely hard to kill.
  • Only by relying on special powers and methods can a Death Consul are be completely erased and reverted back into Beyonder Characteristics (opens in a new tab).
  • This doesn't mean "They" are immortal as "Their" consciousness would gradually erode, becoming an eternally living walking corpse.
  • King of the Dead: A Death Consul is a King of the Dead, who is capable of housing a vast Undead army within "Their" own Internal Underworld.
  • At the same time, "They" can find and directly summon helpers from the Underworld.
  • Absolute Death: "They" can strip all vitality from an area. Before "Them", most Resurrection or Substitution abilities become ineffective.
  • A **Miracle Invoker's** Resurrection that involves History and Change is an exception.
  • Enslavement: "They" also possess an authority over Enslavement at this level.
  • Death Consuls are capable of issuing commands that Beyonders below Sequence 2 of the Death Pathway are nearly incapable of resisting.
  • Even Undead creatures of the Angel (opens in a new tab) level: including Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab): are extraordinarily vulnerable.
  • Death Consuls also hold advantages due to "Their" authority to Judge the Dead.
  • "They" can do more damage against the Dead as well as have a suppression effect based on hierarchy and persona, and this effect applies to all the Dead.

Strengthened Abilities

  • All "Their" previous Beyonder abilities have been greatly enhanced.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab). "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is a Feathered Serpent (Quetzalcōātl (opens in a new tab)), a serpent that is illusory and real. "Their" entire body is covered with huge dark-green scales while white feathers stained with pale yellow oil grow out from the gaps. On each feather, illusory black tubes extend outward, and each scale and feather bears strange symbols of different shapes.
  • Just the mere sight of "Them" would cause one's flesh to decompose, turning all those who look at "Them" into Zombies and various other Undead creatures.
  • In "Their" Mythical Creature Form, "They" are capable of spatting out a Pale-White Flame that is able to cover an entire mausoleum.

Sequence 1: Pale Emperor

Authorities

  • Pallor (Pale World): "They" can create a world that is devoid of all colour, leaving only Pallor.
  • In this Pale World, colours Die and Beyonder powers Wither. Any Beyonder power that manifests colour will suffer immense weakening and will eventually fail completely.
  • Inanimate objects and abstract concepts can also be weathered. Even the concept of Death (not the endpoint) itself can weather away and dissipate.
  • The effects of being weathered under the Pallor happens extremely quickly; thousands of years of time would appear to be washed away in a short span of 2 seconds.
  • Weathered objects would display some characteristics of a Feathered Serpent, namely, they would grow white feathers soaked with light-yellow oil.
  • Enslavement: "They" possess more power over the authority of Enslavement.
  • Soul Control: "They" have a chance to directly extract the target's Spirit Body from their body. Even if unsuccessful, it will cause the target severe mental chaos and diminished vitality.
  • Sovereign of Spirits: Without deliberate effort, "They" appear extreme noble, devoid of the aura of the living - like an illusory deity that lorded over the countless Undead.
  • "They" can suppress and even Enslave any creature with a Soul, no longer limited to Dead creatures and Beyonders of the Death Pathway.
  • Through this aura the living's thoughts will gradually Die along with their body until they became a corpse and become "Their" Slave.
  • Sovereign of Spirits is not a Beyonder power of the Pale Emperor, but rather a trait derived from "Their" Enslavement authority.
  • Death (Death Decree): Any target seen or pointed at by "Them" will Die instantly.
  • A Pale Emperor's Death Decree works on all beings that are below the True Deity level, capable of harming "Them"; however, as it is a mechanistic ability, there are ways to counter it such as not being seen or pointed by "Them" or using mechanisms that can suppress or counter it.
  • A Pale Emperor is also able to create a symbol, which appears like a long-feathered bird or a Coiled Feathered Serpent, in order to Seal targets.
  • The symbol absorbs the surrounding light and will quickly turn corporeal, before flying towards the target, causing the surroundings to become increasingly dim, suffering another round of Weathering as if the Deity in charge of Death had passed the Final Judgment, until it fuses with them. The symbol constantly influence the target until "They" stop responding.

Strengthened Abilities

  • All "Their" previous Sequence abilities are further strengthened.

Sequence 0: Death (Eternal Sleeper)

Authorities

  • Death: The authority of Death ascends to a conceptual level.
  • Under the Death authority, Life will Die, memories will Die, the connections between things will Die, and even the imprints of existence will also Die.
  • "They" can directly sever the connection between the Fool's Beyonder Characteristic (opens in a new tab) and the Historical Void (opens in a new tab), or directly kill the Fool's Beyonder Characteristic (opens in a new tab) itself.
  • This will completely kill the Fool because "Their" Resurrection Miracle relies on the Beyonder Characteristic (opens in a new tab) returning to the Historical Void (opens in a new tab), so if the characteristic cannot return to the Historical Void (opens in a new tab), the Fool cannot use the Resurrection Miracle.
  • "They" can make the Death of Marionettes, Paper Figurine Substitutes, and other similar clones and stand-ins equate to the Death of the main body.
  • They" cannot affect the Lord of Mysteries (opens in a new tab), but the Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab) can do so.
  • Although Beyonder Characteristics (opens in a new tab) are Indestructible, even those characteristics would briefly Die under "Their" Death authority.
  • Pallor: The ultimate form of Withering - where all things fade.
  • The mind, will, and Beyonder powers will all gradually fall silent and succumb to deathly stillness under the influence of the Pallor authority.
  • When the Death's Pallor authority encounters the Sun's Purification, the Pallor authority will be the one that is restrained.
  • Endpoint: "They" are the final Destination of all things, the common Endpoint of all Life.
  • This authority overlaps with the authority of the Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab) and Darkness.
  • By relying on the Door Pathway's powers, the Underworld was derived from this authority.
  • "They" could establish "Their" own Cycle of Reincarnation with aid from the Mother.
  • This will be similar to the Cycle of Reincarnation formed from the Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab) and Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab), albeit limited to a single star system.
  • Undead: "They" are the very source of Undead existence, the master of all Undead.
  • This authority overlaps with the authority of the Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab) and Darkness.
  • Enslavement: "They" are the Enslaver of all things.
  • The Death's authority of Enslavement is limited to those who have Souls.

Twilight Giant Pathway

Sequence 9: Warrior (Divine Blood Warrior, Extraordinary Warrior)

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They possess supernatural strength and agility that greatly transcends those who are not Beyonders.

New Abilities

  • Combat Mastery (Weapon, Armor, Martial Arts): They have a mastery of all kinds of Weapons and Armour, with there being no Weapon they can't use.
  • Warriors also possess a mastery of all forms of Combat and Martial Arts, with there being no fighting style they can't learn.

Sequence 8: Pugilist (Gladiator)

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Their physical abilities alone can weaken the effects of some Beyonder abilities targeting them.

New Abilities

  • Supernatural Resistance: Pugilists are experts in Combat that are able to use their own bodies in order to mitigate the effects of certain supernatural forces.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Combat Mastery (Close Combat): Pugilists are more adept at close-quarters Combat than any other Sequence.

Sequence 7: Weapon Master

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They possess a superhuman strength, physique, and agility.

New Abilities

  • Weapon Mastery: With their Physical Enhancement, as long as it is a Weapon, once it is in their hands, they can use it at a master-level standard.
  • This includes Beyonder Weapons, Mystical Items (opens in a new tab), and Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) in the form of swords, guns, etc. and they can effectively reduce the damage caused by said items negative effects.

Sequence 6: Dawn Paladin

Traits

  • Strength of Giants: Dawn Paladins posess Giant-like strength, powerful offensive capability, and relatively high defense.
  • By now, their bodies are muscular, well attuned to combat and their height is further increased.
  • Dawn Paladins can burst in speeds akin to a steam train accelerating at its highest speed.
  • With a low growl, Father Utravsky (opens in a new tab) charged through the flames created by Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) at the maximum speed of a steam train.
  • Even after experiencing a long drawn fight, a Dawn Paladin's stamina will seem to be limitless.
  • Utravsky (opens in a new tab) was able to attack multiple times in long sessions with his two-handed broadsword despite having been weakened as if experiencing a long drawn fight.
  • The force that a Dawn Paladin can strike with their weapons can create strong gusts.
  • The winds created by a weakened Father Utravsky's (opens in a new tab) two-handed broadsword were so strong that it caused a Sequence 7 Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) to almost lose his balance.
  • Descendants might be born with greyish-blue skin possessed by common Giants.

New Abilities

  • Light of Dawn (Sunrise Gleam): A Dawn Paladin can fill an area of roughly 40 to 50 meters around them with pure, Sacred Dawn Light, which dispel Illusions, Exorcise Wraiths and Shadows, and even weaken Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab).
  • It can dispel powers or energies leaning toward Evil, Corruption, and Degeneration, but in the Domain of the Holy and Light, the Light of Dawn is still inferior to a Light Suppliant's powers.
  • The Light of Dawn can erase Shadows and nullify Concealment effects, such as Witches' Invisibility. For Wraiths and Shadow Ascetics, their peculiarities are diminished.
  • A Dawn Paladin's Light of Dawn is also able to Purify mystical Pathogens in the environment, reduce radiation, and interfere with Electromagnetic Fields.
  • Except when dealing with Wraiths and Shadows, its Mysticism level is very low.
  • Dawn Armour: They can conjure a silver Armour of Dawn around their bodies which is equivalent to a refined full-body armour that doesn't have noticeable weight or inhibit their movement in any way.
  • It can recover from damage, but their stamina will automatically be drained during the process.
  • It will also take a certain amount of time to recover from that damage.
  • A Dawn Paladin's Dawn Armour includes gauntlets, breastplates, and a helmet.
  • Sword of Dawn: They can condense Dawn into different types of Weapons, such as a massive two-handed axe, a disposable arm-thick spear, but the strongest of which is a two-handed great-sword called the Sword of Dawn.
  • The Sword of Dawn is a Dawn light emitting, two-handed broadsword, great-sword, or dagger that is solid and sharp. Each strike from it is imbued with a Purification effect.
  • Hurricane of Light: Their most powerful attack. By inserting the Sword of Dawn into the ground and shattering it, they will form countless fragments of Dawn-like light that create a shimmering, violently sharp Hurricane filled with destructive power, cutting every Shadow and Corrupted entities.
  • Evil creatures like a Devils or Zombies would be subjected to the effects of Purification and the damage of a Fragmentary Blade. The combination of these aspects causes their Hurricane of Light to become excellent at purging Evil.
  • Purification weakens defence and inflicts harm on the Evil creature's spirit and flesh, while the Fragmentary Blade utilises Purification to weaken defence and cut flesh. The more wounds and the deeper they were, the better the Purification effect.
  • Hurricane of Light would be even more effective on Spirits (opens in a new tab) (such as a Wraiths) leaving the target close to death.
  • The Hurricane of Light can directly destroy a person's body, eliminate Wraiths, and even heavily wound Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab). It also possesses a unique strength that can more easily destroy creatures of the Evil and Undead Domain.
  • Their Hurricane of Light is stronger than a Sword of Lava (which is stronger than the Light of Holiness) when it comes to damaging non-Evil domain beings.
  • Although Hurricane of Light is an area-of-effect ability, a Dawn Paladin is able to control its direction to a certain extent.
  • After activation, the Sword of Dawn cannot be condensed for a short time. In addition, a Dawn Paladin would need at least more than 2 minutes of recovery before they can form another Hurricane of Light.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Dawn Paladins experience a qualitative change.
  • Each of a Dawn Paladin's Combat related abilities, whether it be Combat Mastery or Weapon Mastery, will be enhanced massively.

Sequence 5: Guardian

Traits

  • Strength of Giants: Compared to a Dawn Paladin, a Guardian defence and strength is like an adult comparing their physique and strength to that of a child.
  • A Guardian would probably be able to withstand the bullets of a steam rifle, but in the wars of the steam era, they wouldn't die unless they were focused on by large-calibre cannons.

New Abilities

  • Protection: Guardians are rarely injured.
  • By kneeling on one knee and planting the great-sword in front of them, Dawn-like light will emerge, forming two indestructible invisible walls on the left and right. This allows them to take on damage for companions within a certain range, Protecting them.
  • Once fully committed to defence and abandoning offence, few can break through a Guardian's defence below that of the High-Sequences. This is regardless of the types of damage the enemy can inflict and their corresponding effects.
  • When they attack, their defence will be reduced significantly; however, it will still be far superior to that of refined full-body armour.
  • Reapers are one of the few non High-Sequence Beyonders that can penetrate through a Guardian's defences.
  • Illusion Immunity: They can't be deceived by Illusions.

Strengthened Abilities

  • They have gained improvements to other Beyonder abilities from previous Sequences.
  • Their Sword of Dawn, Hurricane of Light, and other abilities can damage any creature.
  • Supernatural Resistance: This Beyonder ability of theirs has been enhanced.
  • Within the same Sequence level, a Guardian can slow down the time of having their Spirit Body Threads controlled and thus being turned into a Marionette.

Sequence 4: Demon Hunter (Witcher)

Traits

  • Physical & Mental Enhancement: Demon Hunters possess a terrifying Physical strength and a Mind that stands between that of a God and a human.
  • They are capable of running at such high speed that it whips up hurricane-force winds.
  • Spirituality: A Demon Hunter's Spirituality will be enhanced significantly.
  • They will possess a strong Spiritual Intuition.

New Abilities

  • Eye of Demon Hunting: This is not a true visual ability but rather a general term for their capacity to identify a target's nature, weaknesses, condition, and whether they are Corrupted or Possessed by relying on their own senses, mental probing, and extensive experience.
  • They become sensitive to any traces of Evil, Degeneration, and Corruption. They can also rely on their sixth sense, Spiritual Intuition, and life experiences to judge the situation.
  • Veteran Witchers can use this to judge whether a target is lying.
  • Using this will cause a complex, dark green symbol to appear in each of their eyes.
  • Knowledge (Hunting, Alchemy): They are highly adept at dealing with all kinds of situations and possess knowledge of how different monster parts and herbs can be used. They are also skilled at discovering the weaknesses of various creatures and identifying the uses of various materials.
  • In a special Cogitation state, they can, based on the former and with the aid of the latter, concoct the corresponding magical potions, holy ointments, essential oils and special marks.
  • By ingesting, applying, or using these items, they can produce different extraordinary effects such as Lightning Strikes, Freezing, Purification, Burning, Decay, and Exorcism.
  • This allows them to counter targets in a highly targeted manner.
  • Orthodox Demon Hunters will typically wield dual swords so that different ointments can take effect simultaneously, enabling them to handle more complex situations.
  • Mind Concealment: They can Conceal one's actions and intentions.
  • This effectively interferes with Divination and Prophecy, preventing even targets capable of foreseeing danger from detecting it: making them a nemesis of Demons (opens in a new tab).

Strengthened Abilities

  • All of a Demon Hunter's Beyonders abilities from the Dawn Paladin and Guardian stages undergo a qualitative transformation.
  • Protection: They can create an invisible and indestructible wall of defense around them. Once it is anchored to the ground, the power of Protection becomes extremely difficult to shake.
  • The power of Protection can even block traversal through the Spirit World as well as block or weaken Curse-type abilities.
  • Light of Dawn: Their Light of Dawn can be condensed into objects other than weapons.
  • Witchers can blanket their weapons with Dawn's glow.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 4 Demigods they receive some level of Godhood, and with it comes an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). Disregarding all consequences, they can release their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) to become an incomplete Cyclops.
  • Their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) looks like a 4 meter tall Cyclops. Their skin turns bluish-black and muscular, and along with its pores and flesh, seemingly violating the normal confines of a human body. Their head swells up significantly, with the area from their forehead to nose cracking open to reveal a black vertical eye-like rift. On their body's surface contains symbols and the corresponding effects of immense power, infinite mystery, and a strange psychic influence.
  • If those under Sequence 4 saw this form, they will suffer a strong backlash. Their brains might suffer an excruciating pain that would cause them to lose their minds, even their Spirituality would be corrupted. And if they couldn't withstand such an influence, going crazy, losing control, or even sudden death were certain outcomes.
  • On one hand, manifesting this incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) of a 4-meter tall one-eyed Giant will enhance a Demon Hunter's strength and level significantly, on the other hand, it would result in intense madness and provide strong inclinations towards the Demon Hunter losing control and becoming a Rampager (opens in a new tab).

Sequence 3: Silver Knight

Individual Differences

  • Blessing: Silver Knights are very good at frontal assaults. There will be small differences in the abilities between them due to different Blessings during their Advancement Ritual (opens in a new tab).
  • Murskogan (opens in a new tab) had received Blessings from the Giant King Aurmir (opens in a new tab), which caused the various aspects of his Silver Knight Beyonder powers (Mercury Liquefaction, Silver Rapier, and Light Concealment) to be much stronger than normal.
  • Colin Iliad (opens in a new tab), who received Klein's (opens in a new tab) Blessings could occasionally make himself turn into a Silver Rapier and Teleport randomly, bringing along beneficial tendencies. In addition, his Mercury Liquefaction had gained some uniqueness.

New Abilities

  • Mercury Liquefaction: Silver Knights are able to melt into a malleable silvery metallic liquid that can restrict enemies and move rapidly in order to evade attacks.
  • The liquid volume of a Silver Knight's Mercury Liquefaction form is solely based on the Silver Knight's current mass upon ability activation.
  • They are also able to turn oneself into a Silver Armour for other targets (to defend an ally or to restrict and suffocate an opponent).
  • When getting suffocated, the enemy would appear as if they are wearing a full-body Silver Armour that has not a single gap.
  • Silver Rapier: Silver Knights can condense silvery white beams of light out of thin air. These Silver Rapiers tear apart everything around it and are hard to detect.
  • These Silver Rapiers can Teleport (Blink) and bypass most barriers and obstacles, directly attacking their target. They can even erupt from within a target's body to deal heavy damage.
  • With a mere swipe of his finger after advancing into Silver Knight, Colin Iliad (opens in a new tab) unleashed a single Silver Rapier, whose destructive power was enough to cleave a small hill in 2.
  • Their Silver Rapiers are able to manifest almost without any indication, making it extremely difficult for an enemy to detect and predict where they will appear next.
  • Light Concealment: Also known as Light Occultation or Hide by Light. A Silver Knight can utilise any light source as a way of dodging, evasion, and movement.
  • Light Concealment may pierce through objects depending on light-source connection.
  • An Unshadowed's Unshadowed Domain is able to fully nullify Light Concealment.
  • Silver Knights can also let other people enter their Light Concealment.
  • Silver Armour: At this level, their Protection materializes as a full-body Silver Armour which is much stronger than a **Giant** **Dragon** in terms of withstanding blows.
  • It's defensive capabilities can shield a Silver Knight against a limited number of Angels' (opens in a new tab) attacks while able to be permanently materialised as Silver Armour.
  • Colin Iliad (opens in a new tab) had fully materialised his Silver Armour for days on end without experiencing any Spirituality expenditure upon advancing as a Silver Knight.

Strengthened Abilities

  • They have gained improvement of other Beyonder abilities in the previous Sequence.
  • Sword of Dawn: At the Sequence 3 level, a Silver Knight is now able to permanently materialise their Sword of Dawn, making it usable as a regular weapon.
  • A Silver Knight's Sword of Dawn possesses top sharpness and Purification attributes, while also being capable of tearing apart a small hill with a single strike.
  • Hurricane of Light: They can ignite their body with a transparent flame, emitting the bright light of Dawn, creating a terrifying Hurricane of Light.
  • Colin Iliad (opens in a new tab), upon using this ability, emanated beams of light that came from his Soul, body, Beyonder Characteristics as the two swords he struck out merged together, turning into a raging, violent Hurricane of Light that swept out and enveloped the Dark Angel (opens in a new tab).
  • Once enveloped, the Hurricane of Light tore at the Dark Angel's (opens in a new tab) body, interrupting the powers "He" was going to use while making "Him" fade away into fragments of light due to losing the source of power that maintained "His" existence.
  • Combat Mastery (Direct Combat): They are extremely skilled in direct Combat.

Mythical Creature Form

  • Their Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) develops further, they are now a nearly 6 meter tall, one-eyed Cyclops. Their body is greyish-blue and their muscles are bluish-black. There is a dark crack on their forehead that attracts the Souls around it. Their eyes are missing, replaced by smooth skin.
  • Every inch of their skin and flesh contains immense power, infinite mystery, and a strange spiritual influence. It makes everyone who witnesses them inevitably feel a sharp pain in their psyche, transforming them into a rampaging mess that wants to destroy everything.
  • These destructive tendencies also include themselves.
  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can listen to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Glory

Description

The three authorities of the Twilight Giant Pathway's Sequence 0: Holiness, Twilight, and Combat: are all manifested at this stage. For Angels (opens in a new tab), this represents Glory itself.

Traits

  • Strength of Giants: "They" can grow to an enormous size.
  • A steel puppet of Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab), possessing a temporary Angel (opens in a new tab)-level Boon from the Evernight Goddess (opens in a new tab) grew to an enormous size, being comparable to Lumian (opens in a new tab) "Himself".

Authorities

  • Twilight: "They" hold the simplified authority of Twilight.
  • "They" can age "Themselves" rapidly, evaporate, and then be reborn in the Spirit World, returning to normal before departing. Likewise, "They" can also delay one's ageing process.
  • Larrion (opens in a new tab), after accomplishing "His" arrangements, attempted to evade Arianna (opens in a new tab) and escape through the Spirit World by rapidly aging "Himself" with the authority of Twilight.
  • Twilight authority can with a single strike, cause a single target or a group within an area to gradually age, have their lifespan reduced, and enter the countdown of life.
  • As dying of aging is something that the majority of Resurrection abilities cannot take effect against, one should never engage in a prolonged battle with a Glory.
  • A Beauty Goddess will be affected by this authority, but "They" will remain Beautiful.
  • A Miracle Invoker's Resurrection is an example of one that can reset age.
  • Combat: "They" hold the simplified Combat authority, thus being the top Sequence 2 in frontal combat.
  • Its subordinate Protection can, at this stage, form a Cage, which in addition to defence, also gains a Sealing effect. This fuses the decaying power of Twilight.
  • "Their" Cages are able to fully Seal off dangerous corruptible Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) (e.g., the Gift of the Land (opens in a new tab)) and Ritualistic Magic, but requires "Their" presence to constantly fuel it.
  • Proof of Glory (opens in a new tab) was used during an event to isolate and Seal the detrimental influences caused by deity-related Ritualistic Magic via the formation of a Cage.
  • "Their" Cage provides extremely powerful defensive and restraining capabilities, capable of Protecting companions and preventing "Their" enemies from escaping.
  • Twilight Great-sword: "Their" Silver Rapier ability as a Silver Knight has evolved into a instantly condensed great sword composed of orange-red Twilight.
  • Through the help of Twilight's Time and Space relationship, it can manifest directly at the target's location- displaying the lower level of Devastation in the Combat authority.
  • Hurricane of Light: This will also let "Them" transform "Their" Hurricane of Light into an orange-red tempest capable of annihilating a wasteland.
  • When it slashes towards a target, it will envelop them in Twilight's glow, freezing them within as their thoughts and actions slow down, as if they existed in a different world.
  • A Kings of Angels (opens in a new tab) Cheek (opens in a new tab) was affected by this from one of Lumian's (opens in a new tab) soldiers, causing "Her" thoughts and actions to slow down and delaying "Her" attempt to destroy "Herself"
  • This great-sword radiates the aura of approaching Twilight and the decay of all things.
  • "They" are able to wield this Twilight Great-sword directly as a hand-held weapon.
  • Holiness: "They" hold a simplified authority of Holiness.
  • Glory is part of Holiness, and death is likewise one of the most sacred and solemn matters of life, therefore "Their" Glory is Dawn, yet also Twilight; it is Devastation, yet also Purification.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab). "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is a dozen of meters tall Cyclops with elongated limbs, greyish-blue skin, and a single vertical eye on the forehead. Every inch of "Their" skin, every pore, and every piece of "Their" flesh seems to defy normal human senses, being combined in a unique way and containing an unimaginable sense of impact.

Sequence 1: Hand of God

Authorities

  • Proxy: Like the Left Hand of Decay in the same domain, "They" can act on behalf of the Deity, Uniqueness (opens in a new tab), or Great Old One (opens in a new tab) "They" serve to manifest divine power and punishment.
  • Due to this authority, "They" cannot acquire new authorities aside from the Proxy authority and can only get enhancements to "Their" previous Sequence abilities and authorities.
  • If "They" don't harm "Themselves", "They" can for the short-term reach Sasrir's (opens in a new tab) level. If "They" harm "Themselves", "They" can be a consumable Half Great Old One (opens in a new tab).
  • In a certain-death situation, "They" can theoretically kill a Red Priest who had not not Sacrificed to the Sefirah (opens in a new tab), but it's also difficult because the duration is very short.
  • The Red Priest would most likely only be at a disadvantage for a short time, unless an opportunity is created in advance where "They" cannot dodge or block.
  • A Hand of God can only manifest such power briefly and with restraint. Otherwise, "They" will gradually lose "Their" sanity and become a true servant.
  • In addition, if the True Deity that the Hand of God had pledged "Their" allegiance too dies, the power that "They" can wield will decrease.
  • "Their" right hand will embody certain properties of the entity "They" serve.
  • Having ascended to this Sequence, the Hand of God Dabomachie (opens in a new tab)'s right hand seemed to be made entirely of glowing orange Twilight.
  • "They" can condense "Their" own power into a mark to lend to others.
  • Combat: Some of "Their" corresponding abilities to the Combat authority have been enhanced.
  • "They" can summon Cages made out of dense light imbued with orange hues and another layer of unyielding radiance outside the targeted area that can prevent even an Observer or Dimensional Shadow from crossing through.
  • "They" can then drive "Their" Sword of Dawn into the barrier of the Cage to repair it after withstanding attacks from multiple Angels.

Sequence 0: Twilight Giant (Twilight, Giant)

Description

"They" hold partial authority over Holiness, Twilight, and Combat (which contains subordinate authorities like Strength, Gigantism, Devastation, and Protection) as well as a portion of the Proxy authority - where the symbol of Enslavement belonging to the River of Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab) manifest in the Giant Pathway.

Authorities

  • Twilight: This authority is derived from symbols of Light, Space-Time, and Decay.
  • "They" can solidify Twilight and slow the Passage of Time, and while solidification is only possible within Twilight, "They" can create a Twilight domain within a certain range.
  • Land of Twilight: "Their" Divine Kingdom formed through Twilight, completely frozen within the Passage of Time. Those inside will find themselves weakened unless acknowledged.
  • It can persist for millennia even after "Their" death (e.g. Giant King's Court (opens in a new tab)).
  • "They" can cause Matter, will, and even the void to Decay, collapse, and vanish, emanating an aura of Twilight's arrival and the Decay of all things.
  • "Their" Twilight Sword, Sword of Dawn, and other abilities would cause even the void to shatter and Decay as things hit would wane uncontrollably and break down.
  • Twilight and the Passage of Time counters the Light, Holiness, and Sun authorities of the Sun Pathway as Twilight represents the end of all these.
  • A Twilight Giant's authority over the Passage of Time is able to even influence the will within Beyonder Characteristics to a limited extent.
  • "They" are able to cause targets to rapidly Age, Decay, and Rot: preventing the Resurrection methods of all beings with finite lifespans.
  • As True Gods (opens in a new tab) do not have the concept of lifespan, "They" won't die from this. However, "They" can still be affected by Aging and get weakened.
  • The Twilight Giant's mere existence causes matter and the void around "Them" to bend, making all things begin to uncontrollably Decay.
  • "Their" aura leaking from across the Astral World into reality brings upon a Twilight so powerful that it can Decay a Saint to the point where they will have difficulty raising their arms.
  • "They" can induce instability and Loss of Control in targets, with those targets' symptoms continuing to appear more and more severe.
  • "They" can slow the formation and opening of Doors.
  • Dawn: "They" also possess the authority of Dawn.
  • The Dawn authority can be used to directly Purify a Beyonder Characteristic.
  • Unlike the Sun Pathway, the Purification of the Twilight Giant Pathway is different from the Sun's Purification as it is achieved through equal destruction and Decay.
  • This is because ending is inherently related to beginning.
  • "They" can weaken targets progressively.
  • Holiness: "They" hold partial authority over Holiness.
  • Death is among the most solemn events of life and of the world: thus profoundly Sacred. Hence, the Twilight Giant also excels in Purification and discerning Evil and Corruption.
  • Combat: "They" hold the authority of Combat.
  • The most terrifying Strength, the most Gigantic form, the most potent Devastation, the most unyielding Protection: together with Skill and experience, these compose individual Combat.
  • The one who commands all this is the God of Combat (opens in a new tab), who is able to strip "His" opponents of Skill, forcing them to fight by instinct alone.
  • Proxy: "They" hold partial Proxy authority.
  • Among the three Pathways of the River of Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab), Death aligns most closely with the Sefirah's essence, Darkness most resembles it outwardly, yet the Twilight Giant can partially employ it. This is one reason the Giant King (opens in a new tab) could contend with the Dragon of Imagination (opens in a new tab).
  • Sefirot is power, but it is also danger. There is no way for "Them" to utilize the power of Sefirot without paying a price.
  • By using Proxy, the God of Combat (opens in a new tab) can theoretically reach the strongest tier of Half Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) for 2-3 seconds. This was how the Giant King (opens in a new tab) was able to escape from the Ancient Sun God (opens in a new tab) and passed on "His" characteristics to "His" successor.
  • However, in reality, it's impossible because "He" couldn't possibly completely pledge allegiance to the River of Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab), as this would mean never becoming a Great Old One (opens in a new tab).
  • Thus, in practice, "His" self-detonation would only be a bit stronger than the Evernight Goddess (opens in a new tab) before accommodating the River of Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab).
  • There were also other factors preventing the true theoretical maximum from being achieved:
  • Firstly, the Evernight Goddess (opens in a new tab) can also use items to call upon a bit of the River of Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab)'s power to counteract, not be completely suppressed, and unable to Resurrect.
  • Secondly, if the God of Combat (opens in a new tab) truly self-detonates, it would threaten the Astral Barrier (opens in a new tab) that protects and separates Earth (opens in a new tab) from the Outer Deities (opens in a new tab).
  • Someone like the White Tower, who can influence Astral World concepts, would use "Their" own methods to interfere with the Proxy.
  • Thirdly, there are other interferences, like the Underworld Daoist (opens in a new tab), etc.
  • Even counting the strongest level, there's a possibility of counter-kill, but it's not certain.
  • If the God of Combat (opens in a new tab) self-detonates at the highest level, "He" could obliterate everything on that battlefield, but that doesn't necessarily mean it could completely kill the Earth Mother (opens in a new tab) and the Evernight Goddess (opens in a new tab) because of "Their" respective authorities.
  • Furthermore, at least more than half of those 2-3 seconds would have to be used for fleeing, arranging final affairs, arranging for an heir, or activating a resurrection backup, just like the Giant King (opens in a new tab) back then.

Demoness Pathway

Sequence 9: Assassin

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Assassins will experience various improvements to their body, making them excel in combat, evasion, and Concealment.
  • Their body shape is slightly adjusted to be more suitable for assassinations, which brings about a slight change in appearance. Those with extra weight will experience minor weight loss.
  • An Assassin's passive physical capabilities have also been enhanced, granting them excellent footwork, nimble limbs, and extraordinary speed, among other traits.
  • In addition to physical enhancements and suitability for assassinations, an Assassin is also able to slightly modify their bodily functions for short periods.
  • Feather Fall: They can be as light as a feather, descending gracefully or gliding through the air.
  • Leaping from a six-floor height and landing safely is an effortless feat for Assassins.
  • Mighty Blow: An Assassin can release all their physical strength in a single blow.
  • Other Sequence 9-8 Beyonders will struggle to avoid a Mighty Blow, especially if the Assassin approaches them stealthily.
  • Heightened Senses: They possess sharp ears and eagle-like vision.
  • Night Vision: Assassins can easily see through darkness.

New Abilities

  • Shadow Concealment: Assassins possess the ability to Conceal themselves within darkness and Shadows, allowing them to hide from their targets.
  • Sprinting at full speed weakens this ability's effectiveness.

Sequence 8: Instigator

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Building on the foundation of an Assassin, their bodies become stronger, but their combat abilities, other than speed, aren't significantly improved.

New Abilities

  • Instigation: Instigators are adept at triggering the evil desires deep in people's hearts, causing them to commit violent crimes. This ability has both passive and active effects.
  • Even without speaking, using Instigation actively makes an Instigator appear reliable and approachable, causing people think better of them.
  • Along with improved thinking and analytical skills, the passive effect of Instigation allows them to sense others' emotions, desires, and even malice.
  • With Instigation and clever words, they can plant thoughts or desires in someone’s mind, prompting them to act as intended.
  • Instigators can Instigate people into starting fights, committing crimes, and escalating conflicts without being noticed.
  • Instigators can easily Instigate others into believing their lies and misdirection through their words and actions.

Sequence 7: Witch

Gender Transition

  • Advancing to a Witch results in becoming a female regardless of the original gender.

New Abilities

  • Charm: A Witch's appearance and charm will be enhanced significantly.
  • The details of their face will become more exquisite and alluring.
  • The proportions of their body will approach perfection.
  • Their height will increase slightly.
  • Dark Magic: They gain various forms of Dark Magic bestowed by the potion and while they can learn other Dark Magic, what they obtain is often sufficient and comprehensive enough.
  • They can conjure Black Flames from their body.
  • They can envelop weapons in Black Flames. Upon successfully hitting a target with such a weapon, they can detonate the flames coursing within the target's body from a distance.
  • They can compress a dense Black Flame in their palm, which they can throw upon fully forming, it would hit with the force of a cannonball while spreading flames.
  • These Black Flames differ from the more conventional flames like that of a Pyromaniac's, Black Fire ignites Spirituality rather than physical matter.
  • This can also be used against things like the effect of a Painter's Painting.
  • This allows Spirit Bodies, like Wraiths, to be targeted and incinerated.
  • This also prevents it from extinguishing underwater.
  • Black Flames are part of the Chaos authority.
  • They gain the blessing of Frost and can cast Spells related to it.
  • They can open locks by freezing the inside of the keyhole and forming the correct key.
  • They can freeze the floor which materialises ice, allowing them to control movement.
  • Encasing the floor in ice can be used to restrict enemy movement by making it slippery.
  • Small patches of Frost that sharply reduce friction allow them to run more quickly.
  • They can freeze a large area to gather ample materials for Mirror Substitution.
  • They can encase a target in layers of Frost to create an icy Seal.
  • They can cause a cold, frosty wind to blow around them.
  • Frost is part of the authority of Catastrophe.
  • Witches are able to manipulate Mirrors, using them in many different ways.
  • Mirror Substitution: They have the ability to utilise Mirrors as a medium to create Substitutes that can take damage in their place.
  • Witches are also able to make Mirror Substitutes for others, provided that they meet these two conditions:
  1. They have a medium to establish such a connection (blood, hair, etc.).
  2. Their target is within no less than 30 meters from them.
  • This ability utilises their Mirror Self, meaning each use results in its death, though it will revive by splitting from the real-world counterpart.
  • They possess the ability to hide within Mirrors, though they are not able to travel between them and are only able to remain inside for a few seconds.
  • They have a unique method of detecting Mirrors.
  • They can Curse targets through blood or other media like a doll made from flesh or hair.
  • Once the connection has been established they can use Black Flames to burn the medium, incinerating their target from within.
  • Targets can shield themselves by mystically cutting off their connection to the medium or through Substitution abilities.
  • They can use certain Ritualistic Magic to Curse their targets, causing them to suffer an early Catastrophic death.
  • They can use other Dark Magic spells including but not limited to:
  • They can use their hair to transfer a mystical connection onto a Mirror by sticking their hair to the Mirror's surface and burning it with Black Flames.
  • This form of Dark Magic is related to Mirror Substitution.
  • Staff Substitution: Similar to Mirror Substitution, Witches are able to use staves as a medium for substitutes in order to counteract fatal harm.
  • Bloodline Curse: Through a medium, they can curse any target within the bloodline the medium represents using this special type of Curse.
  • By using black powder and an incantation, a Witch can surround their target with ghostly figures that press against their body.
  • Invisibility: By scattering shimmering powder and reciting an incantation, a Witch can turn Invisible to the naked eye.
  • Dark Magic other than Black Flames, Frost, Mirror, and Curses requires certain materials and incantations, making it less practical to use in a fight compared to the others.
  • Divination: Upon reaching this Sequence, a Witch will possess considerable Divination capabilities, naturally mastering the use of Magic Mirror and Staff Divination.
  • Anti-Divination: They also are able to interfere with others' Divination.
  • Learning other forms of Divination Arts is also easy for a Witch.

Sequence 6: Pleasure (Demoness of Pleasure)

Traits

  • Their capabilities as an Assassin and Instigator have also been greatly improved.
  • Physical Enhancement: They have strong throat control. Hence, they are not easily choked.
  • Heightened Senses: Their vision has been enhanced, allowing them to see their own Threads.

New Abilities

  • Threads: Demonesses of Pleasure can make thin, almost invisible Threads like spider silk, and use them to control and restrict the enemy's movements. Their hair is the source of their spider silk.
  • A trail of broken Threads can give a Pleasure information about the enemy's size and movements, and can be delicate enough to go undetected.
  • Their Threads can form a cocoon that helps the user recover from damage while also guaranteeing them some protection against attacks.
  • Their Threads can envelop a target in true Pleasure upon contact, causing them to spasm and lose control over their body.
  • Their Threads can be stuck or tied to walls, tangling enemies who walk through them and slowing them down.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their abilities as a Witch have been enhanced.
  • Charm: They will become more beautiful, making them better at seduction and providing unforgettable pleasure to the same or opposite gender during sex.
  • A Demoness, especially one who was in the midst of or having passed the Pleasure Sequence, had a Charm that far exceeded its normal effects when shown to males, making their every action be filled with a Charm that makes men who came close to them feel intoxicated and lost.
  • In a sense, a Demoness of Pleasure's is like consuming opioids and gradually developing into something more serious, to the point of not being able to extricate oneself from the pleasure given by them. Such a Charm can even affect gay men.
  • Dark Magic: Their Dark Magic capabilities as a Witch have been greatly improved.
  • Their Frost and Black Fire capabilities have received a qualitative enhancement.
  • They can ignite a quiet Black Flame inside them that can dispel certain effects.
  • This can let a Demoness of Pleasure expel any ghosts that inhabit them, dispel Curses and negative influences, etc.
  • They can trap Spirit Bodies in Frost-encased Mirrors surrounded with Black Flames.
  • They can make 7 Black Flames around them to launch like bullets at their targets.
  • They can encase themselves in Ice to defend themselves from various attacks.
  • They are able to conjure up and throw frost spears at their targets.
  • The speed at which they can substitute themselves via Mirrors and Staves has increased.
  • They will also gain some measure of recuperation after substituting themselves.
  • A Demoness of Pleasure can Curse a target by having a mirror reflect their full figure.

Sequence 5: Affliction (Demoness of Affliction, Lady of Diseases)

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: A Demoness of Affliction can freely manipulate their hair, turning it into an effective close-combat weapon and a precise tool.
  • Their hair can pierce skin, inject Black Flames, and cause stiffness to the contacted area.

New Abilities

  • Disease: A Demoness of Affliction can create multiple airborne pathogens that have their infection speed and the onset of diseases supernaturally accelerated.
  • The initial range is 30 meters, going up to 50 meters upon full digestion of the potion.
  • They can spread Diseases at a larger range if they utilise the wind correctly.
  • The infection rate and onset of Disease vary based on the constitution of their targets.
  • Once infected, the initial 10 seconds are the incubation period, followed by mild symptoms such as allergies, fever, cough, and sneezing.
  • After 20-30 seconds, the target will begin to experience symptoms of more dangerous illnesses like pneumonia and bronchitis.
  • After 2-3 minutes, the disease will become critical as the target begins to experience cardiac arrest or a brain aneurysm.
  • Flames created by a Pyromaniac (and other similar abilities) are able to kill most of the pathogens created by a Demoness of Affliction, reducing the pathogens' impact on them.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Threads: A Demoness of Affliction's Threads have been significantly enhanced.
  • Now their Threads are like extensions of a Demoness's arms, capable of more precise and detailed actions such as wrapping around small objects and moving them.
  • Charm: A Demoness of Affliction can now use their Charm as an active ability. A simple glance, gesture, or word from a Demoness of Affliction can now completely Charm a person.
  • When combined with showcasing their appearance, figure, and aura, an active Charm becomes more effective. This will most likely lead to 1 of 2 scenarios:
  1. Charmed enemies will hesitate to harm them and be unable to use their full strength.
  2. Some Charmed enemies might even give up resisting just to gain favour from them.
  • Their own appearance, aura, figure, and passive charm have all been further enhanced.
  • Repeated daily interactions and use will make a target truly fall in love with them.
  • Dark Magic: A Demoness of Affliction's Dark Magic capabilities have also been enhanced.
  • A Demonesses of Affliction can now use the Mirror World to create scene illusions with pre-set Mirrors and Mirror Mazes to ensure that their enemies don't escape.
  • Their illusions made from Mirrors can also deceive various recording objects.
  • They can now further Curse their targets by reflecting a part of the target's body in a mirror and burning that mirrored region with Black Fire.

Sequence 4: Despair (Demoness of Despair)

Strengthened Abilities

  • A Demoness of Despair's previous Beyonder abilities, whether from a Witch, Demoness of Pleasure, or Demoness of Affliction, have all been greatly enhanced.
  • Plague: This is the enhanced form of Disease; compared to a Demoness of Affliction, a Demoness of Despair can now spread pathogens and other airborne substances with vastly increased scope, distance, and potency.
  • The following are examples of what they can produce:
  • Spirituality and Strength Sapping Plague: They can form a Plague that saps the target's strength and Spirituality.
  • This Plague gradually weakens the target until even their heart can barely beat, while simultaneously draining their Spirituality. As a result, it can infect even the dead.
  • Rigidity Plague: A Demoness of Despair can create a Plague that causes the body to become rigid and inflexible.
  • Over time, this Plague could even render extremely durable beings, such as Undead, completely inflexible.
  • Flesh Deterioration Plague: A Demoness of Despair can also create a Plague that rapidly deteriorates flesh.
  • This Plague is an enhanced form of their original Disease, primarily infecting organs like the heart, brain, and lungs, with symptoms appearing within just 10 seconds.
  • Demonesses of Despair can also develop their own unique strains of Plague and Disease.
  • This is done by combining their own unique traits, relevant mystical knowledge, special materials, concepts, and experimental methods. However, this takes a considerable amount of time and can’t yield results quickly.
  • Plagues can spread through fog and smog, covering large areas and causing epidemics.
  • Their Plagues can only target beings with Spirituality, not inanimate objects.
  • They are able to remove Plagues using Black Fire and Frost Magic.
  • Their Plagues can now cover a range of up to 3 kilometres.
  • Only one of these Plagues can be maintained at a time.
  • Threads: The power of their Threads, now within their hair, has been markedly enhanced.
  • Their Threads can restrain, bind, interfere, transmit Black Flames and Curses, possess hardness, and now convey the effects of Pleasure.
  • Petrification: If an enemy's body is touched by a Demoness of Despair's hair, that area will begin to Petrify.
  • Charm: Their beauty has been greatly enhanced both physically and spiritually.
  • Their Charm can instantly make Mid Sequence Beyonders fall in love, and the opioid-like addiction effect from their Demoness of Pleasure Sequence now manifests within a short time. Even glancing at them can trigger opioid-like addiction and infatuation.
  • Dark Magic: They possess great mastery and skill in using Mirrors, Frost, and Curses.
  • Their ability to use Mirrors has been enhanced.
  • Mirror Projection: Demonesses of Despair can now project themselves through Mirrors within a city-wide range, creating multiple different illusions of themselves.
  • Demonesses of Despair are experts at locating Mirrors, traversing the Mirror World, and transmitting information via Mirrors, albeit with some risk of interception.
  • Their unique method of detecting Mirrors has been greatly enhanced. They can now locate Mirrors within a 5 kilometre radius or locate Mirrors they have visited before.
  • When Mirror World creatures attempt to intercept their messages, they can imbue the messages with Curses, reducing the likelihood of interference.
  • Demonesses of Despair can now create Mirror Mazes to trap people in the Mirror World and use Magic Mirror Divination with greater precision.
  • Their ways of using Frost abilities have magnified.
  • They can forge Ice amulets that allow the wearer to traverse the Mirror World.
  • Their Curses have also been slightly enhanced.
  • If their enemies fail to Substitute themselves before they are locked onto and the Curse is completed, they cannot transfer or share the damage, even with a Mirror Substitution or Paper Figurine Substitute.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 4 Demigods who gained partial Godhood, they can manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences and become an incomplete Gorgon.
  • Their Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) takes the form of a female humanoid with a great mass of hair that appears to resemble that of various venomous snakes.
  • Anyone who sees their form experiences both Pleasure and pain, making it difficult to mount an effective counterattack.
  • A Demoness of Despair will be able to sustain a Divine Descent for a few seconds, but their Soul and body would collapse.

Sequence 3: Unaging (Demoness of Unaging)

Description

Every Demoness of Unaging is forever youthful, skilled in Resurrection, bizarrely difficult to kill, a darling of the Mirror World, and a true Gorgon.

New Abilities

  • Mirror Self: Upon advancing, their Mirror Person and real-world counterpart's consciousness will fuse together, allowing them to exist both outside and inside the mirror.
  • The simplest application of their Mirror Self is to fix their state into one of their countless Mirror Persons, allowing them to forever maintain their youth.
  • As a byproduct of this method, a Demoness of Unaging’s lifespan exceeds that of other Saints, allowing them to live for at least 2,000 years.
  • This can also be done for other individuals, temporarily fixing their age to match that of a chosen Mirror Person for 30 minutes.
  • This doesn't refer only to facial Agelessness, but also encompass one's entire state: physical, spiritual, and all other aspects.
  • This will maintain their peak state until the end of their long lifespan.
  • When a Mirror Person dies, it splits off from the body again to revive. Now, with the characteristics of a Mirror Person, they can revive through it.
  • A Demoness of Unaging can use environments with multiple Mirrors to temporarily multiply their Mirror Persons. As long as one survives, they cannot truly die.
  • The death of either the Demoness of Unaging's body or the Mirror Person alone is no longer true death for them: it is more like a partial injury that can be healed.
  • Concealed Resurrection: They possess the ability to create a special Mirror Person shielded from harm, within which they can safely Revive.
  • They can use their own blood, hair, skin, or other bodily materials to create a Mirror Person sleeping within a Mirror. This Mirror is hidden in a secret place under Anti-Divination conditions, with almost all mystical connections severed to prevent Curses and other harm from affecting the sleeping Mirror Person.
  • Initially, they can only separate one Mirror Person. With full potion digestion, the number of Concealed Mirror Persons that can be created rises to two.
  • While the Underworld-induced death does not affect the isolated Dormant Mirrors, making it impossible to permanently kill them, the revival process would take considerable time.
  • Losing control will still render both the Mirror Persons or Concealed Mirrors ineffective in Reviving themselves.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Petrification: A Demoness of Unaging's Petrification ability is no longer limited to their hair, but it still cannot directly Petrify targets from a distance.
  • They can slowly Petrify their surroundings, creating a plague-like area that Petrifies anyone and anything that touches the infested zone.
  • Alternatively, a Demoness of Unaging can use their spider silk as a medium for Petrification.
  • Charm: Their Charm as a Demoness of Pleasure has been greatly strengthened.
  • They can perfectly present the Charm of every stage of women, with the corresponding skin condition and temperament. People caught by their Charm find it difficult to resist.
  • When a Demoness of Unaging's Charm is used actively; it is capable of halting someone’s thoughts even if they possess considerable mental resistance and strength.
  • Over daily interactions, a Demoness of Unaging's Charm can make Angels (opens in a new tab) fall in love with them without "Them" realising it.
  • Dark Magic: Their abilities related to Mirrors and Curses have been greatly strengthened.
  • Their Curse related capabilities have been enhanced in scope and power.
  • With large-scale, special Dark Magic, essential mediums, and proper arrangements, some of the Curses created by a Demoness of Unaging can harm Angels (opens in a new tab).
  • As long as there's a physical medium of the victim, a Demoness of Unaging's Curses can not only affect the target themselves but also their direct relatives.
  • As a Demoness of Unaging's eyes have become Mirrors, whatever they see can become a potential target for the Curses they may cast.
  • Their ability to use Mirrors have been massively enhanced.
  • They are able to use Mirror World Transversal with their eyes.
  • They can directly transmit power through the Mirror World.
  • Combined with Mirror Projection, Demonesses of Unaging can manifest their power throughout an area the size of Trier (opens in a new tab) using positioned Mirrors
  • Mirror Projections cannot leave their corresponding Mirror's reflection range.
  • The power attached to this Mirror Projection cannot exceed Sequence 4.
  • They can forcibly pull people into the Mirror World.
  • When it comes to Beyonders (opens in a new tab) at a lower level (in terms of Sequence) to them, they will not even notice themselves getting pulled into the Mirror World.
  • When it comes to Saints (opens in a new tab) and Angels (opens in a new tab) of an equal or higher Sequence level, the success and detection rate depend on the Saint (opens in a new tab) or Angel's (opens in a new tab) current state.
  • Demoness of Unaging can pull multiple houses or streets into the Mirror World. What gets pulled is up to them as it can be done selectively.
  • 1-63 (opens in a new tab) was used by the Nighthawks (opens in a new tab) to selectively pull Beyonders (opens in a new tab) into the Mirror World in order to deal with Lanevus (opens in a new tab) and the Devil Dog (opens in a new tab).
  • They can better use Mirrors for surveillance.
  • They can detect everything that enter or leave an area, even Information or mystical connections, and can use Magic Mirror Divination to trace those who left.
  • They can use Mirrors to transmit Information such as their voice through nearby Mirrors, or a distant scene that can only be viewed by other Mirrors.
  • A Demoness of Unaging can control Mirrors within a 15 kilometre range upon full digestion, as well as the mirrors they have visited before. This can cover an entire small city.
  • Mirror Substitution: A Demonesses of Unaging can now control the timing of their return to reality after activating their Mirror Substitution.
  • Clarice (opens in a new tab) delayed her return to reality after using Mirror Substitution to avoid being burned by Fire of Destruction.
  • Plague: Upon full digestion, a Demoness of Unaging's Plagues can reach up to 10 kilometers.
  • They can temporarily cure some functional disorders through their control of the Plague.
  • Threads: Their own control over the spider silk they produced have been enhanced slightly.

**Mythical Creature Form

  • Their Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) develops further; their form as a Gorgon being more complete as their hair is now fully made of serpents, each with a clear white and black eye on its head.
  • In this form, a Demoness of Unaging's Petrification ability will be greatly enhanced, causing anything their serpents see to be Petrified instantly, as if from thin air.
  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range. As a result of their unified consciousness, they can manage their believers' interactions without hampering down on their combat effectiveness or disrupting the interactions of their daily life.
  • They can respond with revelations and give blessings via the use of Threads, Dark Magic, Plagues, Petrification, Mirror Self and their other Beyonder abilities.

Sequence 2: Catastrophe (Demoness of Catastrophe)

Description

Everyone who mentions "Their" name feels fear from the bottom of their hearts.

Authorities

  • Catastrophe: "They" can treat Beyonders, areas, or natural environments as structures or systems, detonating their hidden issues and triggering Catastrophic collapse by working primarily from the inside out through combined internal and external forces.
  • "They" can bring forth all sorts of natural disasters, including blizzards, floods, tsunamis, earthquakes, meteor strikes, etc., near "Them".
  • This refers not only to damage in the physical world but also to Catastrophes in more supernatural realms, allowing "Them" to collapse portions of the Mirror World.
  • "They" can instantly decrease the surrounding temperature, forming a world of ice and snow capable of freezing Sequence 5 Beyonders (opens in a new tab) on the spot and being cold enough to be almost unbearable for Sequence 3 Beyonders.
  • A Demoness of Catastrophe can instantly increase the surrounding temperature, vaporising water and making Sequence 4 Beyonders feel as if they are being roasted while killing weaker Beyonders (opens in a new tab) without Godhood.
  • In addition, events tied to disasters of the social order, mechanical constructs, certain authorities, and concepts can be exacerbated by "Them".
  • When "Their" Catastrophe concerns authorities or concepts, it entails the inducement or exacerbation of issues to destabilise a previously stable system.
  • If a Beyonder's state is inherently unstable, a Demoness of Catastrophe could just induce them to lose control on the spot. This is undoubtedly a Catastrophe.
  • Examples of "Their" authority over societal disasters include train accidents, building collapses, horse stampedes, and accidental gun discharges.
  • One manifestation of this authority is known as Curses of Destiny.
  • "They" can create an object or leave behind words that, without directly contacting the target, cause anyone who touches the object or hears the words to experience a series of Catastrophes in their subsequent lives.
  • The Catastrophe authority is a lesser manifestation of Chaos.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Plague: "Their" pathogens' power and infective properties have been greatly strengthened.
  • "Their" mystical pathogens can now influence and erode the bodies of complete Mythical Creatures (opens in a new tab).
  • Mirror Self: The number of Mirror Persons "They" can initially separate is 5.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab). "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is that of a Gorgon.
  • While in "Their" full Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab), "They" can instantly summon a forest of poisonous black snakes, obscuring the earth and piercing the sky, completely surrounding "Their" target.
  • As an Angel-level Demoness, a Demoness of Catastrophe will be able to sustain a Divine Descent for a minute or two without dying.

Sequence 1: Apocalypse (Demoness of Apocalypse)

Authorities

  • Apocalypse: The ascended form of Catastrophe authority, and a lesser manifestation of Chaos.
  • The Apocalypse authority "They" possess brings a complete end within a designated area, entangling and concluding all things, including Fate itself, in a total eruption of contradictions- something that the Catastrophe authority cannot match.
  • There is a qualitative difference between Catastrophe and Apocalypse.
  • While the focus of the Catastrophe authority is the different manifestations of disaster, the focus of the Apocalypse authority is the arrival of the disaster's result - Chaos.
  • Black Flame is a manifestation of the Chaos authority.
  • ⁠Frost is a manifestation of the Catastrophe authority.
  • A Demoness of Apocalypse can casually trigger national-scale level natural disasters.
  • Examples of the Apocalypse authority in use include:
  • Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) caused a Pallbearer, who had already been teetering on the edge of losing control due to his corruption, lose control by erupting his inner conflict under the influence of fate.
  • The localisable Apocalypse initiated by Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) caused the area around "Him" to collapse into a void, erasing all remnants except for a singular wooden coffin.
  • Pleasure: The ultimate Pleasure that drives people to indulge is a part of the ultimate Charm, and the extreme emptiness and pain that follow make this Charm even more irresistible. Crying in Pleasure, sublimating in Pleasure, and dying in Pleasure - isn't this a kind of Apocalypse?
  • The Pleasure authority is a lesser authority of Charm.
  • Disease: "They" gain a portion of the Disease authority. No longer limited to controlling mystical pathogens, "They" can now control all causes of Disease.
  • "They" can't manipulate the Mental Plague from the Visionary Pathway.
  • It's only possible after the authority evolves into the symbol of Disease.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "Their" previous abilities have been enhanced.
  • Dark Magic: A Witch at the level of an Archangel.
  • "They" are able to directly utilise the power and special traits of the Mirror World.
  • "They" can also temporarily allow a Mirror Entity to enter reality.
  • Even if these Mirror Entities were to reach the level of a King of Angels (opens in a new tab), a Demoness of Apocalypse would still be able to control "Them".
  • This allows "Them" to rapidly swap reality with its Mirror image.
  • Curses: "Their" Curses can exploit faint connections.
  • A Demoness of Apocalypse's lifespan, with the help of a Great Old One (opens in a new tab), is measured in hundreds of thousands of years.

Sequence 0: Demoness (Chaos Demoness, Primordial Demoness)

Description

"She" is the Source of Catastrophes, the Symbol of the Apocalypse, the Demoness who wields Chaos, and the Ruler of the Mirror World. "She" corresponds to the feminine aspect of the Original Creator (opens in a new tab) and possesses the authorities of Primordium, Chaos, Charm, the Mirror World, Femininity, Dark Magic, and Disease.

Authorities

  • Chaos: The core authority of the Demoness, governing the return of all things to Chaos and the Primordial state.
  • Catastrophe causes the systemic collapse of a structure. Apocalypse intensifies this collapse into a total eruption of contradictions, entangling everything into unity. Chaos represents the ultimate singularity that follows - the outcome of total collapse.
  • Thus, Chaos cannot be applied directly to a stable, balanced target. A Catastrophic collapse must first be initiated within an area, followed by an eruption of contradictions that forms a substantial vortex of Chaos. Only then can Chaos spread outward to affect the target.
  • "She" can create and control a nearly sky-filling vortex of Chaos composed of liquids of every colour. This vortex represents every possibility; anything drawn into it is shredded and dissolved into fragments, becoming unrealised potential.
  • Those caught within this Chaos vortex lose sight and hearing, and their Spiritual perception ceases; they feel as though they have reached their own Apocalypse.
  • The Chaos vortex created by "Her" can also be used defensively.
  • Primordial Demoness (opens in a new tab) formed a Chaos vortex to shield "Herself" from Darkness brought by the Evernight Goddess (opens in a new tab) of the Darkness Pathway.
  • The Chaos authority is a branch of the symbolism of destruction and endings, distinct from Death, Eternal Darkness, Decay, Ruin, Slaughter, or Fragmentation as other forms of finality.
  • Disease & Plague: These are lesser authorities of Chaos and components of Catastrophe. "She" embodies the concept of Disease itself, which can be attached to anything.
  • "Her" mystical pathogens can corrode and infect even True Gods, given sufficient time.
  • The Demoness can also directly attach the concept of Plague to a designated area.
  • Primordium: Chaos represents the end, while Primordium represents the beginning. As the feminine aspect of the Original Creator (opens in a new tab), "She" holds authority over both beginning and end, which are identical to a certain extent. At the level of the Original Creator (opens in a new tab), Chaos and Primordium merge into one.
  • At "Her" current level, the Primordium authority at Sequence 0 represents Stillness, Stagnation, and Omnipotence, with lower-tier authorities such as Petrification, etc.
  • The Stillness and Stagnation of Primordium incline toward a state in which Time ceases to exist. Omnipotence refers to various forms of Dark Magic, contact with Chaos, and the potential to invoke the Chaos Sea (opens in a new tab).
  • Dark Magic: "She" is the Sovereign of all Dark Magic, which is a lesser authority of Primordium. Any Spell that falls within the domains of Darkness, Curse, Depravity, or Evil will either be ineffective against "Her" or be enhanced and altered to "Her" advantage. This does not apply to Spell-like abilities derived from Beyonder Characteristics.
  • The Shadow Magic and Flesh and Blood Magic of the Hanged Man Pathway won't be affected as they are abilities derived from Beyonder Characteristics.
  • A Warlock's own witchcraft that falls under the domains of Darkness, Curse, Depravity, or Evil counts as Dark Magic, as do Imitated Spells.
  • "She" can "open-source" "Her" Dark Magic for use by ordinary people, although it is not very powerful and comes with specific requirements.
  • Such Dark Magic require materials, incantations, Spirit World resonance, Spirituality absorption, etc.
  • Charm: "She" possesses Charm at the conceptual level, exerting an extreme effect on all things by inducing infatuation, reluctance to part, and possessiveness.
  • All things become infatuated and entranced by "Her" slightest expression and remain in perpetual ecstasy. Even rules and concepts are reluctant to constrain or oppose "Her".
  • Cheek (opens in a new tab)'s voice was enough to make Lumian Lee's (opens in a new tab) entire body surrender to "Her". "Her" smile could halt a King of Angels' (opens in a new tab) rage, and "Her" appearance could even Charm The Fool (opens in a new tab).
  • Just a slight look at "Her" hands invoked a full Petrification of Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab), along with an outflow of "His" most primitive desires, rendering "His" mind blank.
  • "Her" Charm works on even Great Old Ones; however, there are dangers.
  • If those Great Old Ones desire "Her" Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) or Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics, "Their" possessiveness will be amplified to madness, compelling "Them" to devour and fuse with "Her", becoming one permanently.
  • If "She" were to go mad, this authority would not reach its full potential.
  • This was the case for Primordial Demoness Cheek (opens in a new tab).
  • Mirror World: "She" has complete control over the Mirror World and all its derivative abilities, including Immortality and Resurrection.
  • Destroying all Mirror Worlds would be the only way to truly kill the Demoness.
  • "Her" Divine Kingdom is tied to the Mirror World and has the following effects:
  • Only Females can exist there: even Gods would acquire distinctly Female characteristics.
  • Without sufficient protection, one would often meet disasters intrinsically tied to oneself.
  • Gazing upon what should not be seen would immediately Petrify one into stone.
  • Extreme Pleasure sporadically manifests, making one reluctant to leave.
  • "She" can prevent the Mirror World from collapsing.
  • Primordial Demoness (opens in a new tab) stopped the collapse that was induced by Dual-Pathway God Amon's (opens in a new tab) Sufferer's re-enactment of Mr. Fool's (opens in a new tab) supernova.
  • Mirror World creatures are subject to "Her" command.
  • "She" can fuse with the Mirror World at any time.
  • This lets "Her" appear in any corner as "Her" voice echoes from all directions.
  • Femininity: As a feminine aspect of the Original Creator (opens in a new tab) and representation of Yin Energy, "She" possesses some authority over female forces and concepts.
  • If this authority were to malfunction, all females in the universe would suffer anomalies.
  • "She" can transform living beings and inanimate objects "She" perceives into females.
  • The Primordial Demoness (opens in a new tab) altered various infants, "Her" hair, and rebellious mystical pathogens to make them real females to control and manipulate.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "She" appears enormous, clad in a white dress made of bone. "Her" visage grows increasingly beautiful, yet from different angles exudes distinct temperaments: pure, elegant, majestic, delicate, pristine, and decadent.
  • "Her" black hair, as thick as pythons, exudes an eerie slickness. Some strands rise and rotate, their black- and-white eyes spinning; others extended forward, sprouting serpent-like heads that flick their tongues. Others coil at "Her" feet, forming a vortex of snakes. Whether one gazed directly at the Primordial Demoness or not, everything would react instinctively to "Her" presence.
  • Anything directly touched by these tentacles is transformed into beautiful women of varying sizes, who then run rampant and destroy all matter.

Red Priest Pathway

Sequence 9: Hunter

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They possess inhuman physical qualities, giving them increased strength, speed, reaction, body control, and natural healing ability.
  • They possess the strength of a bear and the agility of a cat, being slightly equivalent to the combination of the two creatures.
  • Their punches are strong enough to easily cause the air to release cracking sounds.
  • Upon advancement, Hunters will also gain a few centimetres in height.
  • Heightened Senses: a Hunter's overall auditory, olfactory, and visual senses are enhanced exponentially, this gives them strong tracking skills.
  • This allows them to accurately discern different scents; "see" invisible footprints and minute details; and hear hushed sounds from an extremely far away area.
  • Their hearing is strong enough to determine the weight of a person from just their footsteps.
  • Their supernatural sensory abilities would only appear when they focus, taking the form of a weaker version that doesn't disturb them in their everyday lives.
  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality is slightly enhanced as a Beyonder, but they are among the weakest in this field, far inferior to other Sequence 9s who excel at it.
  • Ritualistic Magic: They can learn and cast only the most basic of Ritualistic Magic.
  • Spirit Vision: They can learn to use Spirit Vision through Cogitation.
  • A Hunter's Spirit Vision can only discern the Ether Body and weak spiritual creatures.
  • The probability of a Hunter succeeding in Cogitation on their first try is very low.
  • Danger Intuition: They can passively sense ill intentions and danger.

New Abilities

  • Knowledge (Survival, Traps): Upon drinking the Hunter potion, they will receive an influx of knowledge on how to survive and hunt targets in the wilderness, as well as how to place traps.
  • As for the survival knowledge itself, it is about wild plants and animal organs, potential haemostatic medicine when injured, and poisons to smear their weapons with.
  • When it comes to trap knowledge, they can accurately locate certain spots in their environment, enabling them to efficiently set up traps in their surroundings.
  • Hunters gain a level of expertise with the use of explosives, allowing them to act as a demolition expert, or rig intricate explosive traps.
  • This ability allows Hunters to find natural traps, such as unstable cliffs or quicksand, to trap an opponent without setting one up first.
  • They also gain an innate ability to memorise environments, allowing them to better create and form traps to use against an enemy.
  • They have an unwavering memory for any alterations they made in their surroundings: it was a fundamental part of them.
  • They have very strong spatial perception and positioning abilities.

Sequence 8: Provoker

Traits
