  • Physical Enhancement: A Provoker's physique becomes slightly stronger, granting them an overall increase in their strength, reflexes, speed, and agility.
  • Their natural regeneration also gets enhanced, but not by much.
  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality is slightly enhanced once again.
  • Spirit Vision: They can activate Spirit Vision smoothly using a simple gesture.

New Abilities

  • Provocation: Provokers possess the ability of Provocation which induces a permanent state change on themselves but also requires activation in order to achieve its desired effect.
  • The former refers to an improvement in their observation skills, allowing them to discern which words, actions, and situations would most easily trigger agitation from their target.
  • In extreme cases, they can even cause a target to enter a temporary loss of control.
  • The latter refers to the act of Provocation, which when employed, merges insults and humiliation, causing the targets to lose their composure and make irrational decisions.
  • If they encounter a beast, a monster, or a Beyonder who is out of control and is unable to communicate, Provokers can instead exude a repugnant aura that incites conflict.
  • The more tailored the taunts and humiliation, the more effective the Provocation. However, even a word like "Dogshit!" could incite anger to some degree.
  • The ability of Provocation is well-suited to lure enemies into traps and ambushes which those in the Red Priest Pathway excel in.

Sequence 7: Pyromaniac (Fire Mage)

Traits

  • Spirituality: A Pyromaniac's Spirituality receives a remarkable improvement.
  • Spirit Vision: Pyromaniacs can now easily and discreetly activate Spirit Vision (opens in a new tab), use it better, as well as be able to discern the various components of the Ether Body.
  • Danger Intuition: Their danger instinct has been enhanced.
  • They could now activate their intuition pre-emptively, and as a result, they could detect if they were being followed and employ their anti-tracking techniques more effectively and flawlessly.

New Abilities

  • Pyrokinesis: They possess the ability to freely control and conjure flames within their vicinity.
  • Their control over flames could be categorised into seven distinct aspects.
  1. Compression: A Pyromaniac can Compress flames before releasing them. The longer they Compress their flames, the more flames gathered, resulting in a more potent strike.
  • They can create a highly compressed Fireball which can be thrown at their target.
  1. Fire Armour: They can ignite a layer of Flame Armour over their body, affording them a measure against various forms of assault while still allowing them to breathe in air.
  • It gives some defence against freezing effects, poisonous gases, and other assault.
  1. Conjure Flames: They are able to Conjure temporary weapons using flames, capable of inflicting scorching, cutting, and piercing damage.
  • At this Sequence, a Pyromaniac's Conjured weapons lacked a tangible form, and as such they cannot be used to block or parry.
  1. Area of Effect: They possessed area-of-effect attacks. By extending the reach of the flames instead of hurling them forth, they could ensure precise control over their detonation, causing them to erupt at a desired location or manifest in different forms.
  2. Delay Explosions: They are able to delay explosions. By employing additional spirituality and manipulating the structure, they could fashion a Flame Bomb that would detonate at a predetermined time, rather than immediately upon impact.
  3. Fire Enchant: They are able to Enchant their melee weapons or projectiles with Fire, granting it fire damage, it could also be used to give it Spirit Body burning properties, making it effective against creatures of a soul-like nature.
  4. Fire Infusion: Through close-quarters combat and the forceful clash of strength, they could gradually inject flames into an opponent's body before triggering their detonation, dealing massive damage to the enemy's body.
  • In addition, they receive 4 fire related spells they could cast quickly. Unlike a Warlock, they don’t need materials, symbols or recite incantations in their minds to launch them, in terms of actual combat, it’s faster, and more convenient.
  1. Fire Ravens: Summons multiple ravens made of fire. These ravens are great at intercepting and locking-on multiple targets at the same time making it more difficult to avoid than a regular Fireball and can be detonated early to impede their target's movements.
  • This granted them a degree of control even after launching flames, enabling them to momentarily adjust their flight path and lock onto their intended targets.
  • Without this spell, a recently promoted Pyromaniac, would need to expend way more Spirituality and energy to achieve a similar outcome.
  1. Wall of Fire: Summons forth a pair of flaming serpents that slithered toward the enemy, erecting a scorching barrier around them by utilising the ground as a conduit and drawing upon its own essence to maintain itself without their Spirituality.
  2. Blazing Spear: Creates a spear made of blazing-white fire which can be thrown. This spear does higher damage then an average Fireball but has a lower area of effect. A direct hit would nail their target to the ground before burning them inside-out.
  3. Giant Fireball: This spell is akin to that of the Compression of numerous crimson Fireballs into a single Giant Fireball. Such an attack that directly hits a target will lead to a devastating blast with a large area of effect radius.
  • Their flames can burn a Spirit Body, making them effective against creatures of a soul-like nature.
  • They can exert minute influence over combustible substances within their vicinity.
  • Fire Resistance: Their bodies have a remarkable resistance to flames. Even if doused in animal fat and subjected to the flames of a torch for half a day, the damage they suffered would be minimal.
  • However, the concussive force of an explosion could still harm them in a conventional manner.

Sequence 6: Conspirer

Traits

  • Enhanced Mental Attributes: Upon drinking this Sequence 6 potion, Conspirers will gain an enhanced insight, and a sharper and much more clearer thinking.
  • They will also gain a series of other specific improvements, such as an enhanced intelligence and the ability to fabricate excuses to convince others.
  • Information-Gathering: They gain enhancements on their five senses and spiritual perception.
  • This is the strengthened form of Heightened Senses.
  • Physical Enhancement: Their physique has been improved to a certain extent.
  • Spirituality: A Conspirer's Spirituality has also been enhanced to a degree.

New Abilities

  • Incitement (Instigation): Conspirers can Incite certain thoughts or desires in someone’s mind through conversing with them, such as by consciously igniting the flames in their heart.
  • The way this ability works is very similar to that of an Instigator's Instigation.
  • Misdirection, Confusion, Deception (Conspiracy): These factors of manipulation are the core aspects of Conspiracies which Conspirers use to manipulate their enemies.
  • Medici (opens in a new tab) used various aspects of Deception and Misdirection in order to make it seem that "He" was unable to enter 4th Epoch Trier (opens in a new tab) which "He" then used to commence a sneak attack and regain "His" status as a King of Angels (opens in a new tab).
  • Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) created a quick Conspiracy in order to determine whether a trader was lying about having mystical items. He had also created a Conspiracy to kill Hisoka (opens in a new tab) in both his real and Dream Projection form.
  • Flame Transformation: Conspirers are able to merge with their fire weapons conjured from Pyrokinesis and travel to the destination that their fire weapon lands.
  • They can take other people with them but unlike Conspirers, they are not immune to the flames.
  • They are able to merge with some of the fire spells they can cast too, such as a Fireball, etc.
  • The initial range is 10 meters. This would increase over time as they digest their potion.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Pyrokinesis: Their precise control over flames has improved. Their flames are now crimson-white.
  • Compression: The difficulty of repeatedly compressing the crimson flames to form incandescent white flames decreased. The time required was significantly reduced and, depending on the flame's specific appearance and energy density, it ranged from one to three seconds.
  • Conjure Flames: They can now Conjure their controlled flames into different forms, such as whips and sabres. In addition, due to the more solid and tangible nature of their flames, they are now able to parry with these Conjured fire weapons.

Sequence 5: Reaper

Description

The Reaper has the highest damage output between all Sequence 5 Beyonders, and from this point onward the Red Priest Pathway will have this advantage in every Sequence, however, some Pathways have abilities with instant death effect, which the Red Priest Pathway doesn't have.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Their strength, speed, and endurance have improved.
  • However, they are still not resilient enough to withstand a bullet.
  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality has been enhanced to a significant degree.
  • Enhanced Mental Attributes: A Reaper's thinking becomes clearer.

New Abilities

  • Weakness Investigation: Through supernatural means, a Reaper is able to discern a target’s vulnerabilities and weak points in their defences.
  • They can also find weaknesses in certain physical structures or supernatural barriers (like the walls from a Guardian's Protection).
  • Their Weakness Investigation discernment also applies to non-physical bodies and weather phenomena as well.
  • This is seen with how Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) attacked Hisoka's (opens in a new tab) Dream Projection.
  • Cull: They can infuse any of their attacks with this Beyonder power to harvest their target's life, making each attack akin to striking an enemy's vital points and weaknesses.
  • To a certain extent, they could even inflict real damage on Demigod-level creatures, provided they didn’t block or successfully evade, and refrained from using mystic defences.
  • They can damage non-physical bodies, physical structures, and phenomena with Cull.
  • In an attempt to complete the ritual needed to become a Weather Warlock, Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) had discerned the weakness of the weather in Bansy Harbor (opens in a new tab) before attacking it with Cull.
  • If they hit a genuine weakness or vital point, it could deliver a fatal blow, making it challenging for the target to withstand three consecutive attacks.
  • This rule applies to even high defence targets like Guardians.
  • Anderson Hood (opens in a new tab) hit a weakened Stone Golem in the heart with an uppercut infused with Cull, causing it to freeze on the spot before crumbling into rubble seconds later.
  • Precision: A Reaper is able to precisely target a predetermined location and carefully manipulate Fireballs, Fire Ravens, and all sorts of Fire Spells.
  • Through this, they can split a colossal Fireball into hundreds, striking different targets with accuracy, achieving effective area-of-effect damage.
  • Both Cull and Precision require a substantial amount of Spirituality, which makes them hard to repeatedly use when in prolonged fights.
  • The exception to this rule is using the combination of Precision and Fire Raven, as Fire Raven could allocate a bit of Spirituality and is easily manipulated, making the overall consumption of a Reaper's Spirituality low.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Pyrokinesis: Their ability to manipulate and control flames has been enhanced.
  • Compression: They can Compress flames into a blazing white state in an incredibly short time.
  • Conjure Flames: They appear to be better able to Conjure and manipulate flames.
  • A Reaper is now capable of Conjuring their flames into a burning figure that can move and attack in a simple motion. This serves as a method of attack and deception.
  • Flame Transformation: Ignoring the high Spirituality consumption, they can now merge with their flames and swiftly cover dozens to hundreds of meters.

Sequence 4: Iron-blooded Knight

Gender Transition

  • Advancing to a Iron-blooded Knight results in becoming a male regardless of the original gender.

Traits

  • Courage: Iron-blooded Knights have Courage comparable to steel, giving them high resistance against mental attacks and ensures they are not knocked down by fear.
  • However, such Courage balances fear without recklessness, ensuring that they don't suffer from falling into any traps due to their enhanced confidence.
  • Physical Enhancement: They have gained enhancements to their physical attributes that allow them to be able to fight against Twilight Giant Pathway Giants or Dragons.

New Abilities

  • Weapon Augmentation: Iron-blooded Knights can turn any ordinary object into a terrifying murderous weapon through their Weapon Augmentation.
  • An ordinary fountain pen could become as dangerous as a fired cannonball. Such "weapons" will also have their corresponding durability/strength match their offensive ability.
  • Their Augmented objects can serve as carriers for their Fireballs, allowing for them to divert some power to constantly accelerate, bombing a target area from great distances.
  • An Iron-Blooded Knight can perform such remote bombardments from a 5 to 10 kilometre range, presumably according to potion digestion.
  • Across such great distances, the time elapsed to its destination is enough that even Mid-Sequence Beyonders with strong Spiritual Intuition could detect it and escape the covered area. As such, its greatest use is to destroy fixed targets.
  • Chain of Command: Iron-blooded Knights have a hidden connection with those under their command.
  • The need of a ritual for this connection depends on several things.
  • If the mental resonance is strong enough and lack of subconscious resistance is especially high, merely declaring that a target is part of their team can form a connection.
  • Otherwise, they must conduct a ritual for such a connection to be made.
  • There are 3 ways they can use Chain of Command:
  1. Communication: Using the connection, they can share senses between their troops.
  • While they can't exactly pass down messages to their troops, an Iron-blooded Knight can use the hidden connection to their troops to inform them of certain matters.
  • Egor Einhorn (opens in a new tab) had, in the midst of his thoughts, planned on using the hidden connection between his troops to inform his adjutant to pay him a visit.
  • Egor Einhorn (opens in a new tab), from hearing a sudden noise, immediately woke up every sailor and soldier in the Nepos to prepare for a sudden battle.
  • They can share power, damage, vision, hearing, and feelings with their team.
  1. Strength Concentration: They can focus the power of their army onto themselves.
  • At this level, they can only Concentrate the Spirituality and overall power of their army to themselves, and not the Beyonder powers that their teammates may possess.
  • When it comes to Concentrating the power of an army to themselves, it will cause each and every one of their Beyonder powers to be enhanced in terms of potency.
  1. Alleviation: They can spread the damage on themselves to their troops.
  • This does not only refer to spreading damage that is of a physical nature onto their troops but is also something that can be used on mental influences.
  • Through the Sword of Courage (opens in a new tab), the negative side effect of being overwhelmed by Pleasure was instead turned into a brief daze for Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab).
  • Egor Einhorn (opens in a new tab) had spread the illusory hearing damage he experienced from Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) across his troops, causing them to hear a faint buzz.
  • Galvanisation: Iron-blooded Knights can transform their body and their own flames into steel at will.
  • This increases the their defensive capabilities, but not to the point where their Galvanised form can defend from attacks that will melt or destroy steel.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Pyrokinesis: The heat from their flames increases exponentially, the flames taking on a bluish-white colour. Such an enhancement also increases their flames' explosive strength by many factors.
  • By coating an Augmented item in flames to function as a Fireball, an Iron-blooded Knight can unleash a violent explosion that can destroy everything within a typical public square.
  • Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) had used the Sword of Courage (opens in a new tab) as a Fireball within the Special Mirror World (opens in a new tab) the size of a plaza, causing a massive explosion that had flames burn everything within.
  • They can Conjure a flame sword and have it inserted in the ground beneath them, causing blazing white-blue Fireballs to spread layer upon layer, igniting every corner in a large area.
  • In an effort to kill Voisin Sanson (opens in a new tab), Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) brought the Sword of Courage (opens in a new tab) and inserted it into the ground, destroying and igniting every corner of the ruins.
  • Each strike an Iron-blooded Knight does that is imbued with their high-temperature bluish-white flames can cause a massive explosion and spread to a target's body.
  • Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) demonstrated this through the strikes caused by his Sword of Courage (opens in a new tab) causing massive explosions and spreading onto Higdon (opens in a new tab).
  • Their normal flames and power they possess are akin to that of high-class cannons, being capable of resisting its impact and mutually destroying each other.
  • Egor Einhorn (opens in a new tab) had shot out various flames and Fireballs that intersected the trajectory of those fired cannonballs, causing them to explode prematurely mid-flight.
  • Flame Transformation: They can now flame their body at will, allowing them to disperse into multiple flames which they can control precisely to move and then coalesce back into their body.
  • Even if most of the flames are extinguished by the enemy, it will not affect the integrity of their physical form, but instead weaken their vitality and Spirituality proportionally.
  • In this state, so long as the attack does not harm their spiritual consciousness, they can mostly heal physical-level injuries by devouring natural Flames.
  • Cull: Their Cull ability has reached the Demigod level in terms of potency, allowing them to heavily damage Demigods through a well hit strike or the use of their Beyonder abilities.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences and become an incomplete Calamity Giant.

Sequence 3: War Bishop

New Abilities

  • War Song & War Cry: War Bishops can yell out a War Cry or sing a War Song to enhance oneself and their allies and also weaken any enemies that are near them.
  • These abilities can boost the team's morale, temporarily enhance of strength, influence the enemy's mentality, and suppress the target's performance.
  • Fog of War: A War Bishop can form a Fog of War that disrupts the senses of anyone within it and also isolates the connection of things in the inside.
  • It affects hearing and smell, suppress Spiritual Intuition, as well as hamper sensation of the Spirit World, which prevents most escape attempts using Spirit World Traversal.
  • It also disrupts most forms of mystical connections from accurately targeting those within a Fog of War, preventing most forms of Curses and Divination from working.
  • Within the Fog of War, they are unaffected by anything.
  • Sacrifice: After offering sufficient Sacrifices, each War Bishop can petition the Essence of War (opens in a new tab) or the Symbolism of War for assistance once per battle.
  • Through aid from the essence of War, they can manifest a crimson, dripping banner emblem on their forehead that eases the conditions of Chain of Command.
  • This crimson, dripping banner emblem on their forehead will increase the range of connecting to a target along with lowering the difficulty of forming a mental resonance.
  • A War Bishop will be able to temporarily obtain the Beyonder powers of a Weather Warlock.
  • They can gain an increase in lifespan through Sacrificial Rituals.

Authorities

  • Gathering: The power of the high-level Red Priest Pathway belonged to War, and War was the art of Gathering the Masses, this is the authority of a War Bishop.
  • They could gather power from their army and impart their own power to one of their troops, effectively increasing that member's strength for a period of time.
  • The maximum range they can Gather Strength from others power to use for themselves or Gather power for their allies is 3 kilometres.
  • Not only can they use the Beyonder powers of team members, but they can also share their own abilities and power with them.
  • War Bishops can only fuse the abilities they get from a teammate of the Demoness Pathway. This is a limitation that won't be broken even for the Higher Sequences.
  • Franca (opens in a new tab) had shared "Her" ability of Black Flames with Medici (opens in a new tab), allowing the latter to utilise the Fire of Destruction and Sword of Destruction.
  • They can use the Beyonder powers of their team members without their consent, but the team members need the War Bishop's permission to use theirs.
  • If one ally borrows the Beyonder powers of the War Bishop, other allies cannot borrow other Beyonder powers at the same time.
  • The total amount of Spirituality and strength of the team remains unchanged.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Chain of Command: War Bishops are able to unleash the true strength of an army.
  • Crowd Control: They can fortify and connect members together, allowing them to strongly resist outside interference. This manifests as blood and rust-like beams of light that connect the group.
  • Even while Tyrant Pathway Beyonders in the Holy Wind Cathedral (opens in a new tab) sent several giant bluish-black Wind Blades akin to surface-to-air missiles, the War Bishop's airships remained fine.
  • When those Air Blades were about to hit the airbags of the airship, an invisible layer of defence appeared and shielded it from all the attacks, though the transparent "wall" formed from Crowd Control did shake from the assault.
  • While a Hurricane was formed with the help of Tyrant Pathway Beyonders in the Holy Wind Cathedral (opens in a new tab), the fleet of airships supported by a War Bishop were able to move on.
  • Communication: Their previous ability as an Iron-blooded Knight has now been enhanced, allowing a War Bishop to pass down messages to their own troops.
  • In addition to that, a War Bishop can choose to selectively shield and modify certain information within the Communication, which can be used in many Conspiracies.
  • Pyrokinesis: Their flames are now pure azure, and the corresponding destructive power and the heat that their flames emit have been enhanced significantly.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.
  • The more anchors there are within a certain range from a War Bishop, the stronger they will be.
  • These anchors must be for the War Bishop for this effect to work.
  • Each of their soldiers count as anchors for the War Bishop.

Sequence 2: Weather Warlock

Traits

  • Charm: "They" possess a Charm that makes people want to follow and be loyal to "Them", and may cause women to develop feelings of admiration, but there is no active Charm.
  • Information-Gathering: "Their" ability to observe the environment and thus extraction and restoration of environmental information has significantly enhanced.
  • Physical Enhancement: "Their" strength and stamina are enhanced.
  • Spirituality: "Their" amount of Spirituality gets enhanced as well.

Authorities

  • Weather (Weather Manipulation): "They" possess a partial authority over Weather, allowing "Them" to change regional atmosphere and create extreme weather conditions, such as thunderstorms, hurricanes, heavy rain, hail, blizzards, frost, and dense fog.
  • Specific examples of such authority in action include:
  • "They" are able to guide the Weather to strike with colossal and magnificent lightning bolts, forming a silver-white divine tree that connects the sky and earth.
  • Rather than Concentrate power to "Themselves" to enhance the lightning bolts, it is better to share "Their" Weather authority with "Their" team members as a way to hopefully trigger chain reactions or chaotic changes, exacerbating their power.
  • This is Weather, where a butterfly's wing flap can eventually evolve into a hurricane.
  • If this is successful, it will make the thunderstorm even more pronounced and exaggerated than if "They" had enhanced it by Concentrating the strength of "Their" troops onto "Themselves".
  • If a Weather Warlock were to share "Their" Weather authority with thousands of soldiers, "They" can compete against a Demoness of Catastrophe's destructive power.
  • "They" can make the weather in the sky form torrential rain that can be guided to aim to a single area, which in a span of 2-3 hours, can submerge the entire Bansy Harbor (opens in a new tab).
  • Just as "They" can create extreme weather conditions, "They" are also able to disperse and calm down various weather phenomena, both extreme and normal.
  • While "They" cannot directly form meteors or earthquakes, "They" are able to create some indirectly through the precise trigger of other weather phenomena.
  • "They" can bring forth a horrifying hurricane that "They" can form over the sea which can sweep in towering azure waves over 10 meters high to effectively create a small tsunami.
  • Through this authority, "They" can fly by the wind and levitate in the air.
  • Gathering: "They" can concentrate and Gather strength within a 10 kilometre range.
  • "They" can allow every team member to use "Their" Beyonder powers simultaneously while also lending them the corresponding Spirituality if needed.
  • "They" can only share one ability with each team member at a time.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Tracking: "Their" Tracking skills are of an advanced level.
  • Pyrokinesis: "Their" flames now glow a violet-tinged azure to an azure-tinged violet depending on the potion's digestion, and "Their" control over flames has been massively improved.
  • "They" can cover a battlefield of tens of kilometres, directly raining down Meteor Shower, or summoning flocks of Fire Ravens.
  • Compression: Their a Compressed fireball's explosive power of now far surpasses that of a fleet's main guns by quite a margin.
  • Flame Transformation: "They" can now turn into a stream of flame, a huge flaming spear, and a terrifying flaming meteor to attack enemies or travel quickly.
  • Combined with hurricane-like winds, "They" can reach speeds up to 4000-5000 kilometres per hour, increasing with the potion's digestion.
  • "They" can further enhance "Their" speed through the explosive force of flames to continually accelerate, reaching a terrifying speed at the cost of damaging "Their" body which means "They" shouldn't do it for too long.
  • Weakness Investigation: The scope of this ability has been enhanced, allowing targets "They" see be in the overall sense, including Substitutes, Avatars, and manifestations.
  • "They" can then find the weak points in this whole. if combined with Cull and the target doesn't have enough Substitutes or Avatars, "They" can wipe them all out at once.
  • Cull: Its power has been greatly enhanced, which, when in combination of Weakness Investigation, make it so that even those in the Demoness Pathway can't take a few of such blows.
  • "Their" weapons also become extensions of "Their" bodies.
  • Weapon Augmentation: "They" can make materials like wood and paper as strong as the Sword of Courage (opens in a new tab), which "They" can launch at high speeds over distances at several times the sound barrier.
  • Their remote bombardment range using Augmented objects as carriers has been enhanced to vary between several hundreds to thousands of kilometres, presumably according to potion digestion.
  • Chain of Command: This hidden line of command "They" had since "They" became an Iron-blooded Knight have been massively enhanced.
  • "They" are able to use borrowed ability of "Their" army, along one of "Their" abilities from the Chain of Command to achieve new and unique effects.
  • By borrowing powers of Manipulator, and attaching it to "Their" Communication, teammates would transmit all inner thoughts or fleeting ideas to their companions.
  • A Weather Warlock is able to directly descend to the location of "Their" team member through "Their" team members' prayers.
  • Galvanisation: "Their" ability to turn into steel no longer turns "Them" into ordinary steel, but closer to the symbolism of "steel", able to withstand attacks that would normally destroy or melt real steel.
  • "They" can transform "Their" flames into actual weapons or iron-black armour with this level of symbolic properties, though "They" could only maintain this for about 10 minutes.
  • Fog of War: The War Bishop's ability to produce a Fog of War has been greatly enhanced at "Their" level. At even higher Levels "Their" Fog of War may even affect the Astral World.
  • The range that "Their" Fog of War can initially expand to is 20 kilometres, which will continue increase as "Their" potion is further digested.
  • The War Bishop's trait of being unaffected by anything while within the Fog of War can now be shared with "Their" own team members.
  • At "Their" current level, the Fog of War "They" form now has the ability to interfere with outside Divination and Prophecy.
  • Sacrifice: "They" can now petition the essence of war or the symbolic "war" for assistance once every week, borrowing its strength to help achieve certain victories.
  • In special environments or circumstances, this allows "Them" to turn "Their" flames into a dark-red, nearly purple flame, and temporarily gain the powers of Conquest.
  • By conducting a sacrifice exceeding standard to the essence of war during a large-scale war, "They" can approach or even briefly reach the Sequence 1 level.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature, "Their" Mythical Creature form is a 5-6 meter tall Calamity Giant, an iron-black metal skeleton engulfed in majestic purple flames, along with various symbolic elements representing real phenomena.
  • A Calamity Giant would ignite those who witness and approach "Them", while the unfathomable knowledge emanating from "Them" would materialise various weather phenomena.
  • If "They" don't suppress and restrain "Their" psyche, the weather will gradually become more volatile and extreme within the area "They" reside in, and the probability of wars and massacre events occurring will continually increase.

Sequence 1: Conqueror

Authorities

  • Conquest & War: "They" obtain part of the Conquest and War authorities.
  • Puppets into Soldiers (Casting Beans into Soldiers): A combination of the War and Conquest authorities, allowing "Them" to Conquer inanimate objects to turn into soldiers.
  • If soldier dolls or “beans” have been prepared in advance using Beyonder Characteristics or Boons from other Pathways, those soldiers will likewise possess those abilities.
  • Sauron-Einhorn-Medici (opens in a new tab), through "His" Conquering authority, deployed life-like metallic figurines infused with Beyonder Characteristics (opens in a new tab), instantly showing the formidable strength of "His" legion while implementing "His" plans.
  • These soldiers are able to use the Conqueror's powers.
  • Lumian Lee's (opens in a new tab) Sword of Destruction tore the surrounding Mirror World into fragments, each fragment was Conquered to be turned into a soldier that shot Black Flame composed short arrows towards Judith (opens in a new tab).
  • Through the soldiers made from “His" Conjured flames, Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) possessed a ready made army that can use "His" own Spirituality and activate "His" own Beyonder powers and Contract abilities.
  • Other examples of this usage are:
  • Vermonda Sauron (opens in a new tab) let out a scream, scorching the ground with purple flames as earth puppets crawled out. These 3 to 4 meter tall puppets charred with an iron hue and speckled in dark-red blood became "His" soldiers in battle.
  • Diest's (opens in a new tab) soybeans transformed into giants with blurred faces and yellowish skin while "His" various palm-sized iron soldiers sprang into life and had expanded in size, joining the battle against Vermonda Sauron (opens in a new tab).
  • Conquest: "They" can make the target's body, mind and spirit want to submit, and choose to submit. Once the target is completely Conquered, they will be loyal to "Them" forever.
  • It can also be used to make the target lose consciousness and control the bodies of the affected creatures to act according to "Their" will regardless of whether the creature is conscious or not.
  • Sauron-Einhorn-Medici (opens in a new tab) channelled "His" will of subjugation into the unstable Vermonda Sauron (opens in a new tab), Conquering "His" will and allowing "Him" to plunge "His" sword into "His" skull.
  • There is no limit for the numbers of targets "They" are able to Conquer.
  • Gathering: Gathered power can undergo a qualitative transformation when reaching sufficient numbers, capable of rivalling an attack from an activated (opens in a new tab) Uniqueness (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can enable "Their" soldiers to share "Their" rank by simultaneously sharing all of "Their" abilities and Spirituality; its only drawback is the mass expenditure of Spirituality.
  • War Commander: A Conqueror can establish a temporary team of unlimited size that enjoys almost all the benefits of a true team within a 50 kilometre range.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "They" gain further enhancements and strengthening to "Their" other Beyonder powers.
  • Sacrifices: If a Conqueror were to Sacrifice "Themselves", "They" can achieve a power burst that reaches similar levels to a Hand of God and Hand of Order doing the same.
  • This is the level of the weakest tier of Half Great Old One (opens in a new tab).
  • Spear of Destruction: The Cull ability at this level has undergone a qualitative transformation.
  • It can be used on a single target or to annihilate an area. Even if it doesn’t hit a weak point, it still inflicts massive destruction. If it strikes a clone, projection, or Substitute, it will transmit the destruction to the true body. Striking a true weak point is equivalent to certain death.
  • Galvanisation: "Their" ability to turn "Their" flames and body into steel has been enhanced.
  • "They" are able to create a massive, bloodstained, iron-black chair or a throne pieced together from iron-black weapons just by Conjuring flames and Galvanising it into steel.
  • "They" can materialise an iron-black blood-stained armour whose mystical and physical defences reach a level not much inferior to a Hand of God through Galvanisation.
  • Pyrokinesis: "Their" flames now burn in a pure violet colour.

Sequence 0: Red Priest

Description

"Red" represents the colour of War, and "Priest" can be understood as a ritual of strength.

Symbolism

  • Lord of War: A symbolic extension of the War authority that lets "Him" and "His" teammates share "Their" power, rank, and the power of the Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) across an entire planet simultaneously.
  • Only one team member can use the Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) at any given moment. If "His" subordinate uses it, their insufficient foundation prevents them from unleashing its full might.
  • A single team member can share their Beyonder powers with everyone else.
  • Through the use of 0-01 (opens in a new tab), Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) shared the Blink ability from a Boon Angel (opens in a new tab) soldier of the Door Pathway with everyone within "His" entire army.
  • "He" can freely exchange positions with "His" team at any time.

Authorities

  • Conquest: This authority can extend to territories and even certain abstract concepts.
  • Conquest can only make others soldiers, then utilize their abilities; it cannot directly seize the abilities of others. In theory, it could lead to omniscience and omnipotence.
  • If "He" were to Conquer a True God (opens in a new tab) or, "He" would be able to utilise all of "Their" authorities, concepts, and symbols.
  • When Conquering lower-status beings, even if they resist "His" Conquest, their Beyonder Characteristics may still rebel against them, causing them to lose those Characteristics.
  • Due to Alista Tudor's (opens in a new tab) Conquest, Azik Eggers (opens in a new tab) lost an entire set of Characteristics; only the extra parts remained.
  • Pathways with strong dominance over both others and themselves, such as the Death Pathway, can resist Conquest to a certain degree.
  • "His" Divine Kingdom is formed through completely Conquering a land, battlefield, or special area. This is a deeper conceptualisation of Conquest.
  • Any living being that enters the Divine Kingdom without adequate protection or rank will immediately become a soldier of the Red Priest.
  • The aura of Conquest the Red Priest exudes is so overwhelming that even True Deities may bow "Their" heads down to "Him".
  • The emergence of Lumian Lee's (opens in a new tab) hands from the Door of Summoning caused a group of Sanguines (opens in a new tab) to submit and bow their heads involuntarily.
  • War: Even without personally starting a War, "He" can cause War to break out in a target area through a mere gaze or presence, controlling its scale, intensity, and nature.
  • Courage: A lesser authority of War: the Courage of the mind knows no fear, while the Courage of the body is difficult to destroy.
  • Fog of War: At the True Deity level, the Red Priest's Fog of War should now be able to affect even the Astral World.
  • Destruction: At its highest level, Destruction can shatter an entire planet. At its lowest level, it can kill a True God (opens in a new tab). It also includes the ability to detect weaknesses and lock onto targets.
  • The mere clench of "His" fist can strike the void ahead, making it crack inch by inch as the surrounding space-time within a large area collapses.
  • Those killed by the authority of Destruction cannot be Resurrected without special, advanced arrangements, and will otherwise face their Termination.
  • Flames: A lesser authority of Destruction: the formless and colourless Flame that burns all things, reducing everything to ash.
  • Using the authority of Sacrifices to gain additional power from the City of Calamity (opens in a new tab) will cause "His" Flames to turn blood-red.
  • Disaster: A lesser authority of Destruction: the Red Priest is the master of various calamities.
  • Sacrifices: "He" can influence and interfere with any **Sacrificial Ritual** within a star system and can appeal to the sources of power (Sefirot) to petition for strength or projections.
  • "He" is able to petition to other Sefirot, as long as they are fragments of the Original Creator (opens in a new tab): but this also means constantly walking the edge of Corruption.
  • Sefirot is power, but it is also danger. There is no way for the Red Priest to utilize the power of Sefirot without paying a price.
  • The Red Priest is able to hold a sacrificial ritual towards a Great Old One (opens in a new tab), if "He" decides to surrender and become "Theirs".
  • As the Priest of the Original Creator (opens in a new tab), "He" could once have petitioned "Their" power; however, "He" can no longer do so because the Original Creator (opens in a new tab) is dead.
  • By offering sufficient Sacrifices to the City of Calamity (opens in a new tab), "He" can gain the powers and authorities of the Demoness Pathway temporarily.
  • Charm: Like the Demoness, "He" also possesses a certain degree of Charm authority that is symbiotic with the Conquest authority. The Red Priest is the most charismatic of males.
  • This includes the Charm that makes one desire to submit and be loyal to "Him", as well as the Charm that Provokes hatred and the urge to kill "Him" immediately.
  • Azik (opens in a new tab) had experienced these effects before.
  • Any life form that beholds the Red Priest will be struck by "His" overwhelming beauty. Those of lower status will instantly lose their sanity.
  • Female Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) will feel reluctance to harm or desire to possess the Red Priest, even briefly pausing to admire "Him", while male Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) would react with jealousy and deep loathing, wanting to kill "Him" at once.
  • Masculinity: As a Masculine aspect of the Original Creator (opens in a new tab) and representation of Yang Energy, "He" possesses some authority over Male forces and concepts.
  • "He" is able to transform living beings and inanimate objects into Males, bestowing varying degrees of reproductive ability.
  • The authority of Masculinity makes the Red Priest the strongest, most Masculine, and most fertile Male.

Hermit Pathway

Sequence 9: Mystery Pryer

Traits

  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality will get enhanced upon drinking this potion.
  • Magic & Divination Arts: They have a comprehensive but rudimentary understanding and grasp of magic, Enchantment, witchcraft Divination Arts, Ritualistic Magic, and other mystical knowledge.
  • A Mystery Pryer's use of Ritualistic Magic allows them to summon Spirit World creatures and form Contracts with them which enables them to eventually obtain messengers and helpers with unique powers as they progress forward in their studies.
  • As a Mystery Pryer progresses through the Sequences, they will be able to form Contracts with even more and more powerful and unique Spirit World creatures.
  • They can use many Divination methods, including astrology, cartomancy, spirit pendulums, spiritual numbers, and scrying in order to gain revelations from the Spirit World, however, they are less effective in this matter than Seers.
  • Spirit Vision: Mystery Pryers are able to utilize their Spirit Vision to deduce a person's health and emotions, as well as if an object or person contains some sort of magical aura.

New Abilities

  • Eyes of Mystery Prying: A Mystery Pryer's eyes are special and allow them to be able to see things that normally aren't visible.
  • They can Pry into things that shouldn't or can't be seen. This lets them peer through attempts to trap them in Dreams or Illusions, see truth and reality, discern the light of Spirituality, the state of a target's Astral Body, Ether Body, and Body of Heart and Mind, as well as examine the various details of a target's Astral Body.
  • They can identify if their target is a Beyonder or not through the target's Astral Projection.
  • Utilizing the Eye of Truth (opens in a new tab), Lumian (opens in a new tab) was able to view the concealed Mirror Gardner Martin (opens in a new tab).
  • Cattleya (opens in a new tab) could view the light of Spirituality of the different items Klein (opens in a new tab) was carrying.
  • Mystery Pryers have to be careful and show proper restraint with their powers as a Beyonder as they often see things they shouldn't see, leading to them being most exposed to Corruption.
  • This ability is instinctive and cannot be deactivated. Mystery Pryers can prevent it from affecting their daily lives through Seals or using special Mystical Items (opens in a new tab) of sufficient power.
  • Knowledge (Knowledge Pursuit): Mystery Pryers will occasionally be chased by knowledge brought to life, imbuing them with knowledge in random intervals.
  • This can either lead to them losing control or gaining a benefit, though often it is the former due to its lack of predictability and interference from the Hidden Sage (opens in a new tab), or other hidden entity such as the Inextinguishable Ravings (opens in a new tab).
  • Quick Rituals: They can quickly complete Ritualistic Magic without the need for most ritual items.
  • They can cast an invisible barrier with various sprays, powders, and an incantation.
  • They can cast a Spell that aids a Mystery Pryer in drawing someone's portrait.

Sequence 8: Melee Scholar

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: A Melee Scholar will gain an improved fitness.

New Abilities

  • Combat Prying: They seek the mysteries behind things, and fighting is one such thing.
  • This allows them to master many different styles of martial arts.

Sequence 7: Warlock

Traits

  • Spirituality: They have an enhanced Spirituality, letting them have acute warnings from it.
  • This can allow the Warlock to gain premonitions, foresee it and act before it endangers them.

New Abilities

  • Spellcasting: Warlocks use their knowledge of magic, gained through study, analysis, learning, and sometimes their connection to the Spirit World, to create their Spells using their knowledge and mind.
  • This makes them very versatile, and they can be considered as a traditional fantasy mage.
  • The more knowledge they have the more comprehensive and powerful their Spells become.
  • They can't cast Spells quickly as even the simplest of Spells require 3 steps to finish:
  1. Focus: Concentrating one's own Spirituality.
  2. Mental component: Outlining the corresponding symbol of the Spell in their mind which can be replaced by reciting the Spell's corresponding incantation aloud.
  • While casting steps are required for a Spell, they can be omitted later.
  1. Material component: Using the materials to cast the Spell. The materials can either serve either as a medium or part of the Spell.
  • They can also use certain Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) as a substitute for certain materials.
  • Some of the Spells they can cast include:
  • Scene Depiction: Using some powder to display the scenes they see from their Eyes of Mystery Prying onto mirrors or directly tossing powder to form a realistic picture.
  • Soul Summoning: A supplementary Spell designed to aid spirits in separating from the flesh or to help Astral Projections find their spirits when adrift in the spirit realm.
  • Hand of Force: Using an iron-black powder to create a strong Invisible Hand which can be used as a way to exert force on their targets from afar.
  • Wind Creation: Using a slightly transparent powder to create strong Winds, this is useful to blow away airborne diseases or toxic gas.
  • Exorcism: Using pearl-like powder to clear weeds and vines, this is also useful to combat plant-based Beyonder powers.
  • Flames: Using powder that accurately lands on their targets, bursting into scarlet Flames that silently burn whatever they touch.
  • Purification: Using Sun Flower powder to create Area-of-Effect Purification effects, allowing them to Purify the undead.
  • Lightning: Using powder from a type of tree to create Lightning which can be used to stun enemies or clear areas.
  • Plant Snare: This uses specific leaves, petals and brambles that grow in size and join together to ensnare their targets.
  • Sea Wave: Using a light blue powder they can send out dark blue waves in all directions that can extinguish flames.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Knowledge (Witchcraft): Having grasped the corresponding abilities in the mysticism domains, they can use their acquired mysticism knowledge to make potions and better Mystical Items (opens in a new tab).
  • Due to the influence of the Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab), Warlocks from the Moses Ascetic Order (opens in a new tab) used newborns not only as components in potions but also in witchcraft and better Mystical Items (opens in a new tab).
  • Eyes of Mystery Prying: Their special eyes have been greatly enhanced.
  • As a Warlock, they can naturally Pry into the mysteries of various supernatural powers.
  • They can Pry into special blood, remnant auras, Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) and Beyonder powers to gain the symbols and knowledge to make Spells from different domains like Evil or Life.
  • However, this relies on intellect and knowledge, and is quite dangerous.

Sequence 6: Scrolls Professor

New Abilities

  • Scroll Making: They can make scrolls from various materials to cast Spells. After chanting the corresponding incantation, the scrolls will burn, releasing their abilities.
  • This greatly enhances their casting time and combat ability.
  • Some of the Scroll Spells they can create include:
  • Secret Voice: This Scroll Spell forms a channel linking 3 to 5 people within 50 meters, allowing for communication without distance obstruction.
  • Freezing: When released, this Scroll Spell creates a stream of crystal clear light that can travel mid-air and fall onto a target, freezing the target.
  • Storm: When released, this Scroll Spell creates a wide thunderstorm, that has both abundant wind and lightning and deals great damage.
  • Numb: When released, this Scroll Spell creates a light green luster that can travel mid-air and fall onto a target, paralyzing them.
  • Burning: When released, this Scroll Spell releases burning flames that engulf the nearby area, burning all those in its range.
  • Wind: When released, this Scroll Spell forms a swift wind that envelops a selected target, boosting their speed.
  • Healing: When released, this Scroll Spell releases a green light that heals targets that are enveloped by it.
  • Sun: When released, this Scroll Spell Purifies targets who are affected by its aura of holy light.

Sequence 5: Constellations Master

New Abilities

  • Stellar Guidance: Astrology, Constellations, Stars, and Starlight are all concepts that possess both mystical and practical astronomical significance. A Constellations Master has a basic grasp of the mystical aspects of these concepts, enabling them to utilize corresponding abilities:
  • Starlight Cage: Upon reciting the corresponding incantation, the brilliant Starlight swirling around the caster will begin to detach in successive streams, descending upon the target.
  • The Starlight instantly coalesces, forming a vast transparent amber that completely envelops the target, confining them to their original position.
  • Star Pillar: A Constellation Master can scatter the Stars they create one after another and merge them into a magnificent pillar of Starlight, covering a certain area of space.
  • Any target within the affected area of space will be dissolved in this Starlight, instantly or extremely quickly having it's structure collapse and/or dissipate.
  • Stellar Self: This ability makes the Constellations Master's form instantly transparent, as though transformed into a statue composed of countless Starlight particles.
  • This "statue" can then shatter abruptly, as a brilliant Starlight surges forth in scattered points, allowing the Constellation Master to slip through the fissures as fragments of Starlight will coalesce anew within, revealing the caster's silhouette.
  • Star Concealment: Constellation Masters are able to use the Stars they have formed to Conceal the targeted area and nullify any outside interference within.
  • This could allow them to isolate certain Beyonder powers from affecting them.
  • Starry Shuttle: Constellation Masters can make the resplendent light from the Stars around them to coagulate under structures or themselves enabling Flight.
  • Star Bridge: They can manifest an illusory Starry bridge from their refined Stars to stand upon.
  • Star Illumination: They can also utilize their Stars as a light source in dark areas.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Eyes of Mystery Prying: Constellation Masters will receive a great increase in their ability to sense hidden existences, making most things within a range of several tens if meters be visible to them in an unobstructed yet chaotic manner.
  • A Constellation Master can vaguely see layers of thick, shadowy curtains surrounding them, and behind these curtains, something seems to be watching them, watching all living beings.
  • They can also spy on the condition of an environment from a certain distance.
  • Spellcasting: Their ability to cast Spells have been enhanced. Now, they do not necessarily need materials to cast some Spells and can instead cast them via simple gestures.
  • Cattleya (opens in a new tab), through a few simple gestures and a whistle, was able to summon illusionary ropes to bind two Primordial Moon (opens in a new tab) believers.
  • Squall: They can summon a powerful Wind which when used together with Star Shuttle can allow them to cover vast distances.
  • Cattleya (opens in a new tab) summoned Wind and used the Star Shuttle spell, enabling the The Future (opens in a new tab) to cover a vast distance and evade The Death Announcer (opens in a new tab).
  • Flame: They are able to summon a colorless Flame that is able to burn away things while selectively leaving other things unharmed.
  • Cattleya (opens in a new tab) summoned a colorless Flame to burn away the mutated vines affected by Earth Mother (opens in a new tab)'s remnant aura while sparing the sailors.
  • With the flick of her hand, Cattleya (opens in a new tab) was able to make the drops of blood of Cielf June (opens in a new tab) to float and fly to her hands.

Sequence 4: Mysticologist

Description

The power of a Mysticologist stems from their extensive knowledge of Mysticism, making them extremely dangerous. In addition, among all Sequence 4 Beyonders, a Mysticologist is the Sequence that encounters danger the easiest. This is because they often see things they shouldn't see, hear things they shouldn't hear, and know secrets they shouldn't be aware of. Thus, they must learn to restrain their curiosity if they wish to live a long life.

Individual Differences

  • Mythical Creature Blood Spell: Depending on the type of blood that was analyzed for their Sequence 4 Advancement Ritual (opens in a new tab), a Mysticologist’s strengths and abilities will vary.
  • For example, those who advance using the blood of a Snake of Mercurcy will find it easier to become a Clairvoyant than others, and will also gain the Spell Brief Luck.
  • Brief Luck: This Spell gives the caster great amount of Luck for a short period of time.

New Abilities

  • Mystical Re-enactment: The most core ability of a Mysticologist, a manifestation of their Divinity and knowledge. They are able to draw power from the different mysticism knowledge they grasped, and through that, create all sorts of magic or witchcraft.
  • The exclusivity of the mystical knowledge affects the strength of the Spell; the less that certain mysticism knowledge was known by others and the less that knowledge has spread, the more powerful Spells of this category will be and vice-versa.
  • There can be a chance of retaliation when using high level knowledge.
  • Mysticologists can draw power from the battle between The Fool and Error (opens in a new tab) as well as the battle between The God of Combat and Evernight Goddess (opens in a new tab); however, if they dare utilize it, they shouldn't be afraid of retaliation.
  • With their core ability of Mystical Re-enactment, Beyonders of the Hermit Pathway can potentially live longer and grow stronger through witnessing various mystical events, mastering much mystical knowledge, and creating powerful Spells.
  • Mystical Re-enactments that are created from the Fairy Tales of Earth's Original Civilizations are called Fairy Tale Magic. A few examples are:
  • Avalon (Utopia): The Utopia is neither in reality nor in the spirit world. It is completely hidden somewhere, and only those who are invited or qualified can enter. Moreover, one must also master the corresponding sequence of numbers, 365 digits in total.
  • Spear of Longinus: A Spell that derives power from the knowledge of the one true spear that pierced Jesus Christ in the Bible. It emits a strong sense of destruction and is able to lock against the targeted enemy, following them wherever they go.
  • The Ugly Duckling: A Spell that derives power from the story of "The Ugly Duckling (opens in a new tab)". It allows the caster to temporarily use their Mythical Creature Form without having to worry about losing control but only for 10 seconds and once per day.
  • Snow White: A Spell made from the story "Snow White (opens in a new tab)". It shares similar characteristics with Divination Spells and can counter Divination and clears the battlefield of the caster's tracks. It takes the form of a illusory, ancient Mirror.
  • It can also be used to increase the success rate and accuracy of Prophetic abilities.
  • The Emperor's New Clothes: A Spell derived from the story of "The Emperor's New Clothes (opens in a new tab)". The caster becomes something that doesn't exist at all, allowing them to temporarily avoid any kind of attack once.
  • Ariadne's Thread: This Spell creates an illusory ball of yarn that, when thrown into the void, leaves behind a bright colored thread which allows the caster to traverse the Spirit World by following the thread.
  • It is also able to guide the user’s direction.
  • The Feast of Betrayal: it conjures up an image of the Ancient Sun God (opens in a new tab) getting devoured. It originates from the Mysticism Knowledge of the Ancient Sun God's (opens in a new tab) Death.
  • Its effect is to temporarily awaken or imbue items in the target's possession with sentience, causing them to betray the target.
  • Jack and the Beanstalk: A spell made from the story "Jack and the Beanstalk (opens in a new tab)". It can change the environment to a forest of long beanstalks and vines.
  • The Little Mermaid: A Spell invented from the story "The Little Mermaid (opens in a new tab)". With the Spell, the caster can turn Invisible and disappear into thin air.
  • The Peach Blossoms’ Source: Inspired by "The Peach Blossom Spring (opens in a new tab)", this Spell creates a barrier that is difficult to connect with the outside world.
  • Sleeping Beauty: A Spell derived from the story "Sleeping Beauty (opens in a new tab)" that Hypnotizes the enemy and makes them tired and wanting to fall asleep.
  • The Chess Game of Time: This Spell slows down the actions of the target. It is like entering a region with a different flow of time.
  • The Boy’s Magic Horn: This Spell condenses into a dark, ancient horn, carrying an extremely heavy and powerful connotation.
  • It’s a horn of destruction and its low, resonant sound, combined with sonic waves, can shatter enemies and even Space itself.
  • Hades’ invisible Helmet: A Spell made from the myth of the "Helm of Hades (opens in a new tab)". It allows the caster to become Invisible.
  • The Little Match Girl: It conjures up a burning match, causing the enemy to hallucinate.
  • Cinderella: It transforms the user’s appearance, image, and temperament.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Eyes of Mystery Prying: The is the second core ability of a Mysticologist, their Eyes of Mystery Prying can now detect more Concealed objects and attributes.
  • They gain better control over their eyes, allowing them to deactivate the power of Mystery Prying.
  • A Mysticologist's mere gaze will be able to pierce into the Cosmos (opens in a new tab) and the world barrier.
  • Cattleya (opens in a new tab) upon advancing could see the various celestial objects and Outer Deities (opens in a new tab) that were occupying the area as well as "Their" gaze on earth.
  • They can plant their Eyes of Mystery Prying onto someone else's body to spy on them.
  • Once it goes into a Concealed state it will be very difficult to detect it through other means.
  • Stellar Guidance: Their previous capabilities involving Stars has been enhanced.
  • Star Pillar: The Star Pillar that they can make can envelop the surrounding area, preventing even a Secrets Sorcerer from Teleporting and leaving the enveloped area.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.
  • Their Mythical Creature Form looks like an abstract "black blob" appearing to be in a higher spatial dimension covered in cracks and eyes which have clear blacks and whites, coldly scanning their surroundings, as though they were formations of multifarious knowledge.
  • In this Mythical Creature Form a Mysticologist will be able to induce a knowledge storm in the minds of their targets, disrupting and distracting their thoughts.
  • Certain Spells (like The Ugly Duckling) that a Mysticologist possesses can allow them to temporarily reveal their Mythical Creature Form without danger.

Sequence 3: Clairvoyant

Authorities

  • Mystery Prying: They have gained a partial authority over Mystery Prying.
  • Having truly come into contact with the authority of Mystery Prying, they can not only glimpse hidden secrets, knowledge, and existence, but also the secrets of Destiny.
  • Clairvoyance (Prophecy): Prying into the secrets of Fate, a Clairvoyant is able to foresee a choice's consequences through making a Prophecy of what would happen next, glimpse the best option for oneself, and even visualize past events.
  • They can gain inspiration for certain events and see vague images, but limited by one's own level, rank, and status, they will lack sufficient understanding of the specifics involving higher-ranking beings and cannot grasp the true nature of the matter.
  • The more serious the problem involved was, and the higher their status and level of those involved, the more damage Prying into those secrets would bring to them.
  • Clairvoyants are able to foresee the coming of the Apocalypse (opens in a new tab). After completing the corresponding Ritual (opens in a new tab), they can clearly see the opportunity for Advancement (opens in a new tab).

Strengthened Abilities

  • Mystical Re-enactment: This ability has undergone an enhancement.
  • The number of times they can use certain Spells and abilities derived from drawing power from mysticism knowledge and events has increased.
  • The number of uses of the Ugly Duckling Spell that Cattleya (opens in a new tab) was able to do had increased from once a day to twice per day.
  • In addition to that, a Clairvoyant is also able to draw power from mystical knowledge with a greater accuracy, thus increasing its power.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 3 Beyonders, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Sage

Authorities

  • Mysticism Knowledge: "They" possess a certain degree of authority over Mysticism Knowledge as well as the corresponding, subordinate authorities over Deletion and Revision.
  • "Their" core ability is the control and utilization of Information, including but not limited to the Sage's own Informatization. By abstracting the body and breaking it down into streams of complex Knowledge, "They" will become a pure being of Information.
  • "They" can turn into a pure Information torrent and reform later to bypass any obstruction as well as transform into various symbols and words that can be either mystical or ordinary.
  • Even if some of "Their" Information were to be disrupted or destroyed, as long as the overall structure and balance remained as "They" reformed, "They" wouldn't die. At most, "They" would be missing a few limbs or Spells that can be added back later.
  • This state makes "Them" impervious to most damage, but "They" can still be hurt by things like the Tyrant Pathway's Information-interfering abilities, a Paragon's authority over Essence and Error Pathway's Theft and gifting.
  • Stealing limbs isn't practical but Stealing abilities or data is easy, like using scissors to cut out a piece of Information and take it away. Even when turning into an Information torrent, a Marauder could gift something else back to a Hermit, leaving them with some strange extra components.
  • In this state, "They" can detach "Themselves" from the state of being overwhelmed as a Information torrent, reassembling the body using vast and pure Knowledge.
  • In an Informatized-state, if "They" possess enough self-understanding, without disrupting the overall Information balance within "Them", "They" can add appropriate, non-conflicting, and fully mastered Mysticism Knowledge into a corresponding Information stream, while Deleting the unnecessary Information.
  • This will complete the transformation of the Sage's body as well as achieve the standardization and acceleration of certain Spells.
  • Torriope's (opens in a new tab) modified Information flow let "Him" reform "Himself" into a combination of 5 things: a menacing wolf's head with black fur, a blazing throne of fire, a pale face with strange eyes, a writhing mass of maggots, and numerous asymmetrical symbols.
  • Retia Austin (opens in a new tab) was able to gradually transform "Herself" into a giant Dragon fully at the Informational level. Such a transformation granted "Her" a huge boost in physical strength and vitality.
  • "They" can see and filter out torrents of Information "They" want to know as well as be able to forge and manipulate Information itself.
  • "Their" ability to see Information allows "Them" the ability to see through realistic illusions as well as find weak points and exits in various Seals, such as spatial maze structures.
  • "They" are also able to correspondingly manipulate and redirect the flow of Information within such Seals or structures in order to bypass such obstructions. This even allow "Them" to make transport Information from and into the Mirror World.
  • A Sage can create false Information that misleads others, as well as be able to create false Information in order to deceive laws.
  • Torriope (opens in a new tab) was able to prepare false Information in the form of a false informatized self of "Him" while "His" concealed true Information was rushing to escape Madame Magician (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" could make the sensation of coldness be experienced by the surrounding entities even if said coldness does not exist in the environment.[?]
  • "They" can assimilate objects and Beyonder powers into a part of "Their" Knowledge.
  • This can allow "Them" to absorb attacks into "Their" informatized body.
  • Education: "They" have a small authority over Education.
  • "They" can impart Knowledge in the form of an invisible stream of Information carrying mystical power to targets they are looking at and can “materialize” Knowledge to pursue and attack.
  • This causes those affected to be stunned as they try to process the Knowledge given.
  • Bernadette (opens in a new tab) used a pop-up message to incapacitate multiple people, so that Lumian (opens in a new tab) and team could be able to attack Zaratul (opens in a new tab).
  • Mystery Prying: "Their" Prophecies have been enhanced.
  • Clairvoyance (Prophecy): Once "Their" enemies take action, "They" can gain certain scenes or fragments of the future that can help aid "Them" in navigating and counterattacking such plans.
  • Any of "Their" enemies who are aware of this ability can only try to delay when such perceptions appeared or make the corresponding Prophecies difficult to interpret.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "They" have gained improvements to other abilities in the previous Sequences.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" have become a full Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab). "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is that of an Informational serpent or eyeball consisting of countless cold, eyelash-less eyes that are on the body.

Sequence 1: Knowledge Emperor

New Abilities

  • Knowledge Emperor: "They" are able to utilize the Information gathered in the Spirit World and influence the Seven Lights (opens in a new tab).

Authorities

  • Mysticism Knowledge: "They" gained a deeper grasp over this authority.
  • "They" can imbue abstract knowledge with tangible power.
  • Roselle Gustav (opens in a new tab) bestowed power to the Knowledge in the written potion formulas of the 22 Pathways, transforming it into Cards of Blasphemy that possessed the following effects:
  • Once assimilated into the user's Spirit Body, it will cause it to solidify and possess the full aura along with status of a High Sequence Beyonder of the represented Pathway.
  • If the user is of the same Pathway as what the Card of Blasphemy represents, they will obtain a boost in their abilities; however, it will not reach the High Sequence level like the aura it can bring out.
  • Upon activation, a Card of Blasphemy will create a convergence of High Sequence Beyonders of the particular Card of Blasphemy's represented Pathway.
  • A Card of Blasphemy possesses extremely strong Anti-Divination and Anti-Prophecy attributes that is able to Conceal it's location to even True Deities.
  • Note: A reason the Cards of Blasphemy carry such strong Anti-Divination powers is due to Mother Goddess of Depravity's (opens in a new tab) Corruption of "Him"
  • The Mother card is especially insidious due to the connection with "Her".
  • If "They" have sufficient Knowledge about a certain Beyonder power, "They" can theoretically imbue that Knowledge with power and incorporate it into "Their" own Information Stream, thereby gaining the Beyonder powers of other Sequences.
  • If "They" have enough Knowledge about a Beyonder power like Disorder, "They" can give power to that Knowledge and incorporate in "Their" Information flow.
  • If "They" fully analyzed the knowledge of a White Angel and Conqueror, "They" could endow that Information with power and incorporate it within "Them".
  • "They" could then combine Pure White Light and Spear Of Destruction to create an attack like Pure White Spear of Destruction; however, it won't possess the corresponding authority.
  • "They" can make others switch between a normal and Information stream state, helping them bypass obstructions. "They" can then help those affected reform later.
  • "They" can draw the surrounding Information into the palm of "Their" hand, condensing it into a shimmering ball of light containing the corresponding Information.
  • This not only allows "Them" to ascertain certain matters through Information but also allows "Them" to siphon certain Information which "They" can then replace.
  • Digital Avatar: When "They" transform into "Their" Information/Knowledge flow state, "They" are able to become a Digital Avatar.
  • This can allow "Them" to become a WeChat account, a character in a manga, or even an NPC or player in a video game.
  • "They" can ensure the element of surprise in a sudden attack.
  • Zaratul (opens in a new tab) needed the help of a Knowledge Emperor or Servant of Concealment in order to ensure the element of surprise in a sudden attack against Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can forge Information and spread it along Spirit Body Threads.
  • Roselle Gustav (opens in a new tab) forged false Information about a targeted Marionette and sent it through the corresponding Spirit Body Threads to isolate Klein Moretti's (opens in a new tab) true body.
  • This worked by modifying Information of the owner of that particular Marionette, isolating the influence that Suah (opens in a new tab) and Zaratul (opens in a new tab) had on Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) as a result.
  • Education: "They" have more authority over Education.
  • "They" can conjure up complex and illusory Symbols in their eyes, pouring a massive amount of useless Knowledge into the target's mind, causing the target to explode.
  • Mystery Prying: "They" have a certain degree of Mystery Prying authority.
  • The Mystery Prying authority allows "Them" to directly Pry into many Mysteries, including those of the True Deities and even Great Old Ones.

Sequence 0: Hermit

Symbolism

  • Knowledge (Information) symbolizes the more Mystical aspect of the authority.
  • This symbolism allows the Gods of the two subordinate Pathways, or even the Sequence 1 or Sequence 2, to transform into a vast and complex torrent of Information, an illusory, overwhelming, and terrifying flood of Information.

Authorities

  • Mysticism Knowledge: "They" are the embodiment of the Mysticism Knowledge.
  • One of its core applications is to imbue Digital Objects with power, granting them genuine, distinct symbolic power in the true sense, though significantly weakened compared to the original.
  • "0" represents chaos, the unknown, what existed before the start. "1" represents the beginning, the Oldest One (opens in a new tab) who made the world. "2" represents the world and various Divinities that were produced from the Oldest One (opens in a new tab)'s body. "3" represents the contact between Divinities and material objects existing in the world to create all things.
  • By connecting "1" and "0", end to end, "They" can form a digital world, which "They" can reduce to nothingness by changing "1" to "0".
  • In terms of Symbolism, everything and anything is able to become Numbers with the corresponding occult implications and all of such Numbers possess Spirituality.
  • Backup: A subordinate authority of Mysticism Knowledge.
  • This allows for the Revival of Information after a Backup. For a specific Backup to receive the Uniqueness (opens in a new tab), it must be activated before its destruction. If not activated, Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) will naturally transfer to the most recent Backup, following the proximity principle.
  • With repeated Backups, certain Information will undergo loss, degradation, Errors, and chaos in the process. The more times the overall Information is Backed Up, the higher the Probability of problems arising, and the greater the latent Chaos.
  • This is a fundamental rule of the entire world, a manifestation of Error, Decay, and increasing Entropy.
  • Self-destruction leads to more significant Information decay and Chaos than being killed, because it starts from the inside, the denial of self-awareness.
  • More Revivals may cause some hidden Loopholes and Errors to appear, which is what those in the Error Pathway can capitalize on.
  • "They" naturally know all the potion formulas of Pathways.
  • When the Blasphemy Slate (opens in a new tab) was formed, the Hermit Uniqueness naturally mastered the corresponding Knowledge contained within it.
  • "They" have the corresponding subordinate partial authorities of Copy, Deletion, Revision, etc.
  • Hiding: "They" possess an authority of Hiding.
  • The Hermit can Hide the Information of others or "Themselves", making it impossible for other True Deities to track or locate it.
  • Foreseeing danger, the Hidden Sage (opens in a new tab) Concealed "Itself" and the surrounding area.
  • Education: This is the authority to grant Knowledge to others.
  • "They" are now able to automatically and directly infuse Knowledge, either positive or negative, into the minds of all Beyonders from the Hermit Pathway.
  • The Hidden Sage (opens in a new tab) routinely injects Knowledge into every Beyonder of the Hermit Pathway, causing those who fail to quickly digest and master it to experience 1 of 3 outcomes:
  1. Accept the modifications made by "Him".
  2. Tenaciously resist "His" influence.
  3. Lose control and/or die.
  • While the Education authority of the **Paragon** leans toward Enlightenment, the Education authority of the Hermit leans toward Indoctrination.
  • Mystery Prying: No matter what the secret is, it is a kind of Knowledge, a part of "Mysticism Knowledge" or something that can be Pried into.
  • "They" are able to tell the specialties of "Their" enemies and the nature of their corresponding abilities and arrangements within the environment.
  • The Hidden Sage (opens in a new tab) was able to know the Symbolisms controlled by The Fool (opens in a new tab) and the role the barrier Sealing the unknown realm played at a glance without further analysis.
  • Theoretically, "They" have a chance of piercing through the Concealment of the Darkness.
  • Spirit World Mentor: The Spirit World is a place where all kinds of Information converge, and Information is Knowledge.
  • It is naturally influenced by Knowledge Pathways. Therefore, both the Hermit and the Paragon have partial authority of the Spirit World.
  • The World in the Eyes (Digital Heaven, Land of Fairy Tales): These are the names of Hermit's Divine Kingdom.

Paragon Pathway

Sequence 9: Savant

New Abilities

  • Knowledge (Mysticism and Mechanics): Savants believe that knowledge is power and through drinking the potion, they gain new information about mysticism and mechanics.
  • They have a rough understanding of the mysticism, but are more knowledgeable about the formation and use of aqua regia, nitroglycerin, and other complicated bolts and gears.
  • To an average person, they appear to know everything.
  • Recall (Memory): This is the core ability of a Savant. With it, they can recall every single piece of knowledge and experience they have ever seen.
  • At the same time, they also possess increased learning and comprehension skills.

Sequence 8: Archaeologist

Traits

  • Physical Enhancements: Archaeologists possess a strong enough physique.
  • Spirituality: Archaeologists will barely be able to apply some Ritualistic Magic.

New Abilities

  • Adaption: They have the ability to face many problems.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Knowledge (History, Survival, Mysticism): Archaeologists possess a good deal of knowledge about history and outdoor survival, as well as knowledge of taboos and mysticism about ruins.

Sequence 7: Appraiser

New Abilities

  • Appraisal: Appraisers are able to use this ability to rapid identify the powers and problems of most Beyonder items without Divination or reasoning.
  • This allows them to use those items while keeping the danger to the minimum.
  • If the target item contains a higher status than their Sequence, or they lack certain knowledge of by Recall, their Appraisal will be incomplete or misunderstood.
  • The Appraiser also has the ability to Appraise other things as well.

Sequence 6: Artisan (Machinery Specialist)

Traits

  • Spirituality: Only the level of their Ritualistic Magic will be enhanced.

New Abilities

  • Manufacturing: Whether in reality or in the realm of the mystical, Artisans are undisputed masters of creation, being able to make Beyonder items and mechanical artifacts; however, those Beyonder items and mechanical artifacts will not be particularly powerful.
  • By using Beyonder Characteristics or the main ingredients for potions, Artisans are able to craft Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) which have more powerful effects than normal while also possessing less negative and severe side effects than naturally formed or created Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab).
  • The negative effects of the corresponding Sealed Artifacts depend on both the Sequence level of the Artisan and the Sealed Artifacts' (opens in a new tab) uniqueness themselves.
  • The abilities of their created Sealed Artifacts aren't necessarily weaker than a Beyonder of the same Sequence, and can even be stronger, but that is often a downside.
