  • This means the stronger ability is the downside.
  • By using items with Spirituality, they can produce enchanted Beyonder weapons such as axes, guns and bullets, cannons and cannonballs, bombs, etc. or worn Mystical Items (opens in a new tab) such as belts, brooches, rings, etc. with Beyonder effects but have a limited lifespan.
  • As such, they can directly fix the summoning rituals of Spirit World creatures like Messengers unto an item to make it more convenient.
  • Due to an Artisan's ability to know all the combinations of different Beyonder effects and negative effects while also not lacking Mystical Items (opens in a new tab), their strength can reach the level of a Sequence 5.

Sequence 5: Astronomer (Astromancer)

New Abilities

  • Astronomy: If Astronomers have a preliminary understanding of the nature of different Astronomical phenomena, they can make use of them to a certain extent.
  • When there is a Solar Storm, they can guide the energy and matter that has arrived within the Astral Barrier (opens in a new tab) and is within their own capability to concentrate to a certain extent.
  • This can be used to interfere with or attack the target.
  • When there is a Meteor Shower, they can guide the fire rain with a certain weight.
  • The strength of the capabilities is within the scope of a Sequence 5 Beyonder.
  • Of course, the universe is dangerous, and thus this power is dangerous.
  • If they are not careful, they will encounter all sorts of terrifying and bizarre things.
  • For example, when studying the Blood Moon phenomenon and trying to utilize it, they may find that they are inexplicably pregnant or are no longer themselves.
  • False Constellations: Astronomers can create a fake Starry Sky in order to confuse or interfere with the astrological predictions made by the affected targets.
  • It can also be used to simulate astronomical phenomena, such as solar storms or meteor showers, provided the they mastered the essence of the corresponding phenomenon.
  • By utilizing False Constellations, they can reproduce similar effects to Astronomy, though these are weaker than those generated by genuine astronomical events.
  • The changes in constellations caused by this can also cause corresponding phenomena within a 100 meter range, such as tides or electromagnetic disturbances.
  • Star of Curses: They are able to fire rays formed from condensed Starlight that can cause various effects such as weakness, mutation, and trauma.
  • Blessing of Stars: Astronomers are able to attract Starlight, altering the Gravity acting upon a targeted area or corresponding target.

Sequence 4: Alchemist

Description

Mechanical Heaven is not only a description of the Divine Kingdom of a Paragon but also an acknowledgment of the Alchemists' usual performance.

New Abilities

  • Alchemy: The core ability of an Alchemist.
  • An Alchemist can infuse the items they create with Souls, giving them a certain Life, but its Alchemical life is not as good as that of the Ancient Alchemists of the Mother Pathway.
  • The Souls and Life force are not created out of thin air. They come from fragments of remnant souls in the Spirit World and the extraction of life from the surrounding environment.
  • They can create a machine that looks indistinguishable from humans via injecting it with a Soul, giving it the ability to move, talk, and behave just like a human.
  • The specialty of a Ancient Alchemist can just barely be emulated to create different golems and human beings using incomplete spirits and various metals.
  • They can quickly create various temporary dolls and objects using readily available materials, achieving different effects which depends on the environment and materials.
  • This is a tribute/reference to Fullmetal Alchemist (opens in a new tab).
  • If they have high Sequence materials, they can even create things that can fight against Angels (opens in a new tab).
  • They can also prepare long-term magical dolls with more powerful abilities in advance.
  • The dolls created by an Alchemist can disguise themselves as humans.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Manufacturing: Beyond combat, Alchemists play a wider role in daily life.
  • They can make a mechanical body that has powerful mechanical tools installed inside their bodies such as a cannon, or a device that allows Flight.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Arcane Scholar (Demon of Arcana)

New Abilities

  • Knowledge Spirit: They can transform into a certain amount of knowledge within a certain time limit (ranging from 5 minutes to days depending on the knowledge they turn into).
  • In other words, when a person or a Beyonder opens a book and reads the text or learns knowledge, that Information may be the manifestation of a Knowledge Spirit.
  • The Knowledge Spirit uses this to enter the target's body of mind, subtly influencing their thinking and intelligence, completing the process of erosion and even Corruption.
  • It can also be active in the Spirit World, giving certain misleading information or Corruption to those who obtain Information from the Spirit World.
  • Environment Controller: An Arcane Scholar is able to accurately extract information about the surrounding environment and deduce what happened from it.
  • Though they cannot fully reconstruct the scene, they can confirm the battle that occurred in a certain area, the Sequence level involved, and the residual aura.
  • Regardless of the environment, an Arcane Scholar can effectively use the environment to enhance themselves and weaken the target.
  • Absorption: They can extract Life force from organisms within a five-kilometer radius.

Authorities

  • Dissociation: They can emit a beam of light capable of destroying the structures of most objects. This application is derived from the Analysis and Law authorities.
  • Targets that are affected will be decomposed into fragments that fall to the ground, with even their color evaporating and dissipating quickly.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their previous Sequence capabilities have been improved.
  • Manufacturing: Arcane Scholars possess extraordinary Manufacturing abilities, being able to create mystical items, complex mechanical devices, or combine the two together.
  • Appraisal: Arcane Scholars are able to quickly grasp the relevant information when using Mystical Items (opens in a new tab), effectively avoiding its negative effects completely.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Knowledge Magister (Master)

Authorities

  • Manufacturing: "They" possess a weakened authority of Manufacturing.
  • "They" are able to create most of the items "They" imagine, even those related to the supernatural.
  • "They" can create futuristic wonders beyond the scope of current world-era technologies such as nuclear fusion-based technology, giant mechanical robots (such as the ones in Gundam), and interstellar travel starships with just a simple gesture.
  • "They" can also can have temporary substitutes in the absence of materials.
  • Laws: "They" wield a certain authority over Laws.
  • "They" can alter the physical Laws to a certain extent, making combustion not necessarily produce flames, frost bringing warmth, and even the earth no longer bearing weight.
  • Analysis: "They" have an enhanced Analysis authority.
  • "They" can see the essence of Angels (opens in a new tab) and formulate tactics accordingly.
  • Mentor: This is derived from the authority of Education.
  • "They" possess the ability to Test others and are highly skilled at teaching others.
  • Learning: "They" have a weakened Learning authority.
  • Learning something after just one look is no longer a myth.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "Their" previous Sequence capabilities have been improved.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" have become a full Mythical Creature. "Their" full Mythical creature Form is an Informational being that is composed of numerous depictions of civilizations, though still unable to manifest a complete depiction of Civilization.
  • "They" are able to transform into a substantial amount of pale-white fog to move around, which can contort and writhe later to rebuild "Their" body.
  • This is essentially a form of Information reconstruction; however, since the Paragon is Steam (opens in a new tab), this manifests as transforming into steam.

Sequence 1: Illuminator (Civilization Enlightener, Light of Darkness)

Authorities

  • Civilization: "They" have a certain authority over Civilization.
  • "They" can allow Chaos to settle into a little Order, allowing Destruction to give rise to a faint new Life, allowing Darkness to burst forth with the first Light.
  • "They" can protect and defend against attacks by summoning Civilization image protections.
  • "They" can reveal picture-like projections that record the heavy history of humanity and the development of Civilization to protect against attacks, this is especially useful to contain the Knowledge Injection of a Knowledge Emperor.
  • "They" can rely on the weight of a Civilization in order to bind, impact, and crush a target.
  • "They" are able to prevent targets from correctly using Civilization technology.
  • Illuminators can even use Civilization to realize certain Civilization effects.
  • This is almost similar to Miracles, because if something is a core element of Civilization, "They" can do the corresponding Civilization effects such as:
  • Clearing certain sources of Corruption, which embodies the influence of Civilization in public health and sanitation, such as sewer systems.
  • Rebuilding a damaged city at extremely fast speed, because Civilization is embodied in the field of infrastructure construction.
  • Rapidly transport materials or personnel, or impede it because Civilization is also part of the transportation industry.
  • Manufacturing: "Their" Manufacturing authority has been enhanced.
  • Since artistic and cultural expressions - like music, painting, literature, and other art forms - are components of Civilization, "They" can manifest "Them" with Mechanical Creations, while non-Mechanical Creations can exhibit certain Beyonder properties.
  • Illuminators can use this to compose music that directly influences the audience's emotions, or create paintings that can psychologically affect, inspire, attract, or even draw the viewer into the artwork.
  • Education: "They" have a certain amount of this authority.
  • "They" can enhance the intelligence of a target, provide enlightenment and inspiration, trap the enemy in a mathematical maze, or achieve similar effects.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "Their" previous Sequence capability have been improved.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature now is capable of manifesting a complete depiction of Civilization.

Sequence 0: Paragon

Symbolism

  • Knowledge (Information) symbolizes the more Practical aspect of the authority.
  • This symbolism allows the Gods of the two subordinate Pathways, or even the Sequence 1 or Sequence 2, to transform into a vast and complex torrent of Information, an illusory, overwhelming, and terrifying flood of Information.

Authorities

  • Reality Knowledge: A Paragon possesses all the Knowledge that has been discovered in the Real world and is able to modify it to a certain extent.
  • This authority takes effect immediately at the continental level, rapidly at the planetary level and gradually at the star system level, but is ineffective outside of these levels.
  • The Paragon is able to cause a target to temporarily lose the corresponding Knowledge and be rejected by Knowledge or have Knowledge controlled by a target turn into a lurking agent or Corruptor beneficial to "Him".
  • "They" can make videos, photos, novels, or messages collapse into pure snow-like static, effectively destroying the Information structure it holds, which will also rapidly spread to form a huge Information Vortex.
  • Not only is this an effective way to interfere with general Information, it also can be used to destroy the origin of those Information or deal with the Information abilities of the Hermit Pathway.
  • Civilization: The rise and fall of Civilizations, the weight of Civilizations, and the vast Knowledge that has been accumulated by Civilizations.
  • "They" can designate a group, a country, a continent, or even a planet, keeping them in a state of barbarism and ignorance forever, or rapidly iterate and evolve the Civilization.
  • "They" can turn others into Knowledge, Information, and words, and imprint them into an illusory book, trapping those things which "They" can use for many different matters.
  • Laws: "They" have a partial authority over Laws, which leans toward Reality.
  • Compared to "Their" ability to change Laws of physics versus the Justiciar's ability to change the underlying rules, the Justiciar is stronger as it also effects mystical rules.
  • Laws are a part of Knowledge and thus by mastering the Laws, a Paragon can make the world operate in a way that is more favorable to "Themselves".
  • "They" can release a blurry light that seeps out from the void and envelopes the surroundings, which has the effect of restoring the most basic structure of various things.
  • Education: "They" have a partial authority to grant Knowledge to others.
  • Unlike the Hermit, the Paragon's authority over Education places more emphasis on enlightenment, guidance, testing, and systematization.
  • "They" have the subordinate Learning, Manufacturing, and Analysis authorities.
  • Learning: The authority of Learning can make the Paragon learn something easily, or make it impossible for others to Learn it no matter what.
  • Manufacturing: Knowledge combines in order to create miracles, almost divine things as well as things that are beyond the ordinary.
  • "They" can make advanced programs and effects that carry within it "Their" Beyonder powers and authorities that can then be bestowed onto everyday electronic devices like phones.
  • Franca (opens in a new tab) used the Information Shredder to destroy all image of a painting created by Luo Shan (opens in a new tab). This in the end resulted in the destruction of the original painting.
  • With various help and assistance, the Information Shredder created by the God of Steam and Machinery (opens in a new tab) was used to kill off the Hidden Sage (opens in a new tab).
  • The Mystical Items (opens in a new tab) that "They" create without containing characteristics will still naturally fade over time: some last a few months, others a few years.
  • Analysis: The Paragon can quickly Analyze or even directly see the Essence of things, and then make use of them.
  • The Analysis authority heavily counters the Error pathway, which relies on Deceit, or the Visionary Pathway, which relies on Envisioning false things.
  • Spirit World Mentor: The Spirit World is a place where all kinds of Information converge, and Information is Knowledge.
  • It is naturally influenced by Knowledge Pathways. Therefore, both the Hermit and the Paragon have partial authority of the Spirit World.
  • Mechanical Heaven (Civilization’s Cemetery, Land of Perfection): These are the names of "Their" Divine Kingdom.

Wheel of Fortune Pathway

Sequence 9: Monster

Description

Beyonders (opens in a new tab) of this Sequence often fall into a kind of trance, sometimes whispering things others cannot understand, making others consider them some kind of real Monster.

Traits

  • High Spirituality: This Pathway has a higher Spirituality than most, and at Sequence 9, Monsters possess a high Spiritual Perception and Spiritual Intuition.
  • Foresight: A Monster is often able to hear or see things that others cannot. Monsters will also occasional gain glimpses of the future.
  • This is the specialty of the Fate Pathway, making them able to see things that even Pathways with strong Spirit Vision (opens in a new tab) abilities can't see.
  • Danger Premonition: They have a keen intuitive premonition of danger.

Sequence 8: Robot

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: All aspects of their physical abilities have been significantly improved.
  • This makes Robots naturally talented in fighting and shooting.
  • Mental Enhancement: They have powerful calculation skills and very precise control.
  • High Spirituality: They gain proficiency in Divination and Anti-Divination skills.

Sequence 7: Lucky One

New Abilities

  • Passive Luck⁂: Lucky Ones will often encounter Lucky events in their life, such as finding money on the street, having enemies miss attacks that were aimed at them, getting desired dice rolls, and having women they happen to like coincidentally also like them back.
  • Their Luck isn't fixed and fluctuates: at times, they are especially Lucky, while at other times, they are no different from an ordinary person.
  • This unpredictable Luck isn't something that they should heavily rely upon, and as such, they have to temper their expectations.

Sequence 6: Calamity Priest

Traits

  • High Spirituality: Their Spirituality surpasses that of other Pathways.

New Abilities

  • Calamity Attraction⁂: Their body will now attract Calamities, mainly in two ways.
  • Passive Attraction: They will passively suffer all kinds of Calamities, but can see them in advance via their Foresight and make the preparations needed to eliminate or mitigate their effects.
  • Because of their Foresight, Calamity Priests can use the dangers of their own passive encounters and preparation to attack their enemies.
  • Active Attraction: They can attract Calamities to varying degrees, affecting targets and enemies as a result. Then through their Luck, they can avoid most of the danger from it.
  • In essence, it allows them to pull their enemies into a situation where they can take advantage of their strengths the best.
  • Psyche Storm: Using their Spirituality that surpassed that of other Pathways, they can directly affect their opponent’s Spirit Body, causing them to feel dizzy and lost.
  • If a Calamity Priest's enemy entered such a state, they would be extremely prone to making errors, thus causing the Calamity to snowball and eventually devour them.

Sequence 5: Winner

Traits

  • High Spirituality: Their Spirituality has been greatly enhanced, causing the improvement to their Spiritual Perception and Foresight abilities.
  • Foresight: A Winner possesses an inexplicable strange premonition, allowing them to make the right decisions during a situation and better maximize their chance of success.
  • Just before Enzo (opens in a new tab) was about to run off after successfully evading Oaf's (opens in a new tab) attack, he had a premonition, causing him to subconsciously curl up and protect his vital spots.
  • Fully believing in his intuition, Enzo (opens in a new tab) lunged forward, jumping off the staircase and making two rolls onto the lower street, causing Klein (opens in a new tab) to briefly lose track of him.
  • Upon Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) phasing in front of him to block his escape, Enzo (opens in a new tab) immediately tightly shut his eyes, which unintentionally saved his life for the short term.
  • Enzo (opens in a new tab) had a hunch that if he stalled the situation for a little longer, a number of Nighthawks (opens in a new tab) would catch up to him, making the situation more chaotic.
  • These enhancements, along with their greatly enhanced Divination and Anti-Divination abilities, make them experts in the corresponding mystical fields.

New Abilities

  • Curse of Misfortune: They can Curse their enemies with limited Misfortune, making them more Unlucky. This can range from missing attacks to falling into a dangerous situation.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Passive Luck⁂: To an extent, they can now begin to control their own Luck.
  • A Winner can now rely on their own self-control to accumulate a lot of Luck, and repeatedly avert fatal crises or dangerous situations in dramatic ways at critical moments.
  • By enduring Misfortune without using their own Luck they can accumulate and gain Luck.
  • They will begin to be able to encounter things and events with a low probability of happening in their daily life more occasionally than when they were a Lucky One.
  • These can be things such as a Winner's enemies getting lost or making poor judgments, gaining an inheritance due to a series of mistakes by another person, or having their mistakes or flaws be interpreted as funny actions by others, making them more well-liked.
  • Enzo (opens in a new tab) accidentally tripped on a rock while his Spirit Body Threads was controlled by Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab), the pain that caused snapping himself out of that controlled state.
  • Thanks to his Luck, Enzo (opens in a new tab) had avoided most of the damage caused by the Flesh and Blood Bomb that was planted on Oaf (opens in a new tab), only making him suffer light injuries.
  • Enzo (opens in a new tab) felt a brief stabbing pain in his knee as though his previous fall had given him some light injuries, causing him to crouch down and fully evade Oaf's (opens in a new tab) attack.

Sequence 4: Misfortune Mage

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Their body has undergone a qualitative change and became a Mercury Body with passive Anti-Divination and Anti-Prophecy properties.
  • Their overall physical abilities have also been significantly improved.

New Abilities

  • Misfortune Field: Upon activation, all beings who enter within a 100-300 meter range (depending on potion digestion and Misfortune Mage's state) of them will be Cursed with Bad Luck.
  • The branch that Mr. Harry (opens in a new tab) was stepping on after landing on a tree immediately snapped after merely being within the Misfortune Field for a moment.
  • Group Blessing: This is the same as Blessing, but can only be achieved by the Misfortune Mage consuming a significant amount of their own Luck reserves.
  • It can be given to any creature within a 50-meter radius of the Misfortune Mage.
  • The Misfortune Mage can choose who to give and who not to give Luck to.
  • Blessing: By using their own Luck or pulling the target's future Luck into the present, they can Bless a chosen target, making them Lucky.
  • They can use Blessing to remove a prolonged period of Misfortune.
  • This is because Luck and Misfortune counteract each other.
  • Examples of the Blessing ability being used are:
  • Ricciardo (opens in a new tab) Blessed Darkwill (opens in a new tab) with precisely enough Luck to win around 700 pounds.
  • Ricciardo (opens in a new tab) removed the Misfortune from Anderson (opens in a new tab) by utilizing a Blessing.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Absolute Foresight: Misfortune Mages possess an Absolute Foresight over the changes in Destiny, the existence of Fate Anchors, as well as those of higher mystical status.
  • Through this Absolute Foresight, Ricciardo (opens in a new tab) knew the day he would meet Gherman Sparrow (opens in a new tab) he must not see anything him and thus wore an eye mask on that day.
  • Curse of Misfortune: A Misfortune Mage can Curse the target with Bad Luck, making them extremely Unlucky. This kind of Misfortune is one that can threaten one's life.
  • Due to the Dream having ended before Anderson (opens in a new tab) could ask for Klein Moretti's (opens in a new tab) help, causing Klein (opens in a new tab) to think he was already mutated which made him attack Anderson (opens in a new tab) with several Wind Blades.
  • The axe that Anderson Hood (opens in a new tab) used in the Dream broke in two, and as the crack was towards the back, the fragment shot at him, making his right chest and abdomen bleed like a fountain.
  • Due to the streak of bad Luck, the treasure hunting team Anderson (opens in a new tab) was a part of failed to reach the island on time before the storm arrived, which sank their ship and treasures.
  • The rest of the treasure hunting team either drowned, got struck by Lightning, or got eaten by the underwater monsters, while Anderson (opens in a new tab), being relatively stronger and Luckier than them, was sent flying by the waves and successfully swam to the shore of an island.
  • Soon after Anderson (opens in a new tab) stated that he may attract monsters due to his bad Misfortune, the island they were on quaked as a Stone Giant arose from the primitive forest.
  • The Future (opens in a new tab) (with Anderson (opens in a new tab) in it) happened to cross an area that has the remnant auras of the Earth Mother (opens in a new tab), rapidly Mutating Frank Lee's (opens in a new tab) Crossbreeds.
  • It caused the mushrooms that Frank (opens in a new tab) was working on to enter the Future (opens in a new tab) and merge with it, making it spurt out milk all across the ship.
  • It also made a pirate Beyonder grow a watermelon on his head, which resulted in him dying as he tried to open it with brute force.
  • A grayish black hand also appeared from the sea hitting the Future's (opens in a new tab) side, grabbing it, and attempting to hoist the ship up.
  • Psyche Storm: Compared to a Sequence 6 Calamity Priest's Psyche Storm, a Misfortune Mage's Psyche Storm has undergone a qualitative change.
  • Their Psyche Storm not only affects the opponents' Spirit Bodies through their extremely high Spirituality, causing dizziness and disorientation, it also causes confusion within the mind and thoughts of the affected targets, bringing a bit of madness.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Chaoswalker

New Abilities

  • Keeper of Chaos: They can keenly discern the Chaotic and insane elements of a Chaotic and complex Fate, either evading or Sealing them away.
  • Spiritual Baptism: Just like Baptizing a baby, Spiritual Baptism makes the target's spirit clean, stable, no longer Chaotic, just like the beginning.

Authorities

  • Chaos: They have gained partial authority over Chaos.
  • They can make Predestined Fate become Chaotic, making the result no longer Predestined.
  • They can let the spirit and Fate of a target develop in a more Chaotic and crazy direction.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their previous Beyonder powers from Sequence 4 have been improved.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 3 Beyonders, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Soothsayer

Authorities

  • Fate: "They" possess partial control over the Fate authority, which encompasses the lower authorities of Good Luck, Bad Luck, and Foresight.
  • Prophecy: "They" are able to Prophesize how different results will occur between certain people and events due to good or bad Luck.
  • "Their" spoken Prophecies will have a high probability of becoming a reality and even if the final outcome does not match that of a Soothsayer's Prophecy, it will be similar.
  • The Prophecy "Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) will ultimately emerge victorious in this battle, thanks to his exceptional good fortune." had become a reality during his fight against the sentient Weather Warlock Beyonder Characteristic, causing it to be incapacitated.
  • This was not any change that was caused by Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) attacks. It was instead caused by the attacks in the Bansy Harbor (opens in a new tab) telegraph ruins, causing a leakage point within the City of Calamity (opens in a new tab) that could trigger anomalies and cause the sentient Beyonder Characteristic to be subjected to unseen influences.
  • Revelation of Fate: "They" are able to gaze upon the long River of Fate in order to receive desired Revelations and Prophecies.
  • In Chaotic situations, with many choices and only a few paths leading to a good ending, Prophecies can be used to gain Revelation, which requires interpretation.
  • If it is correctly interpreted it will guide the inquirer to the best possible outcome.
  • If the Revelation is not correctly interpreted, the inquirer will suffer immensely.
  • Prophecies of the Future can be true or false. If someone believes a false Prophecy and prepares to avoid or embrace it, it will become true.
  • Words of Fortune & Misfortune: "They" are able to bring Good or Bad Luck upon any living beings within a 30 kilometer radius.
  • When "They" give Good Luck onto targets, "They" are able to choose whether to consume "Their" own Luck or the someone else's Good Luck.
  • The Misfortune "They" can bring can make any Beyonder (opens in a new tab) under the Demigod level die miserably within an extremely short period of time.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" full Mythical Creature Form is a Snake of Mercury; a giant scaleless snake with dense patterns and symbols on its surface, the symbols being various wheels that are connected to each other. Each wheel is different, and they represent different futures that might happen.
  • Mercury Body: "Their" body has a wonderful connection and indescribable fusion with the River of Fate, becoming a blessed of Fate. Once attacked, "They" have the passive ability to not be hit or affected by anything for ten seconds, and "Their" Luck will continue afterwards.

Sequence 1: Snake of Mercury (Giant Serpent, Snake of Fate, Tail-Devouring Serpent of Fate)

New Abilities

  • Fated Connection:⁂ "They" can use the Connection "They" have with an object to store and channel "Their" abilities through it, even if "They" are not in the vicinity.
  • Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) summoned Will Auceptin (opens in a new tab)'s ice cream from the past to establish a subtle Connection with "Him" in order to be blessed with good Luck.
  • Ouroboros (opens in a new tab) imbued "His" murals with many of "His" powers, be it giving people extreme Misfortune or trapping them in a Cycle of Fate.
  • Will Auceptin (opens in a new tab) utilized Reboots through the medium of "His" folded paper cranes to help Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) in battle.

Authorities

  • Cycle: "They" gain partial authority over Cycle and the corresponding Save and Select authorities.
  • Cycle of Fate: "They" can make people fall into a strange state, where Time maintains a certain degree of flow, but is fixed within a certain range, circulating over and over again.
  • Those affected by it wouldn't even realize they are trapped.
  • It can repeatedly trap other supernatural individuals of similar power level until the target realizes it, but each time consumes "Their" own Luck.
  • By breaking the medium, one can break free from it.
  • The medium for the Cycle of Fate that had placed the City of Silver (opens in a new tab) members in a past Rose Redemption (opens in a new tab) meeting was the hall itself, and destroying it would end the loop.
  • When Colin Iliad (opens in a new tab) destroyed the Ouroboros (opens in a new tab)-like face that was inlaid on Jack's (opens in a new tab) stomach, the Cycle of Fate that made the team repeat the exploration 5 times ended.
  • This balance will continue, that is, relative stillness.
  • Upon seeing a mural with the face of the Angel of Fate Ouroboros (opens in a new tab), Derrick Berg (opens in a new tab), Lovia Tiffany (opens in a new tab), and Colin Iliad (opens in a new tab) were trapped in a Cycle of Fate, with each one of those affected merging and being one of the members of the Rose Redemption (opens in a new tab).
  • Each of the members of the City of Silver (opens in a new tab) (who have now become these past Rose Redemption (opens in a new tab) members) repeated a series of actions like puppets: approaching the table, sitting down, listening, and leaving.
  • This Cycle of Fate made the figures that had once been in this secret meeting cross the borders of time, “revive” at their fixed seats, allowing their words that were from the past to reappear.
  • Derrick Berg (opens in a new tab) was assigned a mission to explore the True Creator's Temple (opens in a new tab), which resulted in him being trapped in a Cycle of Fate with his memories wiped each cycle, having repeated the exploration five times with slight differences each time.
  • In the first iteration of the exploration, all of the animal hide lanterns had been extinguished, nearly leading to a tragedy.
  • In the second iteration of the exploration, someone lost control of themselves and almost swallowed a "mushroom".
  • In the third iteration, Jack (opens in a new tab) told a story about him and his father trying to find the True Creator's (opens in a new tab) holy residence.
  • In the fourth iteration, Joshua was severely injured by Jack (opens in a new tab) who had mutated without any warning.
  • Reboot (Reboot of Destiny/Reset of Everything): "They" can Reset the state or events within a certain area, invalidating all events that took place before a Reboot.
  • However, the Luck they consumed or gained during the period Rebooted won't be affected.
  • The way it operates is different from a Worm of Time's Time authority.
  • Reboot does not reverse the flow of Time like a Worm of Time and instead it overwrites the current manifested state of an environment with an older Saved state.
  • The following are just a few examples of Reboot in action.
  • Will Auceptin (opens in a new tab) had utilized Reboot to Reboot Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatar state to when "He" had not yet Parasitized various people in Boklund Street.
  • When faced with an inescapable danger, "They" can Reboot the Cycle and revert to an embryo, but this doesn't reset "Their" accumulated and consumed Luck.
  • This will reset "Their" madness levels, allowing "Them" to reduce the need for an Anchor (opens in a new tab). However, this reduction does not mean that "They" don't need one.
  • A certain level of anchor is still required. Otherwise, "They" can't sustain this state for long.
  • With each Reboot, "They" will strive to be slightly different in order to maintain a healthy mental state. A child's stage should be a child's, etc.
  • "They" are able to Conceal the peculiarity of "Their" own Destiny.

Strengthened Abilities

  • High Spirituality: "Their" Spirituality can utilize the Spirit World to influence Dreams.
  • "They" can locate one's Astral Projection in the Spirit World and inject information in one's Dreams, creating a Revelation that evolved into a specific Dream.

Sequence 0: Wheel of Fortune

Description

To an extent, "They" are equivalent to the embodiment of Fate, capable of roaming freely in the River of Fate (opens in a new tab).

Authorities

  • Fate: A core authority derived from the Fate Symbolism, though not complete, as other Pathways also have some Fate authority. "They" are the embodiment of "Fate", both Good Luck and Bad Luck, with a particular aptitude for Foresight.
  • Foresight: "They" gain partial authority over Foresight, being able to grasp the River of Fate (opens in a new tab) to obtain visions of the future as well as inevitable anchors.
  • "They" can profoundly influence short-term tributaries of the River of Fate (opens in a new tab) in a short-period of time, ensuring that "Their" Prophecies will be precisely fulfilled.
  • This is akin to a grand Prophecy technique.
  • The Wheel of Fortune has the strongest Prophetic ability.
  • As the embodiment of "Fate", Fooling "Them" is also equivalent to Fooling Fate.
  • "They" can perform the Tunnel Effect (opens in a new tab), but it would consume "Their" own Luck.
  • "They" can make the atoms in "Their" body perfectly align to let a blade pass through "Them".
  • As the embodiment of "Fate", "They" can roam freely in the River of Fate (opens in a new tab).
  • Probability: Another core authority derived from the symbol of Fate, it lets "Them" manipulate the Probability of events and the behavior of peoples and objects from all around the world.
  • Everything can be Probabilistic. This is one of the manifestations of the Disorder nature of Fate. If one masters Probability, they master the Fate of all things.  
  • The Wheel of Fortune can amplify the Probability of adversely affecting a target to the limit, causing them to fail in everything they do while also having rare unlucky events become extremely likely and common for the target. Likewise, "They" can do the opposite.
  • Due to the Die of Probability's (opens in a new tab) pip being 1, Darkwill (opens in a new tab) had almost died in his Dream as his head head swelled with a sharp pain and he struggled to breathe.
  • Soon after, if Klein (opens in a new tab) hadn't properly controlled his strength as the door slammed into Darkwill's (opens in a new tab) head, his skull would have probably cracked open.
  • It had also made it so that even though Darkwill (opens in a new tab) explained his situation and the Die of Probability (opens in a new tab) with lot's of logic, Klein (opens in a new tab) would still not believe him.
  • This was due to the fact that Darkwill’s (opens in a new tab) earlier explanation happened to match certain theories of his, making him instinctively believe that weak lie over the recent explanation as being the true reason behind his predicament.
  • With the Die of Probability's (opens in a new tab) pip at 2, the sky suddenly turned dark as the wind howled with increasing strength and the air’s humidity clearly climbed.
  • As Darkwill (opens in a new tab) looked out the window to check on the exact situation within the ship a silver bolt of Lightning struck him before Klein (opens in a new tab) could even react.
  • Light Cone World: "Their" Divine Kingdom, a completely Probabilistic realm where every move corresponds to a dice with different numbers.
  • The Wheel of Fortune can manipulate these illusory dice.
  • Cycle: Derived from the Return symbolism, it means Returning to the mother body, Returning to the primordial source, Returning to the oldest origin. This is the instinct of the universe.
  • This authority includes the domain of Reincarnation, which is shared with the Mother.
  • Under the Cycle authority are the lesser authorities of Save and Select.  
  • The Save authority can reproduce a past segment of Fate no more than three minutes away from the current segment that can replace the current segment.
  • The Select authority can choose one path among the many Fate Tributaries in the River of Fate. For example, choosing the one leading to Reboot.
  • Disorder/Chaos: The Disorder authority is one of the manifestations of the Disorder symbolism. The essence of Fate is Chaos, which embodies madness. "They" guard and use this Chaos.
  • This Chaos is the Disorder of Fate (opens in a new tab), rooted in the Original Creator's (opens in a new tab) madness.

Mother Pathway

Sequence 9: Planter

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Planters possess several physical enhancements upon drinking the potion, showcased by their high physical strength.

New Abilities

  • Farming Proficiency: Planters possess a high proficiency with farming tools, distinguishing among different seeds, and nurturing them.
  • Weather Forecasting: They can predict the weather to a certain extent by observing clouds, wind, and other natural phenomenon.

Sequence 8: Doctor (Healing Pastor)

Traits

  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality has become enhanced, allowing them to use Spirit Vision.
  • Spirit Vision: Through Spirit Vision (opens in a new tab), they can discern a patient’s health condition with precision.
  • Even without it, they can discern hidden illnesses from the target's external appearance.

New Abilities

  • Healing: Their principle power. They have a variety of abilities regarding the process of Healing, be it in the physical and Soul fields, allowing them to be able to Heal and Treat most forms of injuries.
  • Surgical Mastery: They are experts at surgery, possessing the corresponding skills in suturing severed limbs and transplanting internal organs, and having a fine control over medical tools.
  • It allows them to help a patient's condition without utilising other Beyonder powers. When combined with their Treatments, there are few physical things they can't fix.
  • Treatments: Doctors possess a variety of Treatments and thus are rather good at healing a variety of different injuries/illnesses such Treatments as the baseline method.
  • Evil Ailment Treatment: They are able to relieve certain aliments and diseases associated with the domains of Evil and Depravity.
  • Disease Treatments: Even if the disease is not associated with the domains of Evil and Depravity, they can still heal it.
  • Trauma Treatment: They are able to effectively Treat and cure most forms of physical trauma through a Treatment.
  • For wounds that can be accessed without barriers, they can cure those directly. For example, they can let their palm shimmer with a clear light and press it on the wound.
  • This will make the wound will contract and wiggle, before Healing quickly.
  • For wounds that cannot be accessed without barriers, they must open the cavity and touch the injured area, which is equivalent to performing a surgical operation.
  • Soul Suture (Soul Sewing): By having the patient let go of their bodies and mind, Doctors can carry out a Soul level surgery to Sewing up the corresponding wound.
  • If a person were to completely open up their body and mind, leaving their Soul unprotected, a Doctor could be able to sever the person’s Soul.
  • Soul Suture could be used by them as both a method of attack on the Soul, as well as a healing method to remove Corruption and Curses.
  • With enough practice, it is not impossible for a Doctor to artificially remove certain emotions and desires from a patient's Soul.
  • In terms of healing soul injuries, Soul Suturing is much more effective then simply doing an Evil Ailment Treatment.
  • Giving Life: Doctors are also able to gradually restore the energy of a person in a weakened state, restoring that person's strength and vigour.

Sequence 7: Harvest Priest

Description

A bringer of fertility and growth, whose powers ensure abundance and bountiful harvests.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Their body will receive a variety of different enhancements.
  • However, these enhancements are not much.

New Abilities

  • Seed Catalysation: Through this Beyonder power, a Harvest Priest will be able to directly Catalyse the life hidden within a seed or an already existing plant, causing it to grow faster.
  • There are 2 methods that a Harvest Priest can employ to use this ability:
  1. By directly holding some seeds or plants in one's hand, they could fully Catalyse the Life within and release all it's stored vitality in one burst, causing it to rapidly grow and reach maturity in a small amount of time.
  • Through this, a Harvest Priest can create a large amount of thorned vines, which can be used to entangle and control enemies.
  • If different types of mutated plant seeds can be obtained, this Beyonder ability can play a significant role in combat.
  1. By putting both of their hands on the ground, a Harvest Priest can quicken all Life within a 30 meter radius from them, influencing the surrounding plants and seeds to grow and reproduce much faster then normal.
  • However, it can't make the plants and seeds to burst forth with all their Life force, or complete their life cycle from birth to return within mere seconds or minutes.
  • Through physical contact, it can also work on certain plant-like creatures.
  • To a certain extent, this enables a Harvest Priest to directly Catalyse the vitality of a plant-like creature, either finishing its lifespan or causing it to more quickly mature.
  • Plant & Insect Commanding: Harvest Priests are able to directly Command plants and insects within a 30 meter radius to provide them with a certain level of support.
  • There are 2 perquisites that need to be followed for this ability to work on a plant or insect.
  1. The plant or insect they are attempting to Command does not possess intelligence.
  2. The level of Commanding does not exceed the species' biological limitations.
  • Knowledge (Ritualistic Spells): Upon drinking the potion, a Harvest Priest will obtain several Ritualistic Spells focused on manipulating the weather.
  • Through the Ritualistic Spells provided by the potion, a Harvest Priest will gain the ability to clear the skies or summon rain within a certain area.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Healing: Their Healing capabilities stemming from a Doctor have improved.
  • Disease Treatment: They can now cure diseases in plants and other organisms.
  • Their Healing extends to the land itself - curing crops, fields and lands.

Sequence 6: Biologist[](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flordofthemysteries.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FMotherPathway%2FAbilities%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D4&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")

New Abilities

  • Cross-breeding: Biologists possess the ability to make a chimera or Cross-breed between various animals, plants, and even an object, directly leading to them creating a new species.
  • Biologists are able to create Cross-breeds with different ordinary materials, allowing them to create unique species that possess abilities that can be directed to a certain purpose.
  • Frank Lee (opens in a new tab) created an apple Cross-breed that is not only much softer and juicier then a normal one but could also heal the illness caused by the Biological Poison Bottle (opens in a new tab).
  • Frank Lee (opens in a new tab) created special types of fish Cross-breeds that have alcohol instead of blood. These ultimately failed to become a species because of their short lifespan.
  • Frank Lee (opens in a new tab) was able to create a special type of fungus that is able to make any bull, regardless of their gender, be able to produce milk for a period of time.
  • While they can make Cross-breeds using normal materials, ingredients from Beyonders would allow them to create more magical Cross-breeds with more unique abilities.
  • Frank Lee (opens in a new tab), through combining a Rose Bishop's flesh with mushrooms, was able to give the fungi the ability to grow through the consumption of flesh.
  • Later on, Frank Lee (opens in a new tab) had modified this mushroom Cross-breed and created different variations of such mushrooms that had unique properties from the original.
  • Prototype 2 had the following Cross-breed variations:
  • The first was a Cross-breed with wheat and can be grounded to make bread.
  • The second could be mixed with milk and have milk be drawn from it.
  • The last was Cross-breed with fish and thus had a meaty flavour.
  • Prototype 3 had the following Cross-breed variations:
  • The first type of Cross-breed from Prototype 3 of the mushroom Cross-breed cannot be eaten as it instead accumulates various kinds of poisons.
  • The second type of Cross-breed can be used for food only after being cooked at high temperatures through boiling, stewing, and frying.
  • Before reaching the Sequence 4 level, their Cross-breeds will lack a Soul.
  • Poison Creation: A Biologist's own body can produce highly potent toxin, which can then be accumulated and released through their hair or other means.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Knowledge (Life): They have a deep understanding of the characteristics of living organisms.

Sequence 5: Druid

Description

Druids are the favoured of Nature, attendants of the oak, and are able to rely on plants and animals to accomplish various tasks.

New Abilities

  • They can draw nutrients from the soil and air, and master many Spells of the Earth domain, such as Underground Travel, Swamp, Wrath of Nature, and Child of the Oak.
  • Underground Travel: Druids are able to make the ground beneath their feet soften instantly, turning into a "sink" that causes their body to sink rapidly as if falling into the sea.
  • From there, the Druid can Travel Underground.
  • Wrath of Nature: They can designate 1 to 50 people as adversaries, causing the surrounding environment to turn hostile against them, giving sufficient interference.
  • If there are strong dangerous factors within the environment itself, then these dangers will be highly likely to erupt with the adversaries as the target.
  • In a battle at the foot of a cliff, if there is a high risk of rocks falling and crashing down from above, then this risk will be significantly increased, or even Inevitable. However, if the Probability of this risk occurring is very low, then it will not occur.
  • Swamp: A Druid can make the ground on the target's feet or in an area within a 30-meter radius into a Swamp to restrict their movements or directly bury them.
  • Child of the Oak: This Spell of the Earth domain allows a Druid to create a layer of stone or wood skin on their body as a means of protection.
  • Golem Creation: This is a type of Earth Magic that allows a Druid to create Golems, such as a stone Golem.
  • Animal Transformation: Druids are able to Transform into giant bears to fight, or briefly transform into the creatures that were included in their Advancement Ritual (opens in a new tab).
  • However, even if they were to Transform into one of the creatures included in their Advancement Ritual (opens in a new tab), they won't be able to use its abilities.
  • When a Druid Transforms themselves into a giant bear, they will be twice the height of a person and possess great strength and endurance.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Cross-breeding: They gain abundant insight in the field of Cross-breeding and creating chimeras. This enhances their ability to Cross-breed more and diverse species.
  • Seed Catalysation: By pressing both of their palms to the ground, they can cause dark green mutated vines to pierce the earth and grow wildly at the target's location.
  • Poison Creation: Druids can throw out strands of hair, which can spontaneously combusted and emit a black, unknown, and highly toxic substance.

Sequence 4: Ancient Alchemist

New Abilities

  • Mutation: This is a core ability of a Ancient Alchemist. With it, they are able to make all of their abilities cause Mutations to spring up in the target's body and mind.
  • Besides causing madness to spring up, an Ancient Alchemist's attacks have a chance of Mutating the target's body, producing effects such as but not limited too:
  • Causing a target's body to Mutate with additional organs. Such organs can prop up on the skin, and outer body, but also can sprout directly inside the target themselves.
  • Causing parts of their body to be replaced with various plants like watermelons, mushrooms, and wheat, that cannot be eaten as it would result in contamination.
  • All of an Ancient Alchemist's attacks carry the power to increase an enemy's madness level, therefore increasing the risk for that enemy to lose control.
  • Artificial Life Creation: By using fragmented Souls and other materials, an Ancient Alchemist can complete the ultimate form of Life Transmutation.
  • They are able to create different golems that can be used for combat or other tasks.
  • The golems they can create includes Stone Golems, Mud Golems, and Steel Golems.
  • All of these dolls have Earthen traits and abilities that match their own materials.
  • They can create ordinary humans that can live for a very long time.

Strengthened Abilities

  • All their previous abilities has been enhanced.
  • Creature Commanding: A qualitative upgrade to Plant & Insect Commanding. They can control Beyonder creatures with low intelligence and reduce their insanity for a short period of time.
  • This level of Commanding includes only Beyonder creatures that possess a shred of rationality. Human Beyonders who have lost control cannot be affected.
  • Life Aura: This is a qualitative enhancement to Seed Catalysation. They can now directly fill their surroundings with vibrant Life force, causing plants and animals to grow and reproduce rapidly.
  • Even humans could be affected to a certain extent, causing their body to more rapidly develop and grow under the influence of a Ancient Alchemist's Life Aura.
  • Healing: Their Beyonder abilities regarding Healing, including but not limited to Surgical Mastery, Treatments, and Soul Suture have been strongly enhanced and strengthened.
  • Through touch, they can now Heal anyone quickly no matter how seriously injured or damaged they are, other than those that have already lost control.
  • Even for those who lost control, they can utilise their Soul Suture and Treatments specialised in that field to temporarily give them back rationality.
  • This works with even Beyonder creatures with low intelligence as well.
  • Animal Transformation: They can temporarily transform into a supernatural creature without Godhood; however, there are prerequisites that they must meet in order to do so.
  • The prerequisites are that they understand the corresponding occult knowledge, physical structure, and extraordinary patterns of the supernatural creature.
  • Cross-breeding: Their Cross-breeds can now possess a Soul.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Pallbearer

Descriptions

The Pallbearer is an important component of the Mother Pathway's construction of the Cycle of Reality, thus linking it to the authorities of Death and Return.

Authorities

  • Death & Return: Pallbearers possess many Beyonder abilities situated in the domain of Death and Earth that represents the act of Returning living beings and creatures to the Earth as a means to die.
  • Evil Spirit Transformation: Pallbearers are able to Transform any of the dead within a 10 kilometre range from them into Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab) that serve them.
  • Anyone who has eaten their food or is strongly linked to them within a 50 kilometre range can also be transformed into Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab) by the Pallbearer.
  • Life Deprivation: Each hit that a Pallbearer does on a target will make them undergo a trial of Death, which if failed will cause the corresponding target to Die instantly.
  • Even if one passes the trial of Death, they will suffer a significant loss of Life.
  • Within a certain range, a Pallbearer is able to make Death descend.
  • Even if the target makes no contact with the Pallbearer, their Life will naturally drain away at a rapid pace and be forced to make its way to the Earth.
  • Return to Earth: Pallbearers are able to make Undead creatures within a 10 km range quickly dissipate, Returning to the Earth, to the embrace of Mother.
  • Even if an Undead were to possess Godhood, they can only resist a few seconds. Only an complete Undead Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab) can avoid this effect.
  • Maternal Embrace: The coffin and the earth, as the embodiment of the Mother's Embrace, provide them a possibility of Sealing away Undead Angels (opens in a new tab).

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their other Beyonder powers have been enhanced.
  • Artificial Life Creation: They can directly create and give Life and strength to up to 3 Golems with Sequence 4 power made out of Soil or Clay.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Desolate Matriarch

Gender Transition

  • Advancing to a Desolate Matriarch results in becoming a female regardless of the original gender.

Authorities

  • Earth, Desolation, Harvest, & Life: A Desolate Matriarch holds a partial authority over Earth, Desolation, Harvest, and Life.
  • "They" can induce land within 300 kilometres to bloom with Life, making soil fertile, water flow abundant, boosting the tendency of Life to reproduce, and preventing factors that hinder it.
  • Even the most unfavourable environmental conditions won't stop Life within this area from bearing offspring, only reducing the quantity and frequency of Life produced.
  • "They" can cause the land within a 300-kilometer range to become barren, causing crop failure, and plants to wither. Unless the effect ends, the affected land won't become fertile again.
  • Angel (opens in a new tab)-level abilities similar to Purification are able to suppress but not fully dispel this, limiting the effect it causes to a very small area and making it unable to spread.
  • Desolation: "They" can cause all Life within a 30-kilometer range to rapidly drain away until Death. Similar abilities outside this domain will also gradually wither and be weakened.
  • Lifeless Undead who enter this domain will quickly return to the Earth.
  • Within a 50-kilometer range, the Desolate Matriarch can rapidly form various toxins within the environment and increase the tendency of every Beyonder to lose control.
  • "They" can also grow all kinds of extraordinary plants that are beneficial to "Them" as well as tame any animals within range that does not possess higher intelligence.
  • The Desolate Matriarch can also create edible plants in any environment and promote their growth, reproduction as well as Harvest within a 50-kilometer radius.
  • In the Forsaken Land of the Gods (opens in a new tab), the powers of Gift of the Land (opens in a new tab) had created Black Faced Grass (opens in a new tab) that inhabitants in the City of Silver (opens in a new tab) survived on.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Evil Spirit Transformation: "They" are able to turn all dead humans within a 50 kilometre range into Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab), with the weakest being at Sequence 5 with the strongest as Demigods.
  • This is equivalent to mass-producing Sequence 5 Beyonders and creating a number of Demigod-level Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab) which can cause an area to be inhabitable for years.
  • Those who have eaten food created by the Desolate Matriarch or have strong connection to "Her" within a 300 kilometres radius will also become Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab).
  • Artificial Life Creation: "They" are able to create dolls and Golems from Soil, Plants, Lava, Ores, and Metals, and give them some corresponding level of Life and power.
  • The strongest of the dolls and golems "They" can create can only be at the level of a Sequence 3, and "They" can only make a maximum of nine Demigod-level constructs in total.
  • Mythical Creature Transformation: The improved version of Animal Transformation. "They" are able to briefly Transform "Themselves" into a Mythical Creature.
  • However, "They" must be able to withstand the mysticism knowledge and maddening will brought about by the corresponding Mythical Creature Form.
  • Life Deprivation: Each strike of the Desolation Matriarch will now subject the target to a trial of losing control and a trial of Death.
  • If the target is unable to pass, they will either lose control on the spot or Die instantly.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" have become a complete Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab). "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is a mass of flesh and blood covered with various reproductive organs, golden ears of wheat, mushrooms, vines, and soil.

Sequence 1: Naturewalker

Authorities

  • Nature & Mother: "They" hold a partial authority over Nature and Mother.
  • Child of Nature: A Naturewalker is the Child of Nature.
  • "They" can reshape the environment, making even the Abyss (opens in a new tab) suitable for human habitation.
  • "They" are able to truly become one with the Natural elements within range - earth, forests, flowing water, mountains, ores, etc: and traverse through them at varying speeds.
  • In the Western Continent (opens in a new tab), this is known as "Various Escapes Techniques".
  • "They" can also directly draw upon or utilise their power.
  • As the Mother of All Things is also the Mother of Concepts, things that belong to the broad concept of Nature can be compatible with "Them" and thus heed to "Their" will.
  • This includes Fire, Lightning, the Sun, the Moon, etc.
  • World Creation: "They" can nurture and conceive a realm embodying the concept of Nature, which is akin to the Painting World, the Mirror World, or a more complete alternate Dimension.
  • These realms are easier to break than an Attendant of Mysteries' Realm of Mysteries.

Strengthened Abilities

  • All "Their" previous abilities have been enhanced.

Sequence 0: Mother

Authorities

  • Mother: This authority of the Mother is derived from the Mother of All symbolism.
  • The Mother gives birth to all things, including True Deities, concepts, and worlds.
  • "She" can help catalyse the activation (opens in a new tab) of an inanimate Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) to make it come to life.
  • The Brood Hive (opens in a new tab)'s influence over the Knowledge Moor (opens in a new tab) activated (opens in a new tab) the  ![Hermit Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Hermit_Pathway) Hermit Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) and made the Hidden Sage (opens in a new tab) come to life.
  • Lilith (opens in a new tab) used "Her" Mother Authority to catalyse the activation (opens in a new tab) of the  ![Error Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Error_Pathway) Error Uniqueness (opens in a new tab), helping Amon (opens in a new tab) come to life.
  • Earth: The authority of Earth is derived from the two symbols, Mother of All and Brood Hive of Filth.
  • Once a portion of Nature, Earth was given the meanings of Origin of Life, Mother of All Things, and the destination of which all things Return. Through this, the Earth had completed the Cycle of Reality and became independent from Nature.
  • "She" is able to make the Earth and surrounding land quake violently, tearing open a huge hole and rift across an entire planet that leads directly to the Chaos Sea (opens in a new tab) at its innermost core.
  • This is a symbolic Return to the Origin.
  • Nature: This authority is derived from the Goddess of Origin symbolism.
  • The Mother is a part of Reality, and is difficult to completely destroy or truly Seal unless "She" willingly yields, Returns to the true Mother Goddess (opens in a new tab), or is replaced.
  • "She" possesses immense vitality and regenerative prowess, able to survive direct attacks from True Deities without offering any resistance.
  • Under the Fire of Destruction created by a Dual Pathway True Deity, Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab), Earth Mother’s (opens in a new tab) immense vitality tried to reconstitute "Her" and bring her back to Life, even though "She" offered no resistance.
  • "She" is able to cause plants to grow wildly, forming vast Natural barriers that are capable of withstanding the attacks of even True Gods (opens in a new tab).
  • "She" is able to create a barrier made of clusters of wheat, flowers, mushrooms, newborns, and trees that intertwine layer by layer, Sealing what is inside.
  • Each damaged layer- whether it's the wheat, flowers, mushrooms, trees, or newborns- would quickly return to "Her" embrace and grow again and be reborn, maintaining the barrier "She" has made.
  • Death: "She" possesses a partial authority over Death, which is derived from the symbols of Goddess of Origin and Brood Hive of Filth.
  • "From the Mother you came, and to the Mother you return" - such is the Origin of all things, and Returning signifies Death.
  • "She" can frantically drain the Life of even True Deities should "She" pierce "Them" in the heart, dragging "Them" down in an act of Returning it to the Earth, back to a Mother's embrace.
  • Such an ability was demonstrated when Earth Mother (opens in a new tab) stabbed the God of Combat (opens in a new tab) in the heart, an act that eventually led to "His" death as "His" vitality began to perish.
  • As the Brood Hive also has a part of the Death symbolism, the authority of Death also points to Corruption, Loss of Control, and Bodily Mutation.
  • Life: "She" also possesses a partial authority over Life, derived from the symbols Mother of All and Goddess of Origin.
  • "Her" presence alone would make all kinds of plants mutate and grow uncontrollably, wildly absorbing nutrients from unknown sources; even withered plants would grow once more.
  • In just 7 or 8 seconds, many places in Backlund (opens in a new tab) became a primeval forests. It was as if the city had been abandoned for more than a century, with towering trees connected to one another and covering half the surrounding sky.
  • The Mother is able to make other creatures Mutate uncontrollably, turning them into blooming plants or making them bear fruit, returning them to the land.
  • Amon's (opens in a new tab) Avatars experienced this effect from "Her" authority, with some turning into plants that bloomed or bore fruit, Returning to the land.
  • The ability to make someone instantly Pregnant is the result of a qualitative change of the ability to grant Life.
  • Omebella's (opens in a new tab) corpse (opens in a new tab) could make people pregnant because "She" had once accommodated the  ![Mother Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Mother_Pathway) Mother Uniqueness (opens in a new tab).
  • Bountiful Earth: The Divine Kingdom of the Mother is a bountiful and joyous land filled with the Mother’s own definition of Nature, Life, and Death.
  • However, its Cycle remains incomplete.
  • Return: This is a lower authority derived from the Earth and Death authorities.
  • Through cooperation with the Death, "They" could make "Their" own Cycle of Reincarnation.
  • This will be similar to the Cycle of Reincarnation formed by the Eternal Darkness (opens in a new tab) and Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab), albeit limited to a single star system.
  • Desolation: A lower authority born from the intersection of the Nature and Death authorities.
  • Healing (Treatment): A lower authority originating from the Mother and Life authorities.
  • Transmutation: A lower authority originating from the Mother and Life authorities.
  • Harvest: This is a lesser manifestation of the Nature and Life authorities.

Moon Pathway

Sequence 9: Apothecary

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: While Apothecaries don't gain massive physical improvements as some of the other Pathways at this Sequence, they do gain a few upon becoming a Sequence 9 Beyonder.
  • Their enhancements make them relatively resistant to poisonous elements and toxins.
  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality gets enhanced as a Beyonder.
  • Spirit Vision: Their Spirit Vision shows them a person's overall health and wellbeing.

New Abilities

  • Medicinal Concoction: They excel at creating and mixing various herbs as well as using dead animals parts to create various Medicinal Concoctions, letting them easily treat most illnesses/injuries.
  • Despite their abilities, Apothecaries do not have actual ways to treat terminal illnesses.
  • For those that are in the final stage of a terminal illness, an Apothecary can only try to alleviate symptoms or slow down the progression. They cannot cure the underlying disease.
  • These are just a few examples of the potions and concoctions Apothecaries can make:
  • A potion that would invoke the libido one has experienced during their teenage years.
  • A potion that enhances one's strength, speed, and agility for a short amount of time.
  • A potion that effectively stop bleeding and stimulate the healing of wounds.
  • Taming: Apothecaries are good at Taming and domesticating plants.

Sequence 8: Beast Tamer

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Their physical attributes have been greatly improved.
  • Beast Tamers can fight many wild beasts head-on.

New Abilities

  • Animal Senses: They can read the thoughts of, utilize the senses of, communicate to, and control Animals, gradually Taming them and making them into their assistants.
  • Beast Tamers are instinctively the natural enemies of animals, being able to Intimidate them into complete submission with just their gaze.
  • Upon merely looking at the eyes of a Beast Tamer, Susie (opens in a new tab) suddenly froze for a moment before quickly running away and disappearing without a trace.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Taming: They can Tame, domesticate, and use various unique animals rather effectively.
  • A Beast Tamer's capability of Taming also includes Beyonder and supernatural creatures.
  • They can help animals withstand Beyonder potions to become Beyonder creatures.

Sequence 7: Vampire

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Vampires gain several physical improvements to their body, granting them an array of physical benefits that make them truly a different species separate from humanity. They subsist mainly on blood rich in Spirituality.
  • Their appearance along with charisma improve as they not only possess an extremely strong agility and speed but also gain superhuman regeneration capabilities.
  • They are able to create afterimages while running.
  • A Vampire's lifespan will increase to around 300 years as their corresponding constitution and physical senses have been strengthened and refined.
  • However, all of these benefits don't come without a cost, as Vampires will develop a weak point that can be exploited. That weak point is their heart.
  • Purification powers like the Tyrant Pathway's Lightning are lethal against them.
  • Due to their vampiric physique they will feel discomfort in the Sun.

New Abilities

  • Upon advancing into this Sequence, Vampires will gain access and mastery over a certain number of abilities and Spells that fall under the domains of Darkness, Shadows, and Moon which includes but not limited to.
  • Wings of Darkness: Vampires are able to utilize the Darkness around them to form illusory bat wings that grant them an enhanced speed boost along with some limited flight capabilities.
  • They can turn into a swarm of illusory bats that can attack and pester a group of enemies, emit black gases that resemble a bat's wing, or create a quietly spreading Black Flame.
  • Corrosive Claw: Their nails can grow an extra section with mysterious symbols and patterns on it that make their nails able to cut through steel and give strong corrosion properties.
  • The Claw of Corrosion a Vampire manifests is the bane of all scale, skin, and membrane-based defensive methods, being highly effective against them.
  • Abyss Shackles:A Spell-like ability belonging to the Darkness domain can condense nearby Darkness or Shadows into illusory shackles to restrict or control enemies.
  • The Embrace: If a Vampire possesses excess Beyonder Characteristics, they are able to bestow it onto a human, turning that human into one of them.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Blood Servant Conversion: This is an upgrade to a Beast Tamer's Taming ability and is very similar to The Embrace, except that it does not require any excess Beyonder Characteristics to activate.
  • This is a Spell-like ability within the domain of the Moon. With this ability a Vampire can Convert any living creature into being a Blood Servant of them. This comes with a few properties that are both beneficial and detrimental for the Blood Servant.
  • When an organism becomes a Blood Servant, their constitution and physique will be greatly improved, and they will become immune to many illnesses that could plague them.
  • Any terminal illnesses they originally have before Conversion, will either disappear completely or becomes treatable after the transformation into a Blood Servant.
  • Regardless of the benefits, Blood Servants cannot disobey their master's orders and as such are equivalent to becoming the puppet of a Vampire.

Sequence 6: Potions Professor

Sanguine Rank: Baron

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: A Potion Professor's physique has improved from their state as a Vampire.
  • Not only has a Potion Professor's speed, agility, and strength have all improved to varying degrees, they have also had their natural lifespan improved as well.
  • A Potion Professor's sense of hearing has been greatly enhanced, allowing them to tell if someone is lying or not by the acceleration of their heartbeat.
  • Their natural sense of smell has been improved as well, allowing a Potion Professor to detect entities who can't hide their scent, such as Wraiths.

New Abilities

  • Discerning Spiritual Materials: Upon advancement, they gain the ability and vast knowledge on how to discern spiritual materials needed in various concoctions.
  • This knowledge comes directly from their own Beyonder Characteristics, and as such, can be considered as the qualitative change to an Apothecary's knowledge.
  • This knowledge given to them will now allow a Potion Professor to be able to treat terminal illness, as opposed to only being able to slow down its effects.
  • Potion & Perfume Crafting:⁂ With the aid of their newfound knowledge, Potions Professors can mix and create Potions and Perfumes with extraordinary effects.
  • Potions Professors who made preparations beforehand or who drank the corresponding Potions to counter certain challenges are almost always very difficult to deal with.
  • However, that is not to say that a Potion Professor does not face limitations, as there are many things a Potion Professor must account for when crafting such items.
  • A Potions Professor's Potions and Perfumes are like Mystical Items (opens in a new tab), meaning they lack Beyonder Characteristics, and consequently have expiration dates.
  • There might be some conflicts that may occur between different types of Potions when drunk together, bringing about all sorts of negative influences.
  • A Potions Professor will never tolerate themselves becoming an exploding cocktail and thus will limit the amount and type of Potions they drink in battle.
  • A Potion Professor's level of new accumulated knowledge and the spiritual materials they have access to are what limit the types of Potions and Perfumes they can create.
  • Some known Potions include, but are not limited to:
  • Solar Water Potion: A Potion that is powerful against undead or vampire-type enemies.
  • Dragon's Breath: By pouring into one's mouth, it allows one to spit out a Fire Breath.
  • Invisibility Potion: Can be applied to make oneself or objects completely Invisible.
  • Anti-Smell Potion: It can be used to eliminate the user's smell and body odor.
  • Anti-Dream Potion: This Potion prevents the effects of Dream Pulling.
  • Shadow Potion: It allows for the user to utilize Shadow Movement.
  • Some known Perfumes include, but are not limited to:
  • Animal-Friendly Perfume: A Perfume that makes animals closer to the user.
  • A true, outstanding Potions Professor will always research and invent new types of Potions and Perfumes based on the knowledge they've learned or acquired.

Sequence 5: Scarlet Scholar

Sanguine Rank: Viscount

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They possess terrifying speed and unimaginable regeneration capability.

New Abilities

  • A Scarlet Scholar's corresponding understanding and research on the Moon domain directly correlates with the effectiveness of their three core Beyonder abilities.
  • Full Moon: This Beyonder ability creates an environment that's more advantageous for themselves than for the enemy. This is mainly achieved through the control of Moonlight.
  • If the enemy is not good at dealing with Spirituality or Spirit World related combat and situations, a Scarlet Scholar will create an environment covered by a Full Moon.
  • Within an environment covered by a Full Moon, Spirituality will grow, Death will become stronger, and one's Spiritual Perception will increase.
  • If the enemy is excellent at dealing with Spirituality or Spirit World related combat and situations, a Scarlet Scholar will create an environment devoid of Moonlight.
  • They are able to become immune to the influence of the Full Moon.
  • When the Moonlight is shining upon an area, be it through the use of a Full Moon or done naturally, Scarlet Scholars will be able to use certain abilities:
  • Moonlight Transformation: This Beyonder power allows a Scarlet Scholar to transform into a condensed form of Moonlight that can move around near the Moonlit area.
  • Even if they were hit and shattered into pieces, a Scarlet Scholar could reconstruct and reform themselves either on the spot or in another location under the Moonlight.
  • The only way for a Scarlet Scholar to be injured and/or die while within their Spectral Moonlight Form is if they were hit in the heart by an attack.
  • The strength of the Moonlight Transformation ability depends on a Scarlet Scholar's understanding and research of the Moon realm.
  • When used, they become ethereal and tinted by a pale red color, which will then turn into a hazy ray of Moonlight that shatters, turning into red fragments that dissipate at the site and quickly reform in the distance.
  • Flash: Scarlet Scholars are able to Teleport to another location within a certain radius so long as it has the Moonlight shining on that area.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their expertise in the Moon domain strengthens various aspects of their previous Beyonder powers.
  • Potion & Perfume Crafting: The effectiveness of Potions and Perfumes has been enhanced.
  • Anti-Smell Potion: Scarlet Scholars can create a Potion that not only removes their odor, but also removes their Spirituality fluctuations.
  • Their abilities and Spells related to the Darkness domain has been strengthened.
  • Scarlet Scholars gain a natural resistance to Nightmare-related influences.

Sequence 4: Shaman King

Sanguine Rank: Earl

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They possess a strong physique and constitution, ridiculous speed, and powerful regeneration abilities; however, they still opt a more Spell-caster role in fighting.
  • A Shaman King's lifespan increases to 1000 years, which is considered long lived among Demigod. However, they will inevitably experience irreversible aging and decline. Therefore, 1,200 years is often their natural limit. But through special mysticism methods, they can extend their lifespan.
  • Examples of lifespan extension methods include placing Seals on one's body to limit lifespan usage, sleeping in a coffin as a form of hibernation, etc.
  • The eyeball(s) they lose while using Gaze of Darkness would grow back not too long after combat, something that will permanently disfigure/blind other Demigods of other Pathways if they were to perform the same action required to cast Gaze of Darkness.
  • Although a Shaman King's heart still remains as their biggest weak point, Shaman Kings also develop another weak point they must account for during various situations. That is the small Crimson Moon that exists within the inside of their head.

New Abilities

  • Spirituality Manipulation: Shaman Kings can simply "interact with nature", and such interaction alone replaces all the needed preparation and materials required for Ritualistic Magic.
  • As for what Ritualistic Magic can be performed instantly with the aid of Spirituality Manipulation, these are just a few examples of what Shaman Kings can accomplish:
  • Moon Strength Drawing Ritual: Shaman Kings are able to directly borrow the Moon's power on the spot, making them very terrifying opponents to deal with.
