  • Undead Conversion Ritual: Shaman Kings can increase the Spirituality in a region to convert dead bodies into undead controlled by them.
  • Every Shaman King is proficient in the utilization of Substitution Spells. In this case the act of Substitution can refer to either the Shaman King themselves or their targets.
  • Moon Paper Figurine: Shaman Kings are able to transform the surrounding Moonlight into a Moon Paper Figurine that they can use to Substitute themselves with.
  • They can utilize Moon Paper Figurines in a similar manner to how **Magicians** use Paper Figurine Substitutes, being able to use it to block a fatal blow via Substitution.
  • Gaze of Darkness: When they gaze on someone with their eyes, it forms a Substitution connection that will manifest the state of the eye onto the target.
  • If they were to grab their eyeball on their hand, the target who formed a Substitution connection to that eyeball will be engulfed in solidified, restraining Darkness.
  • This will have the effect of blocking the target.
  • If they crushed their eyeball to a bloody pulp, the target who formed the Substitution connection to that eyeball will be gravely injured or even be destroyed.
  • Bat Swarm Transformation: Shaman Kings possess the ability to divide themselves into a swarm of vampire bats that are in a state that is both illusory and real.
  • While in this form, unless the enemy can kill every single one of those bats, they can reconstruct and reform into their original form again without trouble.

Strengthened Abilities

  • They are outstanding people who control the power of Darkness, Moon, Bizarness and other fields and are proficient in various Spells of the Moon and Darkness domain.
  • Abyss Shackles: They are able to forcibly uproot and suspend in midair an entire roof with the strength of their Abyss Shackles.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: High Summoner[](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flordofthemysteries.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FMoonPathway%2FAbilities%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D7&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")

Sanguine Rank: Marquis

New Abilities

  • Door of Summoning: Extending their hands forward, they can manifest a hazy, ethereal Door, inscribed with numerous mystical symbols to Summon creatures from the depths of the Spirit World to come to their aid, but only once within a certain time frame.
  • Each Spirit World creature that passes through this Door enters into a Contract with the them, granting them service for a limited period of time, typically around five minutes.
  • For longer periods of service, the High Summoner must personally negotiate with the Spirit World creature and renew the Contract for a longer period.
  • Normally, the Summoned Spirit World creature is equal to or slightly stronger than the High Summoner, but it can also be weaker or far stronger.
  • Summoning stronger Spirit World creature carry the risk of them defying the terms and constraints of the Door of Summoning itself, posing a threat to them.

Authorities

  • Summoning: They have obtained some of the Summoning authority.
  • High Summoners are able to utilize the Moon's influence on the Spirit World to Summon various types of powerful creatures from the depths of the Spirit World to help them.
  • If the High Summoner has an especially strong social network, they can even sign a Contract with Angels (opens in a new tab), directly Summoning "Them" when needed.
  • They can Summon even a True Deity, however, respect and ceremony are a must with the preparation of the corresponding altar.
  • Summoning occasionally mutates, resulting in uncontrollable changes, causing strange creatures that are neither from the Spirit World nor have signed a Contract to descend into reality.
  • Rumor has it that these creatures can be traced back to the endless dark Cosmos (opens in a new tab).
  • These Summoning anomalies can be good or bad for a High Summoner.
  • The upper limit for a High Summoner within the Barrier (opens in a new tab) when summoning extraterrestrial beings is Sequence 3, because Angels (opens in a new tab) crossing the Barrier (opens in a new tab) require large-scale Ritualistic Magic, which is easier to discover.
  • Some High Summoners die from such incidents while others obtained powerful abilities or Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) whose corresponding supernatural abilities exist outside of the 22 standard Pathways.

Strengthened Abilities

  • High Summoners are also exceptional magic users of the Moon and Darkness domain.
  • Bat Wing Isolation: High Summoners can manifest a pair of giant bat wings to enclose an area in Darkness and make the surrounding area seem like it has been separated from the real world.
  • Full Moon: They can make a Crimson Full Moon ascend high into the sky, which has a Nourishing effect, capable of making the vines of a Demigod from the Mother Pathway expand swiftly, quickly encasing streets in a forest.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Life-Giver

Sanguine Rank: Duke

Authorities

  • Power of Creation: "They" mastered the Power of Creation: derived from the Life authority.
  • So long as what "They" are treating is not dead, "They" are capable of direct treatment without needing medicines. This also means "Their" self-Healing has reached the highest level.
  • "Their" regenerative capacity has been qualitatively enhanced, capable of regenerating "Their" entire body at an almost instant speed. "They" can even regenerate "Their" body from the ashes with a single drop of "Their" blood being able to regenerate "Their" full body.
  • Even after being attacked by several cannonball-like hailstones, Black Flames, Fireballs, Lightning Strikes, and a meteor ignited by air friction, the damage couldn't keep up with the healing speed of "Their" complete body even when in a weakened state.
  • Despite receiving a direct hit from a meteor capable of blowing "Their" body into pieces: leaving the flesh charred or vaporized and only a broken, blackened skeleton standing: "They" would still not be dead. New, tender flesh would grow, and the bone would slowly shed its charred appearance.
  • "They" can calm the emotions of those who are suffering from Filth or are fighting Corruption and strengthen their will to restore a certain balance, or "They" can do the opposite.
  • "Their" own physical body has reached its peak, and the Vitality radiating from "Them" allows surrounding Life to feel the joy of growth and New Life.
  • A Lifegiver's lifespan has been greatly enhanced, being much more than that of a normal Angel, capable of living for thousands of years.
  • However, "They" still need a variety of means to prolong their life until "Their" final death.
  • Madam Magician (opens in a new tab) estimated that Duke Round Moon (opens in a new tab) is at least 5,000 years old, but “He” still had to live in a coffin in an attempt to prolong "His" life.
  • Whether it's plants, animals, humans, or other extraordinary races, their Lifespan can be extended or shortened.  
  • It can bring about changes in one's Life and short-term bursts of power, akin to a larger-scale Blood Servant Conversion that does not require slavery.
  • Of course, if the target is strong-willed and of high status, they can resist this transformation; however, they will suffer a certain degree of damage from their Life essence.
  • Creatures can mutate from this change in Life caused by this.
  • Some examples are:
  • Grasses that had mouth-like crevices with fibers flying out to capture insects.
  • A spectrum of extraordinary insects with some having snakes or birds for heads.
  • Flowers that used their leaves as hands to harvest pollen for themselves.
  • Grains that were heavy, occasionally emitting wailing from inside.
  • Through this authority, "They" can clean up Filth, Corrosion and other forces.
  • "They" can give New Life to a piece of land the size of Backlund (opens in a new tab) or Trier (opens in a new tab).
  • Spirituality: "They" hold a partial authority over Spirituality.
  • "They" can interfere with and affect the Spirituality of all targets, and can give effects such as rapid recovery, increased consumption, and/or instability.
  • A Life Giver's mere presence is capable of replenishing the consumed Spirituality as if a rainstorm had filled numerous evaporated lakes.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Moonlight Transformation: "They" are able to transform into condensed Moonlight and move around even while not currently being near a Moonlit area.
  • Door of Summoning: While under the influence of Moonlight, "They" can open multiple Doors of Summoning at once as opposed to just 1.
  • Bat Wings: A Life-Giver is able to unfurl giant membranous Bat Wings from "Their" back, capable of blotting out the sky when unfolded.
  • Full Moon: "They" are able to cause a Crimson Moonlight to fall from an unknown place to wherever "They" are: evil, cold, and bloody.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" have become a full Mythical Creature; it is a humanoid creature with a phantom Moon on its back, bright red eyes, and bat wings. "They" look as if "They" were the embodiment of Beauty.

Sequence 1: Beauty Goddess

Sanguine Rank: Queen (Sanguines have only Queens and no Male Princes)

Description

The embodiment of the symbol and concept of Beauty. Inevitably, "They" are always a Female being representing the Yin Energy.

Gender Transition

  • Advancing to a Beauty Goddess results in becoming a female regardless of the original gender, possessing strong Reproduction desires and Divine tendencies.

Traits

  • "They" seem to have no lifespan limitations unlike other Angels (opens in a new tab).
  • Unless "They" were to be killed in battle, a Beauty Goddess would be the same person over thousands of years of history, not being replaced.

Authorities

  • Beauty: "Their" Beauty is pure, sublime, and Divine, making one want to admire and protect "Them", yet daring not to approach, or desecrate "Them", something that is even more Divine than the Charm of the Demoness Pathway, which focuses on femininity and allure.
  • "Their" core and strongest abilities revolve around "Their" Beauty and the corresponding charm "Their" appearance exudes.
  • Any life form that beholds the Beauty Goddess will be struck by "Their" overwhelming and transcendent Beauty. Those of lower status will instantly lose their sanity.
  • Even Great Old Ones, when facing "Them", may feel reluctant to harm "Them", or harbor the Desire to possess "Them", leading to lingering very briefly in admiration.
  • Darkness and Bizarreness Spells and abilities won't mar "Their" Beauty, but would instead make "Them" seem more dangerous, mysterious, and charming.
  • This is the authority of Beauty at a lower level.
  • Plants, Animals, Humans, & Supernatural Creatures: This ability arises both from "Their" mastery over the essence of Life and the irresistible attraction of Beauty.
  • A Beauty Goddess can thus Tame and Command those corresponding creatures.
  • In the same way, no one (of lower Sequence) can refuse "Their" Summoning.
  • Moon: A Beauty Goddess holds a certain authority over the Moon.
  • Just as Beauty is derived from Moon and Yin Energy, the Beauty Goddess may, within reasonable limits, draw upon the power of the Moon to shape environments favorable to "Themselves".
  • "They" can change the color of the Moon.

Sequence 0: Moon

Sanguine Rank: True Ancestor

Description

The Moon (including the symbols of Reproduction and Fertility) represents Spirituality, Plants, Beauty, Summoning, Animals, Humans, Beyonder Creatures, and partially Life, Darkness, and Bizarreness.

Symbolism

  • Moon: The Moon itself is more akin to a symbol than to an authority. Just as the Moon is Earth’s companion, the mother is the first companion of all life. This is the Moon’s most essential aspect. For that reason, it spans across multiple symbolisms:
  • Blood Moon: "She" can induce the Blood Moon (opens in a new tab) to appear every day, making Yin Energy runs rampant, causing the Spirit World and Reality to intertwine for extended periods of times.
  • This will unleash countless unspeakable monsters and Evil Spirits (opens in a new tab).
  • Crimson Moon: In the Crimson Moon, Yin Energy intensifies, and the Spirituality of beings as well as Spells related to Darkness and Bizarreness are enhanced.
  • Many Beyonder abilities arise from this symbolism.
  • Full Moon: Under the Full Moon, Life will flourish, Spirituality will stirs, and emotions will calm. The bonds/connections between people would also grow closer.
  • Silver Moon: The Silver Moon will restore the moon’s silvery hue as well as cut off the connection between Beyonders and the Crimson Moon.
  • This will renders all Beyonder powers tied to the Crimson Moon ineffective.
  • Waning Moon: When the Waning Moon occurs, it will cause the Darkness to deepen and Bizarreness to proliferate.

Authorities

  • Summoning: The Call of the Moon is able to attract very terrifying things. Examples of this include the Brood Hive (opens in a new tab) or Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab).
  • Even with the Seal on the Western Continent (opens in a new tab) and the Astral Barrier, it is not entirely impossible to Summon the Brood Hive (opens in a new tab) on the Northern Continent (opens in a new tab) or the Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab) on the planet respectively. This authority is one of the reasons why Zedus (opens in a new tab) was killed by "His" sister (opens in a new tab).
  • Beauty: "She" possesses the authority of Beauty. Whenever one sees the Moon, they will be reminded of the most unforgettable Beauty.
  • "She" is the second most Beautiful thing in the universe after the Brood Hive (opens in a new tab).
  • Life: "She" possesses a partial authority over Life and has eternal Life.
  • "She" can create or alter Living beings through this authority.
  • "She" is able to cleanse Corruption attached to Life.
  • "She" is able to Heal wounds and diseases.
  • "She" is able to grant or take back Life.
  • "She" can make a peach that extends one's Lifespan for a thousand years when consumed.
  • Plants, Animals, Humans, & Supernatural Creatures: This is a lower-level authority formed from the partial combination of the authority of Life and the authority of Beauty.
  • Therefore, "She" can Tame Plants, Animals, Humans, and other Supernatural Creatures.
  • During this process, one of the most important mediums is Blood, the symbol of Life.
  • Spirituality: The source of Spirituality, the Mother of All's Spiritual forces.
  • This authority is derived from Goddess of Origin and Mother of All Things of the Brood Hive (opens in a new tab).
  • "She" can make a group's Spirituality unable to recover, greatly increasing the cost of usage.
  • "She" can cause the Spirituality of a target group to erupt or spiral out of control.
  • Darkness: "She" possesses a partial authority over Darkness.
  • Different from the Darkness Pathway, the Moon's authority over Darkness is more about gaining access to Spells and traits that are derived from the Moon.
  • Bizarreness: "She" possesses a partial authority over Bizarreness.
  • The ambiguity and mystery of the Moon give rise to uncanny powers such as self-Substitution, terrifying Curses, Moonlight Transformation, etc.

Abyss Pathway

Sequence 9: Criminal

Description

Criminals do not suppress themselves. They do not feel constrained, and their body and heart are ruled by evil desires, but their conscience has not been completely annihilated, and their heart is not dead.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They possess a strong body with keen instincts.

New Abilities

  • Criminal Proficiency (Weapon, Criminal):⁂ Upon advancement, Criminals will gain knowledge of a variety of abilities that designate one a convict in addition to having great combat ability.
  • Regardless of the weapon, be it a knightly sword, a dagger, a longbow, a pistol, a rifle, a six-barrel machine gun, or a spoon; they can utilize all of them to kill a target effectively.

Sequence 8: Unwinged Angel (Coldblooded)

Description

Becoming an Unwinged Angel means that from that moment forth, they lose their conscience and indulge in their evil desires, possessing bodies that look even more inhuman. They don't have the concept of good and evil anymore.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancements: Their bodies are further strengthened and more inhuman.

New Abilities

  • Demonic Attribute:⁂ Upon entering this Sequence, they will undergo inhuman changes, acquiring two or three Devil Spell-like abilities in the process that vary from person to person.
  • Some could wield and create poisonous flames, cast weak Curses with Language of Foulness, or create a toxic black smoke. The most common of these Spell-like abilities is Slowness.

Sequence 7: Serial Killer

Traits

  • Enhanced Mental Attributes: Their intelligence and mental capabilities will be enhanced.

New Abilities

  • Knowledge (Devil Worship):⁂ Upon advancement, a Serial Killer will gain a wealth of and master all kinds of knowledge related to Devil worship and it's Ritualistic Magic.
  • By creating special or unique killing sprees, they would please and gain favors from Devils.
  • Serial Killers often tend to choose those who exhibit degraded behaviors, often linked to their personal traumas- as victims of their serial killing sprees.
  • Such Serial Killers enjoy creating unique serial killings but also commit their crimes not merely as a role, but also to please the Devils of the Abyss (opens in a new tab).
  • Once the serial killing cases are closed they would be able to perform the final step of this Ritual, letting them summon the corresponding Devil projection from the Abyss (opens in a new tab) and obtain it's assistance to achieve their desired outcome.
  • Serial Killers can summon these projections because the Devils respond to the Abyss Pathway’s unique abilities, not because those Devils themselves have attained the corresponding status.
  • Theoretically, the summoned Devil projection will obey the Ritual performer; however, if it's rank is too high or it finds a loophole to bypass the ritual's protection, it will obey the corresponding true Devil in the Abyss (opens in a new tab).
  • Interference: They can effectively interfere with Divination and **Spirit Channeling.

Sequence 6: Devil

Description

Devils biggest weakness is their tendency to easily lose control. Even if they do not lose control, they will often exhibit a kind of insanity that is a culmination of both cruelty and cold-bloodedness. They are very easily possessed and controlled by their desire for blood, murder, and various other things.

Individual Differences

  • Devil Bloodline:⁂ Different Devils morphed from being a Serial Killer will have individual differences. They will obtain unique racial abilities and physiques depending on the race they belong to.
  • This is because of the highly individualistic nature of the Abyss Pathway.
  • The reason behind this lies in the requirement of ostentatious malice, which varies from individual to individual. Unique wills, distinct hearts, and a penchant for Desires all conglomerate to form the diverse nature of Devils.
  • As a byproduct of this, even among Devils originating from the same Devil Bloodline, differences will naturally arise due to their individual nature.
  • Among such Devil species include but are not limited too:
  • Shadow-Shifter:⁂ When forced into a life-threatening situation, this type of Devil can escape with their bodies and leave only a shadow behind.
  • There is a very particular type of special Devil that is able to freely switch between body and spirit like a Wraith but they’re rather rare.
  • Certain Devils can skin humans and perform complicated processes to form Beyonder items with usage or time limitations.
  • No matter who it is, as long as they wear the human skin this Devil made as clothes, they can transform into the other person and disguise themselves.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: The first stage of qualitative changes in the Abyss Pathway is the comprehensive enhancement of the Devil's strength, speed, and defense.
  • Their skin has been mutated, equivalent to wearing a layer of hard armor while their their blood and flesh can act as a retardant that can block objects and reduce damage.
  • A Devil also possesses strong resistance capabilities, being immune to most toxins/poisons and not fearing any Curses or Flames within a certain level.

New Abilities

  • Danger Premonition (Malice Perception): They can sense and grasp the place of origin of danger, as well as who this danger is from. In this way, the Devil can precisely devise countermeasures, take revenge, or nip the threat in the bud. Different Devils have different degrees of this intuition.
  • Unlike a Monster's Danger Premonition, theirs doesn’t stem from Fate but from the Abyss (opens in a new tab).
  • Their Danger Premonition requires 3 conditions to be met before it can activate.
  1. If an existence is a fatal threat to the Devil and can cause life-threatening harm to them.
  2. Said existence is intending on doing such harm within a certain period and range.
  3. Said existence proceeds to actually act upon their intentions to harm the Devil.
  • Different variations of Devils would possess different degrees of Danger Premonition.
  • The "certain period" of sensing danger via Danger Premonition for some Devils can range from just a measly few minutes, to a whole entire 24 hours.
  • The range of a Devil’s Danger Premonition may only span from a few miles- or in other cases- span the range of an entire metropolitan area.
  • Apart from this, they aren’t good at Divination or other methods of sensing danger.
  • Language of Foulness: Devils can speak demonic words originating from the Abyss (opens in a new tab), filled with Filth and Corruption, and unleash their corresponding abilities. At this stage, they can use the following:
  • Slow: This causes all targets within a 7-8 meter radius to instantly turn numb and slow or even come to a halt, however, it can only be maintained for 2 seconds.
  • Death: This Spell causes the target's blood to rust and clot. Victims will cough out rusted clumps of blood and have rusted red marks appear on their skin.
  • If the enemy fails to avoid or resist the effect of a Devil's Death, it can directly cause them to die or become very close to dying.
  • This will make the target's heart feel as if it is being squeezed tightly by an invisible hand as they die covered in mottled red rust.
  • Corruption: An area of effect attack that can cause the targeted area and individuals within to start showing signs and symptoms of Abyss Corruption.
  • This will cover the enemy's body with a slightly viscous black liquid, which then explodes into shattered pieces of paper and corrupted black fog.
  • Upon advancing into this Sequence, Devils will gain access and mastery over a wide range of Spells, encompassing the fields of Fire, Poison, and Filth/Foulness.
  • Sulfur Fireball: They can launch multiple pale blue Fireballs that create a powerful explosion and poison anyone or anything that comes into contact with the Flames.
  • No more than 3 at a time can be launched and conjured.
  • Sword of Lava: They can conjure up a massive blade shaped Flaming sword that looks like a scimitar in design and holds extremely high attack power.
  • A Sword of Lava's damage against non-undead and non-corrupted creatures is significantly higher than the **Priest of Light's** Holy Light Summoning.
  • One swing from a Sword of Lava is capable of slicing a thick stone pillar in two, with the impact surface looking like it has been seared and melted.
  • Flame Cage: Within a certain range, a Devil will be able to conjure up a large Cage of Flames that can be used to block targets from escaping.
  • A pale blue Flame can also be ignited in the palm of their hand, causing bullets to be trapped in the Cage and solidify in the pale blue flame.
  • In addition, Devils also possess Spells and abilities such as Poisonous Flame Manipulation, Volcanic Eruption, Highly Toxic Vapor, etc.
  • Devil Transformation: Devils can transform into their true forms temporarily, gigantifying their bodies, giving them bat wings and goat horns, while also increasing their strength, speed, and defense as well. This is akin to breaking free of their bindings.
  • When they enter their Devil Transformation state, their skin will deeply mutates, appearing in a dull but actually deep, sinister black and their entire body seems to be covered in a thick, hard armor.
  • Their blood and flesh becoming extremely elastic and resilient.
  • While in their Devil Transformation state certain restrictions to Spells have been lessened. For example, they can now launch 10-20 Sulfur Fireballs simultaneously as opposed to just 3.
  • When creatures and people of different races become Devils, their outward appearance will differ; however, they will all share several common characteristics.
  • These details include gigantic bodies, deep black and sinister skin, curved and terrifying ram horns covered with countless mysterious patterns, and pale blue sulfur flames.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their foundation as a Serial Killer and Criminal has been improved. They excel at using all kinds of items and objects to cause harm, hold strong hand-to-hand capabilities, and don't panic or experience fear.
  • This is effectively an enhancement to a Serial Killer's Enhanced Mental Attributes and a Criminal's Criminal Proficiency when it comes to the Combat field.

Sequence 5: Desire Apostle

Individual Differences

  • Devil Bloodline:⁂ Different Devils will develop different special abilities after advancing into a Desire Apostle, such as Shadow Transformation and Desire Symbiosis.
  • Desire Symbiosis: Links the Desire Apostle to a certain Desire of the target.
  • Once this is done, as long as the corresponding Desire or goal is not destroyed, the Desire Apostle who possesses this ability cannot be completely killed.

New Abilities

  • Desire Control: Desire Apostles can utilize and control every existence's emotions and Desires.
  • As long as a target manifests an apparent emotional fluctuation (i.e anger/fear/despair) or has an increase in any type of Desire, they can immediately control that target from afar.
  • From there, they can either bury a Defiling Seed or catalyze the expressed emotion/Desire.
  • When a target's Desire gets catalyzed or a Defiling Seed sprouts the target would either:
  • Gradually become Corrupted by the catalyzed Desire, lose control over the targeted emotion, being unable to fight back or resist against the influence that emotion has on their actions and thoughts, or suffer an explosion of Desires.
  • When the amount of catalyzed Desire exceeds the maximum volume the target's body can withstand, the target will suffer a grave injury, a fatal wound, or damage that could even cause death if severe enough.
  • In cases where the amount of catalyzed Desire does not exceed the maximum volume the target's body can withstand, the target will be exposed to numerous problems, including but not limited too:
  • Emotional breakdown at crucial moments.
  • Gradual Degeneration.
  • Inability to resist.
  • If the target's alertness, tension, and vigilance are amplified by a catalyzed Desire, this can disrupt the target's sense of timing.
  • Mental Shock: They can ignite one of the 2 curved horns on their head to forcefully attack an enemy’s psyche, inducing emotions to a certain degree in an unavoidable manner.
  • It can't be used after the devil horns have burned out.
  • This belongs to the Desire Control branch.
  • Desire Incarnation: Desire Apostles can transform their body into being an illusory, thick, black liquid form that is a collection of condensed emotions and Desires given a semi-visible form.
  • The liquid is like a collection of the most wicked and shameful Desires in the human heart, sweeping around and surging towards the target with a corrupting influence.
  • While in this Desire Incarnation form, a Desire Apostle is quite effective at avoiding damage, hiding their trails, and even affecting their enemies with emotions/desires.

Strengthened Abilities

  • They have gained improvement of abilities in the previous Sequence.

Sequence 4: Demon

Description

The "Demons of the Body" and "Demons of the Mind".

New Abilities

  • Demon of the Mind: Demons are an advanced version of a Serial Killer. They are cold, sharp-minded, and sly. They are the textbook example of a standard high IQ creature.
  • They are cunning and enjoy misleading others.
  • In addition, they can effectively influence targets within a certain range, subtly and imperceptibly diminishing their thinking abilities.
  • This will make those affected careless and prone to errors.
  • Demon of the Body: Being a "Demon of the Body", they have physical attributes that are ranked pretty high on the total ranking list compared to other Demigods.
  • As a Demon, they possess Spells and Spell-like abilities that are ranked pretty high on the total ranking list when compared to other Sequence 4 Demigods.
  • They have gained new Spells such as Acid Swamp, Hellfire, Corrosive Fog, Filthy Illusion, and Projection that does not rely on the Abyss (opens in a new tab).

Strengthened Abilities

  • Desire Control: They have undergone a qualitative change. Now, Demons no longer need to wait for an expression or increase in a target’s Desires. They can now directly manipulate it through their actions.
  • Demons are able to make their targets fall into an unavoidable illusion. Their sorrow, anger, pain, greed, vanity, arrogance, and other Desires would rapidly swell as illusions of those Desires will manifest around them in the form of themselves exhibiting those emotions.
  • Some individuals would have their mind explode from the illusion while others lose their sanity or experience a loss of control due to the illusion of themselves exhibiting that Desire.
  • They can use sound, eye contact, movements, gestures, and various other means to directly influence those within a certain radius, making them enter into a state of delusion while their emotions and Desires will automatically expand at flying speeds.
  • After which, one of three things can happen:
  1. The target(s) cognition or sanity will be completely destroyed.
  2. The target(s) mind will be lit up like a fuse and explode.
  3. The target(s) will start the process of losing control.
  • Danger Premonition (Malice Perception): Their ability to sense danger has been enhanced.
  • Demons are exceptionally sensitive to danger and sometimes, they can even predict the possibility of a threat to their lives one to two days early in advance.
  • Filthy Language: A Demon will possess a more complete set of Language of Foulness.
  • Words like Confusion, Sloth and Blasphemy have been added to their repertoire.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences. Their Mythical Creature Form is mainly determined by race, individual personality, Desires, and will.
  • Devil Transformation: Even though manifesting the incomplete Mythical Creature Form can easily bring about losing control, Demons have a semi-solution around it. They can let a certain part or area of their body manifest the appearance and characteristics of their Mythical Creature Form. After which, they can maintain it that way for a prolonged period of time.
  • This way, they are often able to obtain unique, and bizarre effects and abilities related to the corresponding body part that has been Demonized

Sequence 3: Blatherer

Authorities

  • Corruption: A Blatherer has gained a certain degree of the Corruption authority, which is primarily concentrated in the realms of the Mind and Spirit.
  • Their voice and each and every word they utter can cause Beyonders to either lose control, suffer severe damage, experience mental confusion, or be hexed with all sorts of Curses.
  • Once a connection has been made, they can project their voice from an extremely distant location into a target’s ears, causing the target to inexplicably die suddenly in a safe location.
  • Similarly, if the Blatherer foresees the source of danger (for example via Malice Perception), they have the opportunity to exert a countering influence on the spot.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, "They" can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Bloody Archduke

Description

"They" wield portions of the authorities of “Malice” and “Body”. "Their" core abilities revolve around Blood, Bodily Fluids, Fear, and Malice.

Authorities

  • Malice: "They" have authority over the domain of Malice.
  • Incarnation of Malice: "Malice never dies, neither do Demons". "They" can plant a Seed of Malice deep within a target's psyche. When "Their" main body is destroyed, "They" can Resurrect within the target's Mind, igniting the target's Desires and Blood and killing the target.
  • If "Their" target's main body has a connected psyche to other bodies (e.g. an Unaging's Mirror Self), those psyches will also be eroded as well.
  • Using the Robe of Divine Blood (opens in a new tab), Emlyn White (opens in a new tab) revived within Katarina Pelle's (opens in a new tab) Mirror Self after she herself resurrected, killing her in the process.
  • A Bloody Archduke's Seed of Malice is also able to catalyze the Malice of the target, making the affected target temporarily Cold-Blooded.
  • If the target commits a truly Malicious act during this period, they will fall further into Depravity until they fall into an Abyss (opens in a new tab).
  • This can both cause a target to fall into Depravity as well as be transported to the actual Abyss (opens in a new tab) because of the fact that the Abyss (opens in a new tab) is in everyone's heart.
  • As an Angel-level (opens in a new tab) Devil, "Their" intense Malice and Desires can overpower other entities' mental control abilities over "Them", be it from active influence or passive effect.
  • Rather than succumbing to a Demoness of Catastrophe's Charm, "They" would develop an intense possessiveness, enabling "Them" to act decisively instead of being frozen in place.
  • Malice brings forth Fear to the target. This is a pure and instinctive Fear that can cause the Mind to go blank, making difficult for those affected to think and act.
  • Body: "They" also have authority over the domain of Body.
  • Blood Sovereign: "They" command the Blood and Bodily Fluids of "Themselves" and others.
  • As long as a single drop of Blood or Bodily Fluid has not been destroyed, a Bloody Archduke can quickly return and regenerate "Their" body.
  • A Bloody Archduke can use "Their" own Blood and Bodily Fluids in order to Corrode and Pollute the external world and targets.
  • Being corroded under "Their" influence or touch would make "Their" opponents bleed from all orifices of their body as both their Blood and Desires get ignited until death.

Strengthened Abilities

  • All abilities from "Their" previous Sequences have been further enhanced.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" have become a full Mythical Creature, with "Their" main characteristic being that they seem to be made of congealed Blood, capable of liquefying and coalescing.

Sequence 1: Filthy Monarch

Authorities

  • Filth, Corruption, Corrosion, & Flames: A Filthy Monarch wields portions of the authorities of Filth, Corruption, Corrosion, and Flames.
  • King of Filth: "They" are the ruler of all that is Dirty, Sinful, and Unclean.
  • "They" are able to summon those things at any time to provide assistance, and can also directly affect targets that possess those characteristics.
  • Even Angels (opens in a new tab) of the same Sequence level will suffer a degree of contamination when "They" witness or approach the King of Filth.
  • The only exception is if those Angels (opens in a new tab) belong to domains such as the Sun or similarly Purifying authorities.
  • The Corroder: Even the strongest barrier will be penetrated by continuous Corrosion over a certain period of time.
  • The Flames, Fog and the environment that is created by The Corroder all reflect this characteristic.
  • Flames of the Abyss: This is a Flame that combines Burning, Corrosion, Toxins, and Corruption properties.
  • Most Beyonders’ defenses against Flames only address Burning, leaving them dangerously vulnerable to the Flames of the Abyss' other aspects.

Strengthened Abilities

  • All Beyonder abilities from "Their" previous Sequences have been further enhanced.

Mythical Creature Form

  • The Mythical Creature Form of a Filthy Monarch presents a terrifying image like that of a nightmare in a Filthy and deep black expanse.

Sequence 0: Abyss

Description

The Abyss wields partial authorities of Degeneration, Filth, Corruption, Desire, Curses, and Deviants. Those authorities are then further divided into lower authorities such as Corrosion, Malice, Toxins, Flames, and Body and is characterized by "The Abyss is me, and I am the Abyss."

Symbolism

  • Abyss of the Heart: The authorities of Degeneration, Filth, Corruption, Desire, Curse all involve the Mind authority, or rather, only when the Mind authority is combined with them, or with parts of them, can they be considered truly complete.
  • This also reflects that the Abyss is a symbol of the Abyss of the Heart/Mind.

Authorities

  • Degeneration (Depravity): "They" have partial authority over Degeneration.
  • If the Hanged Man embodies the Degenerate Nature of every living being, then the Abyss is the environment that inevitably leads all those within it to Degenerate, not only inducing Degeneration but also creating it.
  • Corruption: "They" have partial authority over Corruption.
  • It is both an outward extension of Depravity and Corruption, and an inevitable outcome of the explosion of Desire and the loss of rational control.
  • Filth: The Abyss possesses a partial authority over Filth.
  • Filth is a component of the Abyss, a manifestation of all unclean things, which brings multiple impacts and influences on the Body, Mind, and Soul.
  • Toxins: The Abyss possesses a partial Toxins authority, with it being a lower authority under "Their" partial authority over Filth.
  • Demons and Toxins coexist; and "They" master most types of Toxins and those Toxins possessing the characteristics of the Demon Pathway.
  • Desire: "They" have partial authority over Desires.
  • The Abyss’s authority over Desire lies more in inducing, catalyzing, and igniting Desires, rather than embodying Desire itself like the remnants within the Mother Tree of Desire (opens in a new tab).
  • Curses: "They" have partial authority of Curses.
  • Compared to the Chained, "Their" Curses are primarily in the domains of Spirit and Mind.
  • Deviants: "They" have partial authority of Deviants.
  • The impact on lower levels of this authority manifests as Demons exhibiting different Mutations based on personal traits and environmental factors.
  • At the higher levels, it's benefit is that the Abyss possesses and encompasses all such different Mutations, embracing everything.
  • Body: "They have partial authority over Body, focused on controlling and transforming the Body which is a lower authority under Deviants.
  • Malice: "They" are the wielder of Malice, the embodiment of Malice.
  • "They" can turn into a pool of black liquid which manifests Malice, Desire, and evil intent that is real and illusory and that can enter an entity's body, mind, and soul as a Seed of Malice.
  • Not only can this be used to travel with the target across various places (including following a target during a Secret Deed Ritual), this form can also be used to travel across other living beings due to the concept that there is a mental Abyss in everyone's heart.
  • This is a lower authority born from Degeneration and Desires.
  • Flame: "They" have partial authority over Flame.
  • "They" control the Flame of Degeneration, Corruption, Toxins, and Corrosion.
  • "Their" Flame authority is a lower authority under Deviants and Curses.
  • Corrosion: All things can be Corroded.
  • This is a lower authority derived from the authorities of Filth and Corruption.
  • Abyssal Sea of the Mind/Heart: Essentially, the Divine Kingdom of this Pathway is the Abyss (opens in a new tab).
  • This Divine Kingdom exhibits different characteristics and has different names depending on the tendency of its Sequence 0.

Mythical Creature Form

  • The Mythical Creature Form of the Abyss is not fixed as one will see what they fear most or what they yearn for the most, which is similar to the adjacent Chained Pathway, reflecting the fact that there is an Abyss (opens in a new tab) at the bottom of the human heart.
  • Everyone's Abyss (opens in a new tab) is different, and the Abyss presents a different image in their eyes.

Chained Pathway

Sequence 9: Prisoner

Description

The mind is a Prisoner of the body, and the body is a Prisoner of the world. This refers to the madness that is bound and the Desires that are suppressed. The Prisoner is not only a person locked in a prison, but also a person whose Spirituality and Desires are restrained by reason, the body and the world.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: The Beyonders (opens in a new tab) of this Sequence possess strong bodies and keen senses, often possessing not only a staid appearance but also a crazy heart within them.

New Abilities

  • Knowledge (Criminal): Upon advancement, Prisoners will gain knowledge of a variety of abilities that designate one as not only an expert convict but also a master of breaking free from prisons.
  • They gain knowledge that makes them masters of many criminal techniques, such as lock picking with wire, digging tunnels with soup spoons, and killing with seemingly harmless items.
  • They are also possess knowledge that makes them good at using bombs and explosives.
  • Binding: Upon advancement by drinking the Prisoner potion, they will find that their Spirituality and Desires are being constrained by reason, body, and the world.

Sequence 8: Lunatic

New Abilities

  • Berserk: A Lunatic's greatest characteristic is to be able to autonomously sacrifice their rationality and let their Desires run amok in exchange for strength and enhancements in every aspect of themselves.
  • Apart from a Lunatic's mind becoming somewhat unclear during that period, there are not many problems when entering this Berserk state.
  • A Lunatic may even gain stronger resistance towards Beyonder powers that can disrupt their thoughts and influence their mind.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Binding: Lunatics are Bound and restrained in both body and Soul, which makes it difficult to obtain useful information on them by just relying on Spirit Channeling and Divination.

Curse

  • Lunatic's Curse: Starting and from this Sequence onwards, they will begin to be affected by Curses. At Sequence 8, a Lunatic's Curse makes them easily lose control more easily than most Beyonders.

Sequence 7: Werewolf

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Even without transforming, a Werewolf's extreme speed will form afterimages, they also possess terrifying strength, agility, and outstanding self-healing abilities.
  • They can also survive a Pyromaniac's blazing-white compressed Fireball, which possesses explosive power comparable to their Giant Fireball spell but even more concentrated.

New Abilities

  • Werewolf Transformation: They can turn into a Werewolf, growing short, erect hair as fur, turning their nails sharp, long, and firm, like claws, while possessing some Spell-like abilities.
  • While in this form, they will possess terrifying strength, agility, regeneration, and speed.
  • A Werewolf's claws and teeth are equivalent to Beyonder weapons of the same Sequence, capable of destroying thinner steel plates in addition to being poisonous.
  • They are particularly weak to the theurgical Spell-like abilities or Spells from the Sun domain such as a Solar High Priest's Holy Light Summoning.
  • A Werewolf possesses powerful regenerative abilities. This is a trait that will remain even when they exit their Werewolf Transformation form.
  • Even if a hideous wound appears on their abdomen and their intestines spill out, they will only need to wash it with water, stuff the intestines back in, and pinch the side of the gap with one's hands. Eventually the wound will heal.
  • They can outrun a gray wolf while chasing it at full speed.
  • Werewolves can transform partially in order to utilize some of their capabilities.
  • For example, instead of fully turning into a Werewolf to use Werewolf Infection or their sharp claws, they could simply manifest those claws on their hands.
  • Werewolves also possess the ability to use some Spell-like abilities.
  • Werewolf Kin:⁂ When their venom infiltrates a target's body over a period of time, they can turn the target into a puppet similar to a Werewolf for a period of time.
  • The monsters that are created by Werewolf Kin are under the Werewolf's control and typically possess a very short lifespan.
  • Darkness Encroachment: They can make the Darkness grow heavier and condense like frost, slowly but firmly seeping into their target's skin, flesh, and bones
  • This causes an uncontrollable fear to well up within a target's mind, making it hard for them to think straight or move rationally, this also causes a slight impairment.
  • Repel Light: A Werewolf is also able to slightly deepen the surrounding Darkness, banishing faint light or the crimson Moonlight.
  • Anti-Divination: Regardless of whether or not the Beyonder (opens in a new tab) has transformed, any Divination or spiritual means can only reveal a figure covered in black hair, making it impossible to see their true appearance.

Curse

  • Werewolf's Curse: Every Full Moon, they will lose part of their sanity, grow black fur, and their bloodlust and desire for tasting blood would reach its peak.
  • A Werewolf who is always unable to suppress their instinct to kill and their bloodlust during a Full Moon will turn increasingly cold and more twisted, losing their humanity in the process.
  • Certain Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab), particularly those corresponding to a Scarlet Scholar, allow them to maintain their rationality in the event of a Full Moon. This is also applies to the curses of a Zombie and Wraith, which also activate during a Full Moon.

Sequence 6: Zombie

Traits

  • Zombie Transformation: Advancing to this Sequence, they have become a special type of Zombie, one that possesses powerful defense, strength, and Spell-like capabilities.
  • A Zombie's physical body have been greatly enhanced, making their bodies as hard as steel.
  • A revolver shot directly to their head would make them dizzy at best, with them needing to be shot five times in the same spot to break their defenses.
  • If their defenses get broken, all physical damage isn't lethal if their head isn't destroyed.
  • Their defense is weak to Purification powers, or direct attacks to their Spirit Body.
  • They are also immune to fire, drowning, and many types of magic.
  • Their supernatural healing has been drastically improved, with bone-deep wounds now being able to heal in a short period of time.
  • Zombie Strength: Their strength has been raised significantly from their Werewolf state.
  • They can run faster than a steam locomotive at its peak speed, unleash a critical attack that is stronger then their normal blows as well as ferocious attacks that can tear opponents apart.
  • Ice Control: They have some Ice and Frost mastery, which is different from a Witch.
  • Contact-Freeze: Any physical attack from a Zombie that makes contact with a target's skin can Freeze their body, stiffening their flesh and blood.
  • Ice Stun: Zombies are able to Seal their opponents by encasing them in Ice. This also seems to preserve the target's bodily functions as well.
  • Ice Wall Formation: Zombies are able to directly Freeze the water that they come into contact with and form them into Ice walls.
  • Ice Slipping Area: Zombies are able to quickly condense and create slippery layers of Ice to affect their target's movement.
  • They are able to lower the air temperature, causing strong winds to blow around and beautiful dreamlike snowflakes to fall.
  • This can effectively interfere with a target's movements.
  • They also wield some powers over Decay, Rot, and Withering domain.
  • Aura of Decay: Zombies are able to emit an aura of Decay, making the surrounding vegetation visibly wither away while weakening surrounding enemies.
  • Wither Explosion: They can make the air within a mid-range of them explode into countless black wisps that induce Withering upon impact.
  • Rotting Body Aura: A Zombie's body can effuse out a Rotting aura to augment each and every one of their attacks with the trait of Decay.
  • Rotting Sludge Creation: They are able to create Rotting sludge near them to affect their target's movement and strength.
  • Zombie Manipulation: They possess abilities centered around controlling the Dead.
  • They can easily awaken the dead, cultivate puppets, control ghosts, and command them.

Strengthened Abilities

  • The traits and abilities of the previous Sequence remained unchanged without significant alteration.

Curse

  • Zombie's Curse: They thirst for the warm blood and fresh meat of human beings. When the Full Moon shines, this state will be particularly serious, causing them great pain, if they don't give up on self-control, they will be in so much pain that they will lose their ability to fight.
  • This can be limited with the use of certain medicines such as sedatives, however, they would eventually build up resistance against that specific type of medicine, rendering it ineffective. Sedatives made by Beyonders (opens in a new tab) such as Apothecaries would be more effective.
  • The only solace one can gain is that the Zombie's Curse replaces the Werewolf's and Lunatic's Curse. They do not exist together, and it’s the same later on.

Sequence 5: Wraith

Description

Their bodies are like a fusion of spirit and flesh, allowing them to transform their state into a true phantom and gain corresponding abilities, such as passing through obstacles, hiding in Mirrors, and directly attacking the Soul of their opponent. In addition, unlike ordinary Wraiths (opens in a new tab), even those with Spirit Vision cannot detect these phantoms unless they are at a high Sequence level.

Traits

  • Zombie Transformation: Apart from certain abilities, most of their capabilities as a Zombie remained largely unchanged, without significant improvement.
  • Their Ice Control and Zombie Manipulation ability as a Zombie has improved.
  • Zombie Manipulation: They can still control the undead like with their Zombie Form even in their Wraith Transformation state
  • Ice Control: The Zombie's Ice Control at the Sequence 5 level, which they can use even during Wraith Transformation.
  • They can condense thin, translucent, hard to see Icicles to attack their enemies, create reflective surfaces to use Mirror Blink, extinguish flames, and wither vegetation.
  • Spirituality: Wraiths are able to directly communicate with the Spirit World to gain information.
  • Their Divination and Spiritual Intuition will thus be greatly enhanced at this Sequence.

New Abilities

  • Wraith Transformation: They are able to turn themselves into a Spirit Body, a Wraith, thus obtaining all the general corresponding powers and special traits.
  • As a fusion of spirit and flesh, Wraiths have tremendous resilience in both their mind and body, being able to survive after they lose their head.
  • Psychic attacks like an Interrogator's Psychic Piercing typically wouldn't significantly affect them. A Wraith can even cause the psychic attack to backfire on their opponent.
  • Should a Wraith be incapacitated, they will lack the corresponding ability to reflect such psychic attacks onto their opponents.
  • They are weak to Purification powers such as Light of Holiness from a Priest of Light and Lightning Strike from an Ocean Songster when in their Spirit Body state.
  • Demon-Hunting and Exorcism-type Mystical Items (opens in a new tab), Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab), and Beyonder powers can hurt a Wraith, but it would not be fatal or very dangerous to them.
  • They can go without eating or drinking for about 2 weeks and are immune to biological poison, regular flames, and many forms of physical attacks.
  • Purely physical weapons or firearms without special powers cannot harm Wraiths.
  • Their existence as a Wraith allows them to avoid instant death when entering the Underworld, however, lingering for too long will prevent them from reverting to their human form, forever existing as a true Wraith.
  • A Wraith is able to temporarily avoid the Underworld's influence by Possessing an undead creature.
  • Wraiths also possess various auxiliary and support abilities and traits. Most of these abilities aren't unique as they are common in many normal Wraiths and spirits.
  • Spirit World Traversal: Since they can be considered Spirit World creatures to an extent, they can freely enter and exit the Spirit World and move freely within it.
  • However, they can't compare to Spirit World creatures specialized in this area.
  • Wraiths also possess the characteristics of being able to pass through physical obstacles, Fly through the air, and see through the dark, and hide inside Mirrors.
  • Invisibility: Wraiths are able to turn Invisible; however, unlike other ordinary Wraiths and spirits, this is more effective.
  • They are hard to detect for most Low to Mid-Sequence Beyonders. Even with Spirit Vision, it will be hard to discover them unless one was a High Sequence Beyonder.
  • Since they are unable to hide their scent, Potions Professors can detect their presence through their discernment of smell.
  • Since they are unable to hide their Spirit Body Threads through Invisibility, they can be seen by Marionettists.
  • Wraith Shriek: Wraiths are able to let out a sharp shriek that can directly attack the opponents' Spirit Body and induce spiritual damage across a huge area.
  • Depending on the target's resilience they could either be knocked unconscious, be close to that state, or be interrupted for a moment and stunned as they experience terrible pain.
  • Wraith Possession: Wraiths have gained the ability to forcefully invade and Possess their target's body by overlapping with the opponent's eyes.
  • Even when they are Possessing a target, a Wraith will not at all be restrained in their capabilities, being able to become Intangible and utilize their abilities freely.
  • They can accelerate Beyonder Characteristic separation from a corpse by Possessing the target, killing them in that state, and having full control over the body.
  • Using a simple Ritual they gained along with Possessing a target's body, a Wraith can help a person draw things realistically from said person's memories.
  • If their target has a strong body, the Wraith can make them directly commit suicide by decapitation using the target's own bare hands.
  • If the target is killed by a physical attack with the Wraith still possessing them, the Wraith will be unharmed as they are immune.
  • If the target is killed by some other type of attack that can affect the Wraith, they will suffer the corresponding damage.
  • Mirror Blink: Wraiths are also able to instantly jump through most things with reflections, such as mirrors, gold coins, ice, and even eyeballs.
  • The maximum range they can Mirror Blink is 300 meters.
  • This is also known as Mirror Flash or Mirror Jump.
  • Wraiths wield many Death-related Spells and abilities.
  • Vengeful Wraith's Entanglement: One of their Death-related Spells. Its function is to summon a large number of special undead creatures to fix the target in place, paralyzing and stiffening them, making it difficult for one to move.
  • The specific effects vary depending on the type of undead creatures summoned.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Anti-Divination: There Anti-Divination traits as a Werewolf has been enhanced.
  • Any Divination that is directed at them will only show a transparent, seemingly non-existent face or a face shrouded in Darkness.

Curse:

  • Wraith's Curse: On the night of a Full Moon, a Wraith would either need to consume a certain number of human Souls or become extremely weak and both in their body and mind.
  • Choosing the former is equivalent to being on the brink of losing control at any moment.

Sequence 4: Puppet

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Their physical durability has been enhanced.
  • Aside from Sun Domain divine Spells, they can withstand more damage than a **Shaman King**.
  • Spirituality: A Puppet also possesses an enhanced Spirituality.
  • Spiritual Intuition: They possess a formidable Spiritual Intuition.

New Abilities

  • Source of Curses: Puppets are able to transform themselves into mystical puppets and magical paper figurines identical to that of the target. Then through the established connections, Puppets are able to use various different methods as a means to Curse their targets.
  • In order to be able to transform themselves into mystical puppets identical to their target, a Puppet will need to have to first form an established connection.
  • At Sequence 4, they can only hurt the enemy by hurting themselves. Any damage to them will be reflected on the connected target and vice versa.
  • Poltergeist:⁂ Every Puppet can awaken and control all lifeless objects within a certain range. This allows them to utilize their surroundings as weapons and traps.
  • They can control ownerless Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) and Mystical Items (opens in a new tab) that are not held or controlled by anyone physically or through Spirituality.
  • The General of the Pupil-less Eye (opens in a new tab) controlled the Vision of White (opens in a new tab) immediately after the Sealed Artifact (opens in a new tab) was thrown by Emlyn White (opens in a new tab), forming a pillar of light that enveloped Sharron (opens in a new tab).
  • Puppets are able to transform inanimate objects in their surroundings into weapons they can shoot out at high speeds.
  • The General of the Pupil-less Eye (opens in a new tab) let out a scream, shattering the surrounding windows that turned into bullets that shot towards the floating Sharron (opens in a new tab).
  • They can control objects that are in contact with living beings, including Demigods.
  • Shanks (opens in a new tab) tightened Klein Moretti's (opens in a new tab) clothes as if a bear were giving him a hug, almost shattering his ribs and preventing movement as paper figurines covered his face to prevent him from breathing.
  • To counteract the actions of Georgina Augustus (opens in a new tab), Zatwen (opens in a new tab) first Stole her thoughts using a Error Pathway Sealed Artifact (opens in a new tab) before restraining her tightly with her own gown.
  • Zatwen (opens in a new tab) and Mahmosi (opens in a new tab) controlled the guns and machines of MI9 (opens in a new tab), including those held by soldiers, to their advantage against Celt (opens in a new tab) and Georgina Augustus (opens in a new tab).
  • Performance: A Puppet is able to Perform roles such as a Prisoner, Lunatic, Werewolf, Zombie, and Wraith, elevating those Beyonder powers and traits to a weak Sequence 4 with divinity.
  • For example, a Wraith will be able to Possess a Sealed Artifact (opens in a new tab).
  • Objectification: They can transform into a true Puppet, forcefully restraining their inner madness and Desires, but they cannot influence or interfere with the outside world in return.
  • A Puppet can only protect themself through pre-prepared, triggered or area of effect Curses and other controlled Puppets.
  • The Objectification Beyonder power can also be used on others to temporarily control their madness or Seal it.
  • However, at this Sequence the other party must be willing and there must be physical contact.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Evil Spirit Transformation: Their original Wraith Transformation form and it's powers and attributes have entered a qualitative change, allowing them to turn into an Evil Spirit (opens in a new tab).
  • Binding: At this stage, they can restrain the tendency of Convergence (opens in a new tab).
  • However, it is only at Sequence 0 where it can be at the same degree as the Door Pathway.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences and become an incomplete collection of various Curses which are both invisible and intangible.
  • The outward appearance of their incomplete Mythical Creature Form depends on their own self-awareness and choices made during their advancement. it acts as a base to bind and stabilize the various Curses resulting from their disassembly process.
  • A Puppet of the Temperance Faction of the Rose School of Thought (opens in a new tab) would therefore have the outward appearance of a Demigod-level mummy.

Sequence 3: Disciple of Silence (Cursed Artifact)

New Abilities

  • Silent Curse Brewing: With prolonged silence, a Disciple of Silence can brew the most potent Curse, rendering a target powerless to resist.

Strengthened Abilities

  • They have gained improvements to other abilities in the previous Sequence.
  • Evil Spirit Transformation: As a Cursed Artifact, they can Possess objects.
  • Source of Curses: There has been a qualitative change to this ability.
  • A Disciple of Silence using Source of Curses doesn't need to hurt themselves to affect the target but could do so anyways to enhance a Curse's effectiveness.
  • Sharron (opens in a new tab) opted to pluck her eye reflecting Mirror Roselle Gustav (opens in a new tab) to enhance a Curse that had the capability of banishing the latter deep within the Spirit World.
  • They are also capable of using Source of Curses to achieve effects like banishment, fixation, and sleep through different methods or corresponding media.
  • Sharron (opens in a new tab) transformed herself into a dim and stiff doll, then encased herself in layers of Ice which simultaneously emerged around Oxyto (opens in a new tab)'s child, fixing it in place within an Ice Cage.
  • Transfiguration Curse: Both a Curse and qualitative change to Objectification, they can emit a silent scream that transforms their target into a harmless creature, losing most of their traits and Beyonder powers for a certain time period.
  • At this level, a Transfiguration Curse can only affect a single entity at a time.
  • Both living and non-living objects can be affected by this Curse.
  • The effects of this Curse transfers across connected bodies.
  • As such, this will also affect a Demoness of Unaging's Mirror Self.
  • A dormant Mirror Person is exempt from this effect, however, because their true body is reduced to a defenseless animal, the Demoness of Unaging's Resurrection arrangements become vulnerable.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Ancient Bane

Trait

  • Dwelling Space: Ancient Banes need a Dwelling Place, which is a manifestation of "Their" Restraint and also the best way to find and destroy what "They" Possess.
  • if the object "They" are bound to is not destroyed, "They" are immortal and indestructible.

New Abilities

  • Bane: As a type of Deviant, "They" can cause all sorts of negative influences on a target that approach or witness "Them" while "They" are not in "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab).
  • This can range from causing the affected targets to have very strong Evil thoughts, having their values changed, Desires explode, or even losing control on the spot.
  • Spirit Influence: "They" possess the ability to directly influence and attack Spirits.
  • "They" can open "Their" mouth and inhale, forming a cold breeze that forcibly pulls the enemy's Spirit, making it impossible to maintain a state of hiding.

Authorities

  • Curses: "They" have gained a partial authority over Curses.
  • Source of Curses: "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) manifests as a vessel used in Advancement (opens in a new tab).
  • If "They" understand a target's core information, "They" can create Paper Figurines, Puppets, or other mediums to Curse the other party from afar, or even cause them to die suddenly.
  • The patterns, designs, ornaments, and every detail on the vessel are manifestations of different Curses, and any living being that sees it would suffer the corresponding Curse.
  • The surrounding environment will also be affected by "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab), distorted by nature and becoming tainted with various weakened Curses.
  • Transfiguration Curse: This is "Their" Transfiguration Curse now at the Angel (opens in a new tab)-level.
  • As long as the Curse remains, the affected targets are true animals. The limbs that are left behind after a Beyonder is transformed contain some Beyonder Characteristics.
  • Those limbs cannot return from their original state.
  • "They" no longer need to emit a silent scream to affect a target. Now, merely any target that is reflected in "Their" eyes can be Cursed and transformed accordingly.
  • Multiple targets at a time can be affected by a single Transfiguration Curse, and there is almost no limit for the duration a target can be in the Cursed state.
  • Apart from putting up resistance from someone at the same level, one can use the correct method to remove it. No Curse is irreversible. There are always exploitable Loopholes. Otherwise, the Transfiguration Curse cannot be dispelled.
  • "They" can create Curses rooted in one's hatred, anger, and grudges.
  • Reinette Tinekerr (opens in a new tab), who had created a Curse whose root has lied in the anger, hatred, and “Her” grudge that had emerged after “She” suffered an attack, used it in order to repel a piece of "distorted" wood as well as stagger and stun Abomination Suah (opens in a new tab) for a second.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "They" have gained improvements to other abilities of the previous Sequence.
  • Evil Spirit Transformation: The capabilities regarding "Their" Evil Spirit (opens in a new tab) form has been enhanced.
  • Resurrection: With the necessary and prior preparations done beforehand, "They" can Resurrect in the Spirit World in the form of a Spirit World creature.
  • Having had been a Wraith makes this much simpler compared to other Pathways.
  • When Resurrecting this way, "They" will be left with an incomplete body.
  • Reinette Tinekerr (opens in a new tab), after "Her" fall in battle against Suah (opens in a new tab) and other foes, Resurrected in the Spirit World and now attempts to complete "Her" incomplete body.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature. "Their" true Mythical Creature Form is that of a collection of various Curses which are both invisible and intangible.
  • The outward appearance of their complete Mythical Creature Form depends on their own self-awareness and choices made during their advancement as well "Their" core- an ancient, evil item that can bear Angel (opens in a new tab)-level power that is the vessel that carries "Their" aggregate Curses.
  • Reinette Tinekerr (opens in a new tab)'s Mythical Creature Form is a castle-sized doll with blood-red eyes, dressed in a black gothic dress with countless mysterious symbols and sinister vines.
  • For those like Suah (opens in a new tab) and Tirié (opens in a new tab) who have not completed the corresponding rituals, "They" exhibit outward forms that are amplifications of "Their" Beyonder Characteristics.
  • By relying on "Their" inherent vessel and corresponding symbol, an Ancient Bane can enter the Historical Void (opens in a new tab); however, "They" are not able to surpass the era in which the vessel appeared.
  • Within the parts "They" can trace back to, an Ancient Bane is able to counter the History of the Fool Pathway to some extent. This is achieved through Curses.

Sequence 1: Abomination

Literal Translation: Divine Abomination

Authorities

  • Deviants: "They" possess some of the Deviants authority.
  • Transformation: The Curse of an Abomination can not only deform the surrounding creatures, but also transform them into Werewolves, Zombies, Puppets and other Deviant species.
  • However, these Deviant Puppets can only be maintained for a short time and will soon be devoured by madness, turning into corpses or flesh tainted by the curse.
  • "They" can display "Their" true form as Abominations, gaining the corresponding abilities.
  • In "Their" true form, "Their" arms will lengthen; it's surface dark and sticky with a strange liquid flowing from it. Pale skulls, eyeballs with obvious blood vessels, tongues with fangs, and all sorts of other strange-shaped things will grow out from the strange liquid.
  • "They" can emit an eerie roar that pierces the spirit, causing all surrounding creatures to tremble, be somewhat stiff, and suddenly go blank in the mind, briefly losing all thoughts.
  • Abomination Suah's (opens in a new tab) roar had caused the surrounding individuals near "Him" to suddenly pause in movement, their minds going blank and thoughts lost.
  • "Their" true form in this state, not "Their" Mythical Creature Form, inherently carries the effects of Madness, Evil, Distortion, Chaos, Hatred, Indulgence, and Curse.
  • This will cause effects equivalent to revealing "Their" Mythical Creature Form in "Their" area as well as a strong inclination for extreme madness and Evil.
  • One could say that "Their" true forms were a product of "Their" self-perception combined with "Their" complete Mythical Creature Form.
  • In "Their" true form, "They" are able to extend "Their" own deformed arms into the sky and into the ground in order to Seal the surroundings.
  • Curses: "They" have gained more power over this authority.
  • "They" can create Curses normally undetectable even by Saints and that can hit the main body through any connection, making the target to suffer an unexpected and sudden death.
  • In an attempt to suppress Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab), a Historical Projection of Abomination Suah (opens in a new tab) which was controlled by Zaratul (opens in a new tab) Cursed a Marionette that "He" had controlled.
  • Abomination Suah (opens in a new tab) had formed a Curse that hit Klein Moretti's (opens in a new tab) main body (which was in the Historical Void (opens in a new tab) through a Historical Projection that he was operating.)
  • "They" can cause the surrounding Spirituality to deviate, seemingly forming layer upon layers of barriers in an attempt to restrain the target in place and restrict their movements.
  • This is the effect of a Curse upon the environment.
  • While Suah (opens in a new tab) restricted Klein's (opens in a new tab) body and Soul, the surroundings also formed a barrier as the scarlet flames Klein (opens in a new tab) came out of from Flaming Jump bound him to the ground.
  • Near Suah's (opens in a new tab) area, the surrounding Spirituality had transformed into layers of barriers that restrained and restricted Klein (opens in a new tab) and Reinette Tinekerr's (opens in a new tab) every action.
  • Similarly, "They" can cause the vicinity to boil, covering it in viscous black liquid that erodes upwards into the void, disrupting the overlap between Reality and the Spirit World.
  • However, this doesn't immediately disable abilities that use the Spirit World like Teleportation, needing time to completely take effect.
  • Even if a target wasn't directly attacked by "Them" or is a main target of "Their" attacks, "They" can still cause them to face constant erosion and Curses without their knowledge.
  • This affects and makes one's Spirituality "frozen" slightly, seemingly restraining the body and Soul. As the degree of harmony between their body and Soul gradually decreases, their body will gradually be a prison for the spirit, making their movements more stiff and heavy.
  • Suah (opens in a new tab) used this on Klein (opens in a new tab), causing the harmony of his body and Soul to decrease, making his actions and movements be more rigid, slow, and heavy
  • "They" can make dolls the size of a palm appear on "Their" hand which can fuse into something like a Worm of Spirit, transforming into the shape and form of the Worm of Spirit's owner.
  • This will create a connection between the doll and the owner of the Worm of Spirit.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "They" have gained improvements to other abilities in the previous Sequence.
  • Evil Abomination: "They" can rapidly spread feelings of extreme Evil and madness, instantly dry up the surroundings, and cause others' consciousness to be infected with madness.
  • The effect of causing others' consciousness be infected with madness will either result in sudden death, mutation, or attacks on their own people, making them temporarily unable to take effective countermeasures.

Mythical Creature Form

  • If an Abomination has not completed "Their" previous Sequence advancement rituals, "They" would exhibit a Mythical Creature Form of a grotesque tree-like shape coated in viscous black liquid.
  • Creatures who are affected by "Their" Godhood without a sufficient level or protection will be mutated, turning into Werewolves or Zombies.

Sequence 0: Chained

Description

Because of the Symbolism of Binding and Unity, the authorities of the Chained are highly concentrated, mainly focused on Curses, Binding (Temperance), Deviants, and Objects.

Symbolism

  • "They" can apply surface-level symbolism through "Their" authority over Curses.

Authorities

  • Curses: At Sequence 0, "Their" authority over Curses initially manifests through symbolic applications, allowing "Them" to cause targets to unknowingly suffer Curses.
  • Compared to the Chained, the Abyss' Curses are primarily in the domains of Spirit and Mind.
  • "They" can complete all kinds of Curses, and it is very difficult for “Them” to be Cursed.
  • Many symbolic connections cannot affect "Them" unless a strong and direct link exists.
  • Deviants: The Chained is the King of Deviants, capable of transforming into all kinds of Deviants that can exist only for a short period of time and controlling their corresponding abilities.
  • Deviants are monsters formed by the negative effects of Beyonder Characteristics, including Devils and those who have lost control on other Pathways.
  • All Deviants are naturally suppressed when facing the Chained, and those at low to mid Sequences may directly become "Their" loyal servants.
  • The Chained can allow every type of Deviant to pray to "Them" in the simplest manner and receive "Their" response and assistance.
  • Binding (Temperance): "They" can Restrain or Seal the various tendencies of Madness, Desires, Objects, creatures, and Beyonder Characteristics.
  • In this aspect, if something does not reach the level of Sealing, the Chained is stronger than the Door; however, the Door surpasses the Chained within the Sealing domain.
  • With proper use of Temperance, a King of Angels (opens in a new tab) of this Pathway can make the  ![Chained Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Chained_Pathway) Chained Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) and 3 Beyonder Characteristics to exist simultaneously within "Their" body without triggering a qualitative change.
  • This prevents immediate loss of control or death on the spot.
  • The Chained can sever the connection between Reality and the Spirit World, Restraining Beyonder powers that rely on direct Spirit World usage.
  • Conversely, "They" can cause others to lose Restraint and abandon Temperance, which represents Indulgence authority concentrated within Restraint.
  • Objects: "They" can control all Objects, whether sentient or not.
  • Since an unclaimed Sefirah can be considered an Object, the Chained can establish a connection with it and indirectly influence it through "Their" authority over Objects.
  • Thorn Paradise: This is the Divine Kingdom of the Chained.
  • It is a place filled with various Curses bound to different Objects, as well as numerous Deviants that exist as statues capable of being brought to life.

Black Emperor Pathway

Sequence 9: Lawyer

Description

Lawyers are masters of eloquence and reasoning, adept at uncovering loopholes in rules and exploiting their opponents’ weaknesses. They create an advantageous atmosphere to achieve ultimate victory. They can influence judgment, thoughts, and conclusions through their words, actions, and established processes. Additionally, they excel at utilizing the power of Order.

New Abilities

  • Eloquence_⁂_: Lawyers are the masters of speech and reasoning, being able to influence the judgement, thoughts, and conclusions that others are brought to via words, actions, and established processes.
  • Through this, Lawyers are able to effectively distort a target's thinking to a certain degree, making people feel very close to them or willing to trust them.
  • This ability is not only a power that gives them good speaking skills but is also a Beyonder power that enhances their natural persuasiveness.
  • Law Proficiency⁂: They are very good at taking advantage of the loopholes within various social rules and laws, as well as the legal weaknesses an enemy possesses.
  • This gives Lawyers the ability to utilize the "Law & Order" as a weapon.
  • As extremely good Beyonders at using Order, They can deceive dream and spirit channeling abilities.

Sequence 8: Barbarian

Description

Problems that cannot be solved by the law will be solved by force. This is also one of the rules.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Upon advancement, a Barbarian will gain various physical improvements such as a physical strength and constitution that breaks the 'rules' of a normal human body.
  • Mental Resistance: In addition to their Physical Enhancement, upon advancement, a Barbarian will also possess a high resistance to psychological influences.

Sequence 7: Briber

New Abilities

  • Bribery: The core ability of a Briber. By giving their target(s) an actual or symbolic Bribe, they would be able to achieve several domineering effects over their target(s).
  • A Bribe can be anywhere between giving a target money to throwing an 'object' near the direction of the target; even if the target does not accept the 'object', it still counts as a Bribe.
  • There are 4 types of Bribery that a Briber is able to do. These types of Bribery are as follows: Bribe-Weaken, Bribe-Charm, Bribe-Arrogance, and Bribe-Connection.
