  • Bribe-Weaken: Within a certain period of time, the target will become weakened, significantly lowering their ranged and melee attacks, defense, and control over the Briber.
  • Bribe-Arrogance: The target would become proud and Arrogant, lowering their intelligence, and causing them to make mistakes or wrong judgements on their situation.
  • Bribe-Charm: The target will feel an intense feeling of good or would have a good perception of the Briber, making it hard to have negative intentions towards them.
  • Sometimes the target will be completely unwilling to fight the Briber, and in the right conditions, there is a small chance that they will instead fight their allies on the spot.
  • Bribe-Connection: This establishes a 'relationship' between the Briber and the target, or in other words, it creates a Connection between the 2 parties.

Sequence 6: Baron of Corruption (Corruption)

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: A Baron of Corruptions physique is further enhanced.
  • Their punches resemble that of a cannonball, and can cause an entire building to shake.

New Abilities

  • Distortion: Barons of Corruption possess the Beyonder ability that allows them to warp the loopholes found within Order so as to Distort a target's words, actions, and intent.
  • By Distorting a target's words, actions, or intent, they would be able to form a certain Order that provides them with an advantage, achieving the effect of restraint and influence.
  • At their level, they are able to Distort a select few concepts/rules present within the actions (both direct and indirect), intent, or thoughts of a target, thus creating a new order.
  • Klein (opens in a new tab) used Creeping Hunger (opens in a new tab) and Distorted the goal of "separate and intercept" into "separate and take action alone", making Kircheis (opens in a new tab) and his companions separate.
  • Bird Mustang (opens in a new tab) had Distorted the distance between himself and Nast Solomon's (opens in a new tab) cabin within his ship, allowing him to be able to arrive there quicker then possible.
  • The action of “closing the Door” can be Distorted into the rule “Seal this place, isolate the outside from the inside”, to form a potent Seal on the room.
  • Mithor King (opens in a new tab) Distorted the trajectory of a bullet upwards slightly, causing it to miss.
  • Corrosion: They can Corrode anyone within a 10 meter range, causing them to become increasingly more 'dark' and greedy as they become more prone to do irrational actions.
  • Weakness Detection: Additionally, Barons of Corruption are acutely able to sense a target's weaknesses and flaws.[

Sequence 5: Mentor of Disorder (Disorder)

New Abilities

  • Disorder: Mentors of Disorder are able to bring chaos within the Order of the surrounding environment, creating Disorder that grants them several advantages in a situation.
  • At their current Sequence level, a Mentor of Disorder is only able to effect perception, and a select few concepts of perception and control with Disorder.
  • They can make an enemy's actions Disordered, causing them to do things in the wrong order.
  • A target's perception can be Disordered, such that they will make mistakes with their attacks.
  • They are able to use Disorder in order to get rid of the control abilities of the enemy.
  • Majesty: A Mentor of Disorder is able to display a sense of great royalty, a Majesty that causes others to want to lower their bodies and obey their every command.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Distortion: In addition to the strengthened ability to Distort the target's language, actions, and intentions, one can also Distort the concepts of oneself and the target, making both parties bear the damage, Curses, and Disease received on a 50%-50% basis.
  • Lockhart Siakam (opens in a new tab) was able to Distort the stairs to the attic, causing them to rise as if giving him a hand and thus allowing him to get closer to the attic.
  • Lockhart Siakam (opens in a new tab) had Distorted the surrounding vases and other objects in his way, causing them to avoid him as if they had a life of their own.
  • Lockhart Siakam (opens in a new tab) Distorted the effects of Foul Language, causing half of the effects to be transferred into Jason Beria (opens in a new tab).
  • Lockhart Siakam (opens in a new tab) Distorted an attack by a Desire Apostle (opens in a new tab), causing multiple Sulfur Fireballs to miss him and fall by his side, as well as hit the wall, ceiling, and even the Desire Apostle (opens in a new tab) himself.
  • Lockhart Siakam (opens in a new tab) Distorted the concept of “closing a door and sealing the room” to “Seal this place, isolate the outside from the inside”, creating a potent Seal that could withstand several Sulfur Fireballs.
  • Enhancements of other abilities from previous Sequences.

Sequence 4: Earl of the Fallen (Fallen, Depravity)

Description

There are rules to everything, and everything follows certain rules. As Demigods, they are good at finding whatever loopholes there are in an Order to Exploit for themselves. Through Magnify, Exploit and Distortion they can achieve certain things that only Beyonders of the Justiciar Pathway can accomplish.

New Abilities

  • Exploit: Earls of the Fallen are able to directly Exploit the effects of Laws, extending certain states for longer periods of time or ending it ahead of time. This makes the rules more beneficial to themselves.
  • For example, after jumping in mid air, an Earl of the Fallen can Exploit the state of being away from the ground, extending it and achieving the effect of floating.
  • By Exploiting the jumping process of their jump itself while also Exploiting the state of being away from the ground, an Earl of the Fallen can achieve a form of flight.
  • Bestowment: Within a certain range, Earls of the Fallen are able to directly Bestow all sorts of negative traits and attributes to the living beings, making them less effective and easier to manipulate.
  • Among these conditions include the following:
  • Making them only focused on money.
  • Turning the target eager and rash.
  • The feeling of sluggishness.
  • Making the target anxious.
  • Losing the will to fight.
  • Magnify: They are able to Magnify the interactions that make up the surrounding Order, enhancing it's effect to a significant degree and making even the most benign of things dangerous.
  • The interactions and effects an object are able to bring out can also be Magnified, causing said object to possess a stronger influence or effect than normal.
  • They are able to Magnify the effects of Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab), allowing them to make certain lower rank Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) affect even Demigods.
  • They can Magnify the potency of natural laws and phenomena, turning the smallest of weather conditions into a disaster, among other applications.
  • An Earl of the Fallen can Magnify the strong winds near them, enhancing their speed and transforming them into a small Hurricane.
  • Even the state of a target as well as their actions can be Magnified. For some actions, a Magnification of them will bring certain effects.
  • Earls of the Fallen are able to Magnify the act of 'grabbing', allowing them to grab someone from nearly 100 meters away just through the appropriate gesture_._
  • They are able to Magnify a hug and turn it into a restriction. Similar to grabbing someone from nearly 100 meters away, they can do this across large distances.
  • The injuries they have dealt to their opponents or that are just present can be Magnified, making them in some cases simply die on the spot.
  • An Earl of the Fallen is able to Magnify the potency of their ordinary attacks to the point where those attacks will become an execution.
  • Under normal circumstances, their Magnify could only amplify the effects and influence that strengthened one’s body or actions without helping others.
  • An Earl of the Fallen's Magnify cannot be used consecutively in a quick succession. It is limited to a one-time use each time.
  • Their Magnification is effective on abilities above the Sequence 4 level.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Disorder: Their ability to Disorder has undergone a qualitative change, effect more aspects of Order.
  • They can make a seemingly massive building collapse, cause a huge distance to be shortened to that of a few paces, while also causing attacks aimed at them to miss their mark.
  • Qonas Kilgor (opens in a new tab) unleashed Disorder to grasp the patterns of the Concealed world that enveloped Maygur Manor, using the feedback to determine the location of an exit.
  • Bribe: Their abilities of Bribing get stronger as Demigods and can also be used in tandem with Magnify.
  • A simple rose being thrown can be Magnified to an extent that it causes a violent quake when impacting the ground while at the same time imparting the effects of Bribe: Weaken.
  • Distortion: They can Distort the rules of Beyonder powers, as well as better Distort their actions.
  • They can Distort the rules of the Marionette Interchange power of a Bizarro Sorcerer so that they could only swap between 2 Marionettes.
  • They are able to directly create a Seal in thin air, effectively creating an invisible wall, through just Distorting an act of "closing a door".
  • They are able to distort the level of a mental disease, weakening it and slowing down the deterioration.
  • Klein's (opens in a new tab) Air Cannons had it's direction and trajectory Distorted to the right by Qonas Kilgor (opens in a new tab), significantly missing him in the process.
  • Qonas Kilgor (opens in a new tab) was able to fully Distort his moving trajectory to a large degree, causing him to change directions instantly.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences and become an incomplete Curly Haired Baboon.

Sequence 3: Frenzied Mage (Frenzy)

Authorities

  • Hierarchy: "They" gain partial Hierarchy authority.
  • High-Positioner: Majesty originates from "name," from rank, and from strength.
  • It can already materialize as a weapon. Even the voice of a Frenzied Mage can make Spiritual Bodies tremble and make subordinates feel a powerful pressure, forcing them to follow orders and being unable to lift their heads.
  • A Frenzied Mage can gigantize their body, increasing their height in the process.
  • Disorder: "They" gain certain degree of Disorder authority.
  • Frenzy: Within fluctuations of Disorder, the Frenzied Mage's own abilities will undergo some random changes, and this is often beneficial; the enemy's abilities will also be affected, and the changes are often unfavorable. Of course, whether beneficial or unfavorable, the Frenzied Mage himself cannot predict the specific effect.

Strengthened Abilities

  • They gain enhancement of previous Sequences' other abilities and traits.
  • Distortion: It now can directly distort the trajectory of cannonballs. It's also capable of Distorting and strengthening the target's intention to move forward, making them unable to stop.
  • Nast Solomon (opens in a new tab) was able to Distort Klein's (opens in a new tab) intent of "proceeding forward", making that intent into an action that was impossible for Klein Moretti (opens in a new tab) to stop.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 3 Beyonders, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Duke of Entropy (Entropy)

Authorities

  • Disorder: "They" gain partial Disorder authority, which gave rise to the Entropy ability.
  • Entropy: The longer one fights the Duke of Entropy, the more random and Disordered one's own abilities, thinking, and state become, impossible to control, eventually turning into a mess and falling into a strange state of Extinction; the target of Entropy can be enemies, or the environment, rules, etc.
  • Exploit: "They" gain partial Exploit authority.
  • The Exploit of rules have been strengthened to the degree where "Their" airborne state can be Exploited to such an extent that it allows "Them" to travel from the earth to the crimson moon with just a singular jump.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Distortion: "Their" Distortion ability has reached the Angel (opens in a new tab) level, allowing "Them" to Distort the rules created by authorities to a certain degree, twisting them to suit their will.
  • Xio Derecha (opens in a new tab) Distorted the rule created by the Pillar of Severity (opens in a new tab), 'The battlefield shall be divided,' by intensifying its core principle -Balance- to an even more extreme degree.
  • This caused the Balance to focus on Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) as well, causing Xio Derecha (opens in a new tab) and the Demoness of Gold (opens in a new tab) to join the battle between Derrick Berg (opens in a new tab) and Demoness of Orange (opens in a new tab).
  • With "Their" Distortion power, "They" can redirect the change of the battlefield made by a Planeswalker to somewhere else.
  • Enhancements of other abilities of previous Sequences, such as High-Positioner.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" have become a full Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab); "Their" full Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) takes the appearance of a Giant Black Baboon with nine arms and a dark crown on its head.

Sequence 1: Prince of Abolition (Abolition)

Authorities

  • Distortion & Definition: "They" have partial Distortion authority and partial Definition authority.
  • "They" use the methods of re-"Definition" and thereby "Distortion" to make the original Order favorable to oneself and achieve one's own desired goals.
  • For example, defining what is a Substitute, what is the "original body," what behavior is called a Bribe, what person is a "corrupted," making the original body instantly become the Substitute, making normal behavior become a bribe, and so on and so forth.
  • Distortion can use this to directly Distort the corresponding Order and non-underlying Rules.
  • Even through the use of just some of "Their" strength, "They" can Distort and isolate an area from the real world that is the size of a mausoleum.

Sequence 0: Black Emperor

Authorities

  • Dictator: The Dictator authority, a core authority under the symbol of Shadow of Order.
  • Under the Dictator authority are subordinate authorities such as Distortion, Exploit, Definition, and Hierarchy.
  • Except for the Hierarchy authority, others are essentially relying on Order, and by Exploiting Loopholes in Order or Distorting the original intent of Order, they make order serve "Their" own purposes.
  • Similarly, in barren and dead places, both the  ![Justiciar Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Justiciar_Pathway) Justiciar and the Black Emperor can rebuild a complete set of Order suitable for human survival. The  ![Justiciar Symbol2|26 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Justiciar_Pathway) Justiciar relies on the original fundamental Rules to recreate an Order suitable for human survival, while the Black Emperor Distorts the original Rules to make them suitable for humans. The effect is the same, but the methods of realization differ.
  • Distortion: "They" have the authority to Distort certain underlying rules of the world itself. Also capable of Distorting processes and actions, turning them into complete opposites.
  • "They" can Distort Order into Disorder, making light become shadow, noise shift to silence, mouths transform into nostrils, a lack of people becoming a crowd, and death reverse to life.
  • "They" can Distort the extension direction of Spirit Body Threads, making those who can see it unable to detect the target in advance.
  • "They" can delay the consequence of an effect by constantly Distorting their state back to when the effect's activity is only gradual.
  • "They" are able to disrupt Teleportation by Distorting the destination of the Teleportation, turning everything extremely chaotic.
  • "They" can Distort the spatial position between a used Substitute, swapping the positions of the Substitute and the main body.
  • Using this on a Fool Pathway Beyonder will result in them forcibly appearing in the desired position once they exit the Historical Void (opens in a new tab).
  • The rules and process to use Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) can be disrupted and Distorted, stopping the user from activating their power.
  • “They” are able to Distort the True Vision of onlookers, causing them to see scene of the past from one or two seconds ago.
  • "They" can Distort the rules of Concealed spaces, making its entrance appear directly before "Them".
  • When "They" advance to become a Black Emperor, "Their" ascension will cause many Distortions to manifest in reality, disrupting all sorts of Order from across the world.
  • Spirit World Traversals will be Distorted, causing the user to discover that their intended destination is far away, or that their Wandering has ended abruptly.
  • High Sequence Error Pathway Beyonders will have the connection to "Their" external Worms of Time be Distorted, losing the ability to command "Them".
  • The rules of the Circle Inhabitant will be Distorted, allowing leaving the area of the Circle Inhabitant without it triggering the Loop.
  • After fulfilling certain conditions, the Black Emperor will be able to use the Distortion authority to Distort authorities, mystical connections, and even faith.
  • Using "His" Pathways, connection and the Uncertain Mist's (opens in a new tab) Corruption, Roselle (opens in a new tab) Distorted the faith of the Uncertain Mist's (opens in a new tab) followers to being "Himself".
  • This granted "Him" absolute authority over the Uncertain Mist (opens in a new tab) followers while also deepening "His" connection to the Uncertain Mist (opens in a new tab).
  • Roselle Gustav (opens in a new tab) Distorted the relationship between the main body and the external items, briefly making "Himself" an appendage of the Genie (opens in a new tab).
  • Resurrection: Even if "They" were to be truly annihilated and killed, Death is a part of the most underlying and core part of the Order of reality, and thus, the Black Emperor can be resurrected, "They" will still be able to awaken and return from one of the mausoleums "They" made for "Their" apotheosis.
  • There are three stages in the process of "Their" Resurrection:
  1. The Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) leaves the person possessing it, turning into an abstract concept.
  2. The subjects ruled by the Black Emperor will hear "Their" mighty voice again.
  3. "They" will fuse with the Uniqueness (opens in a new tab) and would reappear in the Astral World.
  • The Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics would be returned to "Their" hands.
  • The presence of Sequence 9-2 Beyonder Characteristics would depend on the state of the Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics.
  • This is an Order that other True Deities are unable to Distort or prevent.
  • Even if "They" were successfully killed and have all nine mausoleums destroyed, as long as a certain amount of the Order set up by "Them" remained, it will still be possible for "Them" to mysteriously Revive. This appears to be a loophole against the natural Order of death.
  • "Their" Resurrection can cleanse the Corruption and madness brought by multiple different pathway Beyonder Characteristics (opens in a new tab), but can't cleanse the Corruption and madness that's intrinsic to itself. For the latter, it includes the following such as:
  • Failing the Apotheosis Ritual (opens in a new tab) or the Corruption and madness brought along by the Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab).
  • Disorder: "They" wield the majority of Disorder authority, and it's one of "Their" two core authorities.
  • "They" are no longer merely a parasite, interpreter, or Distortion of Order; "They" have broken free from Order, plunging the very concepts of order and rules themselves into total Disorder.
  • "They" can cause a person's thoughts to descend into Disorder, making it become active and uncontrollable. This seemed to be a trend that couldn’t be changed: one that led to chaos.

Justiciar Pathway

Sequence 9: Arbiter

Traits

  • Order: An Arbiter will subconsciously maintain the current Order, unwilling to disrupt its fabric.
  • If they bear official identities (opens in a new tab), this tendency only intensifies.
  • Physical Enhancement: They have outstanding combat skills to deal with the unexpected.

New Abilities

  • Authority: Arbiters possess a convincing charm and have a considerable Authority, causing people to be more likely to believe and obey their commands and words.
  • When in conflict against an Arbiter, their enemies are often less confident about their chances and will have the feeling of wanting to give up.

Sequence 8: Sheriff

Traits

  • They possess intuition and Spiritual Perception suited for a Public Security Officer.
  • With their supernatural senses as Sheriffs, as well as the distance between them not being too great, they can vaguely grasp their target's current location and predetermined location.
  • They can detect any abnormalities and grasp subtle clues. When put together with Recognition, it allows them to do investigative sweeps in a rather effective manner.
  • When the distance between them and an abnormality is close enough, they can sense unprotected thing related to Evil, Disorder, and Madness.
  • Sheriffs have a sharp intuition for monitoring others and for being monitored by others.
  • Physical Enhancement: Their physical constitution is effectively enhanced.

New Abilities

  • Jurisdiction: A Sheriff is able to designate an area as their Jurisdiction.
  • A Sheriff and their own area of Jurisdiction are always connected.
  • The more familiar they are with the place, and the more trust or support they receive from the people there, the more they can exert abilities beyond their own capabilities and receive some assistance from the environment.
  • Once they exceed their Jurisdiction range, or if they have just acquired Jurisdiction and are not yet familiar with it, they can only rely on their own Beyonder powers.
  • Their area of Jurisdiction is approximately the size of a small town.
  • If they receive an official appointment from the authorities, the area under their administration can be larger, but it must not exceed 5 times the normal limit.
  • Recognition: As long as they see a person in the flesh, in a photo, or a sketch, they'll be able to firmly remember the target’s appearance and obtain an additional sense on an extraordinary level.
  • They possess memory, in the mystical sense, of the routes they have traversed.
  • Weapon Proficiency: A Sheriff has also gained proficiency in portable melee weapons and portable firearms such as pistols and shotguns.

Sequence 7: Interrogator

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Their bodies improve to a certain extent.

New Abilities

  • Illusory Torture Devices:⁂ They can summon Illusory Torture Devices (like branding irons) in their hands which can directly damage the Spirit Body; however, there must be physical contact as these devices cannot be used from a distance.
  • Xio Derecha (opens in a new tab) used an illusory branding iron to stop an Ancient Wraith (opens in a new tab) from attacking her and Fors (opens in a new tab).
  • Psychic Lashing: They can coat their weapons in bolts of illusory lightning which lets them turn regular cold weapons into things capable of affecting Spirit Body-type creatures.
  • Xio Derecha (opens in a new tab) used Psychic Lashing alongside her blade to attack an Ancient Wraith (opens in a new tab).
  • Psychic Piercing: This Beyonder power causes bolts of lightning appear within and shoot out from their eyes to attack their target at an effective distance of 5 meters.
  • It can impose pressure on the Spirit Body, focus the mind, ignore the physical body, pierce the target's Soul, and directly attack their Spirit Body, bringing unbearable pain.
  • Psychic Piercing isn't a Beyonder power that disrupted with thoughts or affected the mind, but is a means to directly attack the Spirit Body. In essence, while other abilities act on the Body of Heart and Mind, Psychic Piercing’s target is the Soul Body instead, the two are significantly different.
  • Whip of Pain: This directly attacks the mind, making the target feel like an electric current are running through their mind, forming a barbed whip that constantly lashes their Soul.
  • This "feeling" is both painful and numb, as if it comes from the depths of the brain, making it irresistible. The affected target can only tremble, their knees going weak, and they have to confess as well as dare not lie.
  • Demolition Proficiency: They have also become demolition experts.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Weapon Proficiency: They are proficient in using a variety of weapons.

Sequence 6: Judge

Strengthened Abilities

  • Authority : A Judge's Authority have undergone a qualitative change, not only making them have an indescribable aura that makes people around them subconsciously avoid their gazes but also being able to influence the environment.
  • They can use Mystical Languages such as Ancient Hermes to establish new Rules or make a corresponding Verdict for a certain area. Everything within that area must abide by the Rules or the Verdict's outcome and violations will result in being bound by the Rules.
  • Both the Judge's Spirituality and Rules limit Verdict to a degree.
  • Examples of common Verdicts are:
  • Prohibition: Pushing forward with an open palm, a Judge can use Ancient Hermes to establish a rule forbidding certain actions or Beyonder powers, forcing everyone within a certain range to comply with the Prohibition.
  • Prohibitions generally follow this format: "'X' is Prohibited here".
  • Some of the examples of the Beyonder powers and actions a Judge can Prohibit include the following: Flight, floating, Teleportation, etc.
  • At its current level, Prohibition targeting specific races or individuals cannot directly kill the target; it can only cause continuous suppression or repel them from the Prohibition's area of effect.
  • Such Prohibitions that are directly aimed at a particular existence will be quickly suppressed if there is a level difference.
  • Examples of this are Prohibiting the existence of beings such as Specters and Wraiths within an area.
  • With preparation and only providing assistance, it can influence even Saints to a certain extent, though not necessarily effectively, but it can cause some disruption.
  • Frunziar (opens in a new tab)'s Prohibition of flight made Ulyssan (opens in a new tab)'s wings seemingly weighed down by invisible objects weighing a hundred times its own body weight, though it eventually managed to fly with great difficulty.
  • Xio (opens in a new tab) caused Botis (opens in a new tab)'s normally instantaneous Teleportation to be blocked by a rusty, abnormally heavy door: something that couldn't keep him from leaving after making adjustments.
  • Imprison: This Verdict creates layers upon layers of transparent walls as well as a flowing, extremely viscous, transparent liquid that freezes the target in place, making it difficult for even Spirits to pass through.
  • Imprison can root Spirit Body type creatures in place but can't prevent Spirit Bodies from escaping via abilities like Substitution.
  • Release: The effect can be ended early using the word "Release".
  • It will not trigger abilities such as Mirror Substitution unless they have been used beforehand.
  • Confinement: This is Imprison applied to a certain area, creating an immaterial wall: a transparent cell with their target at its center, impenetrable by Spirit Bodies.
  • This can be used to circumvent Substitution abilities by Confining a small area.
  • This is because targets would reappear within the Confinement's boundaries after using Substitution abilities.
  • This can be used to Seal a room to prevent entry or exit.
  • Confinement caused the dining room of Capim (opens in a new tab) to "freeze", as if an additional layer of invisible wall surrounded the area.
  • Maintain Secrecy: By making eye contact with the target, their eyes flash with a strange light, making the other person feel that they must do as instructed and not reveal secrets.
  • Death: After declaring the target as Dead, their body merges with some strange force, dragging a blur at speeds that create afterimages as they crash into the enemy.
  • Their fist strikes the target's head with an unavoidable force, causing devastating damage and it can also be aimed at a specific spot on the target, inflicting a severe injury.
  • Flog: Their hand is swung so that the target appears to be struck by an invisible soft whip, which can tear clothes, lacerate flesh, and expose bone.
  • Exile: By saying the word "Exile", they can send an immense and invisible power that forces targets out at high speeds.
  • This affects Spirit Bodies as well, causing them to be blown away.
  • Jurisdiction: A Judge's area of Jurisdiction is enhanced.
  • The upper limit of its maximum range approaches the size of Backlund (opens in a new tab).

Sequence 5: Disciplinary Paladin

Traits

  • Physical Enhancements: Their body is sufficiently strong enough and sufficiently robust.
  • Enhanced Mental Attributes: They have a mystical sense of self-restraint, making them experts at resisting interrogation and prying.

New Abilities

  • Punishment: They can select a target for Punishment, after setting it, they would emanate a dawn-like glow, enhancing their influence and offensive power against the target.
  • Targets for Punishment include but are not limited to:
  • Those who attack the Disciplinary Paladin or affect their actions.
  • Those who are not part of the surrounding environment.
  • Those who violate a certain law or morality.
  • Those who should not affect Reality.
  • Those who violate their own rules.
  • They can choose non-living objects as targets for Punishment.
  • Stratford (opens in a new tab) chose the "bindings" restricting him to be a target of punishment, tearing the Abyss Chains apart with immense strength.
  • They can Punish the offender in different ways, for instance:
  • A Disciplinary Paladin can restrict the offender, seemingly immobilizing their target's feet with invisible shackles, making their movements rigid.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Authority: The aura of their Authority causes surrounding beings to feel inexplicable horror. The affected target's movements become slow, and they unconsciously wish to lower their heads, prostrate themselves, listen to every word of the Disciplinary Paladin and obey every order given by them.
  • Some of the words they can utilize have undergone a qualitative change.
  • Prohibition: This is the Judge ability at Sequence 5, it can be stacked to further impose restrictions on targets that can resist the rules to some extent.
  • If an enemy violates the rules set by the user, the Disciplinary Paladin will be enhanced by an unknown force, attacking the enemy with a guaranteed hit.
  • Death: It has undergone a qualitative change. At this level, this Verdict can be used by them to target a specific location on the target, inflicting severe damage.
  • For example, shortly after Siatas's (opens in a new tab) successful attack, Frunziar Edward (opens in a new tab) used “Death” with the North King’s (opens in a new tab) wound as the target, causing all the flesh and blood in the surrounding area to wither, making the wound open all the way to the bones.
  • They have gained improvements to other abilities and traits from previous Sequences.

Sequence 4: Imperative Mage

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They have gained enhancement to their physical fitness.

New Abilities

  • Law: The core ability of an Imperative Mage is Law.
  • These can set broad restrictions and maintain them for a period of time.
  • The broader the restrictions set by a Law, the shorter the duration. Generally speaking, the shortest duration is 30 seconds and the longest is 15 minutes.
  • Examples of the Laws that they are able to employ are:
  • "Weaken Mysticism, Enhance Reality" will greatly weaken all Beyonders and mysterious effects within an area (including their side), while strengthening Reality's influence.
  • This is a powerful tool for the military in Reality to combat Beyonders.
  • "Weaken Reality, Enhance Mysticism" is the opposite Law of the former, which is able to enhance Beyonder effects while weakening the influence of Reality.
  • Appropriate "Laws" can also help them accomplish many things that are normally impossible.
  • For example, levitation, or being able to slow down bullets and cannonballs as though they sunk into a quagmire formed of air.
  • Contracts: Imperative Mages can also create Contracts that conform to the Rules of the world and internalize these contracts into various restrictions on the physical and Spirit Bodies.
  • Unlike a Notary, the binding force of an Imperative Mage's Contracts comes from the rule-based Order, rather than from the witness of Gods or higher beings.

Strengthened Abilities

  • The abilities of all the previous Sequences have been massively strengthened.
  • Supernatural Intuition: As practitioners of Order, Imperative Mages can distinguish between ordinary people and Beyonders based on their "positions" and can even determine the level of a Beyonder, that is, their "position".
  • Beyonders who have Concealment powers to some degree, such as Bizarro Sorcerers, are able to hide their Sequence level from them but not their status as a Beyonder.
  • They can also perceive the intertwining Beyonder powers of their targets, manifesting in different colors and states. This allows them to use Deprivation effectively.
  • Authority: Their Authority has been amplified to the point that it can intimidate the target and leave them rooted to the spot, also their Verdicts have been enhanced as well.
  • Prohibition: They can now Prohibit more actions and Beyonder powers.
  • They can Prohibit an area from having any interaction from the outside world.
  • They can Prohibit stand-ins, preventing any usage of Substitution abilities.
  • They are able to Prohibit Marionette Interchange.
  • Deprivation: Deprives a target of a certain Beyonder power.
  • Stripped Beyonder powers are made unusable for a certain period of time.
  • Deprivation is unavoidable and could only be resisted or weakened through one's level or Sequence's characteristics.
  • Contrary to a Depriver's Deprivation or a Prometheus's Theft, this only Deprives the target from using / accessing their powers, and does not completely take the ability from the target.
  • Exile: Saying the word "Exile", they can Exile their targets into a void, the destination unknown. This allows them to deal with enemies that cannot be resolved quickly.
  • Execution: An Imperative Mage can make a fist with their right hand and swing it down hard, which can directly Execute the target and kill them from afar.
  • Confinement: By making the left hand loosely clenched, they can Confine the target.
  • Intimidation: This Verdict Intimidates the target and keeps them in place.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences and become an incomplete giant Brass Pillar.

Sequence 3: Chaos Hunter

New Abilities

  • Balancing: They can initially apply Balance capabilities to divide the battlefield: bringing Order to the battlefield: but it cannot prevent this Order from sliding further into Disorder.

Authorities

  • Disorder: They gain a small portion of authority over Disorder.
  • Chaos Hunters have the direct ability to sense, lock onto, and track Disorder, and can also quickly quell environmental Disorder.
  • Judgment: They gain partial authority over Judgment.
  • Sword of Judgment: Chaos Hunters are able to make a direct Judgment on Disorderly things, which cannot be avoided.
  • The more Disorderly the target is (that is, the more it deviates from or disrupts the current Order), the stronger the Judgment effect will be.
  • Through this Judgment, they can use the Order of the environment to instantly jump to the target location or in front of the target.
  • Georgina Augustus (opens in a new tab) erased the distance and appeared directly above the Tutanssess II (opens in a new tab) mummy, Mahmosi (opens in a new tab), and Zatwen (opens in a new tab).

Strengthened Abilities

  • The Beyonder powers of their previous Sequences have become enhanced.
  • Law: They have gained enhancement's to this core power of an Imperative Mage.
  • "Truth recedes here, while Illusion grows stronger" will cause Truth to be weaker while Illusion becomes stronger, making the line between real and false weaker.
  • The Law "All the dead will receive their eternal peace" will have the effect of creating a region that induces eternal rest to the Dead.
  • Jurisdiction: The Jurisdiction has been expanded to include metropolitan areas.
  • If a Chaos Hunter is extremely familiar with the locations within their Jurisdiction, they can arrive at them almost instantly.
  • Verdict: Their ability to impose Verdicts on their target has been enhanced.
  • Prohibition: They can now Prohibit more Beyonder powers and existences.
  • They can directly Prohibit Marionettes, such animated corpses would abruptly cease their movements, and this effect can work against even Miracle Invokers.
  • Exile: By declaring the word "Exile", They can create an invisible and majestic force that coalesces into a terrifying hurricane, materializing directly where the target is.
  • Deprivation: The number of abilities that can be Deprived has been greatly increased.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Balancer

Authorities

  • Balance: "They" have gained a partial authority over Balance. In the presence of Disorder or imbalance, "They" can instantly end it, restore Order, and enforce perfect Balance.
  • "They" can divide the battlefield, separating the various sides into different areas while roughly ensuring a Balance of power in each battlefield.
  • Before ending their own battle and making the corresponding battlefield cease to exist, neither Angels (opens in a new tab) nor Saints (opens in a new tab) can interfere in other battles.
  • If one side becomes too powerful, members who exceed the balance limit will be excluded from the battlefield within a short period of time.
  • This will last anywhere between 10 seconds to 2 minutes and within that time, those affected will be unable to participate in the battle.
  • In a one-on-one situation, a Balancer can forcibly reduce or increase the enemy's strength to a level roughly equivalent to their own within 1 minute.
  • The stronger the enemy, the shorter the duration of this balance with 1 minute being the upper limit. In a less serious way, it also means being evenly matched with anyone, even a True Deity, for 3 seconds.
  • "They" are able to detect anyone, even those within a Concealed state as well as sense the imbalance and Disorder of the surrounding region.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "They" gain an enhancement of abilities from previous Sequences.
  • Examples of this include gaining the ability of forming Laws and Decrees and being able to make multiple Prohibitions or Enhancements take effect simultaneously by defining the environment.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" have become a full Mythical Creature; "Their" Mythical Creature Form is that of a giant Brass Pillar mixed with some other characteristics and features on it.

Sequence 1: Hand of Order

Authorities

  • Order: "They" gain partial authority over Order.
  • Order Proxy: "They" are able to establish many new Rules (not at the underlying level) for an entire battlefield, all "Their" enemies, an entire city, or a small nation.
  • "They" are able to modify or even temporarily remove existing Rules (not at the underlying level), but these rules cannot be completely fixed and remain in effect permanently.
  • Due to the characteristics of the Justiciar Pathway, if the Nation of Disorder (opens in a new tab) gives permission, "They" can act as a Proxy. Otherwise, not. It must have a compliant procedure.
  • When the Sefirah (opens in a new tab) has no consciousness and operates via Symbolism, it must use specific methods to possibly succeed. Those specific methods need to be figured out.
  • If the Hand of Order has authorization from the Celestial Thearch (opens in a new tab), then without harming "Themselves", "They" can reach King of Kings of Angels (opens in a new tab) level of strength for 3 seconds.
  • At the cost of certain death, "They" can reach the level of the weakest tier of Half Great Old One (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can sense the changes in Order.
  • "They" can observe the tug-of-war between Disorder and Balance, the evolving Order of the battlefield, and the enemy forces' formation, carefully calculating the Rules, and what kind of Order should be established.
  • "They" can quell Disorder and Anomalies, exist in an independent position, and control the effects.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "They" gain an enhancement of abilities from previous Sequences.

Sequence 0: Justiciar

Authorities

  • Order: The Justiciar possesses the Order authority as well as the corresponding subordinate authorities of Rules, Edicts, and Laws of Nature.
  • "They" can modify the underlying Rules of the world to some extent.
  • Compared to the Paragon's ability to change Laws of physics versus the Justiciar's ability to change the underlying rules, the Justiciar is stronger as it also effects mystical rules.
  • The Laws presented in grayish-black are in a state that can’t be changed by the Trunsoest Brass Book (opens in a new tab) but if it were able to awaken further, it could do the following modifications:
  • "Scholar of Yore has the ability to summon Historical Void Projections. The success rate of Summoning depends on the familiarity and friendliness of the target..."
  • It might have reduced the success rate of summoning Historical Void Projections.
  • "When one’s rationality drops to 20% of its original value, there would be signs of losing control..."
  • It may cause Beyonders (opens in a new tab) to show signs of losing control if their rationality falls a little.
  • "They" can make certain modifications to the Rules of the Red Priest's Sacrifices.
  • "They" are able to remove existing, non-underlying Rules.
  • "They" are able to establish various new Rules for the world.
  • "They" can theoretically create a method for Resurrection; however, the Rules involved must be mutually reinforcing and can't directly stipulate "Their" Revival.
  • For instance, "They" can establish that the Souls of the deceased in this area remain preserved and do not enter the Spirit World. Then "They" need to specify the duration of Soul preservation before stipulating that Ghosts can retain their memories. Only then, through step-by-step regulations, can Resurrection be achieved.
  • However, this approach is overly complex and easily disrupted.
  • These Rules can't be fundamental but they will be permanent, with an effect ranging from small to large, from a single nation to a planet or a star system.
  • The Son of Chaos (opens in a new tab) can even influence the Laws of Beyonder Characteristics such as Indestructibility, Convergence, and Separation to a certain extent, making limited, low-level, and small-scale modifications.
  • The Trunsoest Brass Book (opens in a new tab) was able to establish several different Laws that need to be followed by making the corresponding Judgment.
  • The Edict's corresponding Judgment could be modified and be made stricter over time. It can reach a level where it will be impossible for a person to abide by "Their" Edicts.
  • Edicts have to be publicized or announced before it could be effective. Thus, Concealing the announcement of those Edicts will make it ineffective.
  • The Rules that had been created also restricted the book as well. However, it could get rid of those Rules to break the restriction.
  • Examples of the Rules that had been established by the book:
  • By proclaiming “Resurrection of the deceased is prohibited here!”, "They" can weaken the will of a Great Old One awakening inside the body of a being.
  • Making a Rule that lets an ordinary person be able to kill an Angel (opens in a new tab).
  • Making an Edict where lost items are regarded as abandoned.
  • The Justiciar can grant Immunity to specific individuals.
  • This will enable those individuals to disregard the effects of indiscriminate Rules.
  • Order Proxy: "They" can reach the strongest tier of Half Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can completely obtain all the abilities and symbolisms on the level of the Celestial Thearch (opens in a new tab) in The Apocalypse (opens in a new tab) war, but "They" would die and could only maintain this state for less than 3 seconds.
  • Judgment: Anyone who violates the Order can be Judged.
  • Each Judgment will be supported by the will and power of the entire world, and this can be performed either remotely or in person.
  • The Trunsoest Brass Book (opens in a new tab) could Punish targets each time its Laws had been broken, which would also increase the corresponding level of Punishment until it reaches Death.
  • Disorder: "They" have partial authority over Disorder.
  • The Justiciar is able to restore Disorder, quell Disorder, and extinguish Disorder. Order can also create Disorder.
  • Balance: "They" are able to force Balance.
  • In addition to the previously manifested Balances, it can also Balance many abstract things, such as restoring the Balance between reason and madness for a certain period of time, but only 3 minutes at most.
  • Divine Kingdom: "Their" Divine Kingdom, it's known as the Ancient Court of Judgment or the Heaven of Edicts.

Eternal Aeon Pathway

Sequence 9: Dancer

Traits

  • Spirituality: When they dance, their Spirituality would radiate outward, merging with the ambient natural forces, which will cause them to enter a transcendent, mystical state.
  • In this state, their thoughts will be concentrated, their minds will be quiet, and they will be able to perceive various subtle phenomena surrounding them, as if their Spirit Vision (opens in a new tab) has been activated.
  • They would also seem to be able to connect to an unseen power within them.
  • In this state, their Spirituality would cause unwanted entities to be attracted to them; however, a Dancer is able to prepare a Wall of Spirituality beforehand to prevent that from occurring.
  • Physical Enhancement: Upon advancement, Dancer would become extremely flexible, allowing them to actually perform the dances they were given knowledge.
  • This makes them a "rhythm master".

New Abilities

  • Knowledge (Mysticism): A wealth of knowledge regarding how to use dance, rhythm, and Spirituality to connect with the forces of nature and converse with unknown entities would materialize in their mind, enabling a Dancer to comprehend it instantly and use it for their own goals.
  • This was the essence of being a Dancer. With this knowledge, they were able to "appease" other entities by creating new sacrificial dances that were specifically tailored to certain situations.
  • Summoning Dance: By executing this dance, a Dancer could attract nearby objects or spirits and allow to be Possessed by one of them, at the cost of their own blood, thereby gaining access to one of its abilities or traits for around 20 to 30 seconds.
  • Some of the Possessors could inflict significant adverse effects on humans, while others might prove reluctant to depart after the Possession, creating complications.
  • When bonding with the monster with the circular mouth, Lumian would become very hungry for prolonged periods of time, though in exchange he will be able to become Invisible (through mystical means) to the naked eye.
  • Although not it's intended purpose, it could be used for Spirit Channeling to gain information from deceased spirits; however, they can't ask questions.
  • Instead, using the Summoning Dance to Spirit Channel will just allow them to be able to randomly see some of the spirit's memories.
  • This use of the Summoning Dance consumes a lot of Spirituality and can only show one memory, making it just better than nothing.
  • The Summoning Dance does not resemble a traditional sacrificial rite but is rather a Dance that is a blend of sacrifice and summoning Ritualistic Magic.
  • Enigmatic Dance: Besides the Summoning Dance, this is another type of ritualistic dance that a Dancer is capable of doing, which allows them to be able to activate a special sort of power that resides within their chest to activate certain effects.
  • With this dance, Lumian (opens in a new tab) could activate the black thorn symbol on his chest while exploring the Dreamscape (opens in a new tab), suppressing or weakening the monsters inside.

Sequence 8: Alms Monk

Traits

  • Endurance: An Alms Monk is resistant towards extreme environments. They do not need summer or winter clothes to function normally; with a simple robe sufficing for most weather conditions.
  • Their Endurance extends to their emotions and Desires.
  • They are also resistant to various smells and smoke.

New Abilities

  • Luck Intuition: They can roughly sense the recent fortunes of others - Good Luck, Bad Luck, potential for Disaster, romantic opportunities and so on - but without the precise details.
  • An Alms Monk can detect if someone is experiencing Bad Luck, but have no way of knowing how unlucky the person would be or how long the Bad Luck would last.
  • Their actions and will are embedded into the future they sense, and when they change their decisions and will, a corresponding change in Luck will be seen.
  • Lumian (opens in a new tab) felt that Osta (opens in a new tab) was going to be unlucky, he realized later it was the consequence of asking him something dangerous, and his warning didn't change the Inevitability.
  • When Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) really changed his prior decisions and thoughts, he was immediately able to see the corresponding alterations in Charlie's (opens in a new tab) Luck.
  • Knowledge (Ritualistic Spells): Upon drinking the potion, an Alms Monk will gain knowledge on 5 different kinds of Ritualistic Spells they can use by praying themselves.
  1. Prophecy Spell: They can use ingredients like a snake's venom sac and rocks from an eagle's nest to make a concoction that can be poured into a corpse's mouth that had been dead for no less then 7 days to momentarily Revive it and ask 3 questions about the Future.
  • The corpse must be un-cremated and un-Purified for this to work.
  • This is the prayer that they have to do before using this Spell:
  • "I implore you, I beseech to be bestowed the Prophetic Concoction… Tulip, a herb that belongs to Inevitability, please pass your powers to my incantation!"
  • There are 4 rules that govern the questioning:
  • The questions that an Alms Monk asks to the corpse must pertain to the Future only. Questions and inquiries about someone's whereabouts and Past actions are forbidden.
  • The description of the question an Alms Monk asks to the corpse must be precise enough. If this condition is not met, an unanswered query would arise.
  • For example, if asking about someone Future, numerous individuals shared the same name. Unless the birthplace or other details were specified, the corpse may instead reveal the Future Fate of a different person.
  • Regardless of the corpse's country of origin or familiarity with the corresponding language, it would respond in the same language as the question posed.
  • A question could only contain one element requiring an answer. It could not be framed in the manner of "when and where will it be?"
  1. Luck Enhancement Spell: By sending an object with their Misfortune and having others open, consume, step on or wear the object, the caster could transfer their own Bad Luck to that individual, enhancing their own Luck in the process.
  • Their Misfortune will be permanently untransferable if not sent to another within 3 days.
  • The Alms Monk can see the Luck of the object used in the Luck Enhancement Spell.
  • It takes up to half a day or at most a full day for this Spell to manifest it's effects.
  • The prayer that an Alms Monk had to recite to put Misfortune in an object is:
  • "I implore you, I implore you to alter this destitute man's Fate. I pray you will take away his Misfortune. Gray amber, a herb that belongs to Inevitability, please pass your powers to my incantation..."
  • Transferring their Misfortune requires around 2 specific conditions:
  1. The recipient had to willingly accept the object and subjectively desire to possess it.
  2. The recipient had to exploit a situation they shouldn't have, for the whole process.
  • For example, to make a purchase, a shopkeeper wouldn't have to bear an Alms Monk's Bad Luck merely because they accepted the item: unless they sold something counterfeit or dishonestly manipulated the transaction.
  1. Animal Creation Spell: By using an animal hide along with a prayer, an Alms Monk can transform a target into the corresponding creature. This can be applied to themselves and canceled early with a corresponding incantation.
  • While a target is under the effects of the Animal Creation Spell, they will be unable to speak as well as unable to use most of their Beyonder powers.
  1. Substitution Spell: They can Substitute their own Fate by making another being live as them for a while, which is used to create sufficient mystical connections for Substitution.
  • In order to build sufficient connections, they must live in their house, use all of their money, and gain recognition from other acquaintances of the Alms Monk.
  • If someone would then try to for example take vengeance on the Alms Monk, they would take vengeance on the Substitute (other person) instead.
  1. Exorcism Spell: This Ritualistic Spell was capable of banishing Wraiths and even Evil Spirits, preventing them from tormenting a Soul. But it came with two caveats.
  2. They needed to know the specter’s real name and possess a personal item them held in life.
  3. They needed ample time in order to be able to conduct and finish this Ritualistic Spell.
  • The Ritualistic Spells of an Alms Monk will be more effective if they adopt the qualities of humility, respect, and act more like a beggar- one without many possessions.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Knowledge (Mysticism): They will gain an abundance of sacrificial knowledge upon advancement.

Sequence 7: Contractee

Traits

  • Endurance: Their ability to Endure more extreme environments has been slightly improved.
  • Physical Enhancement: Their flexibility as a Dancer has been slightly improved.
  • This makes it easier for them to do the Enigmatic and Summoning Dance.
  • Spirituality: Their Spirituality has been greatly increased.

New Abilities

  • Contracts: A Contractee can create special Contracts to obtain a distinctive characteristic skill from various different creatures existing in the Spirit World and other realms.
  • They can forge a long-term Contract, unlike a Dancer who can only borrow powers temporarily.
  • When one's Sequence is low, the number of Contracts they can make is severely restricted.
  • At maximum, a Contractee can make 5 Contracts; however, it does not often exceed 3 due to the limitations and cost involved with it.
  • If a Contractee fails to choose their abilities wisely, they may struggle to beat an ordinary person armed with a gun.
  • By its nature, the Contracts of a Contractee would lose the ability to forcefully compel agreements or obligations once they reached higher levels of power without the qualitative enhancement provided by Inevitability.
  • However, if both parties willingly agreed to and honored the Contract, and the Contractee's body and Soul could bear the power transmitted by the other party, it remained effective. However, such mystical connections were fragile.
  • For example, a Dual-Pathway True God (opens in a new tab) with a Contractee Boon can sign a Contract with a Half Great Old One (opens in a new tab) to use "Their" powers, but it could not sustain more than two uses per ability, being easily disrupted.
  • The main issue with the Inevitability Pathway's Contractee was that the strength of Contracted abilities could not surpass the Contracted creature's potential. This meant that early-stage Contracted abilities were hard to enhance unless the initial contract was with a Demigod-level creature, constrained only by one's own spirit and flesh from utilizing the ability to its fullest. This could potentially enhance the Contracted ability with each sequence advancement.
  • Below Sequence 4, without the qualitative factor of Godhood, even Sequence 7 or 8 level Contracted abilities could participate in Sequence 5 level battles and play significant roles. However, at Sequence 4, facing opponents of the same level, most of these abilities would struggle to be effective, necessitating new suitable Contracted creatures.
  • Every Contract not only has a cost but also comes with a significant long-term downside.
  • The cost is different for each Contract and can differ greatly. Some examples include a sacrifice of fresh human blood, the loss of the ability to fall in love, the sacrifice of a Beyonder Characteristic or thirteen portions of prepared meat.
  • The associated downside can vary greatly as well. Examples include: an increased desire for sexual intercourse, the urge to show off, a permanent Spirituality drain or an increased susceptibility for hunger.
  • The costs are the price one pays to the entity one makes a Contract with. They may be diminished through negotiation, Beyonder powers, or the backing of a great figure.
  • They can't use Spirit World creature Contracts if their connection to the Spirit World is severed even if they reach the level of an Angel (opens in a new tab).
  • The Mystical Language of Fate is the language used to form their various Contracts.
  • In a way, their Contracts function as a weaker version of a Shepherd's Grazing.
  • Contractees are only able to gain 1 ability per Contract they make.
  • Here are some examples of the abilities they might obtain:
  • Bottle of Fiction: This allowed allowed Guillaume Bénet (opens in a new tab) to transform spaces, often with symbolic elements like doors and windows, into enclosed realms with conditions of entry.
  • Only those who meet the requirements of his conditions of entry can access these spaces while others will be sent back to their original positions.
  • Shadow Transformation: This Contract ability granted Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) the ability to authentically morph into a Shadow; merging with it to Conceal him and move around stealthily.
  • Soul Assimilation Mystic Spell: This allowed Guillaume Bénet (opens in a new tab) to use the real name of an entity to affect their mental body, or even have their Spirit Body extracted.
  • Spell of Harrumph: An ability gained by Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) that is capable of affecting the target's Spirit Body directly, inducing dizziness or even unconsciousness.
  • Its potency will grow with the Contractee's level, potentially influencing divine entities if they were to reach Sequence 4 or temporarily elevated their level.
  • Weakening Ray: This is something Voisin Sanson (opens in a new tab) can use which creates a a ghostly green light condensed around his eyes that disintegrates anything it hits.
  • Death's Summon: A Contract ability that allowed Voisin Sanson (opens in a new tab) to form a semi-transparent figure resembling him that can dissipate nearby influences.
  • Rebirth: Sybil (opens in a new tab) is able to be Reborn within the body of the one who killed her and take control; however, only within 2 minutes after her death.
  • Iron Body: This allowed Voisin Sanson (opens in a new tab) to metallize his body, increasing his defenses to the point where he can resist a Sure-Hit bullet.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Luck Intuition: The specificity and accuracy of the Luck they can sense has increased.
  • Knowledge (Mysticism): They will gain knowledge on the Mystical Language of Fate.
  • They will also gain all sorts of information regarding summonable/recruitable creatures, the costs of forging a Contract with them, and the abilities one can gain. from said Contract.
  • Summoning Dance: This dance now exceeds a broader sphere of influence, and their ability to possess bizarre creatures can now be done with creatures of a higher status.

Sequence 6: Ascetic

Traits

  • Endurance: Their Endurance stemming as an Alms Monk has been enhanced.
  • This makes them more adaptable to extreme weather, to the point where even if they encounter frost, they won't be frozen. This can also be applied to their emotions and Desires.
  • Spirituality: An Ascetic's Spirituality has been further improved.

New Abilities

  • Compression: They are defined by Endurance, accumulation, and eruption. Compression can be used for the Mind and also produces positive effects in the Physical and Mystic Domains.
  • Mental Compression: Their emotions and Desires can be suppressed. This ability will accumulate these emotions and Desires and erupt it at critical moments for the desired effect.
  • While an Ascetic's emotions and Desires are Compressed, it will make the corresponding negative effects of Contracts, Mystical Items (opens in a new tab), and Sealed Artifacts (opens in a new tab) more bearable, but an Ascetic must regularly vent their emotions to remain psychologically sound.
  • Breaking an enemy's neck is something that counts as venting their emotions.
  • Strength Compression: By accruing their Spirituality and strength, it allows Ascetics to recover their Spirituality all at once and temporarily enlarge like a giant once un-Compressed.
  • In this un-Compressed form, an Ascetic's strength, speed, and agility would be enhanced to the point where they can physically fight against a Dawn Paladin for 1 or 2 minutes.
  • Ritualistic Compression: The accumulation of ritualistic processes allow them to simplify certain Ritualistic Spells learned at Sequence 8, making them applicable in combat.
  • Animal Creation Spell: They can now simply envelop the target in an animal skin and utilize ritualistic accumulation as well as intoning the incantation to transform the target.
  • A cumbersome and intricate ceremony became unnecessary.
  • Exorcism Spell: The ritual itself can be intoned onto an object and be used in conjunction with the target's real name in order to achieve the desired effect.
  • The long ritual needed before will become unnecessary.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Knowledge (Ritualistic Spells): A Ritualistic Spell of theirs has been moderately improved.
  • Luck Enhancement Spell: The limitation of transferring their Misfortune has been increased to 13 days, with longer time limits relying upon the Fate Appropriation ability from now on.
  • Contracts: They are able to sign up to 8 Contracts.

Sequence 5: Fate Appropriator

Traits

  • Endurance: Their Endurance stemming from an Ascetic has been moderately enhanced.
  • Spirituality: A Fate Appropriator's Spirituality has been enhanced significantly.
  • Physical Enhancement: Their flexibility has been greatly strengthened.
  • They could now perform horrific and incredible actions with their body to the point where if ordinary folk were to merely glimpse at the corresponding shadows they cast, they would most likely deem the Fate Appropriator as being a monster.

New Abilities

  • Fate Observation: They can directly perceive an illusory River of Fate (opens in a new tab) stemming from all sapio-sentient entities, enabling them to view the target's Past, Present, and Future information.
  • The nearer the scenes of Fate they see are to the Present and the less those scenes involved high-level matters, the sharper they become in their eyes.
  • Despite Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) being able to see everything in the past week (except scenes with high-level entities like the Evernight Nation (opens in a new tab), Madam Judgment (opens in a new tab), and the Demoness of Black (opens in a new tab)) when viewing Franca Roland's (opens in a new tab) River of Fate, he could not gleam much information from Hela's (opens in a new tab).
  • When actively using this ability, they could touch the River of Fate of a target, enabling them to “see” a part of their Fate without their awareness.
  • There is a time constraint when actively using this ability.
  • Fate Appropriation: By touching the target, Fate Appropriators would be able to Appropriate and extract the desired Fate from them in the form of Fate Fragments.
  • They can Appropriate the Fate of living creatures, but it requires a certain amount of time.
  • The less 'heavy' the corresponding Fate, the quicker the process, and vice-versa.
  • The more 'heavy' the Fate Fragment, the more significant it is to the target.
  • They can Appropriate a portion of the Fate of the recently deceased.
  • The target's overall Fate will be locked and unable to create new changes.
  • The time to complete this type of Appropriation is very brief.
  • Fate Appropriation has a limited range of 15 meters to work.
  • Fate Exchange: They can Exchange a Fate that they have stored in a Fate Fragment via Compression in exchange for a specific Fate of the target.
  • If the Fate Fragments of the target match, the process of Fate Exchange will begin in almost instantly. If not, then it will take anywhere between five to six minutes.
  • Fate Exchange is generally quicker in taking Fates in the form of Fate Fragments from living creatures than Fate Appropriation is.
  • Examples of Fate Exchanges that can happen are:
  • A Fate Appropriator is able to transfer the Fate Fragment of pregnancy from a female to a male in order to make the male pregnant.
  • Compelling Fate: Through the use of various means like Rituals or Curses, a Fate Appropriator can increase the probability of an event by enhancing a portion of their target's short or long-term Fate.
  • This can be accomplished this through 2 methods.
  • Magnified Fate: By utilizing the surrounding environment around them, Fate Appropriators are able to directly enhance the probability of short-term events occurring.
  • The 2 prerequisites:
  1. The targeted Fate must align with the current environment and circumstances.
  2. The targeted Fate's duration must last for only a total of ten seconds.
  • Even after Compelling the Fate of a being, the exact way the target would embark on this Fated path is unknown to them. The details are beyond their sight.
  • Compared to Fate Rituals, the curse of Magnified Fate are simpler to activate with fewer required conditions. However, that significantly limits the ultimate effect and makes it so that nothing outlandish can be achieved.
  • Fate Rituals: Through the use of mystical connections -such as a target’s blood, close relatives, and other items- they can alter the long-term Fate of their targets.
  • Compared to the curse of Magnified Fate, Fate Rituals are harder to accomplish and take longer to activate, however are able to effect the target for much longer periods of time, while also having more of an effect overall.
  • Fate Rituals can only affect the target in a general direction. They can make someone have a bad day, but not be able to exactly dictate the exact flavor of Misfortune.
  • When engaging in Fate Appropriation or Fate Exchange, a Fate Appropriator will be unable to attack the target until the process is finished or canceled.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Knowledge (Ritualistic Spells): Certain Ritualistic Spells can be used more easily and efficiently.
  • Animal Creation Spell: A Fate Appropriator can now use a more symbolic representation of animal skin in order to achieve the desired outcome of transforming a target.
  • Compression: They can store Fate Fragments via Compression.
  • At their maximum level, they can store up to 3 within their body.
  • Contracts: They are able to sign up to 12 Contracts.

Sequence 4: Circle Inhabitant

Traits

  • Endurance: They are able to resist to a certain extent against the Charm of a Despair.

New Abilities

  • Circle Inhabitant: They can create a Cycle of Fate; a Cycle of Cause, Effect, and Process; or a Loop of the Past and the Present.
  • A "Circle" needs one or more trigger conditions that would Cause the target to Loop back to its initial state.
  • The restrictions on what can be set as trigger conditions depend on what is the target of the "Circle".
  • As the Circle inhabitant themself is the source of the effect, they cannot trigger a reset by leaving the Loop's range, that would mean truly leaving. They have to trigger it in another way, like by committing suicide.
  • Its target can be a 1 kilometer area, a single individual, or the Circle Inhabitant themself.
  • The range-type Circle Inhabitant trigger conditions cannot be harsh and can affect Angels (opens in a new tab) in the corresponding area.
  • The individual-type Circle Inhabitant can set some relatively harsh trigger conditions, but if the target's status is higher than their own, the effect will be significantly reduced, even to the point of ineffectiveness.
  • There are no restrictions on using Circle Inhabitant on themself, and it can be restarted even if killed by an Angel (opens in a new tab).
  • Only one "Circle" can be maintained at the same time, and the same type of "Circle" needs to cool down for 3 minutes before it can be created again.
  • Each Circle Inhabitant effect lasts a minimum of 3 Loops and maximum of _9 Loops, depending on the amount of Inevitability power they invest.
  • A Destined Fate will arrive once a "Circle" exceeds its Cycle count.
  • The Circle Inhabitant themself has to choose the Destined Fate, needing to discern and choose a tributary from a target's River of Fate.
  • The worse the Destined Fate, the worse the final result, the more Inevitability power they have to invest, and the longer it would take to complete the Circle Inhabitant.
  • A "Circle" can last for a long time, unless the number of times is reached or they actively remove it.
  • If a "Circle" attached to oneself is set to restart near death, and there's no chance to trigger it afterward, it can last up to a year at most.
  • They can specify what exactly is reset by a "Circle", for example, letting it reset their own Spirituality and body, but not their own Fate and actions.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Fate Observation: They can selectively filter out certain Past, Present, and Future scenes of a target's Fate, preventing them from accidentally getting Corrupted from the information.
  • Voisin Sanson (opens in a new tab)'s Godhood allowed him to observe most of Ludwig (opens in a new tab)'s Fate without peering into fragments containing dangerous scenes or knowledge.
  • Fate Appropriation: Once they have grasped the desired Fate within a target's River of Fate, they are able to instantly Appropriate it from the target without any wait time.
  • Circle Inhabitants are able to Appropriate the Fates of beings with the status of Angels (opens in a new tab); however, it would take a few minutes for the Appropriation to work.
  • As long as they don't touch the most critical parts of the Angel (opens in a new tab)'s Fate, they needn't fear backlash or losing control on the spot.
  • Fate Exchange: Once they have the desired Fate Fragment, they are able to instantly Exchange it with the target, even if those 2 Fates aren't similar to each other.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Sufferer

Description

Among Circle of Inevitability (opens in a new tab)'s authorities over the Past, Present, and Future, Sufferer signifies the Present.

Traits

  • Endurance: Their tolerance and resistance against direct damage is significantly enhanced.

New Abilities

  • Reenactment: They can reproduce the suffering they have experienced onto their target. The potency of the attack reflects the depths of their anguish and torment, as well as their own level.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab), as a Dual-Pathway True God (opens in a new tab), Reenacted the supernova The Fool (opens in a new tab) used against "Him" in The Fool's Gambit (opens in a new tab) against the Primordial Demoness (opens in a new tab), attempting to block "Her" escape.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab), as an Angel of Redemption, Reenacted the supernova used against "Him", though it was far from a true supernova explosion, merely a kind of simulated reproduction.
  • The Circle of Inevitability (opens in a new tab) Reenacted the aftermath of the Original Creator's (opens in a new tab) awakening to form a massive suction force that diverted an attack from Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab).
  • Present State: A Sufferer can set a Present State on themselves to counter the ignition of Desire, Psychic Shocks, etc. without triggering the Loop they have created.

Strengthened Abilities

  • They gain improvements in the abilities from previous Sequences.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Sinner

Description

Among Circle of Inevitability (opens in a new tab)'s authorities over the Past, Present, and Future, Sinner signifies the Past.

Trait

  • Depraved Nature: As Sequence 2 Sinners, "Their" Depraved Nature is exceptionally strong, becoming nearly equal to "Their" existence. As a result, this makes "Them" especially vulnerable to the  ![Sun Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Sun_Pathway) Sun Pathway's Purification and the  ![Hanged Man Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Hanged_Man_Pathway) Hanged Man Pathway's Degeneration.
  • Even if a Sinner were to enter a Past state of being a True Deity of the  ![Door Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Door_Pathway) Door and  ![Error Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Error_Pathway) Error Pathways, rapidly Blinking would not let "Them" evade the effect of the Hanged Man's Degeneration.
  • While others can suppress it's effects, "They" cannot as "They" were Depraved to begin with.
  • Purification would not stop at "Their" Depraved Nature: it would include the Sinner "Themself".

Authorities

  • Past & Cause: "They" gain initial access to the authority associated with the Past and Cause.
  • "They" can revert to any Past state, with the duration depending on specific circumstances
  • For forces involving the Uniqueness (opens in a new tab), the consent of the current wielder is required.
  • With the permission of Mr. Fool (opens in a new tab), Amon (opens in a new tab) was able to use this authority to revert back into the state when "He" was a True God of both the  ![Door Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Door_Pathway) Door and  ![Error Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Error_Pathway) Error Pathways.
  • To borrow powers from the Past, "They" must remain in a state of being a Sinner.
  • As such, if an Angel of Redemption reverts to "Their" Past state, "They" will revert back to being a Sinner, regaining "Their" Depraved Nature.
  • "They" can anchor a target's Past sins to catalyze a desired outcome in the Present.
  • "They" can implant a virtual Cause into the Past to influence the Present.
  • This works by implanting the temporary, virtual Cause: a false fragment of Fate: into the River of Fate's (opens in a new tab) Past, thereby influencing the Present.
  • As this false fragment of Fate is temporary, it is quickly washed and destroyed by the River of Fate (opens in a new tab), lasting no more than a second.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their previous Beyonder powers get further strengthened.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature. "Their" Mythical Creature Form is that of a Two-headed, Two-bodied, and Four-Armed Giant.

Sequence 1: Angel of Redemption

Description

Among Circle of Inevitability (opens in a new tab)'s authorities over the Past, Present, and Future, the Angel of Redemption signifies the Future.

Trait

  • Redemption Instinct: Upon advancement, "They" acquire an inherent instinct for Redemption.
  • "They" also don't possess the Depraved Nature "They" had as a Sinner.

**Authorities

  • Future & Effect: "They" gain initial control of the authorities over the Future and Effects: that is, Destined Fate, which is essentially equivalent to a branch authority under the symbol of Inevitability.
  • "They" can directly fix a target's Fate onto a specific River of Fate (opens in a new tab) tributary, dictating the occurrence of a specific Effect without relying on the Past or a Cause. When done against a target with a status higher than "Them", backlash is likely.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) fixed Franca (opens in a new tab) and the others' Fate for the next ten minutes so that they wouldn't die in their fight against Higdon (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can create a new possibility, a new River of Fate (opens in a new tab) tributary within a Destined Fate, saving the Future by creating something out of nothing.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab), through a prayer, brought forth a Future possibility within a situation where there was none, allowing "Him" to slow down the rate of the Primordial Demoness's (opens in a new tab) Chaos vortex.
  • "They" can enter the River of Fate (opens in a new tab) and immerse "Themselves" in its various currents, each symbolizing a different Future. When "They" emerge in a burst of holy light, "They" will align with the chosen Future state, completing "Their" self-redemption.
  • The simplest application is to use this to escape "Their" Inevitable collapse or ending.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) had escaped the destructive effects of the Supernova that "He" Reenacted on the Special Mirror Worlds (opens in a new tab) while in "His" Past state as a Dual-Pathway True God (opens in a new tab).
  • "They" can shed the burdens of "Their" Past, including "Their" Depraved nature.
  • Amon (opens in a new tab) separated "Himself" from "His" state as a Dual-Pathway True God (opens in a new tab) to escape the attempt of making "Him" lose control by the Primordial Demoness (opens in a new tab).

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form has now developed into that of a Three-headed, Three-bodied, Six-Armed Giant around 4-5 meters tall that does not form a continuously Looping circle. "Their" heads represent "Their" Past, Present, and Future.

Sequence 0: Eternal Aeon

**Authorities
