  • Cycle & Inevitability: "They" wield the authorities of Cycle and Inevitability, encompassing Past, Present, Future: Cause, Process, and Effect as a whole.
  • Past & Cause: It is at this stage that an Eternal Aeon is able to revert "Their" state to any moment in the Past that is connected to a Sefirah (opens in a new tab).
  • The Calamity associated with the Eternal Aeon is of a greater and more fundamental nature than the suffering endured by the Sufferer.

Chaos Primogenitor Pathway

Sequence 9: Villain

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: They obtain a robust physique.

New Abilities

  • Intimidation: They can induce a sense of "fear" or "apprehension" into a target.
  • Combat Proficiency: A Villain possesses exceptional combat skills.

Sequence 8: Gardener

New Abilities

  • Knowledge (Botany, Alchemy): Upon advancement, a Gardener will obtain knowledge on a variety of plants as well as knowledge that lets them create various mystical concoctions.
  • Several known official concoctions are listed below:
  • Scorpion Poison: It is a poison to be primarily used on weapons. It can induce arrhythmia and respiratory paralysis, ultimately leading to death.
  • Healing Agent: This is a Healing Agent that mends most external wounds, alleviates severe injuries and eliminates minor ailments.
  • Bark Agent: This is an agent that temporarily toughens one's skin and muscles, rendering them as resilient as trees' bark.
  • Berserk Agent: This is a concoction that grants the consumer temporary extraordinary strength.
  • Tool Mastery (Garden): A Gardener is very good at using a pair of garden shears or a scythe as a weapon. This ability likely extends to all gardening tools,
  • Hammers and scissors are also a part of gardening tools as well.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Intimidation: They have a natural deterrent effect on creatures related to flowers, plants, and trees.
  • Spiritual monsters and Spirits that were born from trees, plants, and flowers will become highly frightened at the sight of a Gardener.

Sequence 7: Heretic Spellmaster

New Abilities

  • Undying Lands: If a Heretic Spellmaster is allowed to set up a series of magic circles and imprison at least a few dozen people in a location, then, later on, they can invoke these enchantments and consume the life force of the captives to materialize an area called the Undying Lands within that location.
  • The Undying Lands are filled with life force and Souls, greatly enhancing the power of their Spells.
  • Outside of the Undying Lands, a Heretic Spellmaster's Spells will become much weaker.
  • Some Spells like Soul Traversal is not able to be used while outside the Undying Lands.
  • Spellcasting: A Heretic Spellmaster is able to cast Spells use through life force. The life force used may be their own, but it could also be the life force of others as well.
  • Evil Word: A type of weak Curse, one that Curses multiple targets at once through precisely enunciated words.
  • This induces a variety of effects such as racing hearts, throbbing headaches, blurred vision, nosebleeds, and extreme dizziness.
  • Blood Spirit: A type of weak Curse, one that transforms Blood into Blood Spirits, which can exist in the form of a zombified corpse, a figure of Blood, or be adorned as armor.
  • An enemy's exposed Blood can be condensed into a thin Blood-colored figure to attack the enemy. It will continue to feed on their Blood to strengthen itself.
  • Recently deceased corpses can be shrouded in Blood, as if infused with life force, zombifying them into Blood Spirits.
  • Their own Blood can coalesce into a thin Blood-colored figure to attack the enemy.
  • Their own Blood can envelop their body, as though adorning themselves in blood-colored full-body armor.
  • Soul Traversal: They can vanish on the spot and hide within the Undying Lands. While hidden, they can replace of one of the many Souls present, reemerging in its position.
  • This Spell is tied to the Undying Lands, it cannot be used outside of it.
  • The Midwife could no longer cast Soul Traversal upon leaving her Undying Lands.
  • Life Burning: This spell can be used one of two ways; targeting themselves or targeting others, the latter requires sufficient wounds and blood.
  • Targeting themselves will greatly enhance their abilities.
  • Targeting the enemy will directly ignite exposed blood, producing a bright flame that resembled the spring sun. It quickly spreads deep into the wound and into the blood vessels, rapidly draining their life.
  • Weak Black Flame: They can ignite a layer of malevolent Black Flames on a target, rapidly depleting their strength and stamina.
  • Commanding Evil Creatures: They can Command and control Evil Creatures.
  • Heretic Sight:⁂ They are able to detect if someone is under a Curse and location of their blood.
  • Knowledge (Mysticism): They possess the knowledge of and can use the New Life Ritual.
  • New Life Ritual: Through this Ritual, they can give New Life, a method for eliminating the hidden dangers of a Curse.
  • They can use a female statue as a keystone for the ritual; by entering its abdomen and reemerging, it symbolizes a “rebirth.” Coupled with Weak Black Flames burning the statue, it can sever any connection with items that had fallen into the enemy’s hands.

Sequence 6: Sower

Description

A Sower serve as a source of propagation for all living entities, capable of bestowing life, granting healing, and producing seeds.

New Abilities

  • Sowers are studs for all living things, bestowing Life.
  • Whether it is a man, woman, or even animals, so long as they engage in intimate relations with the Sower and exchange bodily fluids, the Sower can conceive a child according to their desire, impregnating others.
  • The child's birth will be accompanied with a bird-like nest where, like a fruit, the outer layer is the epidermis, and the fetus is the pulp. Before birth, the two are joined together, only splitting when ripe.
  • This bird-like nest is a key ingredient for a certain healing Potion, can be used to provide power for Spells, and can enhance the condition of human skin.
  • Pualis de Roquefort (opens in a new tab) impregnated Louis Lund (opens in a new tab) and had him conceive a child.
  • Bestowing Life includes the capacity for Healing.
  • Seed Creation:⁂ A Sower can create Seeds that have a special connection to themself.
  • These Seeds can be used for communication with others. and can also be used to sense the surroundings at Higher Sequences.
  • Other abilities include:
  • They are adept in surgery and can directly heal others. They know a ritual enabling a human to survive for a period even without internal organs
  • They can merge with trees and wooden articles for Concealment, acquire a sturdy shell, and evade detection.
  • They can stimulate the Growth and Reproduction of creatures, including but not limited to rats, fleas, bedbugs, fungi, and various plants. However, this drains their vitality.
  • Their vitality can be replenished through an unsuccessful Child of God descent ritual. Every nine rituals necessitate a batch of internal organs to be replaced
  • They can inflict Curses upon others, summon malevolent creatures, and consume his life for the casting of a few nefarious arts.

Sequence 5: Banshee

Gender Transition

  • Advancing to a Banshee results in becoming a female regardless of the original gender.

Traits

  • Regeneration: A Banshee possesses exaggerated self-Regeneration abilities.
  • Flight: They can sprout a pair of chestnut-brown feathered wings from their back, granting them Flight.
  • They will become slightly more beautiful upon advancement due to the  ![Chaos Primogenitor Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Chaos_Primogenitor_Pathway) Chaos Primogenitor Pathway's adjacency to the  ![Moon Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Moon_Pathway) Moon Pathway, which is the Pathway (opens in a new tab) of Beauty.

New Abilities

  • Weakening Curse: A Banshee can cast Weakening Curses, which work extremely well with their Death Shrieks.
  • Death Shriek (Banshee's Howl/Shriek): A terrifying piercing sound, those affected will feel as though a high-speed spinning drill bored directly through their Soul.
  • This can cause dizziness, unconsciousness, or immediate Death to those with weak constitution or who are affected by multiple Weakening Curses.
  • This causes both spiritual and physical damage, able to wound souls, rupture capillaries, and shatter surrounding barriers.
  • Evil Summoning: They can summon Evil Entities including Devils, Evil Spirits, Wraiths, and creatures from the Cosmos (opens in a new tab).
  • Only weaker Evil Entities are able to pass through the Astral Barrier (opens in a new tab) and thus be successfully summoned by a Banshee.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Black Flames: Their Black Flames can now be fueled by the lives of others.
  • Knowledge (Mysticism): They possess knowledge on and can perform the Rebirth Ritual.

Sequence 4: Madame (Evil Overlord, Benevolent Overlord)

New Abilities

  • Paramita: It is a wilderness they can summon that changes their surroundings, akin to creating an alternate space favorable for the Madame.
  • The Paramita can effectively isolate the inside from the outside.
  • One can escape from Paramita through the wilderness' periphery.
  • Once the Paramita's location is pinpointed by those outside, they can enter.
  • Can be folded and unfolded by them, allowing them to drag others into the Paramita during fights.
  • Within Paramita, they can awaken and control the Undead.
  • In the dream (opens in a new tab), Madame Night (opens in a new tab)'s Paramita contained an Undead horde, among them were Death Knights.
  • Oxyto (opens in a new tab)'s child awakened and controlled the Blessed of Death (opens in a new tab) in the core area of the Underworld.
  • Certain Beyonder powers get enhanced inside Paramita, such as the Banshee's Shriek.
  • Some Paramitas can mutate as a result of the surrounding area or the Madame's uniqueness.
  • Some contain an Underworld and can grant powerful Resurrection capabilities while others can allow for the mass creation and outpour of different living creatures.
  • Pomelo Sago: A dew sprinkled from a mistletoe-wreathed oak branch that heals both body and Spirituality.
  • Resurrection: They can Resurrect the dead and restore their bodies, but it's far from perfect.
  • Resurrected ones aren't quite human anymore, becoming part corpse and part monster. They only retain fragments of their original memories and can only exist for seven days.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Their abilities as a Heretic Spellmaster receive comprehensive enhancement.
  • Commanding Evil Creatures: A Madame can now control high-level Evil creatures like Demons.
  • Both Madame Night (opens in a new tab) and Lady Moon (opens in a new tab) controlled a pair of Demons to pull their carriages in their respective Paramita.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 4 Beyonder they have gained some level of Godhood and with it comes an incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab). Disregarding all consequences, they can release it to be an incomplete colossal winged female composed of stacked Reproductive Organs.

Sequence 3: Divine Mother

Description

A Divine Mother is a weakened version of Sequence 0.

New Abilities

  • Divine Conception:⁂ They can Conceive a God without perishing.
  • As a Divine Mother of future Gods, they are able to suppress storms and absorb them into their body, using them as nourishment for the fetus.
  • In battle, this lets them absorb attacks through their mouth.
  • Facing Madam Judgment's (opens in a new tab) Exile, Lady Moon (opens in a new tab) made it surge through her mouth and permeate her body.
  • The activated Gift of the Land (opens in a new tab) absorbed most of the Lightning generated by the Weather authority from Lumian (opens in a new tab)'s team.
  • In return, the fetus grants the Divine Mother certain special traits, allowing them to acquire traits that typically belong only to Gods in advance, such as the ability to:
  • Manifest a complete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) to a limited extent without losing control.
  • Obtain Godhood for a very brief moment.
  • The corresponding Godhood of a Divine Mother depends on what is being gestated.
  • Deeply utilize the Astral World.
  • The Divine Fetus nestled within their womb empowers them.
  • Empowered by a Divine Fetus and the essence of the Tree of Shadow (opens in a new tab), Lady Moon (opens in a new tab) Revived the accumulated Desires from over a millennium in their original corporeal forms, which included multiple Demigods.
  • They gain the the abilities and traits of the gestated God.
  • Divine Conception relies on external factors; they can't Conceive Gods at will.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: The Supreme (Broken Pillar)

Authorities

  • Reality: The Broken Pillar represents the authority of Reality, a subordinate version of the corresponding Pillar symbolism.
  • Any attacks against "Them" will suffer a backlash from the Physical World, imposing various restrictions.
  • "They" are nearly impossible to kill and are extremely hard to Seal or Exile.
  • New Life: "They" gain initial access to the authority that grants all things Spirit.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" are a complete Mythical Creature. "Their" Mythical Creature Form is a colossal winged female composed of stacked Reproductive Organs. "They" stand loftily, as if holding up the sky itself to prevent it from collapsing, yet "Their" abdomens are entirely hollow.

Sequence 1: Valley God (Tree God)

Description

The Valley God is the root of heaven and earth. The Tree God, supporting heaven and connecting earth, Proliferates endlessly.

Authorities

  • Proliferation & Reproduction: "They" wield authority over Proliferation and Reproduction.
  • "They" can bestow Life and grant New Life to Resurrect the Dead.
  • True Resurrection has prerequisites and time limits; otherwise the Revived being would simply be a monstrous imitation.
  • "They" can create a new personality, subtly altering the target's mind.
  • Once Corrupted by "Their" power, escape is impossible unless "They" withdraw "Their" influence: it perpetuates endlessly.
  • However, some Pathways have abilities to defend against this Corruption such as a Chaos Gastric Juices that can Devour and Digest it.
  • "They" can revoke Life, inducing instant Death.

**Strengthened Abilities*

  • Paramita: Compared to an Attendant of Mysteries' Realm of Mysteries, "Their" Paramita is harder to fully destroy or Seal, but easier to break.
  • Divine Conception: A Sequence 1 Divine Mother.
  • After absorbing the silver-white lightning, resembling a divine tree, a bumpy protrusion emerged from its trunk (opens in a new tab). The bump quickly split open, birthing a "child". This "child" was composed of countless intertwined silver-white electric snakes, the lightning previously swallowed, now Reborn. The "child" instantly disintegrated, terrifying, bright lightning sweeping the surroundings.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form resembles an immense greenish oak tree that seems to pierce the heavens.

Sequence 0: Chaos Primogenitor

Symbolism

  • Nascent Original Creator of the Next Universe: The Chaos Primogenitor is the Original Sin of the universe, the nascent Original Creator (opens in a new tab) of the next universe. Even though currently "It" is only a Sequence 0 in this universe, "It" holds supreme authority and has the most unique symbolism.

Authorities

  • New Life: "It" can endow all things with Spirit, including enemy attacks.
  • Degeneration/Depravity "It" holds an authority over Depravity.
  • While the Hanged Man's Degeneration involves self-Corruption, the Chaos Primogenitor's Degeneration is a comprehensive Corruption of body, mind, and Spirit.
  • Violating one's three outlooks, values, and morals is Degeneration. Violating the Rules established by the Trunsoest Brass Book (opens in a new tab) is also Degeneration.

Note:

  1. The following abilities are listed under Sower, however, in Circle of Inevitability (Novel) (opens in a new tab), Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) notes that said abilities are derived from an amalgamation of the pathways under the Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab).
  2. The reason why they feed on storms specifically is because this sequence is a literal representation of Virgin Mary: The Virgin Mary is also sometimes associated with calming storms, with stories and prayers invoking her intercession to bring peace during turbulent times; essentially, she is seen as a powerful intercessor who can bring calm amidst chaos, drawing on her maternal role as a protector and comforter.

Patriarch Pathway

Sequence 9: Scrooge

New Desire

  • Greed: A Scrooge is exceptionally greedy and stingy. They will go out of their way to pay as little money as possible, pick up any coin they see on the street and never give back a found item if they can help it.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Through the act of not wasting food, a Scrooge will become stronger or more resilient than what their appearance seems to show.

New Abilities

  • Greed Inducement: They can Induce an extreme sense of Greed in a target, compelling them to comply with this Desire, which will be strengthened if an object is used as a medium.
  • Ive (opens in a new tab) gave Lumian (opens in a new tab) a coin during his fake mugging, compelling Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) to take the coin and run instead of continuing with his original plan.
  • Ownership: For a limited time after losing track of their possession, a Scrooge can track objects that belong to them and eventually find the object's current location.
  • After Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) gave Ive's (opens in a new tab) coin to a beggar, Ive (opens in a new tab) was able to track the coin down to the beggar the next day through this ability.
  • Gluttony Inducement: Similarly to Greed Inducement, a Scrooge can Induce a target's appetite, which if used with specific items as medium ensures a better effect.

Sequence 8: Sex Addict

New Desire

  • Lust: Sex Addicts are extremely lustful to the point of needing frequent sex. If there are no willing partners available, Sex Addicts will often fulfill this desire through rape.

Traits

  • Perpetual Condition: Their body and mind are in a state of perpetual hunger and thirst.
  • Their body is constantly maintaining a robust and healthy physical state while they are constantly utilizing mental faculties to augment their strength, reflexes, agility, and resilience.
  • This constant state of excitement grants a Sex Addict resistance to certain influences while also significantly reducing their resistance to the Desired targets.

New Abilities

  • Lust Inducement: Sex Addicts are capable of placing targets into a Lustful state, like they were dosed with a powerful aphrodisiac. They can do this through several means.
  • They can employ their gaze, speech, and actions to subtly Induce a measure of Lust into a a target.
  • Spell-like abilities and physical contact to make the target feel varying degrees of sexual desire.
  • The strongest of which can cause a person to temporarily lose their mind.
  • Knowledge (Drugs): Upon advancement, a Sex Addict will receive an influx of knowledge on the preparation of rape drugs and other similar concoctions.
  • Several known official concoctions are listed below:
  • Truth Serum: A serum that compels those affected to speak the truth. Once the target's Desire to spill secrets is triggered, along with the interrogator's questioning, it becomes exceedingly challenging to lie. What they utter would stem from their innermost Desires.
  • A foul-smelling stimulating gas, that after inhaling, causes the target to sneeze a few times, causing them to wake up and also gradually returning one's strength after being knocked out. This substance is the antidote to the prior one.
  • An odorless gaseous sedative, that after inhaling knocks the target out, leaving their body in a feeble state. A whiff of this odorless gaseous sedative at a close range was enough to severely weaken an Assassin's strength.
  • Hormonal Analysis: They can acquire differentiating hormonal information of various individuals.

Sequence 7: Actor

New Desire

  • Acting: They awaken their hidden Desire to showcase themselves and perform. They require a proper stage to satiate this Desire without arousing suspicion and every applause from the audience validates them. They need to be cautious against becoming too engrossed in their roles while Acting.

Traits

  • Physical Enhancements: An Actor possesses a heightened control over their body.
  • They can manipulate their muscles, skin and bones to a certain extent.

New Abilities

  • Performance Inducement: An Actor can Induce a deep yearning for attention and a Desire to perform inside their targets, which can lead to emotional instability and irritability.
  • During the fight between Rentas (opens in a new tab) and Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab), Lumian (opens in a new tab) was compelled to confront Rentas (opens in a new tab) and speak to him instead of immediately attacking.
  • Acting: An Actor is able to convincingly portray as anything through the process of Acting which not only is reflected in reality but also within the field of mysticism.
  • When Acting as animals, Actors can exhibit certain traits of the animal they’re Acting as.
  • Charlotte Calvino (opens in a new tab) was able to Act as a serpent-like creature and as a result, her body instantaneously grew pliable and was able to secrete a slimy substance.
  • If an Actor portrays a previously observed Beyonder, they can replicate their abilities.
  • These abilities won't have any effects and are more like Illusions; however, if they can closely observe and learn from the Beyonder for several months, they will be able to perform similar but significantly weakened abilities.
  • An Actor is able to imitate certain features of an occupation or identity.
  • They can Act as the opposite gender, but they need to prepare various props such in advance.
  • If they were to Act as a soldier, they'd display remarkable combat and marksmanship abilities.
  • If an Actor portrays an ordinary person, their Astral Projection will appear ordinary as well.
  • They can Act as a person’s shadow and later, detach themselves from the owner to attack.
  • Knowledge (Performance Preparations): They are skilled in actions that aid them in a performance, such as makeup techniques and prop creation.

Sequence 6: Recipient

New Desire

  • Success & Recognition: They crave Success and Recognition from high society or the public.

New Abilities

  • Adrenaline Rush: They can enter an adrenaline-fueled state, dramatically enhancing capabilities.
  • Fulfillment Inducement: A Recipient can invoke a deep yearning for Fulfillment.

Sequence 5: Fallen Tree Spirit (Spirit of Lust, Baby Cupid)

New Desire

  • Possessiveness: Fallen Tree Spirit's Possessiveness will gradually lead them into believing that they're their victim's spouse, driving them to kill the victim's lover(s).
  • Susanna (opens in a new tab) became very possessive of Charlie Collent (opens in a new tab), even convincing herself that she was his wife.

New Abilities

  • Upon advancement, a Fallen Tree Spirit will gain several abilities associated with Tree Spirits, as well as powers that deal with emotional and sexual Desires.
  • Vitality Drain: Through the medium of an intimate act, they can absorb a target's vital energies.
  • Dream Invasion: They are able to project themselves into a target's Dream as either gender.
  • Tree Host: They can be Hosted by a Tree granting them varying, limited special abilities.
  • Examples include a restricted higher rank or being difficult to completely kill.
  • Branch Arrow: A Fallen Tree Spirit is able to shoot Branches as arrows.
  • Illusion Creation: A Fallen Tree Spirit can also create Illusions.
  • Vine Creation: A Fallen Tree Spirit is able to generate vines.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Desire Inducement: At this level, a Fallen Tree Spirit’s ability to invoke Desire is greatly improved, planting cues on a target’s actions, emotions, and thoughts.
  • Susanna (opens in a new tab) could imbue Lumian (opens in a new tab) with the Desire to Live to stop suicide attempts as well as can kindle his Desires and create Illusions to make him 'unite' with a certain flower or crevice.
  • Affected by the Desire to Live, Franca (opens in a new tab) succumbed to intense fear that stems from her knowledge of the current situation, placing her in a dilemma to either flee or stay.

Sequence 4: Tree Supplicant

New Desire

  • Knowledge & Survival: They are driven by the Desire for Knowledge and Survival.

New Abilities

  • Tree Supplication: They can pray to different Trees which grants varying responses and abilities.
  • Fundamentally, the Mother Tree of Desire (opens in a new tab) is a Tree, so it responds with its perpetual blathers.
  • A Tree Supplicant created a human skin castle as a sacrificial ritual that could briefly display power equivalent to Sequence 2 by sacrificing many humans, but it fundamentally couldn't resist a true Angel (opens in a new tab), let alone an Angel (opens in a new tab) leading a team.
  • The abilities that a Tree Supplicant can get cannot be maintained permanently.
  • Treant Summoning: They are able to summon Treants (opens in a new tab).
  • Treant Commanding: They can control Treants (opens in a new tab).

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Desire Priest

New Abilities

  • Desire Executor: Desire Priests are the executors of the concept of Desire.
  • So long as a being has Desires, they can be affected by Desire Priests.
  • Rationality Stripping: They can temporarily Strip others of Rationality.
  • Targets will feel as if they have lost their Soul.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Sequence 3 Beyonders, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Cupid

Authorities

  • Love: "They" have the authority over Love.
  • "They" can mediate Love with two or more entities through a medium.
  • Love is a divine authority and it is not simply a human emotion.
  • As such, a Cupid is able to make others fall in Love with certain ideas and concepts, affect abstract concepts through Love, and make abstract concepts fall in Love.
  • For example, "They" can make "Their" target fall in Love with the concept of "killing".
  • A Cupid is able to fire arrows that steal True Hearts.
  • The Cupids from the Outer Deities' (opens in a new tab) side were able to incite internal strife within Medici's (opens in a new tab) legion of Angels (opens in a new tab) by firing arrows that stole "Their" True Hearts.
  • "They" can make anyone fall in Love with them.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab), "Their" Mythical Creature Form is a Cupid wearing fresh flower wreaths, appearing beautiful, holding wooden a bow and arrow like true deities.

Sequence 1: Leviathan

New Desire

  • Domination: "They" gain the Desire to Dominate others.

Authorities

  • Envy: A Leviathan has gained the authority over Envy.
  • Leviathans are able to stir Envy and dissatisfaction within others.
  • The influence of the Leviathans caused many Angels (opens in a new tab) to become Envious and dissatisfied, nearly leading to the disbandment of Medici's (opens in a new tab) legion.
  • This authority can be applied on abstract concepts.
  • Reason: "They" gain initial authority over Reason.
  • This corresponds to the Heartless God portion of Mother Tree of Desire's (opens in a new tab) Honorific Name (opens in a new tab).

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) developed into a Leviathan, a Tree-like sea monster, covered in slimy blossoms and chaos-slick scales, dotted with brown-green tumors.

Sequence 0: Patriarch

Authorities

  • Sentient Beings & Blathering: "They" are the sovereign of all Sentient Beings: like another father, and the embodiment of wrathful reprimands and agonized murmurs.
  • Desires unextinguished, Blather unceasing, Reasons no longer exist, the Patriarch remains Eternal. When "They" die, another Patriarch will be born within Desires and emotions.
  • The new Patriarch is not the same Patriarch who died before.
  • The Patriarch's perpetual Blathers echo through Desires and emotions, drawing all Sentient Beings to sink into Depravity as they chase Illusionary pursuits.
  • Ravings: "Their" authority over Ravings emphasizes the effects, not the Ravings itself.
  • "They" can utilize Sound interactions to establish mystical connections and influence the thoughts, tendencies, and emotions of living beings.
  • This True Deity also has authorities over Madness and Propagation.

Chaos Mist Pathway

Sequence 9: Broker

New Abilities

  • Brokering: They can facilitate transactions and exchanges through their words and connections.
  • Before reaching a deal, they will agree on a price with both parties, and sometimes no remuneration is required. It’s mainly to establish and maintain relationships.
  • A Broker becomes more attuned to their certain needs and are able to find the suitable candidates needed in order to fulfill those needs and requirements.
  • The main purpose of Brokering is to establish and maintain connections, which does not involve or utilize any supernatural power.
  • Exceptional Eloquence: Upon advancement, a Broker will obtain a mastery of language.
  • As a side effect of Exceptional Eloquence, they can decipher a target's emotions through observance of their facial expression and words.
  • Gray Perception: They can sense the Gray Domain between white and black.
  • White represents Order and black represents Disorder.

Sequence 8: Shadow Merchant

New Abilities

  • Shadow Creature Detection: They can detect mysterious and dangerous creatures hidden in the Darkness and Shadows while remaining safe from their attacks.
  • This allows a Shadow Merchant to Broker deals with said creatures.
  • There are limitations regarding their safety towards these creatures.
  • They will endure the corresponding Corruption if they see something they shouldn't.
  • They can’t attack first or secretly do anything that disadvantages the other party.
  • They can’t harbor Malice when striking a deal, lest the other party discovers it.
  • They will suffer indiscriminate damage if they are embroiled in a battlefield.
  • They cannot make said creatures engaged in combat stand down.
  • Shadow Contract: They can create and sign Contracts with the Shadows of both parties as witnesses, directly connecting them to each other’s Souls.
  • If any of the party members were to violate the Contract, the Shadows will harm their spirits. The spiritual damage the violator faces is akin to that of a powerful Curse.
  • They can use their control over symbolic Shadows to secretly modify key terms the moment it is signed, allowing them to twist the Contract in their favor.
  • Pacifying Aura: A Shadow Merchant possesses an aura that automatically reduces any nearby creatures' Malice to an extent.
  • The higher the target's level, the weaker Pacifying Aura's effect will be.
  • Shadow Utilization: They possess the ability to utilize Shadows of both a real and symbolic nature.
  • Fake Shadow Creation: They can create fake Shadows to deceive their enemies.
  • Shadow Transformation: They can transform themselves into a Shadow.
  • This allows them to move great distances and avoid physical damage.
  • Shadow Concealment: They can Conceal themselves in Shadows.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Brokering: Their ability to create connections and facilitate exchange of valuable items have increased.
  • Jebus Lata (opens in a new tab) was able to obtain bullets that can absorb Life, cause a target’s Implosion, and Impregnate a human through his transactions and connections.
  • A Shadow Merchant can attempt to find items at the level of a Demigod, but it will take a long time, and the success rate would not be very high.

Sequence 7: Prosecutor

New Abilities

  • Knowledge (Words of Order): They will gain an initial knowledge on the Words of Order, a supernatural language that is used to enable their Accusations.
  • Crime Discernment: A Prosecutor will be able to discern the target's crimes, but they are not able to witness the process of the target doing the crime.
  • Accusation: Through the Words of Order, a Prosecutor can first declare individuals as guilty and then Accuse them of various charges.
  • For ongoing crimes, they can directly Accuse the target, not needing to specify the charges, which forms a restriction on the target, making it hard for them to move and use any abilities.
  • The Accused target will receive the corresponding punishment from some entity or the world itself.
  • The exact punishment depends on the severity of the target’s crime with the most terrifying punishments leading the Accused target to immediate die and lose control on the spot.
  • The damage and effects of different crimes are completely different. They cannot predict it beforehand and can only make a guess based off of their previous "cases".
  • Lumian (opens in a new tab) experienced a massive amount of Corruption from the Circle of Inevitability (opens in a new tab) upon being Accused of blasphemy, however, he was saved by Mr. Fool (opens in a new tab)'s Seal.
  • It is not clear to even the Prosecutor using Accusation on how crimes are determined.
  • Jebus Lata (opens in a new tab) speculated that an act recognized as a crime by most humans would be considered. It includes blasphemy, murder, rape, fraud, theft, and so on while Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) speculated the charges stem from something more fundamental.

Sequence 6: Ambitionist

New Abilities

  • Ambitious Drive: The inexhaustible Ambition of an Ambitionist brings about a powerful physique, a keen perception, and an outstanding Spirituality.
  • Mental Resistance: Their burning Ambitions make them unwilling to rest even for a moment, allowing them to resist being forced into Dreams, comas, or other debilitating states.
  • The Sequence 5 Under the Table, Jebus Lata (opens in a new tab), woke up and quickly used Shadow Utilization before he hit the ground right after taking a direct hit from Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab)'s Spell of Harrumph.
  • Combat Proficiency: The Ambitious Drive of an Ambitionist will drive them to constantly pursue improvements in their combat abilities.

Sequence 5: Under the Table

New Abilities

  • Under-the-Table: The sole Beyonder power they gain upon advancement. There are 2 ways to use it:
  • They are able to establish an unseen and tranquil Under-the-Table atmosphere in combat and emergency scenarios. Through this, an Under-the-Table can forcefully cause their enemies to comply with their demands by offering them valuable items in exchange.
  • There are around 3 things they need to keep in mind for a successful Under-the-Table:
  1. A target's inclination and experience in the Gray Domain determine the success rate, with those having more experience and inclination being more likely to be affected.
  • Even without the suppression of Godhood from a Demigod, it would be almost impossible for an Unshadowed to fall victim to an Under-the-Table transaction.
  1. They must behave normally. If not, the enemy(s) who agreed to the transaction may recognize that something is off and immediately snap out of its effects.
  • Being reminded of their abnormal actions and state during an Under-the-Table by a third party can help an affected target snap out of its effects.
  1. The Sequence 5 Under the Table cannot injure the effected target(s) or impact their state in any other way during and throughout the transaction.
  • The second application allows an Under the Table to utilize a barely Sealed space in order to form a true Under-the-Table scenario. This application of this Beyonder ability requires time and is not suitable during combat and emergency scenarios.
  • In this Under the Table state, where they don't know the counterparty or how their needs will be fulfilled through the transaction, they can achieve the desired result by stating their request and offering the item the other party desires. How this is accomplished isn't relevant.
  • The other party(s) may possess malicious intentions, which may cause hidden negative effects to occur to the Under the Table.
  • The other party(s) involved in the transaction may be able to circumvent the rules of the Under-the-Table transaction.
  • The difficulty of the task itself as well as the items given are what limits the effectiveness of this type of transaction.
  • There is a possibility of running into swindlers during an Under the Table deal.
  • When such a scenario occurs, they will be in one side of the table, and the mysterious creature or entity concealed in the Shadows and Darkness will be on the other side.
  • They won't know the party(s) identity beforehand or sense who the other party is. The identity of the other party(s) could be some entity they have previously dealt with or a completely new entity from the unknown.
  • Such Under-the-Table transactions are not limited to 2-way exchanges. These transactions can be a three-way deal, a four-way deal, or even more.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Gray Perception: They can use this to assess their target's experience and inclination in the Gray Domain, allowing them to judge if an Under-the-Table transaction would be successful.

Sequence 4: Overseer

New Abilities

  • Overseeing: An Overseer can monitor everything within a range of 200-2000 meters, including things such as secrets, 'hidden spaces', subordinates and exert influence on that area.
  • As Overseeing is a sacred duty, this Beyonder power grants them Protection. This makes them immune to any attacks from beings without Godhood, reflecting them as punishment.
  • Since nuclear bombs don't possess any Godhood, they can survive a nuclear explosion.
  • Against beings with Godhood, they can invoke Protection, creating invisible barriers that block 2-3 strikes, each time inflicting a certain degree of punishment to the attacker.
  • They can Oversee Contractual parties and automatically enforce punishment.
  • They can direct influence on anything they Oversee via the Words of Order.
  • By declaring in the Words of Order, "An Overseer sees all secrets!", Perle (opens in a new tab) was able to reveal and destroy the Bottle of Fiction that Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) and Anthony Reid (opens in a new tab) were residing in.
  • When Jebus (opens in a new tab) was going to say the location of the School of Truth (opens in a new tab)'s headquarters and the Overseer he reports to, he suddenly exploded from the inside out, his shattered flesh merging with the pale-white fog, transforming into a peculiar blood mist before seeping into the soil.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Gray Perception: They can detect traces of the Gray Domain that enter the area they are Overseeing.
  • Under-the-Table: The conditions that limit the second application of this power has been loosened.
  • They no longer need a long amount of time to create a true Under-the-Table scenario, being capable of achieving the effect by placing an item inside a "Sealed" space (such as a bag).
  • By paying a steep price and offering up a considerable number of precious items, Perle (opens in a new tab) was able to affect two demigods (opens in a new tab) and Lumian (opens in a new tab)'s team to give up far too readily and hastily with Moran Avigny (opens in a new tab)'s case.
  • Some characteristics of the individual may make it difficult to do Under-the-Table transactions against them.
  • Although Mr. K (opens in a new tab) had done worse things than Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab), he only had a small Gray spot. This suggested that finishing an Under the Table transaction with Mr. K (opens in a new tab) would be hard, as if it needed certain conditions. It seemed to come from extreme devotion. All Under the Table transactions can only keep going with the permission of the one (opens in a new tab) he has faith in.
  • Accusation: This Beyonder power has undergone a qualitative enhancement in power.
  • They can Oversee unpunished crimes and have those crime victims manifest to attack the target.
  • However, If the crime is too severe for a punisher to manifest directly, the punisher will simply disintegrate against the target.
  • The effects and duration of their Accusations will persist until the target is well and truly dead.
  • Lumian's (opens in a new tab) punishment from Perle (opens in a new tab) was in the form of a Lightning bolt continued to persist and manifest in different forms as it continued to chase after him.
  • Accusations can now be used to redirect or even nullify the opponent's attacks and abilities.
  • Perle (opens in a new tab) caused Lumian's (opens in a new tab) Implosion Bullet and Flame Spears to redirect towards himself.
  • Jenna (opens in a new tab)'s Invisibility was completely nullified as a blaze of Sunlight exposed her body.
  • Accusations can use other individuals and aspects of the target as an effect.
  • Upon being Accused by Perle (opens in a new tab), the Accusation's effect caused Madame Judgement's (opens in a new tab) Confinement to fully encase Franca (opens in a new tab) and Jenna (opens in a new tab), preventing them from leaving.
  • Through an Accusation, Perle (opens in a new tab) was able to utilize Madame Judgement's (opens in a new tab) Exile in order to send the Sealed Artifact (opens in a new tab) Pride Armor (opens in a new tab) out of the Sealed Mirror World.
  • Shadow Utilization: They gain an enhancement to their use of Shadows.
  • Brokering: They can obtain rarer items through their connections.
  • Perle (opens in a new tab) was able to create a counterfeit exit to the Mirror World that was able to fool the senses of Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) through her connections.
  • Perle (opens in a new tab) was able to obtain a Mystical Item (opens in a new tab) that allowed her to create an exact Substitute of her that can use her Beyonder powers.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Vortex Weaver[

New Abilities

  • Vortex Weaving: A Vortex Weaver is the core of all transactions, capable of forming complex networks. They have essentially become a true "platform".
  • The Vortex that is created involves more complex transactions with multiple different traders.
  • Transactions can occur between any of the groups involved. There can be a three-way, four-way, or even more parties involved. Connecting the corresponding lines creates a Web or a Vortex, involving many people.
  • All participants of the Vortex contribute power to maintain the Ritual until their part of the transaction is complete. Thus, once the Vortex was formed, destroying it would become increasingly difficult.
  • Even the grievous wounding of the Vortex Weaver would not stop the Vortex. Their complete death is needed to stop the Vortex - a difficult task even for Angels (opens in a new tab).
  • During the Vortex, they would transform into white mist and be a part of the Vortex.
  • This allows them to disappear and reappear within it at will, making them very hard to hit.
  • When grievously wounded, they can still barely survive by utilizing the white mist.
  • When announcing the transactions, they announce it using the Words of Order.
  • They are able to initiate trades across spatial distances without prerequisites.
  • From the Primitive Island in Fog Sea (opens in a new tab), Perle (opens in a new tab) formed a Vortex that encompassed Port Santa (opens in a new tab), Trier (opens in a new tab), areas beyond the Astral Barrier (opens in a new tab), as well as the locations of Higdon (opens in a new tab), Héloise (opens in a new tab), Voisin Sanson (opens in a new tab), Harrison (opens in a new tab), Mr. Sage (opens in a new tab), Madam Hart (opens in a new tab), and the Chained God (opens in a new tab).
  • They can ignore disparities in level with the protection of the Ritual.
  • Perle (opens in a new tab) was protected by the Ritual during Project Vortex (opens in a new tab) and accepted a wisp of mist from the Uncertain Mist (opens in a new tab), which allowed her to remain unaffected despite having knowledge of and speaking about Above the Sequence beings.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can listen to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Blasphemer (Angel of Blasphemy)

Authorities

  • Deconstruction: "They" can Deconstruct binary oppositions, such as all that is Sacred and Profane, and Light and Shadow all alike. Deconstruction is subordinate to Truth authority.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Under-the-Table: "They" can Steal power from transactions, even if they involve higher level beings.
  • The limit of the power an Angel of Blasphemy can Steal is at the level of Great Old Ones, but "They" would likely crumble and perish in the process.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" have become a full Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab). "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) takes the appearance of an Uncertain and shifting Fog.

Sequence 1: Truth

Authorities

  • Truth: "They" are the Truth and everything within the Gray areas shall be defined by "Them"; Light is too extreme, Darkness is too Corrupt. Order is too rigid, and Shadows are too Distorted: Grayness is the only ultimate Truth of the universe.
  • Truth can, to a certain extent, redefine and substitute logic. It operates in accordance with Gray principles, more often introducing ambiguity and blurring into logic, or first Deconstructing existing logic, rather than directly altering it.
  • In Truth, the ways of human relations are Truth; not only the inherent flaws of all humanity, but also the art of dealings among True Deities.

Sequence 0: Chaos Mist

Authorities

  • Chaos (Uncertainty): The embodiment of Chaos from the Son of Chaos (opens in a new tab). "They" can make all Certainties become Uncertain, including the trajectory of Fate, Inevitable outcomes, and even words spoken face-to-face or events that just happened.
  • A Chaos Mist cannot alter what has already happened; rather, "They" can render the developments or outcomes that must follow from such events no longer certain.

Tail-Devourer Pathway

Sequence 9: Tramp

Traits

  • Digestive Enhancements: Their digestive capabilities become notably stronger.

New Abilities

  • Hunger: Having lost everything else, they are always searching for food, barely surviving.
  • Their overwhelming craving for food becomes their primary Desire. In other words, the impact other Desires have on them become significantly reduced.
  • Adaptation: A Tramp's ability to Adapt to their environment has been improved.
  • Combat Proficiency (Street Fighting): They gain good street fighting skills.

Sequence 8: Glutton

Traits

  • Digestive Enhancements: They have gained a qualitative enhancement in their digestion.
  • Such Digestive Enhancements a Glutton has gained encompass:
  • Possessing strong, powerful teeth, and a bite force that exceed normal limits.
  • Internal organs that are better suited for digesting food and absorbing energy.
  • Being resistant to most toxins, viruses and bacteria that are inside food.
  • However, their resistance to these substances does have it's limits and many Gluttons perish from indiscriminate consumption.
  • Being able to derive different abilities from food more efficiently.
  • Hunger: Hunger and the want for food truly becomes ingrained in a Glutton's body.
  • A Glutton's appetite will exceed human limits.

Sequence 7: Gourmet

Traits

  • Digestive Enhancements: Their digestion and consumption abilities will improve further.

New Abilities

  • Ingredient Analysis: The core ability of a Gourmet. With it, they can Analyze and discern various Ingredients and their corresponding properties for cooking.
  • They are able to Analyze whether or not certain Ingredients are able to be consumed.
  • They are able to Analyze which Ingredients can bring along certain special effects.
  • They know what Ingredients to combine together to achieve a maximum effect.
  • They can extract certain information or memories from the consumed food.

Sequence 6: Chef

Individual Differences

Every Chef has different characteristics and abilities due to the food they’ve Cooked.

New Abilities

  • Cooking: Chefs are able to use special ingredients to create mystical dishes, pastries, drinks, and cocktails that can give effects and abilities that are either permanent or temporary.
  • A Chef is not actually able to consume entire Beyonder Characteristics yet. For now, a Chef is only able to use Beyonder Characteristics as mystical ingredients for their dishes.
  • The strength of the traits and abilities a Chef can obtain from Cooking far less than those acquired by other methods like a Scribe's Recording or a Shepherd's Grazing.
  • As long as a Chef embraces their Hunger and greed, there won’t be an upper limit to the number of permanent effects a Chef can obtain through various mystical foods.
  • Depending on the ingredients and finished products, the mystical dishes or cocktails with permanent effects created by a Chef will bring forth a variety of downsides.
  • Similar to the permanent effects gained, there’s no limit to the number of negative effects.
  • These downsides are significantly weaker than those a Contractee will face.
  • Examples of the permanent effects a consumer can gain from a Chef's dishes are:
  • Gaining potent self healing capabilities that are only outrivaled by a Vampire.
  • Altering one's lineage to become a symbolic "child" of a certain entity.
  • Having one's infertility become completely cured.
  • Being able to easily use **Cogitation.
  • After eating a boon recipient (opens in a new tab) of the  ![Chaos Mist Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Chaos_Mist_Pathway) Chaos Mist Pathway, Lez (opens in a new tab) gained the ability to discern who deserved to die.
  • Eating books won't grant them knowledge, they would have to eat the teachers.
  • Ingredient Processing: Chefs have excellent skills in Processing Ingredients.
  • They are excellent in the technique of cutting, chopping, and slicing.
  • They can find and exploit weaknesses within Ingredients.

Sequence 5: Depriver

Traits

  • Digestive Enhancements: They are able to consume Corruption to a certain degree, as well as Lightning, Fireballs, and other energy forms via their digestive system.
  • Bainar (opens in a new tab) opened his mouth wide and sucked the blazing-white fireball created by Lumian (opens in a new tab) like a whale swallowing water, remaining unharmed.
  • They can spit out the things they have Devoured as attacks against their enemies.
  • In face against the massive, blazing-white fireball shot by Lumian (opens in a new tab), the bar owner (opens in a new tab)'s eyes narrowed, and he immediately spewed the blazing-white flames from his stomach, transforming them into a torrent to meet the incoming fireballs.

New Abilities

  • Deprivation: They can strip one to three abilities from a target for a period of time.
  • If they then consume part of the target’s flesh, they permanently gain one of those abilities, and the target permanently loses it unless they drink a potion again or kill the corresponding Depriver.
  • When Depriving abilities, the Depriver also takes away the Beyonder Characteristics corresponding to the Beyonder power.
  • This Deprivation is more like a Theft of the ability like a Prometheus, Erasing this ability from the target, rather than a Deprivation like an Imperative Mage.
  • They can sense which abilities and traits of the enemy are most dangerous to them. Even if they don't know exactly what those abilities and traits are, they can still Deprive the abilities of them based on the level of danger they pose.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Ingredient Processing: A Depriver is able to Process Corruption, Fireballs, Lightning, and other energy forms and use them as Ingredients for their Cooking.
  • Bainar (opens in a new tab) raised his nearly shattered cleaver and slashed at the blazing-white fireball. The fireball split in two, losing its momentum and destructive aura.
  • Cooking: Upon advancing into a Depriver, they gain an enhancement to their Cooking abilities and can Cook dishes using Corruption and energy forms.
  • By using Abscessed Hand (opens in a new tab)'s corpse as an Ingredient, Bainar (opens in a new tab) and those who also ate it gained some self-healing ability, became stronger on moonlit nights, and learned some dark spells.
  • But in return, self-control would significantly decrease, intelligence would regress, and nightmares would be frequent.
  • Bainar (opens in a new tab) was able to make Abscessed Hand (opens in a new tab)'s rotten flesh look and smell like real steak.

Sequence 4: Sea Monster

Traits

  • Sea Monster Transformation: At this Sequence, they have transformed into a truly colossal being- a veritable Sea Monster- possessing Sea Monster levels of strength and vitality.
  • Digestive Enhancements: A Sea Monster's digestive capabilities have been greatly strengthened, making them capable of consuming 10 to 20 tons of food in one feeding.
  • Ludwig (opens in a new tab)'s mouth kept opening wider, until eventually, his entire head and body seemed to become part of the mouth, with sharp teeth reflecting the brilliant sunlight, creating a massive whirlpool in the sea, swallowing marine creatures numbered in the thousands, streaming endlessly.
  • The massive whirlpool's appearance triggered changes in the sea area, with water currents becoming turbulent and massive waves rising in the distance.
  • They can directly consume attacks and consume Beyonder Characteristics and Mystical Items (opens in a new tab) of other Pathways- which they can then Digest and store, allowing them to be used by them.
  • The latter does not cause them to lose control, but it will make them gradually accumulate both madness and an ever-growing Hunger.
  • At the Sea Monster level, their Digestive Enhancements can allow them to consume a Parasite that is living inside their body.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Hydra

Traits

  • Sea Monster Transformation: The Beyonder Characteristics and Mystical Items (opens in a new tab) they have consumed have been Digested and absorbed, becoming the Hydra's other bodies and heads.
  • Topsy (opens in a new tab) transformed into a monster towering dozens or hundreds of meters high, with a lower body resembling a giant snake covered in shark-like skin with hidden evil patterns. The upper body split into nine necks, each with a different head-some resembling snakes, some like giant sharks, some with wet black wolf heads, some possibly of legendary dragons. The most bizarre central head appeared human but had only a mouth left, with teeth sharp enough to crush anything.
  • The Hydra can launch out 9 simultaneous attacks.
  • Digestive Enhancements: They are able to Devour a Seal.
  • Another light point had already expanded, revealing a member of the School of Deliciousness (opens in a new tab), Topsy (opens in a new tab), Devouring an invisible Seal over the ocean.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Angel of Devouring

Authorities

  • Devouring & Erasure: "They" have gain initial mastery over the authorities of Devouring and Erasing, capable of Erasing some conceptual things.
  • There are limits to the number and range of things that can be Devoured and "They" are not able to directly Devour an entire area or tangible target.
  • To Devour physical targets and areas, "They" instead have to create a vortex in "Their" mouths and draw the target in before proceeding to the next step.
  • "Their" core ability is to Devour the rules and various shallow-level concepts governing the area.
  • Depending on how it was Devoured, a Devoured concept can recover on its own with time or permanently disappear from the area unless outside powers interfere.
  • Ludwig Phil (opens in a new tab) Devoured the concept of "gold" from a chandelier, causing it to dull and blacken. And with interference from Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab), the concept was returned.
  • Any rule "They" Devour can be replicated by "Them" once. Repeated use of a rule requires "Them" to Devour the source of such rules.
  • Ludwig Phil (opens in a new tab) Devoured the rule of 'sunlight illumination' and engulfed a space in Darkness. Later, "He" replicated the use of that rule to bring back light within the place.
  • Similar to Devouring concepts, a Devoured rule can also recover depending on how long it was Devoured. This takes anywhere between one to three minutes.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become full Mythical Creatures. "They" appear as a dark vortex revealing bared white teeth and chaotic liquid encompassing all colors: much like an abstract, living stomach.

Sequence 1: Chaos Gastric Juices

Authorities

  • Devouring & Erasure: "They" are the embodiment of the authority- the Cleanser of the Universe.
  • Except for Uniquenesses (opens in a new tab), Sefirot, Beyonder Characteristics, and the mental imprints of the Great Old Ones, everything else can be Digested and Erased- even "Their" own brain and wisdom.
  • "They" are able to Devour things such as “emotions”, “memories”, “spirit”, “consciousness”, “night”, “day”, “good”, “evil”, “order”, and “disaster”.
  • If released, the third layer of the Box of the Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) might start by consuming the subconscious and the deepest parts of the islands of consciousness. It would eat emotions, memories, spirit, and consciousness, then flesh and blood, then night, day, good, evil, order, and disaster. It would continue until it consumed parts of the world's fundamental rules, destabilizing reality and dissolving the barriers at their foundation.
  • As opposed to an Angel of Devouring, a Chaos Gastric Juices can now directly Devour an area in reality and everything within it.
  • If the third layer were to be opened, the Box of the Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) would Devour everything within the surrounding area.
  • The Corruption that a Tree God is able to give can be Devoured and Digested by a Chaos Gastric Juices.
  • A Chaos Gastric Juice's domain is not merely eating and Devouring; it also governs the domains of Digestion, Utilization, and Erasure.
  • Unlike Concealment- which simply hides and can be later recovered- the Devouring of a Chaos Gastric Juices leaves nothing behind.

Sequence 0: Tail-Devourer (Self-Devourer, Gluttony)

Description

The Sequence 0 name means Devouring oneself, Digesting oneself, and growing oneself anew.

Authorities

  • Convergence & Hunger: "They" have mastered the authority of Convergence and Hunger.
  • The Tail-Devourer is constantly striving to Devour everything- even "Themselves"- to achieve the ultimate Convergence and a corresponding sense of satiety.
  • Because of "Their" Convergence authority, even if "They" lack the explicit ability to Devour and Digest Fate, "They" can still influence it to some extent.

Condenser Pathway

Sequence 9: Astronomy Aficionado

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: An Astronomy Aficionado will obtain an enhanced physique.

New Abilities

  • Knowledge (Astronomy): An Astronomy Aficionado will gain an initial perception of reality.
  • They focus on acquiring knowledge of the Cosmos (opens in a new tab) and it's related information.
  • An Astronomy Aficionado excels at observing changes among the Stars.
  • They can calculate the patterns within the Stars as well as the timing of Celestial phenomena.

Sequence 8: Star Worshipper

New Abilities

  • Language of Stars (Star Language): A Star Worshipper has gained knowledge of and can decipher the Language of Stars in order to receive insights from Fate.
  • This gives them potent Spiritual Intuition, which can manifest in the form of change in the Stars.
  • This change extends through changes of tides, the waves of the sea, and the trajectories of the Stars thus allowing them to avoid danger and make the right choices.
  • Beside the incumbent Governor of the Sea, Juan Oro (opens in a new tab) noticed the once calm azure sea undulating while the barely visible Stars in the gray sky underwent changes, stirring an inexplicable throbbing and emotional shift within him; however, he was unable to determine if the anomaly was good or bad.

Sequence 7: Star Sacrificer

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Their physique and durability has been strengthened.

New Abilities

  • A Star Sacrificer gains powers through Sacrifical Rituals involving the Stars.
  • Some powers they can gain through these rituals are as follows:
  • Gravity Abnormality: Through the power of the land and the Stars, they can make the gravity of an area either increase or decrease to a certain extent.
  • They are able to use this to cause the target to be firmly bound in place and unable to move.
  • They can also lift the target into suspension.
  • They can use gravity on themselves and stomp heavily, causing a building to sway.
  • They can use this to crumble and redirect the trajectories of different attacks.
  • This can allowing them to not have their chest completely obliterated when they get punched by the crimson nearly white flaming fist of a Conspirer.
  • They can have their palm intercept a bullet, having it decelerate and spin before landing in their palm, as if it had fallen into a thick swamp.
  • They can greatly dim ambient light with the use of this Beyonder power.
  • Cosmic Ray: They have mastered a type of Cosmic Ray known as a Weakening Ray which causes rapid internal destruction to any target it hits.
  • If not treated with the corresponding Beyonder abilities, the target will suffer an irreversible and exceptionally painful death.
  • The Cosmic Ray attack of a Star Sacrificer moves at the speed of light and thus can only be dodged in advance.
  • Electromagnetic Attraction: They are able to attract 2 targets together, including their own body, through Electromagnetic Attraction.
  • Cosmic Void: A Star Sacrificer can create this half-real Illusion that resembles a pitch-black void created through gravity lensing.
  • The target trapped inside would still be in the real world once they passed the barrier of Spirituality that is the end of the Cosmic Void.
  • This was because the mid to low-level Cosmic Void resembled more of an Illusion. There would be a barrier akin to a wall of Spirituality around them. After falling into it, their bodies remained in reality.
  • The exact appearance of the Cosmic Void is that of a pitch black void with glimmers of light at the depths of the darkness.

Sequence 6: Navigator

**New Abilities

  • Guidance (Direction): They possess a deeper understanding of Space and Dimensions, allowing them to locate hidden illusory passageways in the void, hidden from the normal eye as well as navigate and adjust routes between the Stars. Guiding ships at sea becomes a straightforward task to them.
  • A Navigator can detect potential escape routes using this Beyonder power and be able to rapidly distance themselves from their original location.
  • Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) surveyed the areas untouched by shadows, discerning vague figures drifting in the void, intermittently appearing and disappearing.
  • Lato Guiaro (opens in a new tab) identified several "passages" in the silver hall suffused with cerulean-blue gasses, imperceptible to ordinary humans.
  • They can hide within these illusory passageways, being hidden from ordinary eyes; however, this does not let them directly escape attacks.
  • They can locate and access hidden Doors or passageways within the void such as the entrances of areas like the Bottle of Fiction.
  • This Beyonder power also allows them to Guide some extraterrestrial being into the area and to obtain their assistance.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Cosmic Ray: They can gain potential mastery over an additional Cosmic Ray type.
  • Their eyes now can emit two beams of blue light that can penetrate through a target's body while simultaneously weakening their aura.

Sequence 5: Tidal Scholar

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Their body possesses very durable Starlight scales.
  • A Tide Scholar's physical strength is also strong enough to break their own sternum with a slam of their chest, causing their flesh to tear open and blood to release like a torrent.
  • A Tidal Scholar is also able to rapidly transform into a humanoid lizard. Their eyes will turn vertical, their scales will grow and their limbs will thicken.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Gravity Abnormality: They gain further mastery over Gravity and can whip up massive waves capable of shattering ships and demolishing docks, with such Gravitational control applicable to other aspects.
  • A Tidal Scholar can manipulate the weight or flotation of objects by using the power of the lands and Stars, thus being able to alter their speed.
  • This can be used to slow down targets or attacks as if they were stuck in amber, effectively blocking them. This application also works with energy bodies such as Fireballs or the Purification Halo of the Sun Pathway.
  • They can use the power of the waves to increase the potency of their attacks. Such strikes are capable of parrying an attack of a **Dawn Paladin**.
  • Unable to dodge and employ other abilities in time, Ultraman (opens in a new tab) unleashed a punch resembling a thousand tonnes of sea water causing the sound of surging tides to echo.
  • Enveloped by an ethereal tide, Lato Guiaro (opens in a new tab) swung his fist, resembling a colossal wave crashing down, diverting the broadsword of light that was about to hit him.
  • They can use their control over Gravity to pull the fabric of any unstable Space, which could be established by some Beyonder power.
  • A Tidal Scholar is able to intensify their target's Heaviness, thus rendering the affected target unable to move normally.
  • A Tidal Scholar is able to utilize Gravity Abnormality in order to Fly or induce oscillations in the surrounding air.
  • They can extend their hand and pull, stirring the void as a means of uncovering Concealed entities or areas.
  • Language of Stars (Star Language): They can sense impending danger through Fate Perception.
  • Fate Perception is an obtained from deciphering the Language of Stars.
  • Cosmic Void: They can willingly allow objects to manifest correspondingly in the Cosmic Void.
  • They can also create a localized bleed between reality and the Cosmic Void, where illumination is drawn across the threshold, dimming the environment due to the "bleeding".
  • Cosmic Ray: They can apply Cosmic Rays to other areas such as Spatial constructs.
  • Their Weakening Ray can rapidly melt, peel and expose the flesh beneath a target.

Sequence 4: Heavybringer

Traits

  • Physical Enhancement: Upon advancing into a Heavybringer, their body goes through a qualitative change, becoming extremely dense and durable.

New Abilities

  • Heavybringing: They can bring forth Heaviness, attracting everything within a hundreds to thousands of meters radius and influencing their movements.
  • The effect of this is akin to an unusually heavy iron ball falling from the center of a taut fishing net, dragging objects down and pulling the surrounding net with it. In these circumstances, still objects, people, and energy bodies (like Flames) will begin to naturally slip away, and those who are in a state of Concealment will become exposed.
  • When Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) had a temporary Boon of a Heavybringer he caused the Gravity to shift, causing Flames, bottles, organs from various body parts, lightweight items in the room and a hidden Prinpino (opens in a new tab) to soar towards him.
  • In this state a Heavybringer's Heaviness will be strong enough to pull light-based things such as Starlight as well as be able to become Heavy enough to bend the surrounding Void and make a ship begin to sink with nearby seawater being pushed aside.
  • When close enough to the Heavybringer, targets will feel a Spatial inversion, as if there front and back has been switched up and down.
  • A Heavybringer is also able to pull Soul and Spirit Bodies towards them through their pull formed from being the Source of Gravity.
  • A Heavybringer can increase their own Weight to resist attempts at Banishment or the Winds created from the Tyrant Pathway.
  • Examples of this are:
  • Silently, Lumian (opens in a new tab) witnessed the sea around him morphing into a translucent azure mountain peak, looming over them as they descended to the seabed. It resembled the walls of a deep well, and the well mouth, formed by these walls, grew more distant with each passing moment. Till the betrothal ship, now resting on the seabed as if weighed down by a colossal boulder.
  • It can distort the River of Fate (opens in a new tab) for everyone present towards the Heavybringer causing future Fate Tributaries to narrow and converge, inevitably leading to one possibility. This can be used to inevitably converge Fate Tributaries to the possibility of death.
  • A Heavybringer possesses an attraction to Fate, and can bestow a series of Misfortunes and orchestrate tragedies, as well as bestow Fortune.
  • Over the next two years, Clémence Athana's (opens in a new tab) family suffered a series of misfortunes: Her father, intoxicated, fell into a cesspit at night and drowned; her mother, overcome with grief, hanged herself; her siblings killed each other over inheritance disputes; and her sister, who had gone home to intervene, went missing and was never found.
  • A Heavybringer can also converge Fate into a possibility of Losing Control.
  • The deputy hosts, apart from Lumian (opens in a new tab), felt an unseen force tugging at them. Struggling, they staggered towards the humanoid Sealed Artifact. The sea’s power within them wavered, propelling them to the surface, revealing sparkling starry scales that hinted at losing control. The Maidens of the Sea (opens in a new tab) and the sailors on the ship struggled against the terrifying suction force, swaying on the spot. Some experienced their skin smoothing, others felt scales emerging in their flesh, and a few shifted their feet intermittently.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Gravity Abnormality: This ability has undergone a qualitative enhancement.
  • They are able to manipulate vortices and massive waves through Gravity and can create terrifying meteors through accumulated dust.
  • They are able to impose immense Weight upon targets, and those with insufficient constitutions may collapse inwards on the spot.
  • Heavybringers can use Gravity Abnormality to bend the area, thus forcefully yanking out a Traveler amidst Teleportation.
  • A Heavybringer can make the air surrounding the target immediately grow Dense, as if it were assuming a tangible form.
  • This causes an illusory curtain to bend, compressing the corresponding area into a dark and transparent sphere, forcibly separating the Spirit World within and outside the sphere.
  • Teleportation abilities at the Sequence 5 level, such as Traveler's Blink, will not be able to escape the dark sphere's confines.
  • They can use their wave generation abilities in the Spirit World as a means to slow down and Seal Teleportation.
  • Cosmic Void: With a gesture, they can cause a target to be placed in an semi-real, semi-false Illusion of a Cosmic Void, with specks of brilliance shimmering in their eyes, as if the Cosmos (opens in a new tab) had descended.
  • This was fundamentally different from lower-middle-level abilities. It is now both an illusory realm and an alternate Space that could cause people to lose themselves and become abnormally fragile, akin to a Bottle of Fiction augmented with hallucinations.
  • It puts the target in an empty night sky with Stars and makes them rooted the ground in a daze. Without any other actions, they will resemble a machine that had lost it's energy and controller.
  • A Heavybringer, through their eyes, can Banish a target into the Cosmic Void and leave them disoriented and unable to find an exit for a certain period of time.
  • Similar to the Space Concealment of a **Secret Sorcerer**, such a Cosmic Void has only 1 real exit/Door and it extends to the Spirit World, effectively Sealing Teleportation as an exit.
  • A Heavybringer is able to repeatedly cast other parties into the Cosmic Void, making those affected repeatedly lose themselves over and over again.
  • A Heavybringer can use their wave generation abilities inside the Cosmic Void through the manipulation of the Stars within it.
  • Guidance (Direction): At this level, a Heavybringer is capable of remote perception, which allows for the observation of targets far from one's field of view as well as perceiving through solid matter.
  • Lumian (opens in a new tab), using the temporary authority as the Governor of the Sea (opens in a new tab), used his enhanced perception to see the flesh-and-blood bird’s nest deep within the metal tunnel more distinctly than before. Simultaneously, he sensed a connection between the black hole-like object and another place. A profound, weighty, dense, and terrifying aura loomed over the world.
  • Cosmic Ray: They can now control various Cosmic Rays.
  • Weakening Ray: A Heavybringer can condense a dark-green light in their hands and fire it toward their target which causes the target's skin to melt and their aura to rapidly wane.
  • Series of Cosmic Rays: They can condense a dark-green light that descends in a series of rays, powerful enough to rapidly weaken a Tidal Scholarto the point of death.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Star Shepherd

New Abilities

  • Electromagnetism:⁂ A Star Shepherd has a deep mastery over the Electromagnetic Force, encompassing the Strong and Weak Forces.
  • This lets them directly alter matter, cause nuclear fission, and create large-scale radiation.
  • Star Grazing: They are able to Graze asteroids and exert minor influence over Planets.
  • They can derive power from the laws governing the motion of Stars and Star clusters in order to induce localized Fusion with prior preparation of materials.
  • A Star Shepherd is able to influence and utilize Celestial Bodies and Stars that have a mystical nature, such as the Red Priest Pathway's War Comets.
  • They are able to guide the War Comets of the Red Priest Pathway to appear prematurely as a way of bringing Disaster.
  • A Star Shepherd can also assist Beyonders of related Pathways in digesting their potions.
  • An Astrologer can digest their potion by observing the Grazed asteroid of a Star Shepherd.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can listen to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Radiant Angel

Authorities

  • Fusion: The brilliance of stars comes from Fusion: which is subordinate to the Fundamental Forces authority.
  • At this level, Fusion is induced through Magnetic Confinement.
  • Despite having the Fusion authority, "They" cannot yet create small Stars.
  • Due to this authority, "They" naturally radiate brilliance akin to Stars.
  • "They" can effortlessly wipe out an entire city through their radiance.

Strengthened Abilities

  • "They" have gained advancement to "Their" powers as a Star Shepherd.
  • Star Grazing: "They" are better able to utilize the Stars "They" have Grazed.
  • "They" are able to enhance or deceive the Divination results of any Astrologer and Star Worshipper who observe "Their" Grazed stars.
  • Compared to a Star Shepherd, at this level "They" will have a significant impact on a planet to a certain extent if "They" don't restrain "Themselves".

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab); "Their" Mythical Creature Form (opens in a new tab) is a being composed of multiple magnetically confined small Fusion clusters, which can take the form of a giant, a dragon, radiant beings of Starlight with six pairs of wings, or even an indescribable shape. "Their" core is a large number of Fusion clusters.

Sequence 1: Star Dragon

Authorities

  • Gravity: "They" gain a degree of control over Space-Time derived from Gravity.
  • Where Space is Time, Time is Space, Heaviness causes Slowness, and Starlight brings Disorder.
  • "They" can cause planetary-scale asteroid impacts capable of wiping out most life.
  • By influencing Space, a Star Dragon is able to indirectly impact Time.
  • "They" have a certain degree of control over mystical Astrology.
  • "They" can alter planetary orbits.
  • Fusion: "They" are now able to achieve Fusion through Inertial Confinement.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Cosmic Void: "They" can create the highest form of Cosmic Void.
  • The highest form of Cosmic Void is a near-absolute zero Cosmic (opens in a new tab) environment filled with various types of radiation for combat.
  • Electromagnetism:⁂ "They" can create Electromagnetic storms.

Sequence 0: Condenser

Description

A Stellar-level being, capable of shaping the Galactic order.

Authorities

  • Weight & Density: "They" can temporarily achieve the Density of a white dwarf or even a neutron Star. Through self-sacrifice, "They" can become a Black Hole.
  • The Condenser is able to, to a certain extent, impose the Weight & Density authority on non-material concepts such as the River of Fate (opens in a new tab).
  • Fundamental Forces: "They" hold authority over Fundamental Forces.
  • Fusion: "They" can directly rely on the authority of Fundamental Forces to achieve Fusion, with no need for Inertial or Magnetic Confinement.
  • Quantum Mechanics: "They" have a partial authority over Quantum Mechanics.

Everlasting Pathway

Sequence 9: Initiator

New Abilities

  • Initiation: An Initiator is at the first step to "ascend" and become Immortal. They can begin to master various Spells, such as the Midoro's Worship Spell.
  • Midoro's Worship: A novice Spell that is conducted by a Secret Deed Ritual.
