The performer's Astral Projection would ascend to various heavenly domains and witness extraordinary phenomena while also traversing the Formless Door and closely aligning with the Inextinguishable Ravings (opens in a new tab).
  • This allows them to touch the fringes of Immortality and gain knowledge and corresponding abilities, enabling them to undergo a fundamental transformation behind the Formless Door.
  • Different people who undergo this Secret Deed Ritual will experience different things, and thus the subsequent abilities they obtain are different.
  • Even ordinary people would be able to learn this after receiving proper guidance.

Sequence 8: Commentator

New Abilities

  • Commentary:⁂ They can intuitively sense the mental fluctuations and Conscious inclinations of others allowing them to make the most appropriate choices and actions.
  • The one who truly knows you is not yourself: but the Spectator and the Commentator.

Sequence 7: Orator

New Abilities

  • Oratory:⁂ They can express their personal Consciousness and spiritual fluctuations through refined Oratory with all who hear their speech being profoundly influenced.
  • The magnetic voice of Loki's (opens in a new tab) Singer Marionette repeatedly interrupted both Franca Roland's (opens in a new tab) and Lumian Lee's (opens in a new tab) actions by piercing their minds and Spirit Bodies.

Sequence 6: Singer

New Abilities

  • Singing:⁂ A Singer can now channel special effects gained through ascension into reality through the act of Singing, with different melodies producing different effects.
  • Their Singing is closely linked to the insights they have gained as an Initiator.
  • Loki's (opens in a new tab) Singer Marionette sang an aria that created a blinding Sun rise in the minds of Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab), Franca Roland (opens in a new tab), and other passersby, rendering their thoughts sluggish.

Sequence 5: Secret Transmitter

New Abilities

  • Knowledge Transmitting:⁂ They can directly impart the Knowledge gained from ascension to others, including the dangerous and benign secrets they have learned. This is not only an efficient method of information Transmission, it is also an unguarded spiritual communication.
  • They become more powerful with learning more dangerous and terrifying Knowledge with the information they gain from ascension capable of manifesting in reality. Each word from their voice can transform into a living, peculiar entity within the hearts of their targets.
  • I Know Someone's (opens in a new tab) patient substitute imparted the secrets of Midoro's Worship to Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab), encouraging him to pass through the Formless Door with a voice that resonated within the latter's heart and ears, seemingly emanating from the depths of the void and the source of his consciousness.

Sequence 4: Philosopher

New Abilities

  • Philosophy:⁂ Philosophers delve into the origin of Philosophy, however, they dwell in agony and confusion, forever treading the thin line between Wisdom and madness.
  • Using the characteristic of ravings, they can pull targets into their Philosophical world.
  • This will cause the targets to engage in the corresponding Philosophical reflections, usually unable to break free from such contemplation in a short amount of time.
  • If the target is deeply immersed in or resonates with the ideas proposed within this Philosophy, they will be unable to extricate themselves.
  • This will either lead to being like still statues, descending into madness, or losing control.
  • They can draw power from different Philosophies to create a variety of Spells.
  • Examples of the following Spells a Philosopher is able to make are:
  • Subjective Idealism: If they/others believe they exist then they exist and the reverse is true, allowing them to make projections of themselves without being at that location.
  • Materialism: This can generate a field that weakens or nullifies supernatural phenomena: comparable to the Weaken Mysticism, Enhance Reality of the Justicar Pathway.
  • Their current state could prevent them from using some Philosophies.
  • For example, starting from Sequence 2, the Materialism Spell will be counterproductive, unsustainable, and self-repelling due to "Their" lack of a physical form and purely supernatural nature, causing "Them" to get expelled out of the area if used.
  • An example of this power being used is below:
  • The questions from I Know Someone's (opens in a new tab) patient substitute made Lumian's (opens in a new tab) head throb in agony, feeling the sensation of a steel drill boring into his skull, stirring his delicate brain.
  • The questions from I Know Someone's (opens in a new tab) patient substitute triggered bizarre alterations in Lumian's (opens in a new tab) Spirituality and surroundings. Madness surged forth, as if probing the boundaries of sanity.
  • The Darkness seemed to take on a human nature while the bed and floor near Lumian (opens in a new tab) gradually etched bizarre patterns, with his body being consumed by an intense itch, as if yearning for him to shed the outermost layer of his skin. Within the writhing Darkness, an indescribable form began to take shape as he was powerless to resist or halt the transformation.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Messenger of God

New Abilities

  • Divine Envoy:⁂ A Messenger of God serves as a Divine Envoy of True Gods (opens in a new tab) or Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) while maintaining control over the influx of profound secrets.
  • If they are a Divine Envoy to Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab), they will have entrusted their Fate to that connection, meaning their survival or destruction hinges on "Their" capricious whims.
  • The Corruption that a Messenger of God possesses grants them power through the profound secrets of either True Gods (opens in a new tab) and the Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab).
  • They can turn into a "letter" to pursue the target. Such a letter will have properties related to the symbols and powers of the God (opens in a new tab) or Great Old One (opens in a new tab) that is sending the letter.
  • For example, a letter from the Circle of Inevitability (opens in a new tab) will have certain properties related to Inevitability, causing all branches of the River of Fate (opens in a new tab) to lead to the same Destiny: the target receiving the letter.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Initiation:⁂ They have undergone a qualitative leap as an Initiator.
  • A Messenger of God will receive revelations like the secret knowledge regarding Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) during Initiation. This includes the Voices, thoughts, or utterances of the Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab).
  • They gain the ability to maintain sanity when receiving/holding such hidden knowledge.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Great Old One Attendant

Authorities

  • Consciousness & Spirit: "They" gain initial authority over Consciousness and Spirit.
  • "They" become pure mental and spiritual entities, aligning more closely with the Inextinguishable Ravings (opens in a new tab). "They" serve "Him" and embody a facet of "His" thoughts.
  • As a pure mental and spiritual entity, "They" can temporarily take over the physical form of other creatures or possess lifeless objects.
  • "They" are also capable of channeling one aspect of the Consciousness and Spirits of other Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) without completely losing control.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" have become a full Mythical Creature. "Their" Mythical Creature Form is that of a pure Consciousness and spiritual entity.

Sequence 1: Voice of the Heart

Authorities

  • Ravings: The Voice of the Mind is an unstoppable Raving.
  • So long as one can "think", they will not be able to escape from "Their" influence within the same planet.

Sequence 0: Everlasting

Authorities

  • Consciousness & Spirit: "They" hold mastery over the authorities of Consciousness and Spirit, eternally co-existing and intertwined with these two concepts, thus becoming Everlasting.
  • The Everlasting could die, but "Their" Spirit remains, allowing "Them" to slowly Revive.
  • Culture & Ideology: "They" have some authority over Culture and Ideology.
  • "They" can affect a person's world view, outlook on life, values of worth, emotions, and behavior.
  • Ravings: "Their" authority embody Ravings itself, not just the effect.

Second Law Pathway

Sequence 9: Patient (Rotting Patient)

Traits

  • Disease Constitution: Upon advancing, Patients will find themselves gaining traits beneficial to transmitting Pathogens and Diseases across a small area.
  • Their bodily fluids possess the ability to carry Pathogens that spread through direct contact.
  • They can also actively create ulcerous wounds on themselves to release those Pathogens, infecting enemies in a small area around them without need for direct contact.
  • A Patient's physical attributes and resistance against Diseases are greatly enhanced.
  • This essentially allows a Patient to carry their Pathogens inside them without being negatively affected by any possible side effects that might occur by doing so.

Sequence 8: Secretary (Bureaucratic Representative)

New Abilities

  • Bureaucratic Proficiency:⁂ They are proficient in a number of skills involving Bureaucracy.
  • A Secretary is skilled at handling documents, can exploit loopholes in fixed procedures, and possesses strong insight into the minds of their superiors.
  • However, in the third case they will gradually lose empathy, developing disdain for those with reasonable demands that inconvenience them.
  • A Secretary is very powerful when representing an organization, but once separated from it, they do not possess any strong abilities.
  • Eloquence:⁂ Upon advancement, a Secretary gains excellent Eloquence.

Sequence 7: Vermin (Corruptor)

Traits

  • They have limited lethality against individuals, relying mainly on their enhanced Patient abilities.

New Abilities

  • Corruption: They are able to draw strength and nourishment from organization as well as emanate a Corruption Aura that subtly breeds Desire to those nearby, making them part of their Corrupt faction.
  • They are extremely dangerous to organizations, creating countless Parasitic Counterparts that hollow out the organization from within.
  • The organization may appear intact on the surface, but its operations are thoroughly Decayed, ready to collapse at the slightest push.
  • Corrupting an organization until it collapses is the finest tribute a Vermin can offer to the Monarch of Decay (opens in a new tab).
  • A Vermin can also actively use Corruption to make specific targets abandon their principles and embrace self-interest.

Sequence 6: Disease Envoy

New Abilities

  • Disease: Similar to that of a Demoness of Affliction, a Disease Envoy is able to spread Pathogens and Diseases onto targets within a certain range.
  • Compared to the  ![Demoness Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Demoness_Pathway) Demoness Pathway, which uses pathogens to control diseases, the  ![Second Law Symbol2 (opens in a new tab)](https://lordofthemysteries.fandom.com/wiki/Second_Law_Pathway) Second Law Pathway represents the very essence of Disease. As a result, a Disease Envoy can spread various Diseases that stem from one's self, including:
  • A Disease that can cause someone to become Obese.
  • A Disease that can make someone Degenerate.
  • A Disease that can make someone Lazy.
  • Like a Demoness of Affliction, they can discreetly spread their Diseases.
  • They can also use the Patient's method of releasing Pathogens as well.
  • A Disease Envoy's Pathogens contain Spirituality.
  • Thus it can be vulnerable to certain Beyonder powers such as a Witch's Black Flames.

Sequence 5: Child of Decay

New Abilities

  • Pathogens: As the embodiment of Pathogens, the Child of Decay is not easily killed completely, as Pathogens are very good at self-division and replication.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Disease: They gain the ability to make others Rot.
  • In addition, compared with a Demoness of Affliction's infectious Diseases, they can spread more numerous Diseases to a higher degree and variety than that of a Disease Envoy.

Sequence 4: Doomed One

New Abilities

  • Decay: They can spread Decay within a 3 kilometer radius, causing rapid decline in their surroundings.
  • This can cause opposing Beyonder powers to deteriorate, and can be used in conjunction with Disease to counteract an enemy's active resistance to some extent.
  • Franca (opens in a new tab) and Jenna (opens in a new tab)'s used Black Flames to burn the Disease surrounding them but the accompanying Decaying power quickly dimmed and eventually extinguished the Flames.
  • Using Decay, Higdon (opens in a new tab) extinguished the blue-white Flames created by Lumian Lee's (opens in a new tab) use of the Sword of Courage (opens in a new tab) that ignited his body.
  • Jenna’s (opens in a new tab) spider threads Decayed by Higdon’s (opens in a new tab) mere approach, causing them to wither and loose their effectiveness.
  • Purifying forces can effectively resist this type of erosion.
  • Pride Armor (opens in a new tab) resisted the corrosion that came with Higdon's (opens in a new tab) Decaying power.
  • Objects without Spirituality will also Decay.
  • A cabin made of wood will collapse, rocks and metals will weather and rust.
  • Certain Death: They can fire a greenish-black light beam at the target that causes Certain Death.
  • If it hits the true body, Death is Certain. Even a Saint-level Beyonder would be critically injured and gradually Die. Even against Higher-Sequence enemies, the effect is potent.
  • Those below Demigod level would Die instantly unless they had a Substitute.
  • Sure Hit: They can fire a dark yellow beam of light that will Surely Hit the target, this can also be used to augment their physical attacks, for example, enabling their arm to lash out like a whip.
  • Unless the target replaced their true body with a Substitute before the attack, or placed the attacker under an Illusion and causing them to miss their aim, they will be hit for certain.
  • If the attack was aimed at the true body at the moment of launch, it will hit the true body, rendering Substitutes ineffective. Without special abilities to evade, they will be hit.
  • The effects of Certain Death and Sure Hit cannot be stacked.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Pathogens: A Doomed One can cover their entire body with greenish-yellow pus to enter the embodiment of Pathogen state.
  • Their body can deform, split, and dissolve into countless Pathogens then reassemble: making them immune to conventional physical damage, able to evade attacks, and relocate freely.
  • They are able to create Avatars or regenerate missing limbs into complete duplicates, with each Avatar possessing the same level as the original body, not weaker.
  • While there is an upper limit to the number of Avatars, destroying one alone will not affect the others and it is only through Curses or other similar abilities can they be killed simultaneously.
  • Even if one Avatar is struck with Certain Death, the others will be unaffected.
  • They can be used with Certain Death and Sure Hit: suddenly disintegrating into bursts of light for area attacks, achieving different effects, or serving as an escape method.
  • One such effect is to use Certain Death as an area attack, striking all targets within a certain range indiscriminately.
  • A Doomed One's strength is slightly weaker than that of the average Sequence 4, but with multiple Clones working together, they can achieve the terror of a true Demigod.
  • Disease: They can spread Diseases within a 3 kilometer radius.
  • Jenna (opens in a new tab) felt a wave of lethargy, as if stricken by a Sickness called "laziness." It felt as if her desires were wilting, showing signs of Decay, and as if parts of her brain were beginning to malfunction.
  • During this process, as Franca (opens in a new tab) and Jenna (opens in a new tab)'s Mirror Substitutes were still forming, their internal organs sprouted noticeable tumors, autonomously drawing nutrients. Blood vessels around the heart and within the brain rapidly became fragile.
  • lf they hadn't actively triggered their Mirror Substitution, it would have been much more difficult to deal with the actual tissue changes in their bodies. They would need to perform a ritual, praying to the Primordial Demoness (opens in a new tab) or a corresponding Angel (opens in a new tab) to transfer the disease to a designated mirror, or one would need to stick to the target while the other left the area, allowing Lugano (opens in a new tab) to perform surgery combined with the Doctor's abilities for treatment.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Left Hand of Decay

Downside

  • Their Left Hand of Decay is suspected to be a downgraded blessing from an original Angel (opens in a new tab)-level power, which may explain why Saints of this Pathway suffer weakened abilities elsewhere as a cost.
  • As a result, their other aspects become quite ordinary, even inferior to Sequence 4 Demigods of the same Pathway, in addition their thinking and reactions will Decay to some extent.
  • However, the extent to this level of Decay is unclear. Despite being a Left Hand of Decay, Mocoxidos (opens in a new tab) was able to instantly realize the true intentions of the Demoness (opens in a new tab) that Dalberro (opens in a new tab) spoke to.

Authorities

  • Proxy: Similar to the Hand of God, they hold a portion of the Proxy authority. Their Left Hand surpasses Sequence 3, reaching the power level of an Angel (opens in a new tab), and even higher in terms of status.
  • Those who see their Left Hand will have their field of vision be completely occupied by it, as if they were beholding the hand of a True Deity. Their body would instantly stiffen, unable to move or evade, while all their Beyonder powers become unusable and their thoughts rapidly Decay. Eventually, their whole body rots to death in a short period of time.
  • Even viewing it through a clone or projection will severely injure the true body, immobilizing and dooming all clones and projections unless the connection is severed beforehand.
  • Most Sequence 3 Saints of other Pathways will perish instantly upon facing this attack directly, without any means of resistance.
  • Even a Demoness of Unaging would die along with their normal Mirror Person upon viewing this hand. They can only revive through their concealed Mirror Person. This would take dozens of minutes or even hours, making further participation in a particular battle impossible.
  • It can cause the rapid Weathering and Decay in the surrounding environment, as well as make Beyonder powers Wither and Decay, making it useful for blocking attacks.
  • Their Left Hand can be used to launch objects (like dirt or gravel), capable of launching them with the force of steam-powered rifle bullets.
  • The palm of their Left Hand will be entirely blue and swollen to the point of being translucent, with yellow-green pus flowing inside.
  • Every capillary will also be extremely clear, and these capillaries and the lines on the palm together will form one complex symbol and pattern after another.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Certain Death: If they hit their target, unless the target had previously used a Substitution ability, their original body would inevitably Decay and move towards Death.
  • Disease: A Left Hand of Decay can doom a Disease Envoy to certain death, with symptoms appearing instantly and with no clear indicators.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Time Giant

Authorities

  • Time: "They" begin to touch the authority of Time.
  • "They" can disrupt, speed up, and slow down Time to a certain extent, but "They" are unable to stop Time.
  • "They" can also segment Time, segmenting the beginning, process, and outcome of an event to create Disorder and exert certain degrees of interference and influence.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form is complete. "They" seem to be composed of water-colored time, "Their" massive forms slowing everything around "Them".

Sequence 1: God of Decay

Authorities

  • Decay & Time: The fusion of the authorities of Decay and Time. All beings are bound to Age and Decay, and Time accelerates this process; Aging is the most terrifying Pathogen.
  • As dying of old Age is something that the majority of Resurrection abilities cannot take effect against, one should never engage in a prolonged battle with a God of Decay.
  • A Beauty Goddess will be affected by this authority, but "They" will remain Beautiful.
  • A Miracle Invoker's Resurrection is an example of one that can reset Age.
  • When "They" master the authority of Aging, "They" have the capability to match the Twilight Giant's authority of Twilight in the aspect of Aging.
  • This depends on how much authority the Sequence 0 has delegated or allowed.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" were hunched, ancient to the point of decrepitude, with loose, wrinkled skin blotched with Decay. Aside from "Their" mountainous size, "They" appeared unremarkable.

Sequence 0: Second Law (Second Law of Thermodynamics, Ragnarök)

Description

The Second Law is the conceptual representation of the Second Law of Thermodynamics (opens in a new tab) and Ragnarök (opens in a new tab) - the "Twilight of the Gods".

Authorities

  • Second Law (Time, Disease, Decay): All things eventually Rot. The Entropy of the entire universe can only increase: irreversibly. That day, which is bound to come, is also the endpoint of the River of Time.
  • Perhaps the universe too will be afflicted with Diseases, and will ultimately Putrefy and die.
  • Virus Incarnation: "They" are the embodiment of Virus.

Sublunary Eye Pathway

Sequence 9: Shaman

Traits

  • Spirit Body Connection:⁂ Their Spirit Body can sense and initially connect with other worlds or higher Dimensions, but it will cause their Soul to be noticed by monsters and become a target for invasions.
  • Their Territory is a special space equivalent to their Spirit Body merging with the Spirit World. If such creatures invade reality through this space, it is equivalent to invading their Soul.
  • Once the invasion succeeds, their Soul and Spirit Body will be controlled by the invading monster, or in extreme situations, even replaced.

New Abilities

  • Territory Creation:⁂ Shamans are able to borrow power from the surrounding area's Spirituality to create Totems that performs various different kinds of mage crafts.
  • To create such a Territory, they must find a fixed area, set up a Totem and perform a fixed ritual. After those steps, they can communicate with the surrounding area's air, earth, water, trees, and creatures to borrow power from their Spirituality to cast various Spells.
  • A Shaman is able to change their Territory, but the process is complicated and takes around three days. In addition, after leaving their Territory, a Shaman's power will rapidly weaken. The further away they travel, the weaker their abilities become.
  • If a Shaman were to stay active and commit to daily activities inside their Territory at night, it would not affect their body's normal functions much at all, allowing a Shaman to only need to nap during the day to function.

Sequence 8: Reporter

Description

Reporters sometimes feel changes in personalities and begin to hate the world and dislike things that do not match or satisfy their Imagination. They want to reform the world itself to suit their Fantasy.

Traits

  • True Sight:⁂The core abilities are to touch Truth, perceive Truth, and articulate Truth. Namely, to observe, investigate, and uncover the true nature of the world. As such, their observation and investigation skills have been drastically enhanced, allowing them to analyse and observe reality in further detail, Seeing things that ordinary people can't see.
  • By actively activating this ability, they are able to observe the true nature of the world, and it is subject to a time limit. In this state, a Reporter can see through same-level Mirror Substitution, Mirror Maze, Illusions and Spirit Body Threads (these can only be perceived and cannot be affected).
  • They can also See a multitude of scenes from various angles, things that normally would be out of their Sight, or visible only from one angle, but it can't be maintained for too long.
  • Physical Enhancement: They possesses extreme speed, including both movement speed and the speed of actions (such as hand speed).

Strengthened Abilities

  • Territory Creation:⁂ Even if their territory's shield is broken, they will no longer be affected.

Sequence 7: Painter

Traits

  • True Sight:⁂ Painters can witness another Reality, unveiling a Painting's truest form.
  • This would also have the effect of allowing them to perceive the creator's most profound creative intentions regarding the Painting they have made.
  • Spiritual Intuition: A Painter possesses a strong Spiritual Intuition.
  • From this Sequence onward, mental instability gradually emerges, akin to historical Painters who suffered psychological abnormalities due to contaminated pigments.

New Abilities

  • Painting Creation:⁂ They gain the ability to create art and become natural Painters. By using their Spirituality, they can depict the reality they intend, granting their Paintings with various Beyonder and mystical effects.
  • In some parallel aspect of the world, each Painting held a semblance of reality. However, they remained two-Dimensional, flat, and lacking in depth, incapable of significantly impacting the human realm or the Spirit World. They can amplify the limited, flat nature of these objects, opening a pathway to the realm of the real.
  • Their Paintings can also manifest some aspect of it into Reality to a limited extent.
  • As a partial manifestation of a Reality a Painting can be Devoured by a Depriver.
  • At times, having once perceived and touched Truth, a Painter's works may carry a degree of Prophetic nature.
  • If an element manifested from it is destroyed it cannot come back and would disappear.
  • A target must stare at a Painting for at least three seconds for its effects to trigger.
  • Their Paintings are a type of Beyonder Weapon (opens in a new tab) and will lose its power over time.
  • It will last about two months when folded and three days when unfolded, at most.
  • Examples of some of the Paintings a Painter can create are:
  • A depiction of the attack of the boat German Sparrow (opens in a new tab) and Cattleya (opens in a new tab) took in the Battlefield of the Gods (opens in a new tab). Through the Mother Pathway's power, it can manifest part of the Giant into Reality.
  • A riot of vivid colours, weaving a surreal and mesmerising scene, inducing confusion and vertigo to varying degrees. Prolonged exposure to it could even result in mental illness.
  • A triangular house with a greyish-blue hue, green trees and rain resembling mud. This Painting causes itching all over the body and an irresistible urge to scratch oneself.
  • A golden-red sun surrounded by a vibrant circle of colours. This Painting can warm the surroundings near it while also providing a simple Exorcism effect.
  • A boat in a storm, which can be used to create illusory waves of water to extinguish flames.
  • A self portrait that allow the Painter to spy from it and be able to manipulate their image.
  • A simple drawn door on a window that can allow access to the Mirror World.
  • They can Paint a mark onto certain creatures and could use the connection between themselves and a Painting to drive the corresponding mark, thereby directing the creature, provided they maintain a certain distance.
  • Painting Hiding⁂: They can Hide in some of their Paintings, often taking the form of a human figure.
  • Painting Disguise⁂: They can also use cosmetics on a face to achieve an excellent Disguise.
  • This can also be done on someone else.

Sequence 6: Literature Enthusiast

New Abilities

  • Fantasy Manifestation:⁂ A Literature Enthusiast loves to and are skilled in Imagination, and, can, to a certain extent, bring those imaginings into reality.
  • These Manifestations lack the full potency of their original counterparts. They possess only a rudimentary semblance of their appearance, personalities, and abilities.
  • The Pixie wearing a blue beret Manifested Aurore Lee (opens in a new tab) in an attempt to dissuade Lumian Lee (opens in a new tab) from attacking.
  • Using this Beyonder power causes their eyes to act as a boundary between fiction and reality, through which fictional figures can enter the real world.
  • This Pathway bears some resemblance to the Visionary Pathway, but it is fundamentally distinct. One derives its power primarily from the mind, while the other seems to harness the qualities and might of alternate dimensions or alternate spaces to manifest entities.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Painting Creation:⁂ The Reality of their Paintings can now be fully manifested into Reality.
  • The Painting in this case will be one with the fully manifested creation. As such, the destruction of the manifested creation would result in the destruction of the full Painting.

Sequence 5: Pixie

New Abilities

  • Dimension Shifting:⁂ By stabilising one Dimension, a Pixie can enter a peculiar state, existing somewhere between the Spirit World and Reality (opens in a new tab).
  • They become untouchable and invisible, difficult to detect even with Spirit Vision (opens in a new tab).
  • Unless they actively enter Reality, some Saints might not even be able to attack them.
  • They must exit this special state to interact with the area or attack someone.
  • They are able to freely enter and exit the stabilised Dimension.
  • Flight: They possess a pair of translucent dragonfly-like wings, which helps them Fly in the air.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Painting Creation:⁂ Pixies gain an enhancement in their Painting Creation power.
  • Painting World: A Pixie can create an incomplete world within a Painting, which is surrounded by a deep, dark void with a formless barrier. One can access the world by touching the Painting.
  • This world isn't considered advanced and has many false mechanical aspects to it.
  • Only a Painting World created by a Dimensional Shadow would be a complete world.
  • There is a fake Spirit World within it but it is not connected to the actual Spirit World.
  • In other words, one could only Teleport within the Painting World but could not leave it.
  • They can Paint direct attacks against their enemies with their clothes serving as a canvas.
  • The Pixie with red pants used his clothes as a canvas to depict Lightning Bolts, forcing Jenna (opens in a new tab) to use a Mirror Substitution Spell to evade the attack.
  • Fantasy Materialisation:⁂ They can create ethereal flying servants: blurry figures emitting a faint glow: which can be used to guard the Painting World.

Sequence 4: Visitor (Dimensional Traveler)

New Abilities

  • Dimensional Visitor:⁂ They have become beings of another Dimension and have gained deeper mastery over Dimensions, capable of travelling to other Dimensions and points in Space-Time.
  • Thus, they can exhibit various abilities, some wondrous and others terrifying.
  • Hostel: They can use their body to house different entities in a separate Dimension, bringing them along with them and allowing them to summon these Visitors at any moment.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: String Player (Performer, Instrumentalist)

New Abilities

  • String Playing: They begin to be able to control Strings, and by Playing those Strings, a String Player will be able to influence and alter Reality.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Painting Creation:⁂ Through the sacrifice of many lives, including Lower Sequence Boon Recipients of the Sublunary Eye Pathway and themselves, they can create an outstanding Painting capable of letting 2 Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) bypass the Astral Barrier (opens in a new tab) to some extent to transmit "Their" power.
  • Endless Cosmos (opens in a new tab) is one such example, which allowed the powers of he Inextinguishable Ravings (opens in a new tab) and Circle of Inevitability (opens in a new tab) to enter reality and bypass the Astral Barrier (opens in a new tab).

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, they can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Dimensional Shadow

Authorities

  • Dimensions: "They" have become a complete higher Dimensional creature, capable of freely ascending and descending across Dimensions while also utilizing Dimensions at will.
  • "They" are able to ascend to up to 11 higher Spatial Dimensions.
  • Even if "Their" connection to the Spirit World is severed, "They" will still be able to ascend Dimensions.

Strengthened Abilities

  • Painting Creation:⁂ It is at this level where "They" are able to create a complete world within a Painting, one with complete rules that can allow living beings to live inside it.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature (opens in a new tab). "Their" Mythical Creature Form is that of a Dimensional Shadow, a shadowy figure traversing different Dimensions.

Sequence 1: Observer

Authorities

  • Truth: An Observer's way of Observation will directly and critically affect the subsequent development and final outcome of the Observed target.
  • The manifestation of this authority is similar to the Lord of Mysteries' (opens in a new tab) ability to turn falsehoods in truths; however, the realisation mechanism behind the effect is different.
  • Fantasy: "They" are able to create a fabricated self born of Fantasy that can be used to deceive their enemies of the real location of "Their" true body.
  • However, there will still be a connection between the fabricated self and the true body of the Observer, which can be exploited by certain Beyonder powers.
  • Dimensions: "They" can use higher Dimensions as setups for Revival and recovery.
  • The type of Revival arrangement done using higher Dimensions is harder to disrupt but it consumes additional time and requires more complex and secretive processes.
  • An Observer possesses access to other Revival arrangements that are faster, at the cost of those arrangements being easier to disrupt.

Mythical Creature Form

  • At this level, "Their" Mythical Creature Form of a Dimensional Shadow would possess faint, unattainably high humanoid shapes.

Sequence 0: Sublunary Eye

Literal Translation: Eye of the Mortal Realm

Authorities

  • Truth: "They" see everything in the world, and "They" perceive the changes of Fate. When "They" see, the flowers bloom brilliantly; when "They" do not, the flowers and the heart fall silent together.
  • The "Falling silent" part of the passage "the flowers and the heart fall silent together" means Extinction, Disappearance, and Non-Existence.
  • Through "Their" Observation and Imagination, "They" can make real objects disappear and turn Fantasy into reality.
  • Dimensions: "They" can freely alter or influence anything in lower Dimensions through the projection of those objects within higher-Dimensional space.
  • This functions like how beings who exist in three Dimensions can effortlessly modify or erase parts of a two-Dimensional Painting.

Eternal Edict Pathway

Sequence 9: Dreamless

Traits

  • Dreamless State: Upon advancement, a Dreamless will lose the ability to Dream and can no longer receive revelations through Dreams.
  • Only those with the authority over Dreams can break through this state to a limited extent.
  • They still can be lulled to sleep by abilities similar to ones of a Midnight Poet.
  • This is because being Dreamless does not mean being Sleepless.
  • Fate Sensation: They begin to Sense the flow and changes of Fate.

Sequence 8: Musician

Description

Many Musicians blind themselves to focus on listening and playing the voices of Fate.

New Abilities

  • Fate Symphony:⁂ They can hear the voices of Fate, and through extensive preparations and sufficient time, they can repeat those voices, influencing target's Fate and causing a certain degree of change.
  • This mainly manifests in magnifying certain Fates. This Symphony resonating from the depths of the River of Fate (opens in a new tab) seem to also inflict a weakness on the target mind.
  • There’s a chance that excessive desires could cause the target to explode on the spot.
  • Target who are less fortunate than others may find themselves extremely unlucky.
  • Individuals with illnesses or old injuries will inevitably face severe consequences.
  • Those with unstable minds may experience symptoms akin to madness.
  • Those with psychological issues might have latent problems triggered.

Sequence 7: Fate Pryer

Traits

  • Spirituality: They possess a strong Danger Premonition.

New Abilities

  • Fate Prying:⁂ They can directly perceive and hear the revelations of Fate without the need for a medium.
  • This manifests as "seeing" a myriad of intertwined Fates in the form of threads, allowing them to discern the threads' approximate origins.
  • This allows them to very quickly discern the goal and reason for the goal of a target.

Sequence 6: Mute

New Abilities

  • Words of Fate:⁂ The Fate Pryer who has seen Fate can convey it and directly impact a target.
  • This may manifest as affecting the target's mind, such as replaying traumatic memories from their past.
  • When General Philip (opens in a new tab) stated that Fate cannot be avoided and that Anthony Reid (opens in a new tab) will ultimately end up as his sacrifice, the latter's mind replayed harrowing scenes from his past, causing him to be stunned by fear.
  • Each usage comes with a significant drawback: a self-imposed silence lasting for an extended period so as to avoid backlash from Fate.

Sequence 5: Deceased

New Abilities

  • False Death: They can escape their original Fates through a False Death.
  • This will make them no longer bound to the previous limitations, allowing them to more normally exercise their abilities to pry into and influence Fate.
  • This False Death can deceive Divinations and Prophecies on the level of Fate, able to fool even the investigation of Saints (opens in a new tab).
  • A Deceased was able to mislead Madam Justice (opens in a new tab)'s investigation as his corpse, his Fate, and various mystical connections all seemed to point to him being truly dead.

Sequence 4: Fatebender

New Abilities

  • Fate Manipulation: They begin to directly control Fate rather than just influencing it.
  • They can change the Fate of others as well as themselves.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As Demigods at Sequence 4 who have obtained partial Godhood, they are able to manifest their incomplete Mythical Creature Form if they disregard any of the consequences.

Sequence 3: Fate's Attendant

New Abilities

  • Fate Weaving: They can achieve effects similar to an Author's arrangements by Weaving Fate.
  • At Higher Sequences, they will become better at arrangements than an Author.
  • Certain uses of this ability entails a backlash from Fate, causing self-mutilation up to death.
  • A price must be paid when:
  • Weaving a far-reaching Fate;
  • Manipulating the Fate of high-ranking targets; or
  • Attempting to Weave the Fates of many targets into a "web".
  • Such damage is difficult to recover from unless treated by the corresponding Pathways, such as those related to the Mother Goddess of Depravity (opens in a new tab).
  • Héloise (opens in a new tab), using a blessing from Fate, Woven that the "Project Vortex will be successfully completed", causing a large piece of skin on the right half of her face to be torn off by an invisible force, revealing the bloody, wriggling flesh beneath.
  • Certain mediums can help them Weave Fate normally unattainable at their current level.
  • Héloise (opens in a new tab) forcefully Wove a far-reaching Fate with the help of the Goddess (opens in a new tab)'s statue, though each Weave brought severe damage.
  • They can Weave Fate by using their own hair as threads on a loom, which will shimmer with a faint light, containing a wealth of information.
  • A destiny thread will include the corresponding information of a target, such as their location, state, and current actions; this can be plucked and given to others.

Mythical Creature Form

  • As a Sequence 3 Beyonder, "They" can respond to prayers within a certain range.

Sequence 2: Web Weaver (Eyeless One)

Authorities

  • Weaving Fate: "They" begin to touch the authority of Weaving Fate.
  • "They" will no longer suffer backlash when Weaving the Fates of numerous targets and making them intersect into a "web".
  • With certain mediums, "They" are able to Weave new Fates for "Their" targets or "Themselves", bringing along new possibilities, both good and bad.
  • A Web Weaver is able to Weave a certain Fate into the Past of a target in order to affect the Present, but the Past itself will stay the same.
  • For example, "They" could Weave an accident in the Past of a target, leaving them with scars and trauma in the Present, but the Past itself would have stayed the same.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "They" become a complete Mythical Creature. "Their" form is that of a three-bodied entity: the left body is eyeless: Weaving Fate; the central body is armless: Gathering Fate; and the right body is headless: Judging Fate. The armless and headless bodies are blurred and not fully formed.

Sequence 1: Blade of Fate

Authorities

  • Weaving Fate: "They" surpass an Author in terms of arrangements.
  • Judging Fate: "They" begin to control the authority of Judging Fate.
  • "They" are able to condense the Blade of Fate to sever Fate and its tributaries.

Mythical Creature Form

  • "Their" Mythical Creature Form has developed further, with "Their" headless body becoming clear.

Sequence 0: Eternal Edict

Literal Translation: Law of Eternal Life

Authorities

  • "They" Weave Fate, Gather Fate, Judge Fate, and achieve Eternal Life within Fate.
  • As long as the Fates of all things are interwoven and merged into the River of Fate (opens in a new tab), "They" will have Eternal Life. Even if "Their" body was to be destroyed, "Their" consciousness and spirit are able return from the River of Fate, allowing "Them" to regain "Their" body.
  • This method of regaining "Their" body does not rely on present Resurrection methods like most Great Old Ones (opens in a new tab) or "Their" immortal Spirit to Revive within Sefirot, Uniquenesses (opens in a new tab), or Beyonder Characteristics (opens in a new tab) after a long time.
  • There are only four known ways to kill "Them":
  1. The Lord of Mysteries (opens in a new tab) and Key of Light (opens in a new tab) joining forces can perform a Substitution at the level of Fate identity and status of the Goddess of Fate (opens in a new tab).
  2. Destroying all living beings which will disrupt the River of Fate (opens in a new tab), causing it to briefly fall into complete disorder.
  3. The birth of the Fourth Pillar (opens in a new tab), representing the Termination of all things.
  4. Encountering the Oldest One (opens in a new tab), who can make the impossible happen.
